releases.body:
<!-- Notes of the GitHub release made by .github/workflows/android-apk.yml. -->
Beta of the Android version of **Naruto: The Broken Bond PC Port v2.5**: the recompiled game with its native renderer on Vulkan, PC Options, a launcher and on-screen controls.

**Android port by [1nsec](https://github.com/1nsec).** The official page is [github.com/1nsec/Naruto-The-Broken-Bond-Android-Port](https://github.com/1nsec/Naruto-The-Broken-Bond-Android-Port): copies on other sites are re-uploads.

> **Beta:** the game plays at 30 FPS on a Snapdragon 865 handheld (Retroid Pocket 5), the open world included, but it has been tested on few devices. Expect the odd crash, graphics problem or stutter; logs from your phone help fix them (see below).

> **No game files are included.** You need your own Xbox 360 ISO of Naruto: The Broken Bond.

## New in the beta

releases.body:
<!-- Notes of the GitHub release made by .github/workflows/android-apk.yml. -->
Beta of the Android version of **Naruto: The Broken Bond PC Port v2.5**: the recompiled game with its native renderer on Vulkan, PC Options, a launcher and on-screen controls.

> **Beta:** the game plays at 30 FPS on a Snapdragon 865 handheld (Retroid Pocket 5), the open world included, but it has been tested on few devices. Expect the odd crash, graphics problem or stutter; logs from your phone help fix them (see below).

> **No game files are included.** You need your own Xbox 360 ISO of Naruto: The Broken Bond.

## New in the beta

- **DLC:** the launcher's **DLC** button adds the game's downloadable content from your own Xbox 360 (the package files of `Content/0000000000000000/55530825/00000002/`); the game installs them at its next start.
- **Your own GPU drivers:** Settings > GPU driver > **Add driver (.zip)** installs other Turnip builds (the adrenotools packages published for Android emulators), next to the Turnip the app carries. Snapdragon (Adreno) only.
- **Auto-rotate:** the game turns with the phone between the two landscape sides.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.8.0 Beta 1
releases.body:
AbyssME now brings 24 platforms together on ARM64. The new platform gallery lets you pick a device and browse its games. Turn on **Show platforms without games** to find a new system, install its firmware if needed, and add your first game.

Alongside Java ME, Mophun, Symbian and N-Gage, the ARM64 edition includes WIPI / SKVM, Dingoo A320, Gemei A330, Aquaplus P/ECE, Watara Supervision, Mega Duck, Cybiko, Flash Lite, Gamate, Palm OS, Palm webOS, Firefox OS, KaiOS, Atari Portfolio, early iPhone OS, Arduboy / FX, Gamebuino Classic, Pokitto, original Thumby and ESPboy. The ARMv7 edition includes Java ME and Mophun.

**Download** the standard APK for ARM64 or the APK marked **armv7** for a 32-bit ARM device. Both require Android 10 or later. Install over the previous official APK to keep your games and saves. Supply your own games and system files.

[Setup guide](https://abysstail.art/guides/abyssme-setup.html) · [Source and build instructions](https://github.com/EriArk/JavaEmulator/blob/v0.8.0-beta.1/docs/releases/v0.8.0-beta.1.md)

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Wine（x86_64 / X11）

- 形态: x86_64（unix x86_64 + PE i386/x86_64 WoW64，aarch64 设备经 box64 加载）

releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.2
releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksum of the APK

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

### Files

Close Anka, unzip **`Anka-1.0.1-win64.zip`** into your Anka folder and replace the files. Your `user` folder (settings, keys, firmware and saves) stays as it is.

New to Anka: follow the quick start in the [1.0.0 notes](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/releases/tag/anka-v1.0.0). Unzip into a new, empty folder, start `anka.exe`, and install your own keys and firmware.

## What's in 1.0.1

### .nup packages
- `.nup` ("Unencrypted (Archival) Package") is a container format from upstream Eglantine. It holds one title's base game, update and add-on content in a single file.
- Anka now **reads** .nup files. You can open them with **File › Load File…**, and they appear in the game list with their icon, name and version. `anka-cli.exe` and its launchers open them too, including from the `Games` folder.
- Mods (LayeredFS) and Anka's game-specific settings apply to games opened from a .nup, the same as for other formats. Anka finds the title ID before the game starts.

releases.name: Anka 1.0.0
releases.body:
First release of **Anka**, a Nintendo Switch 2 emulator for Windows, focused on performance.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `b7542ece8b5c695e2f01d5e46b74c0806d48ae96`; both programs carry this commit.

## Quick start

1. Unzip **`Anka-1.0.0-win64.zip`** into a **new, empty folder**. Do not unzip it into another emulator's folder: its Qt DLLs would replace that program's.
2. Start **`anka.exe`**. Anka keeps its settings, keys, firmware and saves in the `user` folder next to it (portable mode) and does not touch `%APPDATA%\eden` or other installs.
3. Install your own keys and firmware as with other Eden-based emulators. Anka includes no games, keys or firmware; only use what you legally own.
4. Settings: **Emulation › Configure… › Anka**. The first start picks *Recommended*, the setup we measured (with GPU Mode *Fast*, the default; it also turns Reactive Flushing off).

Coming from PokeDinner-Eglantine 2.0.0: back up its `nand` folder (your saves), then copy its `user` folder next to `anka.exe`.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with a current Vulkan driver. Qt and the Visual C++ runtime come with Anka.

## What's in 1.0.0

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

Know before you set up: the app and the launchers now check whether your device can run the game.

## New

- **A minimum spec, checked for you.** Below it, setting up takes 30 to 60 minutes and can end in a black screen, so the app and launchers now say so first. Below the minimum they stop by default and explain why, with a choice to try anyway. If a device only falls short of the recommended spec, you get a warning.
  - **Android:** the app checks when it opens and again before **SET UP** or **START**. Minimum: Vulkan 1.3, a CPU core at 2.4 GHz or faster, 6 GB of memory, and an Adreno 640 / Mali-G68 class GPU or newer. Older Mali GPUs (G31 to G76), Mali-T, PowerVR and Maleoon are below it. Recommended: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer with 8 GB.
  - **Send to my phone** checks the phone before it builds anything, and asks before sending to a phone below the minimum (`b3_win.py phone --anyway` on the command line).

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.16
releases.body:
A second fix for the GPU hang in heavy scenes on Android and Steam Deck.

## Fixed

- **A full upload buffer no longer hangs the GPU** ([#10](https://github.com/aoxzh/bayo3-recomp/issues/10)). v0.3.15 gave each frame the whole buffer, but a heavy enough frame could still fill it, and the game then overwrote data the GPU was still reading. Now the rest of such a frame goes into extra memory of its own, freed a few frames later, and nothing in use is overwritten. This works the way the Witch-Time project handles the same case. In a test with a deliberately tiny buffer, the old code hung within a minute; the new one kept playing with steady memory use. The log line is now `upload ring full (… MB in this submit): the rest of it goes to blocks of its own`, with a summary every 60 frames. `NX_RING_OVERFLOW=0` in `config.txt` brings back the old behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.15

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files in `Internal storage/Bayonetta 3` stay.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.15
releases.body:
A fix for a GPU hang on Android and Steam Deck in heavy scenes.

## Fixed

- **GPU hang after "upload buffer full"** ([#10](https://github.com/aoxzh/bayo3-recomp/issues/10)). On Android and on Linux with an integrated GPU (Steam Deck), a frame could only use half of the upload buffer: the previous frame's data stayed reserved longer than it was needed. In a scene with heavy uploads the buffer filled, the frame overwrote data the GPU was still reading, and the game stopped with `GPU hang (a submit did not finish in 2 s)`. That reserved part is now released as soon as it has been read, so the whole buffer is available. Windows with a discrete GPU was not affected.

## Coming from v0.3.14

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files in `Internal storage/Bayonetta 3` stay.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.14
releases.body:
Easier setup on every platform: a guided setup, a faster route to Android from a computer, and a one-click bug report.

## New

- **Send to my phone** (desktop launcher, or `b3_win.py phone`): a computer that has already set the game up builds the Android version itself, then copies it over USB. It installs the app, copies the game data and hands over the game. This takes a few minutes instead of 30 to 60 minutes of setup on the phone. You need USB debugging on. Some phones (vivo, Xiaomi) ask you to confirm the install on the screen, so keep the phone unlocked.
- **Setup guide** (desktop): the first setup is now a step-by-step window. It says how to extract your own copy with your emulator, finds extractions on the computer and checks each one: is it update 1.2.0, are ExeFS and RomFS both present, is the RomFS complete. Start setup is enabled only for a good one. The recomp does not decrypt anything: you extract the files from your own copy with your emulator.
- **Report a bug** (desktop and Android): makes the report zip and opens a new GitHub issue with the version, system and GPU filled in. Attach the zip and describe the problem.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.13
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **The title screen's models turned white after leaving stage select** (#6). The title's new lighting cube map has
  the same address, format and size as the stage-select one, so it shared that GPU image and was never read from
  game memory again: the title was lit with stage-select's lighting. A texture that takes over a shared image now
  reads it again. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_SHARE_REUPLOAD=0` in `config.txt` restores the old behaviour, for comparison.
- **Grass, bushes and leaves drawn as solid light-green blocks** (#7, e.g. at the start of Chapter 4). Foliage is
  drawn in two passes: a depth pass that discards the cards' transparent texels, then a colour pass that only draws
  where the depth is EQUAL. That EQUAL was run as LESS_OR_EQUAL (a workaround for a precision problem on Metal),
  so the colour pass also drew every transparent texel. EQUAL now stays EQUAL, as on the console, everywhere but
  Apple. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_EQUAL_AS_LEQUAL=1` restores the old behaviour. If you see new black edges or missing surfaces, please open an
  issue with a bug report.

## Coming from v0.3.12

emulators.latest_body:
It is my pleasure to announce a new version of Hades!

There's a ton of new and exciting features on this one, I'm happy it's finally landing in your hands 😁. 

Among others, this release provides:

## **Highlights**:
- **Cheat code support**:  with all three major cheat devices: GameShark, CodeBreaker and Pro Action Replay v3 (PARv3)
- **xBRZ scaling filter**, for sharp, smooth visuals at high resolutions
- **Idle loop elimination**, to boost the performances of some of your favorite games

## **Emulation**:
- **ROM Mirroring support**, which fixes a bunch of input issues in the Classic NES Series games
- **OBJ rendering cycle limits**: sprites now have a per-scanline rendering budget, like the real PPU
- **PSG channels 2 and 3** are now resampled correctly each time their frequency changes
- **New color correction profiles** based on the work of Pokefan531 and Hunterk

## **Performance**:
- The scheduler now uses a **min-heap** to find the next event faster, giving a significant performance boost
- **Link-time optimizations (LTO)** are now enabled by default for release builds
- Fixed a performance issue when a file dialog was open

## **Interface**:

I am proud to announce the first release of Hades, version 1.0.0!

This first release provides:

  - A complete emulation of the Game Boy Advance (with the exception of most external devices and add-ons)
  - Decent accuracy
  - Game controller support
  - Keys and buttons remapping

Than you for taking the time to check on Hades~

releases.name: ARMSX2 nightly 20261125 (d4fe08faeb)
releases.body:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64.AppImage, for 4K, 16K and 64K page kernels alike
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- COP2: a VU0 sync runs VU0 to the EE's clock, never past it

releases.name: ARMSX2 iOS 2.6.1
releases.body:
Everything below is compared with 2.6.0.

## New

**Report a Problem.** (@J1coding: #1032) Settings has a new Diagnostics page and the pause menu has a Report a Problem row. They bundle recent logs, settings, crash files, a photo and the paused frame into one report, with sensitive details redacted. After a crash, a freeze or a failed start, the next launch asks once whether you want to send one.

**Automatic Performance Tuning.** (@bmdhacks) A new switch in the emulator settings tries lower resolution, blending accuracy and other options on its own when a game runs slow. It keeps what helps and tells you on screen. It can also lower the emulated CPU clock when the device can't keep up. It is off by default.

**Rebuilt pad layout editor.** (@J1coding: #1065) The old editor is gone, and every entry point now opens the new one: Settings > Virtual Pad > Edit Layout, the pause menu, Per-Game Settings > Pad and the library's game menu. It works with a controller and VoiceOver. You can move, resize and fade pad pieces from 10 percent to full opacity, including the whole D-pad or face button cluster as one piece.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.4 beta
releases.body:
## Graphics and memory

**Faster frame submission.** MoltenVK now turns each frame into Metal work on its own thread instead of on the graphics thread, so the graphics thread spends almost no time submitting a frame. Framebuffers are now freed only after the GPU has finished with them, which this needed. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Freed textures give their memory back.** Large texture allocations now get memory of their own, which goes back to iOS when the texture is freed. Before, one texture still in use kept a whole 64 MB block, and One Piece held 2.3 GB of blocks for 643 MB of textures. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Upload buffer space comes back sooner.** The texture upload buffer gives back finished space after every full GPU wait, where it held it until the next frame and swapped in a new buffer instead.

**No stall on the first new shader.** The shader compiler's one-time setup now happens at boot. It used to land in gameplay, on the first shader a game hadn't shown before. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Black Ops II weapon.** The weapon in your hands no longer draws with its triangles over each other.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7.1
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7.1 ## Games - **Uncharted 2: Among Thieves, Super Street Fighter IV, Journey, and other games:** fixed the stop with "Failed to compile fragment shader" at the default Shader Precision (Low). - **Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction:** fixed the freeze on Cobalia (thanks Seeslo for testing). -**Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception** gets The Last of Us fix for freezes during play, since both games run the same job system, prevents freezes in UC3. ## Save states - **Save states from 1.7 and earlier don't load in 1.7.1,** because RPCS3's font module update changed the save state format. In-game saves are not affected.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.3 beta
releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

## Black Ops III

# WeHavePhones 0.0.14

This alpha update lets you install, update and remove WoW from the Play screen without opening Battle.net. It also adds a touch layout editor, controller help in Battle.net, and lower CPU use after you enter the world.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Install, update and remove games from Play.** Pick a game version on Play to **Install** it, or pick an installed one to **Play** or **Update**. **Verify** and **Uninstall** sit below **Open Battle.net**. They run through Battle.net's own installer without opening the Battle.net window, and a progress screen shows the download size, speed and time left. Uninstall keeps your add-ons.
- Play shows when the selected game has an update.
- **Account** on Play lists the WoW licenses Battle.net shows for the selected game, such as WoW1 and WoW2. Pick one and Play starts that license. Each game remembers its own choice.

They run through Battle.net's own installer without opening the Battle.net window, and a progress screen shows the download size, speed and time left. Uninstall keeps your add-ons.
- Play shows when the selected game has an update.
- **Account** on Play lists the WoW licenses Battle.net shows for the selected game, such as WoW1 and WoW2. Pick one and Play starts that license. Each game remembers its own choice.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

## Driver diagnostics and session sharing

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

releases.name: Azahar 2127.0
releases.body:
Azahar 2127.0 is arguably the single largest update we have ever published, and is a truly monumental release.

It includes countless improvements, fixes and new features, including long-awaited additions such as per-game setting support on Android, a fully rewritten interpreter for JIT-less environments which allows full-speed emulation on any modern iOS device, support for a new bundled ROM format which includes game content and updates in a single file, a fix for a long-standing death animation glitch in Shin Megami Tensei IV, and many, many other things.

We hope you'll take a quick read of the changelog to see what we've been working on.

---

> [!NOTE] 
> This release invalidates any existing generated shader cache.
> Because of this, performance may temporarily be impared after updating from 2126.2 or earlier.
> Performance will improve again after playing for a while.

---

- **Azahar's license has been changed** from GPLv2+ to **GPLv3+**. All downstream projects exposed to Azahar's source code must ensure that they follow the license terms and correctly update any license metadata as necessary. | @OpenSauce04 #2626 #2635

> [!NOTE]
Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

### Changelog
- Collected Jinjos will be now be permanently saved when collected, just like Notes. A new option has been added to choose only saving Jinjos or Notes if desired. The new default behavior will be to save both Notes and Jinjos as present in the Xbox 360 version of the game. Special thanks to @wedarobi for their work on this major feature!

> [!WARNING]

>
> **Note on Asset Updates:** Releases are only published for main app updates. When other assets (such as Mesa or KWin) are updated, no new release will be created; instead, the files will be updated directly under the current latest release.

## Highlights

- Fixed a possible black screen on first Wayland desktop launch by reattaching the Surface after a successful native host start.
- PRoot Hyprland is supported for the first time: `libaquamarine-compat.so` and a sample profile are provided, and dmabuf/EGL clients such as kitty work normally.

releases.name: Trierarch 0.5.0: A Complete Reset
releases.body:
0.5.0 is a reset of Trierarch, not a simple continuation of 0.4.x.

> [!WARNING]
> **Known Issue (proot users):** When Arch Linux rolls out a KDE update, KDE may stop working due to an outdated patched KWin version. **Please check that the KWin version in your Linux environment matches the version in this release before downloading.** If the release version is outdated, please wait or notify the developer to compile and provide an updated package, or compile it yourself using the provided patch if you are able to.
>
> **Note on Asset Updates:** Releases are only published for main app updates. When other assets (such as Mesa or KWin) are updated, no new release will be created; instead, the files will be updated directly under the current latest release.



This release drops the previous complex, verbose UI and moves control to CLI tools. In addition to the PRoot container, it adds two new runtimes, chroot and DroidSpaces, and provides Mesa drivers and hardware acceleration for both rooted and unrooted setups.

This is a major update. Read the tutorials to learn the new workflow before configuring anything:

releases.name: Trierarch 0.4.1
releases.body:
## Trierarch 0.4.1 (2026-04-16)

### Added
- **GPU acceleration (UNIVERSAL):** cross-chip GPU acceleration mode (host-side VirGL; guest OpenGL via **virpipe**; guest Vulkan via **Venus**). Existing **VIRGL** / **VENUS** preferences migrate to **UNIVERSAL**.

### Fixed
- **Keyboard:** fix soft keyboard mapping for `_` / `^` and improve Backspace handling for IMEs that use `deleteSurroundingText()`.

### Developer Note
I originally planned to work on a **higher-performance GPU acceleration path** and an **integrated Winlator**, but I ran into many **pitfalls** and **unclear bugs**. So I’m pushing this interim update to smooth out daily usage and keep things moving while I continue to tackle those bigger issues—just so you know **I haven't disappeared!** 👻

Full changelog in the repo: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Beauty114514/trierarch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: Trierarch 0.3.0
releases.body:
## Trierarch 0.3.0 (2026-04-04)

### Added
- **In-app terminal** (Termux-style) for the proot shell, with bundled monospace fonts, **Appearance**, and packaged font licenses.
- **Multi-session terminal:** per-session PTY and tabs from the orb (switch / add / remove); sessions use ids **1, 2, …**.
- **Display on session 0:** startup script runs on a dedicated shell so the desktop and terminal tabs no longer share one PTY.

### Changed
- **Terminal** screen respects **status bar** and **soft keyboard** insets.
- **Pointer:** separate scroll scaling for **physical wheel** vs **two-finger** gestures; **faster** touchpad cursor (finger × 2.5).
- **Glass/orb UI:** menus and settings sheets **size to the window**; orb grouped under **Common**, **Desktop**, **Terminal**.

### Fixed
- **Touchpad two-finger (Wayland):** avoid stray **left-button** / stuck behavior when the second finger cancels hold-drag timing, and keep **simulated touchpad** state correct after **two-finger tap → right click**.
- **View Settings (Wayland output):** **Scale** had no effect and **Resolution** vs **Scale** did not behave distinctly (only changing resolution drove UI size).

**New: open the panels with a controller button, close them with a tap ([#87](https://github.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/issues/87))**

For the panels over the game on one screen:

- **Settings → Controller → Open the panels with**: Off, Start, L3 or R3. That button opens and closes the panels, and the game doesn't get it. Select + Start still leaves the game. It works with or without the on-screen button, and it also hides and shows **Side by side**'s panels. Start pauses FF7's battles, so pick L3 or R3 if you use that.
- **Tap the game beside the panels** to close them. The on-screen controls keep working while the panels are open.
- The **X** is gone: the arrow in the panels' header closes them.
- The panels now stay clear of a system bar that remains on the screen, such as a tablet's taskbar.

![The panels over the game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/main/docs/release-images/1.1.54-panels-open.jpg)

![Settings, Controller, Open the panels with](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/main/docs/release-images/1.1.54-open-the-panels-with.jpg)

Thanks to NilsSchoovaerts for the suggestions.

releases.name: v1.1.53
releases.body:
**Fixed: the game closed when a mod left out a character's head model ([#67](https://github.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/issues/67))**

When a model mod is missing one of its pieces, the game skips that piece and carries on. The blinking code didn't: if the missing piece was a **head**, the game closed as soon as the character appeared. Now that character is drawn without the head, so you can keep playing and sort out the mods.

If someone shows up headless, a model mod (or a mix of them) is missing files.

### Updating
Go to **Settings → Updates** in the launcher (or install this APK over your current version), then press **Play**. It asks to **Update the game** once (a few seconds).

releases.name: v1.1.52
releases.body:
**Fixed: mods that replace shaders did nothing with the OpenGL ES renderer ([#89](https://github.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/issues/89))**

Mods like **PSX Battle Shadows and Vertex Snapping** come with shaders for the PC's renderers (OpenGL, Direct3D and Vulkan). Phones' OpenGL ES can't read any of those, so with **Settings → Display → Renderer → OpenGL ES** the mod was quietly left out, and it only worked with Vulkan.

The game now converts such a mod's Vulkan shaders to OpenGL ES when it starts. Nothing changes with Vulkan, or without a shader mod.

Thanks to epigonone-netizen for the two reports and screenshots.

Go to **Settings → Updates** in the launcher (or install this APK over your current version), then press **Play**. It asks to **Update the game** once (a few seconds).

releases.name: Borked3DS v2024.03.10
releases.body:
This Mar.10 update brings a couple of bug fixes, some minor Vulkan improvements, and ports some fixes and features from Azahar.

### Major Bugs Fixed
* Games crashing on launch with Vulkan on executables compiled with GCC.
* Fixed issue where Circle Pad and C-Stick Up/Down button mappings are
reversed when configured with the "Set Analog Stick" button on Desktop.

### What's Changed
* renderer_vulkan.h: Set PRESENT_PIPELINES = 4 by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/346
* renderer_vulkan: Implement memory type fallbacks and improve logging by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/349
* Make verbose logging the default by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/350
* renderer_vulkan.cpp: Add some framebuffer logging by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/353
* renderer_vulkan: Add initialization checks, prevent null image views from being used in descriptor sets by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/355
* vk_instance.h: Add more tile-based GPUs to the list of ShouldFlush() by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/360

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.02.14
releases.body:
## 🥰 Happy Valentine's Day! 🥰

**NOTE**:  It is recommended that you clear the contents of your `shaders` folder before upgrading to this version.
* On Desktop:  Navigate to `File->Open Borked3DS Folder` and empty the `shaders` folder.
* On Android:  Long press on a game, tap on the folder icon, tap on `Open Shader Cache Folder` and delete the contents.

This release focuses mainly on stability and bug fixes, with a couple of new features which will hopefully improve performance.

### Bugs Fixed
* The MacOS build does not launch properly (x86_64 and AArch64).
* Rotating the display in Android may result in a crash.
* The Android app may not launch correctly on Android 9-11.
* Regression: Launching the Home Menu may not work correctly in Android (NOTE: If it still doesn't work after upgrading to this release, you may need to re-download the System Files or clear out your User Folder and then re-download).
* Regression: There may have been some minor missing textures when using OpenGL.
* Borked3DS now builds with gcc-12 on Bookworm-based Raspberry Pi (or similar aarch64) devices (NOTE: It may still not run properly regardless; this is still being looked at).

This release is identical to [v2025.01.23](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23) except that instead of being built with SDL2, it's built with SDL3 via [sdl2-compat](https://github.com/libsdl-org/sdl2-compat). The intent is to port the project to pure SDL3 eventually, but in the meantime, this allows users the ability to test the new backend.

## What's Changed
* externals: Switch from SDL2 to SDL3 via sdl2-compat by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/315

Third Party Updates

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/compare/v2025.01.23...v2025.01.23-sdl-compat

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.01.23
releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

releases.name: v0.2.7: Multi-region hooks, black models/cubemaps fix & NVN write-back/spill perf
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

releases.name: v0.2.6: Hide controls option & Play crash null safety fix
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.6

### Español
- **Ocultar controles en pantalla:** Se añadió la opción en el Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) para ocultar los controles visuales. Los controles siguen 100% activos y funcionales al tacto, permitiendo una experiencia de pantalla limpia.
- **Corrección de cierre inmediato al iniciar (Play crash):** Se reforzó la verificación nula de punteros JNI y chequeo de permisos de almacenamiento en `android_main` para dispositivos cargando directamente por NSP/FD.

---

### English
- **Hide On-Screen Controls:** Added option in the Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) to hide the on-screen touch overlay while keeping touch controls fully functional.
- **Play Crash Hotfix:** Safe JNI pointer and storage access checks in `android_main` when launching via direct NSP/FD.

releases.name: v0.2.5: Fix continuous phantom dodge/evade & SixAxis decouple
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.5

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras

- **Continuous Phantom Dodge/Evade Fixed / Corrección de esquiva/dash continuo fantasma (Fixes #13, #15, #18):**
  - **IHidServer IsSixAxisSensorAtRest (cmd 82):** Implemented Horizon OS nn::hid::IHidServer command 82, returning isAtRest = true. Previously, unhandled command 82 returned false, tricking the game into detecting constant controller movement and triggering endless motion-controlled evades/dashes.
  - **SixAxis Angular Velocity Decoupling:** Restricted right-stick gyro motion aiming simulation exclusively to Persona 5 Royal (Darts minigame). In NieR, the right stick controls the camera; feeding stick inputs into the virtual gyro was generating violent angular velocity spikes that triggered unwanted evade maneuvers when looking around.
  - **Versión oficial v0.2.5 (versionCode 7):** Se corrigió la esquiva automática e incontrolable del personaje al implementar el comando IPC IsSixAxisSensorAtRest y desacoplar la simulación giroscópica del stick derecho de la cámara.

releases.name: v0.2.4: maintenance release & stability improvements
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.4

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Maintenance & Stability update / Actualización de estabilidad y mantenimiento:**
  - Bumped internal version code to 6 (v0.2.4) for official distribution and updates.
  - Consolidates touch controls edge rejection, PC save file auto-conversion, dynamic GPU upload buffer scaling, and memory stability fixes.
  - Actualización oficial con versión interna actualizada (versionCode 6), que consolida las mejoras de estabilidad, control táctil en bordes y asignación dinámica de memoria de vídeo.

releases.name: v0.2.3: PC save conversion, touch ghost-press fix, and large map stutter/crash fix
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.3

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Automatic PC save conversion to Switch format / Conversión automática de partidas de PC a Switch:**
  - Saves imported from PC (`SlotData_0.dat`, `GameData.dat`, or saves with 64-bit SteamIDs) are automatically converted into native Switch save files (`SlotData_0`, `GameData`).
  - Las partidas de PC (archivos `.dat` o con SteamID) se convierten automáticamente al formato de Switch tanto al importar como al abrir el launcher o presionar Play.
- **On-screen touch controls & ghost-press fix / Corrección de toques fantasma en botón A:**
  - Shifted right-side action buttons inward (`x = 0.860`, button A from `0.940` to `0.925`) and tightened touch hit radius (`1.35f` -> `1.22f`).
  - Added palm rejection on the extreme right bezel (`x > 0.985`), preventing unintended auto-presses of the A button when gripping the phone in landscape.
  - Se movieron los botones de acción hacia adentro y se añadió rechazo de palma en el borde derecho para evitar que la palma presione el botón A al sostener el móvil.
- **Large maps stuttering and crash fix / Solución a tirones y cierres en mapas abiertos:**

releases.name: v0.3.7: Battle cut-ins & two-sided stencil rendering fix
releases.body:
## Persona 4 Arena Ultimax for Android v0.3.7

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Battle Cut-ins Missing Fixed (Fixes #4):**
  Fixed missing special move, super attack, and Persona summon cut-in portraits and animations in battle.
  - Implemented proper two-sided stencil dynamic state (reference, compare mask, and write mask).
  - Added support for \VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT\ and \VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM_S8_UINT\ in dynamic rendering pipelines, enabling stencil writes on all mobile GPUs.
  - Added state invalidation on pass end (\g_bound = Bound{}\) so dynamic stencil state is correctly bound in every render pass.
  *Se corrigió la ausencia de los cut-ins de personajes, ataques especiales e invocaciones de Persona en combate. Se reparó el estado dinámico de stencil de doble cara, el soporte para formatos D24S8/D16S8 en Dynamic Rendering y la invalidación de estado al terminar pases.*

- **Corrección de cierre inmediato al iniciar (Play crash):** Se protegió el acceso a JNI y verificación de permisos de almacenamiento en `android_main` para dispositivos cargando directo por NSP/FD (POCO X7 Pro, POCO F6, etc.).
- **Solución al congelamiento en "Preparing game":** Se limitaron los hilos del compilador de shaders a un máximo de 4 durante la importación, solucionando bloqueos indefinidos en procesadores MediaTek Dimensity 8350.
- **Corrección de cuelgues de GPU (GPU Hangs):** Se deshabilitaron las divisiones de renderpass a mitad de pase (`NX_CHUNK_IN_PASS=0`) por defecto en GPUs TBDR (Adreno 830 / Mali).
- **Corrección de texto en mensajes (IM / SNS Chat):** Se corrigió el renderizado del texto en las opciones de respuesta del chat del teléfono móvil (PR #251).

releases.name: v0.5.11: Audio resume, UI pipeline state & Qualcomm movie alignment fixes
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.11

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Audio resume on sleep/lock screen (Fixes #238):**
  Automatically recreates the AAudio stream when disconnected, restoring game sound upon waking or unlocking the phone.
  *Se re-crea automáticamente el flujo de audio de AAudio al desconectarse, restaurando el sonido del juego al desbloquear o reanudar el teléfono.*
- **UI stripes and color banding on tile-based GPUs (Fixes #243):**
  Fixed bound pipeline and dynamic state cache invalidation on render pass end, preventing dull colors and white stripes in menus and dialogue on Adreno, Mali, and PowerVR.
  *Se corrigió la invalidación del estado dinámico y pipelines al finalizar un pase de renderizado, solucionando colores apagados y franjas blancas en la interfaz.*
- **Qualcomm Snapdragon cutscene video alignment (PR #245):**
  Applied proper row alignment independently of stride for Qualcomm hardware decoders, fixing green and distorted lines during opening cutscenes.
  *Alineación de filas independiente de stride para decodificadores Qualcomm, eliminando líneas verdes y distorsiones en cinemáticas.*
- **PowerVR title screen stability:**

releases.name: v0.5.10: PowerVR title screen crash fixed
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.10

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **PowerVR crash at the title screen fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed right after the opening movie, when the title screen appeared. It now reaches the title and keeps going.
  **Arreglado el cierre en la pantalla de título en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba justo después del vídeo de la intro, al aparecer la pantalla de título. Ahora llega al título y sigue.

### Known issue / Problema conocido
- On some PowerVR phones the picture may hold for a few seconds at that point while the sound keeps playing; then the game continues.
  En algunos móviles PowerVR la imagen puede quedarse quieta unos segundos en ese punto mientras el sonido sigue; después el juego continúa.

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.name: v0.5.9: fixed movie stripes and PowerVR crash
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.9

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Movies without diagonal stripes:** since v0.5.7 the videos and some cutscenes showed diagonal colour stripes on many phones (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek and some Snapdragon). The port misread how the phone's video decoder lays out each frame; it now reads it correctly.
  **Vídeos sin rayas diagonales:** desde la v0.5.7 los vídeos y algunas cinemáticas salían con rayas diagonales de colores en muchos móviles (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek y algunos Snapdragon). El port leía mal cómo el decodificador de vídeo del móvil organiza cada imagen; ahora lo lee bien.
- **PowerVR crash at start fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed a few seconds after opening, on the loading icon. It now starts and plays normally.
  **Arreglado el cierre al iniciar en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba a los pocos segundos de abrirlo, en el icono de carga. Ahora arranca y se juega con normalidad.

# Skate 3 Mobile v2.1.0 DEV

New audio, rendering, and Android startup fixes are here. Huge thanks to
[Andrew Nakas](https://github.com/andrewnakas) and contributors for the underlying
work, and [AlanConstantino](https://github.com/AlanConstantino) for integrating
it and testing on Retroid Pocket 6 in [PR #123](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/pull/123).
Alex McHugh's Skate3Recomp and ReXGlue/Xenia remain the foundation of this port.

## Download

Most players want **Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk**. Install over your existing
main app. Do not uninstall first. Android will ask you to approve the update.
Your extracted game files stay in place.

[Download the main APK](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0/Skate3-Mobile-Android.apk)
or [get the separate QA Build](https://github.com/Buku313/Skate3-Mobile/releases/download/v2.1.0-qa1/Skate3-Mobile-QA.apk).
The debug APK is for users of the separate developer app.

Older QA and developer builds used the main app's update address. Install the
matching v2.1 APK once, without uninstalling. From this version onward, each
app receives updates for its own package only.

## What changed

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 7
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 7

This QA build targets startup hangs on the AYN Thor and Retroid Pocket 5.

- Android now keeps the boot frontend and startup movies on the complete emulated presentation path.
- Native Vulkan pipeline compilation waits until the game has actually queued world content.
- A false boot-time gameplay signal can no longer switch the following EA movie into native loading mode.
- A four-second watchdog completes only the first continuously stuck frontend movie. Later career movies are not affected.
- The stable app and stable update channel remain unchanged.

Use the System Driver first. Fully close the QA app between attempts and test at least five cold launches. On a successful test, confirm that you reached gameplay. On a failed test, attach the launcher diagnostics and full log to the existing device issue.

The APK includes no game data.

## Português do Brasil

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6

This QA build targets an intermittent early-boot hang reported on the Retroid Pocket 5.

The failed QA 5 diagnostic showed a live audio thread but no first presentation, native pipeline creation, scene target, or crash. The guest render thread stopped immediately after its first offscreen 2D captures.

QA 6 tightens the boot capture boundary:

- Only the four verified 2D vertex layouts and three supported primitive types are accepted.
- Individual and per-frame 2D payloads have conservative size limits.
- Invalid transient draw state is rejected before reading guest memory.
- The first twelve guest frames now log capture begin and completion markers.

Install QA 6 over the previous QA app, keep the System Driver selected, fully close the app between attempts, and test at least five launches. Attach diagnostics from any failed launch.

The stable app and stable update channel are unchanged. The APK includes no game data.

## Português do Brasil

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5

This is an opt-in diagnostic build that installs over earlier **Skate 3 QA** builds and preserves QA app data.

## RP5 intermittent black-screen fix

QA 4 proved that the Retroid Pocket 5 can render the Quality profile's 1280x720 scene target, but testers reported that startup only succeeded roughly half the time.

The QA 4 profile copied Performance's visible feature settings, but one internal pipeline gate still used the profile number. Quality therefore compiled optional outline, spline, and shadow shader families even though those features were disabled. Cold and partially warmed shader caches could take different startup paths.

QA 5 fixes the mismatch:

- The 1280x720 Quality target remains enabled.
- The pipeline builder now follows the active lean-scene flag instead of assuming every Quality profile needs the full optional PSO set.
- Renderer installation applies the same defensive lean-feature guard.
- The startup log must report `lean Android set` for this QA Quality profile.
- Stable v2.0.17 and its update channel remain unchanged.

## RP5 test

1. Install QA 5 directly over QA 4.
2. Keep the System Driver selected.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.0
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Motion sensitivity
- **Motion sensitivity X axis** and **Motion sensitivity Y axis** set how fast turning left and right, and tilting up and down go, from 25% to 500%. They are next to the motion inversion on each controller's page in **Input settings** and in the quick menu under Controls, and work for the motion of the device and of controllers
- They scale the turning speed the game gets, which is what aiming with motion uses. A tilt that is held still settles at the real angle of the device

### Updated to the latest Cemu
Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:
- **Wii U CPU on ARM:** fixes in the ARM64 recompiler that runs every game, for single-precision float stores (now faster too), division by zero, carry flags and a few wrong instructions. The default NaN mode of ARM is turned off to match the Wii U
- **Performance:** smaller Vulkan and GPU optimizations, like checking only the render state that changed, caching shader lookups and using the fast draw path more often

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.3.6
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Input settings, redone
- Each controller has all its settings on one page, the ones used most first: what it emulates, the controller in use with **Set up all inputs**, its buttons and sticks, motion, rumble, profiles, and the stick and trigger sensitivity at the end under **Advanced**. The **Controller settings** dialog and the separate **Device settings** screen are gone
- The controller in use is picked from the connected ones right on the page, and **Set up all inputs** binds that one directly
- **Invert motion X axis** and **Invert motion Y axis** are next to **Use motion** on each controller's page
- The touch screen, sensors and vibration of the device can be moved to a controller from its page, and the vibration strength of the device is set there too
- The inputs are shown as a grid of tiles that say **Not set** when nothing is bound
- The input settings list the controllers in use, with **Add a controller** for the next free one, then **Hotkeys** and **On-screen controls**

### Controller profiles per game

releases.body: First Release of CHDBOY for android. Easy smart compress. just select folder of bin, cue, iso, etc. It will automatically pick the createdvd or createcd depending if its a dvd or cd. It should also do the correct hunksize for PSP iso's for example. If there's already a CHD with the same name in the folder it will skip it and move on. I was going to put this on Google Play Store for like a dollar, but i see alot of people already found it. So its free. Please consider if I release anything on the Play Store in the future to support me. *CHD conversions of large iso's will take awhile. Make sure to accept notifications when it ask for it. That way you can exit the app and get notified when its done.*

releases.name: Need for Speed: Underground - Android v1.0.7
releases.body:
- Lower CPU load during races. Vulkan reuses uploaded vertex data, shader parameters, and descriptor sets. Index data is written directly into the rendering buffer, eliminating an intermediate copy.
- Fewer draw calls. Objects with matching geometry and compatible rendering state can now be drawn together in the main pass and in reflections. Each object keeps its own position and rendering parameters.
- Faster P8 texture handling. Paletted textures now use NEON decoding, and a texture cache fix reduces redundant decoding of textures that haven’t changed.
- Lower runtime overhead. Xbox thread scheduling checks, graphics command processing, and frequently used port routines take less CPU time.
- Lower audio processing overhead. The low-pass filter processes both channels in parallel, and diagnostic calculations run less often.
- Improved 30/60 FPS switching. The selected mode is applied through D3D frame presentation while preserving simulation speed and game timers.

releases.name: Need for Speed: Underground - Android v1.0.6
releases.body: - Added automatic scaling for different screen aspect ratios: 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, and more. - Added adjustable touch button opacity.

releases.name: Need for Speed: Underground - Android v1.0.5
releases.body:
Added save file access through Android’s system Files app and improved touchscreen controls when trading cars.

- Added an **NFS Underground** location in Files, exposing profile folders for backup and restoration. Files and folders can be copied, renamed, and deleted. Duplicate names receive a numbered suffix without overwriting existing saves.
- Fixed taps and swipes being ignored on **Choose Trade Car** while camera rotation continued to work.
- Added **Choose Car** and **Cancel** touch buttons to the car trade performance screens.
- Fixed a crash when advancing to the next stage of a car trade.
- Improved swipe detection in Quick Race, garage, and trade car selectors, including cases where the selected thumbnail is not rendered.
- Added `build_debug.sh` at the repository root to build the Debug APK with the register-block and executor-TLS-argument flags.
- Expanded touch regression tests and documentation.

The touch changes previously passed host regression tests and `assembleDebug`. Button visibility and the **Choose Car** transition without crashing were confirmed on Xiaomi 24076RP19G. Broader device testing remains pending.

releases.name: Need for Speed: Underground - Android v1.0.4
releases.body:
## What's new

- Added a customizable **Reset** button that puts the car back on track. Existing touch layouts get the button in its default position.
- Fixed touch controls when trading a car in Career mode, including the selection arrows, the Next button on the stats screens, and Yes/No confirmation.
- Turning off **Blur/Bloom** now disables both speed blur and bloom.
- Optimized Vulkan rendering, movie playback, and audio processing on ARM64. Frame pre-rotation removed an extra GPU composition pass for the game layer in tests on the ASUS Zenfone 7 Pro.

releases.name: TMNT v1.1.2
releases.body:
TMNT 1.1.2: WIDE's skateboards end again, and what the game takes away at the screen's edges goes by WIDE's sides.
As before, nothing of the game comes in these packages: keep your own `tmnt.zip` (MAME's ROM set, World 4 Players)
beside the game, and it takes its assets out of it the first time it starts.

**Fixed**

- **WIDE, the skateboards' road** (issue 30, on the Steam Deck and the Switch): after the first helicopters, the
  ones that come in at the left were never seen and never gone, their shadows going by again and again, and the
  road never ended. They were put past the wider picture's left side, where the game read their place as past the
  right edge: they flew away from the turtles instead of to them. They come in from the left side now, fly to the
  turtles and go, and the road ends as in 4:3.

**Changed**

- **WIDE, the game's screen edges**: every place where the game takes something away, stops it or keeps it in at a
  side of the screen now goes by WIDE's sides, all at once, instead of the arcade's 4:3 edges. What vanished in
  sight in the sides now leaves by the picture's edge: the Mousers carrying Splinter off at the building site's

releases.name: TMNT v1.1.1
releases.body:
TMNT 1.1.1: the Switch starts again, BOSS RUSH's cards, and a faster picture on slow devices. As before, nothing of
the game comes in these packages: keep your own `tmnt.zip` (MAME's ROM set, World 4 Players) beside the game, and it
takes its assets out of it the first time it starts.

**Fixed**

- **The Switch** (issue 27): 1.1.0 stopped at its start on every Switch, "The window cannot be opened: EGL not
  initialized", TMNT and TMNT Arcade both. The window now asks for what devkitPro's SDL 3 needs to open it. Built,
  but not yet tried on a Switch: the picture docked and handheld, the sound and the controllers are still the first
  things to tell. If it does not start on yours, 1.0.7 is the one that does.
- **BOSS RUSH's cards** (issue 24): with VSYNC on (the default), the picture stood still while the turtles crossed
  each area, the card with the area and its boss never shown, and the boss's fight came out of nowhere. The card is
  on the screen through the crossing again.
- **The turtle choice's song** with DEMO SOUND off: the menus' song went on over it instead of the choice's own.

releases.name: TMNT v1.1.0
releases.body:
TMNT 1.1.0: SDL 3, the Raspberry Pi, and iPhone and iPad. As before, nothing of the game comes in these packages:
