first time it starts.

**New**

- **Raspberry Pi**: `tmnt-raspberrypi-arm64.tar.gz`, TMNT and TMNT Arcade for a Raspberry Pi 3 or later (3, Zero 2 W,

  the App Store, and never will be: you install them yourself (AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly, which sign them

releases.name: TMNT v1.0.7
releases.body:
TMNT 1.0.7: the players' issues, the attract mode and coins at home. As before, nothing of the game comes in these
packages: keep your own `tmnt.zip` (MAME's ROM set, World 4 Players) beside the game, and it takes its assets out of
it the first time it starts. This version takes them out once more: they now hold the rest of the program's bytes.

**Fixed**

- **The Technodrome's lift** (issue 21): the game closed when the lift landed with a turtle pushing the scroll. The
  shaft is drawn there from past its map's end, which the arcade board reads and draws out of sight; the game took
  those bytes for missing, and stopped. Both games, TMNT and TMNT Arcade.
- **The Switch's picture** (issue 19): it fits the screen, docked and handheld, with the TV at 1080p or 720p. TMNT
  no longer goes full screen there: the Switch's SDL made that a 1920 x 1080 picture, of which the 720p screen
  showed a part. Not yet tried on a Switch.
- **WIDE, the highway's cars** (issue 14): once a car has driven past, nothing of it stays at the picture's sides.

emulators.name: Overlay Translator
emulators.description: 无需 root 的屏幕实时翻译，译文直接覆盖在游戏与视觉小说画面上。
emulators.latest_body:
# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。
emulators.note: 支持端侧与云端 OCR，可离线运行。

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
# v0.4.7 主要更新

新增：停稳翻译，画面停止变化后自动翻译，翻页后自动更新译文。

新增：划词翻译支持「仅提取文字」，框选即可提取文字，支持复制和朗读。

新增：输入翻译，可翻译输入框中的文字并直接替换。

新增：自动识别设置，可为不同语言选择识别方式。

新增：截屏区域设置，支持控制区域边框显示、截屏时自动隐藏、区域位置与大小调整，以及自定义区域样式。

新增：PaddleOCR 支持韩文识别。

新增：小牛翻译，可在翻译引擎中选择并配置使用。

新增：LLM 服务商预设，支持查看官方文档、测试连接和获取模型列表；API Key 需自行填写。

新增：[Issue #23](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/23) 提出的快捷设置磁贴，可快速启动或停止截屏服务。

新增：[Issue #22](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/22) 提出的画面方向修正，支持手机竖屏但游戏内容横屏等场景。

新增：翻译库支持「全部停用」，无需逐项关闭。

新增：关于页面增加「使用手册」入口，方便查看功能说明和操作步骤。

新增：开发者选项增加全屏共享开关，开启后请求共享整个屏幕。

优化：改善漫画文字识别和译文显示效果。

优化：改善朗读语言判断、权限处理和服务商配置体验。

优化：提取文字支持悬浮窗口的合并强度设置，显示、复制和朗读使用相同的分段结果。

修复：模型下载失败、断点续传异常及配套模型未自动下载的问题。

修复：自动识别韩文时可能识别错误或只返回标点的问题。

修复：多种语言同时出现时，自动识别可能选错识别结果、遗漏部分文字的问题。

修复：切换应用语言后，部分悬浮菜单、翻译卡片和选框按钮仍显示原来语言的问题。

releases.body:
# v0.4.5 主要更新

新增：术语库支持从 JSON 文件批量导入，可在导入前预览、筛选并处理重复内容。

新增：悬浮窗支持点击英文单词查看简要释义，并可打开完整词卡。

新增：实验性支持将当前画面随翻译发送给兼容的 LLM，用于辅助判断阅读顺序、识别内容和画面语境。该功能默认关闭。不同多模态模型的识别能力差异较大，暂时不能保证提高文字识别质量；开启后还会增加等待时间和调用费用，请根据所用模型的实际效果选择。

优化：完善思考模式、推理强度、图片清晰度和自定义请求参数等 LLM 设置。

优化：调整日文、中文、韩文和拉丁文字识别流程，并改进 Paddle OCR 的批量识别与竖排文字处理。

优化：改进同屏、连续和全部合并翻译的顺序、结果对应与异常恢复，减少重复请求和翻译失败。

优化：统一欢迎页与设置页的模型推荐、下载检查和离线方案选择。

优化：提升 Shizuku 及部分兼容实现的适配稳定性。

修复：若干悬浮窗、原文覆盖、设置状态和界面显示问题。

releases.name: v0.4.4
releases.body:
# v0.4.4 主要更新

新增：快速、同屏、连续三种翻译模式，可根据速度、当前画面上下文或前后画面对话选择合适的翻译方式。

新增：更自由的 LLM 控制，可按模型需要调整流式输出、思考模式、采样参数和消息模板。

优化：漫画文字识别与原文覆盖效果。

releases.name: fexdroid 0.3.108-alpha (experimental: native ARM64 Steam)
releases.body:
**Experimental build 0.3.108-alpha, not for general use.** Built from `e370fb1` (branch `steam-arm64`) on 2026-09-29. The regular build is at [apk-latest](https://github.com/cobrabm12/fexdroid/releases/tag/apk-latest).

What is new here:

- **Valve's native ARM64 Steam client** instead of the translated one: Settings › Game › "Native Steam client (experiment)" › Start. It downloads about 1 GB from Valve, installs apart from the regular Steam and asks you to sign in again. Games cannot be started from it yet.
  - Tested on a Xiaomi (Dimensity 7200, Android 16) up to 0.3.107: the client installs itself, runs and starts its web helper, then refused the web helper's connection because `lsof` was missing. 0.3.108-alpha has an `lsof` for native programs; with it the client draws its sign-in window on a PC. Not yet confirmed on a phone.
- **Frames straight from the game** (Settings › Performance, off by default): the game's picture skips the X server. Tested with vkcube only.
- The way every program of a session is started has changed. The regular Steam still starts with it (tested on the same Xiaomi).

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.5.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.4.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.4.0): one executable that keeps itself up to date, the game's own menus played with the mouse, prompts that name your keys, and a faster renderer.

## New

- **One file: `CoD3SP_s.exe`.** FFmpeg's libraries for the sound and the films are built into it; nothing else to unpack.
- **Updates itself.** At every start it asks GitHub for a newer release; if there is one, it downloads it, replaces itself and starts the new version. Turn it off with `auto_update = 0` under `[game]` in `CoD3Recomp.ini`, or start it with `--no-update`.
- **New first start.** The console window asks whether this is a fresh install (choose your disc image, then the folder to install into) or the game is already installed (choose the game's main folder, the one with `default.xex`).

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.4.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.3.0
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

> **Still in development: bugs can and will occur.**
> *Még fejlesztés alatt: hibák előfordulhatnak.*

The first release since [0.2.3](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.3): the campaign goes on from one mission to the next, a level runs above 60 frames a second, and a row of picture faults is gone.

## New

- **The next mission after a win.** The console restarts the game between missions and hands the next one over; the port does the same, so a finished mission leads into the next one instead of closing the game.
- **A mission's briefing film can be skipped** with Space (A) once its level has loaded. On the console it always plays to its end.
- **Unlimited frame rate in levels** (settings menu, on by default). A level runs at what the machine can do, around 100 to 115 frames a second where it had 60; the menus stay at 60 and the films at their own 30. The game's speed does not change with the frame rate.
- **Model detail** (settings menu): the game's own level of detail, or the finest version of every model at any distance.

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.3
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

releases.name: NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2 - drivers Vulkan y compatibilidad
releases.body:
# NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2

Carbon incorpora las mejoras de compatibilidad de Most Wanted 0.5.4, el selector de drivers Vulkan y las actualizaciones opcionales, conservando su launcher, idiomas y controles.

## Mejoras

- Adaptación del renderer y de los shaders para GPU que admiten solo **cuatro conjuntos de descriptores**, presentes en algunos Mali y otros dispositivos.
- Conversión **BC4/BC5 en CPU con Xclipse** y el driver propietario de Samsung.
- **Sincronización ARM adaptada a las funciones de Carbon**: se publican las órdenes completas antes de ejecutarlas desde otro hilo, corrigiendo una causa de posibles cierres al entrar a carrera.
- **Drivers Vulkan externos:** importa, selecciona, prueba y elimina ZIPs Android ARM64. La prueba se ejecuta en un proceso independiente y muestra GPU, Vulkan y funciones disponibles. Puedes volver al driver del sistema.
- **Avisos opcionales de nuevas versiones** de este repositorio con **Actualizar** o **Más tarde**, más **Buscar actualizaciones** en el launcher. Puedes seguir jugando sin actualizar ni tener conexión; no se instalan ni descargan APKs automáticamente.

releases.name: NFS Carbon Android v0.3.1
releases.body:
## Español

Correcciones sobre la v0.3.0:

- **Personajes visibles y con color:** los modelos de los personajes (escenas con la tripulación, rivales) no aparecían o salían negros con el renderizador nativo. Carbon guarda los índices de hueso como floats, usa más entradas de vértice que Most Wanted y sus shaders de píxel usan las 256 constantes de la Xbox 360; los tres casos ya están soportados.
- **Voces de los personajes y la policía** con los textos en español (y **Idioma de las voces** en *Inglés*): la copia PAL inglesa solo trae las voces en inglés y ahora el juego las carga. También se corrige una pantalla de carga que no terminaba al empezar ciertas carreras.
- Los shaders se vuelven a generar automáticamente la primera vez que pulsas **Jugar** (unos segundos).

Se instala encima de la v0.3.0. Necesitas la edición **Xbox 360** de Carbon con el `default.xex` indicado en el README.

## English

Fixes on top of v0.3.0:

releases.name: NFS Carbon Android v0.3.0
releases.body:
## Español

**NFS Carbon (Xbox 360) en Android con el renderizador nativo de NFSMW Android Evolved.** El juego se ve completo (coches, escenario, vídeos y menús) a unos 60 FPS en un Galaxy S25 Ultra, también a 1920×1080.

- Renderizador **Nativo** por defecto (Vulkan directo, compatible con Vulkan 1.1); *Xenos* sigue disponible en los ajustes.
- Los shaders se generan en el teléfono la primera vez que pulsas **Jugar**, a partir de tu propia copia (unos segundos).
- Resolución interna hasta **1920×1080** con el renderizador nativo.
- **Idioma de las voces** aparte del de los textos: la copia PAL inglesa solo trae voces y vídeos en inglés; así el inicio de las carreras ya no suena raro con los textos en español.
- Contador de FPS del renderizador nativo.

Necesitas la edición **Xbox 360** de Carbon con el `default.xex` indicado en el README (SHA-256 `b1e42391…`), copiada en `Memoria interna/NFSCARBON`. El APK no incluye el juego. Probado en un Samsung S25 Ultra; si lo pruebas en otro teléfono (MediaTek/Dimensity, Exynos…), envía el registro con **Enviar crash o log**.

## English

emulators.name: NFS Most Wanted Recompiled
emulators.description: 《极品飞车：最高通缉》2005 PC 版的静态重编译移植，提供安卓 ARM64 与 Windows 构建。
emulators.latest_body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

Hello!

It's been a little while, so I thought I would just give a small update on project status. 

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:
- Fixing dynamic package name paths for the gamepad implementation so that name can be changed, such as adding a ludashi benchmark version with the SDL joystick native controller support.
- Input control / touch screen control bindings bug fixes
- Minor UI improvements and enhancements
- Updating all drivers, Fex, Box64, and graphics Wrapper, following Pipetto-Crypto's advice when it comes to Streamlining and avoiding feature creep (...and avoiding pure AI code slop). 
- Improve ALSA-Reflector so audio stops cutting out after 15 minutes unless you switch to headphones.

releases.name: Cmod Progress Update - December 2025: What's next?
releases.body:
Hello!

It's been a little while, so I thought I would just give a small update on project status. 

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:
- Fixing dynamic package name paths for the gamepad implementation so that name can be changed, such as adding a ludashi benchmark version with the SDL joystick native controller support.
- Input control / touch screen control bindings bug fixes
- Minor UI improvements and enhancements
- Updating all drivers, Fex, Box64, and graphics Wrapper, following Pipetto-Crypto's advice when it comes to Streamlining and avoiding feature creep (...and avoiding pure AI code slop). 
- Improve ALSA-Reflector so audio stops cutting out after 15 minutes unless you switch to headphones.

releases.name: Winlator Cmod v13.1.1
releases.body:
_Minor update v13.1.1 fixed custom icons, default renderer, and warning prompt handling on new installs_ 

------------------------------

-   **`evshim` Rewrite:** The entire controller shim (`libevshim.so`) has been rewritten, **completely eliminating the use of shared memory (`mmap`)**, resulting in a massive reduction in CPU overhead and a significant performance boost, especially on lower-end devices. Box64 3.2 and 3.6 are now compatible, and have been restored.

-   **ALSA-Reflector Improved** The pacer's ring buffer and reconnection logic have been refined, expect better performance and reliability.

-   **Universal CPU Overhead Reduction:** I've gone through the code to find and eliminate performance bottlenecks, once again, big thanks to @Pipetto-crypto as always for the guidance and his improvements to the Graphics Wrapper. 

### ✨ New Feature: VkBasalt Integration

-   **Per-Shortcut Sharpening & Effects:** Thanks to @Pipetto-crypto You can now enable VkBasalt on a per-shortcut basis to apply CAS and DLS to your games.

### 🐞 Stability & Bug Fixes:

This update includes a huge number of fixes for a smoother experience.

releases.name: Winlator Cmod v13: The Controller Revolution is Here! (And much more...)
releases.body: The wait is over. After months of work the next major evolution of Winlator Cmod has arrived. I teased that a controller revolution was coming, but the reality is so much bigger. This isn't just an update; it's a top-to-bottom overhaul focused on bringing a native, seamless gaming experience to your device. This release is the culmination of a journey, and I'm proud to share it with you. ✨ What's New in Cmod v13 ✨ -------------------------- ### 🎮 The Controller Revolution: Native Gamepad Support is Here! The old input methods are gone (sorta), replaced by a completely new, from-the-ground-up controller implementation built on a native SDL2 backend. - **Native XInput & DInput Support:** No more switching settings per game! Controllers are now treated like real controllers. If it works on a PC, it should just work here. - **Multiplayer (Up to 4 Players!):** You heard that right. Connect up to four controllers and they will be properly recognized as Player 1, 2, 3, and 4.

releases.body:
Are you Ready 2 Rumble? Or vibrate? 

Do you have friends? Like, up to 4? 

Are you tired of switching between dinput and xinput?

Wouldn't it be great if every game just treated your controller like a real controller? No more remapping madness?

Well I have news for you... very good news. Seriously- stay tuned. 

SHM you soon! ;)

releases.name: Winlator Cmod - Project Status Update - April 2025
releases.body:
### Statement on BrunoSX’s hiatus
Bruno (@brunodev85) announced he’s pausing Winlator development after false virus accusations. There are no viruses in Winlator, at least not intentionally—debug symbols in the bundled Wine builds can trigger antivirus heuristics, but I realize that the latest release had something a bit different that scrambled executable file names. The reality is that these things can happen, it's certainly not intentional. *Update: TestD3D.exe _was_ infected with floxif. Again, this was not intentional, but it should be noted.  

### Where Cmod & the Bionic fork stand
My own Cmod branch has been quiet since Prototype 5 / v12 alpha (Discord-only). Meanwhile, amazing work continues:

@Pipetto-crypto – Bionic & graphics wrappers

@cjxyz – Bionic Winlator fork and new features

### My roadmap
I’m resuming work—slowly, around a busier job—but the plan is:

🔧 Fix Gamepad Configurator

🖥️ Streamline Big Picture Mode (Cmod Big Picture Mode, the frontend looking menu I made a while back. But Steam support is still on my radar)

🍷 Update Wine & core assets

🏷️ Expand on shortcut settings / per-app tweaks

Expect incremental releases rather than one big drop.

releases.name: Def Jam v1.3 — Discord, Voice & Controls Update
releases.body:
Def Jam v1.3 brings Discord account integration, room discovery corrections, voice chat, refreshed menus and restored custom analog controls to the Android ARM64 port.

## Online and Discord
- Sign in through the official FFNY Online Discord account service. New connections use the verified account name; the manual player-name screen is removed.
- Saved sessions use encrypted app-private storage. Account sign-out, deletion and privacy controls remain accessible inside the game.
- Fixed the PC build fingerprint used for ordinary room and player discovery. The missing build-number bytes previously separated Android players from compatible PC lobbies.
- Choose Europe or North America from the launcher. Both players must use the same region.
- Added real account statistics and leaderboard access in the native online menu.
- Preserved room codes, native room creation, fighter selection and the existing online flow.

## Room voice chat
- Added PC-compatible room voice with push-to-talk: enable voice, allow microphone access and hold MIC to speak.
- Added a microphone permission prompt on first game entry, playback volume and a Mute/Unmute microphone button.

releases.name: Def Jam v1.2 — Controls & Compatibility Update
releases.body:
Update for the Android ARM64 port, focused on controls, frame pacing and online compatibility.

## Changes since v1.1
- Expanded Xbox/PlayStation-style and custom touch control layouts, including dual analog input and editable menu buttons.
- Improved the online player-name prompt and retained the original in-game online menu with room codes. Removed the extra floating ONLINE shortcut; Enter/Start is retained.
- Updated automatic 60 FPS menu / 30 FPS low-end combat pacing, frame-time statistics and CPU/network diagnostics. Actual performance depends on the device and scene.
- Reduced repeated missing-file lookups and refined online input waiting and delay handling.
- Updated the public relay connection handshake and corrected misleading password errors and repeated connection attempts after rejection.
- Included experimental, opt-in rollback support. It is not certified for stable cross-device play and respects the relay's rollback permission.

Existing saves, the built-in ISO/XISO extractor, gamepad support, English/Portuguese/Spanish interfaces and asynchronous Vulkan rendering are retained.

## Important online notice

releases.name: Def Jam v1.1 — The Online Update
releases.body:
The Online Update brings online play, more flexible controls and focused performance improvements to Def Jam on Android.

## Added
- Integrated FFNY Online lobby, public rooms, room codes, fighter selection and arena voting.
- Spanish interface alongside English and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Editable menu controls: move and resize A, B, the grouped D-pad and Enter/Start, with individual opacity settings.
- An always-visible ONLINE shortcut with editable position, size and opacity.

## Fixed and improved
- Fixed touch controls remaining hidden after a gamepad is disconnected.
- Touch controls stay visible during online sessions; the 15-second inactivity timeout applies offline. The ONLINE shortcut stays visible in both modes.
- Improved access to the built-in Xbox ISO/XISO extractor on smaller screens.
- Vulkan synchronization fixes for Mali devices, including the presentation and gamma/FXAA paths.
- Reduced repeated Vulkan pipeline lookups, diagnostic clock reads and temporary touch-input allocations. Actual FPS gains depend on the device and scene.

releases.name: Copperline 1.1.0
releases.body:
Copperline 1.1.0 is the first feature release of the 1.x series. Hard drives can now run at the speed of the period drives each Amiga shipped with. The MMU-less 68EC030, 68EC040 and 68EC060 are new CPU choices. The JIT is much faster on fast-RAM code and heavy disk I/O, and has a new "fastest" speed. A500 CIA, interrupt and bus timing are corrected against measurements of a real A500. It also includes every fix made on the 1.x branch since 1.0.1.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.1.0.** Players and spectators need the same build.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version.
- **Desktop save states from 1.0.x still load.** The CIA chunks are migrated to their new layout. A resumed 1.0.x state continues under the corrected timing, so it can drift from what 1.0.x would have produced (a factory A500 state from 1.0.1 still renders byte-identical frames). States saved by 1.1.0 do not load in 1.0.x, which reports that the state comes from a newer Copperline.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.1
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.1 is the first maintenance release for 1.0. Most of it fixes problems reported against 1.0.0: an AGA display fetch error, a blitter race on fast CPUs, warm reboots on the A3000 and A4000, the 68060 FPU at reset, the copperhf hard-disk driver, and a window-resize hang on Windows. Menu settings are now remembered between launches, and screenshots save the picture as you see it.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.1.** Players and spectators need the same build.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files still load: the save-state format has not changed, and a 1.0.0 state resumes byte-for-byte as it does in 1.0.0.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0
releases.body:
Copperline 1.0.0 is the first stable release. It follows two weeks of testing of 1.0.0-rc.1 and is the 23rd release since the source went public on 14 June.

This release adds Smart framing and native 1:1 screenshots, more control over where and how the window opens, VHD hard-disk images, a fix for AGA sprites that use scan-doubling, and a Check for updates button that only contacts GitHub when you press it.

## Copperline 1.0 at a glance

- **Machines:** A1000, A500, A500+, A600, A1200, A3000, A4000, CDTV and CD32, with OCS, ECS and AGA chipsets and 68000 to 68060 CPUs, FPUs and MMUs.
- **Accuracy:** the CPU and custom chips run on one colour-clock timeline, with the chip bus shared out cycle by cycle. Timing is checked against a real A1200, A4000 and CD32, and 45 test programs are compared pixel for pixel on every change.
- **Ready to run:** the open AROS ROM is bundled, as are ROMs for the A2091, A4091 and IDE boards, the CD32 FMV module and the HRTMon freezer. WHDLoad packages and Amiga programs boot directly.

releases.name: Copperline 1.0.0-rc.1: the first release candidate for 1.0
releases.body:
This is the first release candidate for Copperline 1.0. If testing does not turn up problems that need a second candidate, the next release will be 1.0.0.

This cycle brings three- and four-player netplay on the desktop, debugger watchpoints on device registers with a timed trace of CD32 drive commands, a refreshed AROS ROM, and a review of the whole manual against the program, which also found and fixed a few mismatches in the program itself.

Please try your usual games, demos and configurations with it. Anything that worked in 0.21.0 and does not work here is exactly what a release candidate is for: [open an issue](https://github.com/CopperlineHQ/Copperline/issues) with the configuration and the software involved.

## Before upgrading

- **Netplay peers must all run 1.0.0-rc.1.** The wire protocol moved to version 3 to carry up to four players, so a 0.21.0 peer cannot join.
- **Recreate RetroArch save states after updating the core.** The core's states carry a build fingerprint that includes the release version. Desktop `.clstate` files from 0.20.0 and 0.21.0 still load; states from 0.19 and earlier do not.

emulators.latest_body:
## 1.2.14 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Scenes made of many small pieces run much faster. A game that draws lots
  of small triangle strips one after another has them drawn as one, and each
  draw uploads only the shader constants it uses. 007 Everything or
  Nothing's first level, looking at the courtyard, went from 38 to about 135
  fps uncapped on a fast PC, and at Original it now holds 30 where it
  dropped to 13 (#429).
- Interrupts reach the emulated CPU with a single memory write instead of a
  call into Windows, which made every game's interrupts cheaper.
- Uncapped games that show a frame every second vblank no longer wait on
  Windows' timer between the two, which can't wait less than half a
  millisecond.
- Unlocked on a 120 Hz or faster display (VRR or not): a frame that comes
  late is shown at once instead of waiting for the display's next refresh.

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: Spyro A Hero's Tail ran at 64.5 fps at Up to 60. The
  limit followed a vsync grid that slowly moved back, and the display's
  refresh period could be measured as a fraction of the real one. Frames are
  now counted against the display's refreshes (#430).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.13
releases.body:
## 1.2.13 (2026-11)

A cleanup and optimization release: the same emulator, with less code.

### Changes
- The code is cleaned of everything that no longer served: the paths for
  platforms xbased doesn't run on, the workarounds for graphics drivers no PC
  has, old files, and functions nothing called any more. About 8,000 lines of
  code less, the executable a little smaller, and nothing that changes how
  games run.
- Depth buffers are created only with the uses they have, which leaves the
  driver more room to compress them.
- The debug switches (props.ini) are read by one piece of code on Windows and
  Linux alike.
- The source repository is tidier: README, BUILDING and CHANGELOG at its root,
  the build steps in one place, and every library built in listed with its
  license.

### Fixes
- The Linux build compiles without warnings on Ubuntu 22.04 (a few
  declarations its C library doesn't have).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.12
releases.body:
## 1.2.12 (2026-11)

### New
- Downsampling (Settings > Video > Downsampling: Off, 1x, 2x, 4x): the game
  is drawn at the internal resolution, then the picture is averaged down to
  the console's own resolution, or twice or four times it, before it's scaled
  to your screen. Smooth edges with the original look. It needs an internal
  resolution above the size chosen, and works with FXAA, FSR and the CRT look
  (#427).

### Fixes
- Fable The Lost Chapters: the hero's hair could turn into streaks up close
  after some area loads, until the next restart. The game builds the hero's
  look into a cache on the hard disk at each load, and a piece of it drawn
  where a swizzled texture of the same size had been landed in the wrong
  pixel order (#380).
- Savestates: a state made from a .chd loads from an .iso of the same dump
  and the other way round, and a state that is refused says why in the log.
- Frame rate limit: with the GPU maxed out (a high internal resolution on a
  laptop) the frame rate could drift above the limit, 64 fps at Up to 60 in
  Crash Bandicoot The Wrath of Cortex. The moments the presenter picks frames

releases.name: xbased 1.2.11
releases.body:
## 1.2.11 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: games that keep three frames ready, like Crash Bandicoot
  The Wrath of Cortex, could go over the limit on a busy PC (64-65 fps at
  Up to 60 on a laptop). Right after a frame went through, a second one could
  be let through a millisecond later before the emulated GPU had moved on
  (#411).
- Games that flip in their own interrupt handler, like Star Wars Republic
  Commando, went about one frame a second over the limit (61 fps at Up to 60):
  a frame they flipped outside that handler didn't count against it.

releases.name: xbased 1.2.10
releases.body:
## 1.2.10 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Glow and blur effects at higher resolutions: a game's blur passes, which
  sample a target at offsets of one pixel of the console's resolution, now
  run at the console's resolution, so above 1x they blur instead of breaking
  into copies. Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow's goggles had a grid of green
  dots round them instead of a soft halo (#412, #421).
- SoulCalibur II after loading a state: the picture went softer and slower.
  A frame buffer taller than the screen came back from the state shorter than
  it is, and the game's final filter, which reads all of it, went through
  memory at the console's resolution every frame (#418).
- Dead or Alive 3 kept its 16:9 picture only until a state was loaded, which
  brought it back in 4:3. Its shape is now read from the game at boot as well.

### Controls
- Pressure modifier: a new input under each player's buttons. While it's held,
  A, B, X, Y, Black and White are pressed at the amount set in the controller
  settings (50% by default), for games that read how hard the face buttons
  are pressed, like Metal Gear Solid 2 (#420).
- A trigger assigned to a face button presses it as far as the trigger goes,

# Notas de la Versión — ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1 (Oficial)

## 🚀 Resumen de la Versión 1.1 (2026-11-02) — Despliegue Móvil Autónomo 1-Tap (Cero PC / Cero Cables)

**ProjectJaina-Imito v1.1** introduce la arquitectura de instalación completamente autónoma para smartphones y tabletas Android, eliminando al 100% la necesidad de ordenadores, cables USB y depuración ADB:

1. **Preset Soberano Embebido:** La APK incorpora la preconfiguración oficial de Project Jaina en español (`Project Jaina - Datos del Juego`), con la URL directa de Internet Archive precargada y botón de acción directa `[Descargar Juego]`.
2. **Streaming por Rangos HTTP 206:** Integración con el motor de streaming nativo de WoW-Imito (`RemoteZipChannel` + `PublicZipInstaller`), desempaquetando los 16.23 GB directamente en el almacenamiento interno sin requerir duplicación de espacio (ahorro de 16 GB en el teléfono).
3. **Resistencia a Caídas y Descarga en Segundo Plano:** La descarga corre mediante `ForegroundService` con `WakeLock`, permitiendo apagar la pantalla o minimizar la app sin interrumpir la transferencia, con capacidad de reanudación automática ante pérdidas temporales de conexión Wi-Fi.

releases.body:
## New here? Install Tessera in 3 steps

Tessera runs Linux desktop apps (GIMP, LibreOffice, Firefox, VS Code and thousands more) on your Android phone, each in its own window. No root needed.

1. **Download [tessera-v0.8.0.apk](https://github.com/daryan044/tessera-linux/releases/download/v0.8.0/tessera-v0.8.0.apk)** (also listed under **Assets** at the bottom of this release; the "Source code" files are not the app).
2. **Open the downloaded file and install it.** Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager: allow it. It may also warn that the app isn't from Google Play; Tessera can't be on Play by design.
3. **Open Tessera → Setup → install Debian** (a few GB of free space), then pick apps in the **Store**.

Needs Android 7 or newer on a 64-bit (arm64) phone. Tessera is in alpha: if something doesn't work, Setup → **Copy diagnostics** and [open an issue](https://github.com/daryan044/tessera-linux/issues).

---

### What's changed in 0.8.0

This release is mostly your reports and requests. Thank you, all of you; you're named next to what you asked for.

emulators.name: DOSBox Wii
emulators.description: DOSBox 的 GameCube 与 Wii 移植。
emulators.latest_body: * **Start straight into a game (Wii).** Name a game when you launch DOSBox Wii and it starts with that game's config on top of `dosbox.conf`: from the Homebrew Channel (`<arguments>` in `meta.xml`) or from WiiFlow, either as a plugin (the zip now includes `wiiflow/plugins/dosbox-wii.ini`, which lists the `.conf` files in `DOSBox/Games` as games) or from its Homebrew list. A game can be named as `-gameconf <conf or folder>`, as a bare `.conf`, or as a bare folder that holds one (`autoboot.conf`, or its only `.conf`). A relative name is looked for as written, beside the launched `boot.dol`, then in the `DOSBox` folder, so a game's `.conf`, `.map` and files can all live in one folder, anywhere. If the game cannot be found DOSBox starts without one and says why on the DOS screen. The **Status** page has an **Autoboot** row, and the app now knows it was started this way (`IsAutoboot()`), ready for a single-game menu later. See the README's *Starting a game at launch*

releases.name: 4.0.4 - November 3, 2026
releases.body:
## 4.0.4 - November 3, 2026
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.
* **Redesigned Saves screen.** The Save, Load and Delete buttons are now a single **Saves** button. Snapshots fill a grid, with the game's **Cartridge Save** (shown only for games that have one) in its own card beneath. Choosing a card opens a small popover of what can be done with it; the save file's backups are listed from its popover. The Auto Load, Auto Save and Append Auto settings are replaced by a single **Save Mode**: **Snapshot** (the default), **Cartridge Save**, or **Manual**.

releases.name: 4.0.3 - October 20, 2026
releases.body:
* **New menu look!** The menus have been rebuilt with a fresh, modern style: a deeper red header and footer, cleaner rounded buttons with soft shadows, a redesigned game list with a slimmer scrollbar and a clear highlight on the selected entry, new prompt windows, and more. The menu graphics are now drawn procedurally by the renderer instead of being loaded from PNG images, so they stay sharp at any output resolution
* **New controller status bar** in the menu footer, replacing the Wiimote battery icons. Each of the four player slots (P1-P4) now shows the type of controller connected (Wiimote, GameCube controller, etc.), with the battery level shown for Wiimote controllers and the Gamepad. Empty slots appear dimmed
* Wii U: Japanese/Korean/Chinese fonts are now also found in `fceugx/` or `wiiu/apps/fceugx/` on the SD card even before settings have been saved, and stay crisp at 1080p
* Wii U: fix texture reuse causing cover art issues with varying image sizes

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-8
releases.body:
**省流：** 新增设置内的中英文切换，默认中文；修复观片台长按拖选和启动兼容问题，补齐性能测试、处理队列及大图尺寸提示。

内部安装版本码递增为 **128**，沿用原发布签名。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

- 设置中选择中文或 English，立即更新界面，保留当前照片、配方与编辑；重启后记住语言。胶卷、风格和参数搜索支持中英文名称。修复启动时过早访问 Activity 主题导致的崩溃，并回归首次启动与已有状态恢复。
- 观片台长按按实际触点选中照片；松手不再撤销选择。跨行拖选提前消费移动事件，避免首个大幅垂直移动被滚动抢走；保留普通滑动、边缘自动滚动和双指缩放。
- 性能测试直接在设置里显示首次预览、换风格、导出和建议。系统不允许读取峰值 RSS 时，增加独立的阶段采样 PSS 增量，注明可能漏掉峰值，并说明尺寸建议未按峰值内存筛选。采样放在计时渲染段之外，不替换内存准入规则。
- 处理队列在空闲时显示正确状态，区分已保存与已取消；明确重启后保留最近 30 条已结束记录，清除记录不会删除相册照片。工作尺寸和缩图提示说明设置、GPU、内存的共同上限，保留用户原尺寸选择。
- HEIF 主图 EXIF 尺寸与实际输出一致；外部文件重复打开走现有 Activity，文件提供器的异步读取可取消。JNI 在取消检查完成前继续持有显示像素，避免失败路径提前释放。
- `.spklook` 导入统一限制解压总量，未知条目、重复条目和目录内的附带数据也计入预算，避免跳过条目时继续无限解压；正常风格、色表与缩略图格式保持兼容。

11 月 14–15 日 Xiaomi 13 Ultra / Android 16 的候选版本实测覆盖中英文重启、观片台拖选、批量导出、JPEG / TIFF / HEIF、后台保存、取消重试及 24 MP 合成输入。该设备实测单缓冲上限 128 MiB，大图实际工作尺寸为 3547×2364；不是全尺寸 24 MP 成片。最后一个实测候选为 `c4a45e5`，本次新增 PSS 采样和队列文案在手机拔出后以云端回归验证，尚未再次安装真机。

发布由完整云端构建、JVM / 界面回归、RAW 与 Vulkan 数值检查、原发布证书和 16 KiB 对齐检查把关。既有实测数据见 [扩展真机记录](docs/ALPHA8_EXPANDED_DEVICE_2026-11-14.md)，最终审计与发布验证见 [Alpha 8 发布记录](docs/ALPHA8_RELEASE_2026-11-15.md)。

releases.name: beta 0.5
releases.body:
Mobile Odyssey 0.5 (beta)

this patch was more or less a bug fix update, with some small optimizations:

There are two APKs. odyssey-0.5.apk is for most phones. odyssey-0.5-armv8.0.apk is for phones with older processors, and the launcher tells you if you need it. Install it over your current version. Your save and settings stay, and so do the graphics your phone already built. Uninstalling first deletes those, and the game then has to build them again, which means a long first start and stutters the first time you visit each area.

Loading screens that never ended after a door, a pipe or starting a new game are fixed.

The game no longer crashes when you enter Shiveria Town in the Snow Kingdom.

The game no longer freezes right after the first frog capture in Cap Kingdom, and that cutscene no longer stops on one picture with frame generation on.

The intro cutscene has its proper lighting again with frame generation on or with steady speed under 60 fps.

The game uses about 1.3 GB less memory, which helps phones with 8 GB of RAM or less, this can vary depending on the device

releases.name: beta 0.4
releases.body:
new update fellas:D this one brings more optimization and bug fixes

Mobile Odyssey 0.4 (beta)

There are two APKs. odyssey-0.4.apk is for most phones (ARMv8.2 or newer). odyssey-0.4-armv8.0.apk is for phones with older processors (ARMv8.0 or 8.1), and the launcher tells you if you need it. Both install over 0.3, and your save and settings stay

added Frame generation: makes an extra frame after each real one, so the game shows 60 frames a second while running at 30. It looks smoother but with the latency of 30. You can set it to Off, On or Auto in the launcher or the in-game menu. Auto only turns it on when your phone can't hold 60 but can keep up with frame generation. The motion comes from the game's own camera and objects, so the extra frames line up well with the real ones. This ran pretty well for me but might be troublesome for older phones, so use Fast quality for it to run a bit better.

Frame generation also has a quality setting. High gives Mario, enemies and other moving objects their own motion. Fast follows only the camera and is meant for slower GPUs

releases.name: beta 3.0
releases.body:
Beta 0.3

This update focuses on speed. On my Galaxy S24 Ultra (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3) Cascade now runs at about 58-60 fps, a pretty good improvement from about 44 in 0.2. On a tester’s Xiaomi with a Dimensity 8300 (Mali-G615) it runs at about 40 fps, fairly stable, with no graphical issues. Your results will likely be different, since it depends a lot on your phone.

What’s new:

Mali phones should see one of the biggest changes: the GPU doesnt sit idle waiting for the CPU anymore, so the game uses about 1 GB less memory now

A new “Preparing graphics” progress bar on game starts, instead of the frozen Joy-Con screen. (as always this will take a hot second if its your first launch, give it a minute to build the cache, and any launch after that should be MUCH faster.

the new Steady game speed:D, replacement of the original 30 fps option,now its  an option that keeps the game at normal speed at ANY fps below 60 fps. This means you can run the game at any fps and the game will NOT run in slow motion, as long as you enable it.
(its still recomended that you cap the fps to something you can consistantly hit)

releases.name: beta 0.2
releases.body:
the second release, big imrpvoement for the 60 fps mode, and Mali phones finally look right.

**Performance (my S24 Ultra, phone's own driver)**
- 60 fps mode: 60 fps in small and medium areas, 40-45ish in some heavy areas
- 30 fps mode: full speed, holds 30 most of the time

**What's new**
- Much better fps in the 60 fps mode in my tests, though the picture gets softer when the game lowers its render size
- Mali visual errors fixed on the one phone we've tested so far (thanks u/CAPELINI_W). Other Mali phones are untested
- New default settings on fresh installs. They run faster but make the phone warmer

**Updating from 0.1?** Install it over 0.1. Your old settings stay, so to get the speedup set these in Graphics: Presentation **Mailbox**, CPU boost **Always**, Custom scale **100%**, Anti-aliasing **FXAA**, Sharpening **75%**. The first start rebuilds the shaders, so expect one slow load.

You still need your own copy of the game (1.0.0) and `prod.keys`.

Thanks to u/zzzarathustra-dev ([Power Moon Recomp](https://gitlab.com/zzzarathustra-dev/power-moon-recomp)) and peiikai ([LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)) for the findings and optimizations we borrowed.

releases.name: beta 0.1
releases.body: the first release gentlemen. again performance is ass compared to emulating it on a snapdragon, but i would say its good enough to be playable (for my 8gen3,fps was  60-35ish depending on the scene, please report any issues via github or by dming me on discord, holdup.lethimcook

releases.name: v0.2.25
releases.body:
Xbox button layout for controllers.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Controller face buttons": "As on Switch" (as before) or "By letter (Xbox: A = A)" (#36, #40). By letter, the button printed A works as A and the one printed X as X. Applies at once, no restart; the pause menu follows it. The on-screen touch buttons do not change.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.25-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- ⚙ → «Кнопки A/B/X/Y геймпада»: «Как на Switch» (как раньше) или «По буквам (Xbox: A = A)» (#36, #40). По буквам кнопка с надписью A работает как A, с надписью X — как X. Срабатывает сразу, без перезапуска; меню паузы тоже следует выбору. Экранные сенсорные кнопки не меняются.

**Установка:** ставится поверх любой прошлой версии, сохранения остаются; setup заново запускать не нужно. Android 10 или 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.25-arm64-android10.apk`.

## 简体中文

**新增**
- ⚙ →“手柄 A/B/X/Y 键”：“同 Switch”（与之前相同）或“按字母（Xbox：A = A）”（#36、#40）。按字母时，印着 A 的键就是 A，印着 X 的键就是 X。立即生效，无需重启；暂停菜单也随之改变。屏幕上的触控按键不变。

releases.name: v0.2.24
releases.body:
Text input fix, frame output setting, lighter textures on Mali and PowerVR.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Frame output on its own thread": Auto / On / Off (applies on next launch). Auto works as in 0.2.22: on, and switched off by itself only if that thread really crashes twice. The phone closing the game to save battery does not count.

**Fixed**
- Naming a hero: OK no longer stays grey with "finish choosing characters" while the cursor is at the end of the name (Gboard, SwiftKey and other Latin keyboards).

**Improved**
- Mali and PowerVR phones: textures are unpacked on the GPU with a checked decoder and kept in a compact format, so they take less video memory. Nothing changes on Snapdragon (Adreno).
- If the graphics driver fails, the log now says why, which helps fix such crashes.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.24-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**

releases.name: v0.2.23
releases.body:
Faster drawing on Mali and PowerVR.

## English

**Improved**
- Mali and PowerVR phones: the lighter way of drawing from the test build 0.2.11-test4 is now in the release (#4). The GPU skips saving and reloading parts of the frame nobody needs and waits less between drawing steps. Testers on Helio G99 and Dimensity 7050 went from about 30 to 45–60 fps. Nothing changes on Snapdragon (Adreno).
- Everything from 0.2.22 stays: camera zoom-out, LAN play, the newer drivers.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.23-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Улучшено**
- Телефоны на Mali и PowerVR: более лёгкая отрисовка из тестовой сборки 0.2.11-test4 теперь в релизе (#4). Видеокарта не сохраняет и не перечитывает ненужные части кадра и меньше ждёт между этапами отрисовки. У тестеров на Helio G99 и Dimensity 7050 было около 30 fps, стало 45–60. На Snapdragon (Adreno) ничего не меняется.
- Всё из 0.2.22 на месте: отдаление камеры, игра по локальной сети, новые драйверы.

releases.name: v0.2.22
releases.body:
Camera zoom-out, smoother frame delivery.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Camera zoom-out" (100–140 %, changes live): moves the camera back to show more around the hero, at the same angle; the interface keeps its size (#31). 100 % = as on the Switch, about 120 % = as far as on the PC. More of the world on the screen means more GPU load.

**Improved**
- Frames are handed to the screen on a separate thread, so the game's main graphics thread has more time for the next frame. This helps most where the CPU is the limit (a hot phone, slower CPUs). If this ever makes the game crash, the port switches it off by itself after the second such crash.
- A fix for how the game's threads end.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.22-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- ⚙ → «Отдаление камеры» (100–140 %, меняется сразу): камера отъезжает назад, и вокруг героя видно больше, угол тот же; интерфейс прежнего размера (#31). 100 % — как на Switch, около 120 % — как на ПК. Чем больше мира на экране, тем выше нагрузка на GPU.

**Улучшено**

releases.name: v0.2.21
releases.body:
Damaged game files are found and named, a slightly faster graphics engine.

## English

**New**
- If the game crashed before the picture appeared, the next start checks the game files once (up to a minute, with progress on screen). A file of the right size but with damaged contents (usually a bad copy to the phone) is named on the screen, so you know which one to copy again (#33). The check runs only after such a crash, and files that passed are not checked again.

**Improved**
- The graphics engine is built with stronger optimization: a little less CPU time per frame.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.21-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- Если игра вылетела до появления картинки, при следующем запуске она один раз проверяет файлы игры (до минуты, проценты на экране). Файл правильного размера, но с испорченным содержимым (обычно из-за неудачного копирования на телефон), будет назван на экране — понятно, какой перекопировать (#33). Проверка запускается только после такого вылета, прошедшие её файлы повторно не проверяются.

**Улучшено**

releases.body:

releases.name: v0.5.6
releases.body:
## English

**New**
- Upscaling to your screen resolution now uses AMD FSR 1 instead of GSR: a cleaner, sharper picture (#44). With sharpening on, it sharpens after upscaling, at the screen resolution.
- Experimental: SGSR 2, a temporal upscaler. It builds the picture from several frames at your screen resolution, for finer detail on edges and distant objects. Two options: at the normal 3D resolution, or at 75 % 3D resolution for more FPS.
- The gear (⚙) has one choice "Upscale to screen resolution": Off / FSR 1 / SGSR 2 / SGSR 2 at 3D 75 %. If you had the old upscale box on, you get FSR 1.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `DOOM-Mobile-v0.5.6-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- Масштабирование до разрешения экрана теперь работает через AMD FSR 1 вместо GSR: картинка чище и чётче (#44). С включённой резкостью она применяется после увеличения, уже на разрешении экрана.
- Экспериментально: SGSR 2, временной апскейлер. Собирает картинку из нескольких кадров в разрешении экрана — тоньше детали на краях и вдали. Два варианта: при обычном разрешении 3D или при 75 % для большего FPS.

>
> **Тестовая сборка для issue #45 (Samsung Xclipse с драйвером RADV-Xclipse). Это не обычный релиз.** Если у вас не Xclipse, оставайтесь на [v0.5.5](https://github.com/Desm0nt/doom-port/releases/tag/v0.5.5).

## English

- RADV-Xclipse: five different tries at fixing the smeared level textures (#45).
- On Xclipse phones the pause menu has a red row "RADV test: N of 5". Each tap asks for confirmation, then the game restarts itself with the next try.

**How to test:** pick RADV-Xclipse 1.9 in the gear (⚙) and load your save. Open the pause menu and tap the red row: the game restarts with test 1. Continue from your save and check if the smears are gone. Then tap the row again for test 2, and so on up to 5. Tell us in #45 which numbers fixed it (if any), and send `boot.log` and `boot-<driver>.log` from `Download/DOOM Mobile/logs`.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `DOOM-Mobile-v0.5.5-test1-arm64-android10.apk`.

releases.name: v0.5.5
releases.body:
## English

**New**
- Frame rate limit 40 and 45 in the gear (⚙) (#36). 40 shows up on phones with a 120 Hz (or 40 Hz) screen mode, 45 on phones with 90 Hz; both run perfectly even there. On a screen without a 90 Hz mode, 45 is listed as "45 (uneven)": frames come a little unevenly, but the phone runs cooler and the battery lasts longer.

**Fixes**
- When a custom Vulkan driver fails and the game switches back to the system one, the message is now a window with an OK button. On Android 12+ the old short message was cut to two lines and a long driver name hid the important part.
- Small stability improvements in the graphics core.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `DOOM-Mobile-v0.5.5-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- Ограничение частоты кадров 40 и 45 в шестерёнке (⚙) (#36). 40 появляется на телефонах с режимом экрана 120 Гц (или 40 Гц), 45 — с режимом 90 Гц; там они идут идеально ровно. На экране без режима 90 Гц пункт называется «45 (неровно)»: кадры идут чуть неравномерно, зато телефон меньше греется и дольше держит батарея.

**Исправления**

releases.name: v0.1.13
releases.body:
Turnip drivers on more Adreno phones.

## English

**Fixes**
- On some newer Snapdragon chips (for example the Retroid Pocket G2) the Turnip drivers were hidden and even deleted, because the phone reports its GPU with a short two-digit name. They now show up, and the bundled Turnip is picked by default there. Thanks to danjaniell for this one!

**New**
- Driver manager: **Allow drivers this phone does not support**. Off by default. With it on, a driver the app thinks won't fit is still installed and offered in the list, with the reason next to its name. If the game fails to start twice with such a driver, the system driver comes back on its own.

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.13-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Исправления**

releases.name: v0.1.12
releases.body:
More memory for big mod setups, Brazilian Portuguese and Polish text.

## English

**Fixes**
- The game could crash when entering a big zone (for example The Temple Steppes) with several large mods together, such as TL2-ACE with CLASSES_FULL. It only had as much memory as on the Switch. Now it gets as much as your phone can spare: all RAM minus 3 GB for Android, up to 6 GB (was about 3 GB). Memory the game doesn't use is not taken from the phone.
- The game is now in Brazilian Portuguese or Polish when your phone uses that language (before it fell back to English). You can also pick any of the game's 11 languages under **Game language** in the ⚙ menu.
- Includes v0.1.11: skill trees now show up for classes from mods like SYNERGIES. Thanks to danjaniell!

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.12-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Исправления**

Skill trees for more modded classes.

## English

**Fixes**
- Classes from some mods (for example SYNERGIES) opened an empty skill menu. Their skill trees now show up. In a few SYNERGIES classes (Ranger, Necromancer) a tab may carry another tree's name, but the skills in each tree are right. Thanks to danjaniell for this one!

**Note:** on the first start after the update your mods are converted once more, so that start takes a little longer.

releases.name: v0.1.10
releases.body:
Character list fix for modded classes, game folder on an SD card.

## English

**Fixes**
- The game closed when you chose "Change Character" or "Manage Characters" in the main menu while one of your characters was of a class added by a mod. Now both screens open; such a character shows the Outlander's portrait in the list.

**New**
- The game folder can now be on an SD card or a USB drive, not only in Download on internal storage. The app looks for `Download/Torchlight2Mobile` (and `Torchlight2Mobile` at the root) on every storage, internal first. You can also pick the folder yourself under **Game folder** in the ⚙ menu, or on the error screen when no game files are found. A card is slower than internal storage, so levels load longer from it. Thanks to danjaniell for this one!

**Install:** update the APK over the old one, your saves stay. No need to re-run setup. New install: prepare the game folder with setup from this repository (base game + update v327680 + prod.keys, see docs/INSTALL.md), copy Torchlight2Mobile to the phone's Download folder, install the APK. Android 10 or 11: `Torchlight2-Mobile-v0.1.10-arm64-android10.apk`.

**Исправления**

- The OK button in the text input window stayed grey ("finish choosing characters on the keyboard first") while the cursor was at the end of the name. Now OK takes the name as typed.

releases.body:
**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed an AGA bug affecting invalid dual-playfield modes (#1039).
- Fixed the A1200 and A1000 configuration schemes, which failed to set up the bank map correctly (#1037).
- Fixed a bug in `Texture::clear` that caused the specified offset to be applied twice (#1036).
- Disabled the logic analyzer by default to avoid unnecessary performance overhead.

**Enhancements**

- Removed the navigator console from RetroShell (#1040).
- Made gamma correction parameters configurable (#1035).
- Added an experimental MCP server.

This release finalizes the 5.0 series.

Emulation accuracy
- New option CPU_START_DELAY staggers the CPU start relative to the beam. Without it, some memory configurations always hit a timing race in Kickstart 1.3’s PAL/NTSC detection (#1029).
- Reinstated the ADF track-length fix that had been dropped by mistake (#1021).

Usability
- Improved auto-warp condition (#1008).
- “Close unsaved instances without asking” now works reliably.
- Choosing the Performance preset no longer wipes the saved collision-detection defaults.

Under the hood
- Public API cleanup
- Detailed API documentation at https://dirkwhoffmann.github.io/vAmiga/docs/index.html

Enhancements: 
- Moira now emulates the 68020 instruction cache.

Bug fixes:
- Improved AGA support (#999, #1003, #1004, #1009, #1011, #1012, #1013).

New features: 
- AGA support

# Release Notes

## Enhancements

- The floppy disk API now supports disk images stored in memory buffers (#992)
- Added proper gamma correction to the palette builders (#998)
- Replaced the 4096-entry palette lookup table with a smaller table based on an affine transformation, paving the way for AGA support.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the server launch daemon to fire every cycle (#990)
- Fixed a bug that prevented preferences from loading correctly (#995)
- Added guard checks for potential Swift `nil` values
- Fixed a bug in the **Export to…** menu (#989)
- Reverted pull request #837 (#984)

releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

## DK64 Recompiled — APK Android 1.0.3-android

APK **release assinado** (arm64-v8a), compilado pelo workflow `release` no commit `7edb0f7` (`fix/first-launch-crash`).

---

## O que mudou nesta branch (`fix/first-launch-crash`)

### Corrigido o crash na 1ª inicialização (selecionar ROM + Start Game fechava o app)
Na primeira execução do app, depois de selecionar a ROM e tocar em **Start Game**, o app fechava sozinho; na segunda inicialização funcionava perfeitamente. Causa raiz multi-fator, todas eliminadas:

- **Ciclo do seletor de ROM quebrava a sessão gráfica**: ao abrir o seletor (DocumentsUI), a surface Vulkan era destruída/recriada e a fila de present ficava congelada — o **Start Game** na MESMA sessão rodava em estado frágil (por isso o processo limpo da 2ª execução funcionava). Agora, após a ROM ser selecionada, **o app reinicia sozinho** (~1,5 s, o mesmo mecanismo do menu de GPU Driver) e o Start Game roda num processo limpo, com a Vulkan inicializada apenas 1× por processo.

releases.body:
## Novidades — 1.0.3-android

Resumo do que foi feito nos commits da branch `fix/mod-file-picker-saf`:

### 🎮 Gamepad virtual — redesign completo ("dark glass" + identidade N64)
- Novo visual em **vidro escuro** com gradientes, sombras suaves e contornos finos — fim dos halos planos.
- **Identidade de cor por botão** como no hardware do N64: A azul, B verde, C amarelo, START vermelho; botões neutros acendem no verde-banana do DK64 ao serem pressionados.
- Feedback de toque com qualidade: o botão **afunda** e acende com glow radial, animações suaves de pressionar/soltar e o HUD entra/sai com fade + deslize.
- **Ergonomia**: áreas de toque generosas com prioridade por proximidade, histerese de saída (deslizar o dedo para fora solta o botão — mata "ghost press"), stick com zona morta reescalada, retorno animado do knob e menor latência de toque.
- **Correções de robustez**: o pad aparece sozinho quando o jogo inicia e reaparece se a Activity for recriada (novo acesso nativo `is_game_started`); controles respeitam a área do recorte (cutout) da tela; a escolha de esconder o HUD fica salva.

releases.name: DolphinVR Redux v0.5 - The Fall Update
releases.body:
DolphinVR Redux v0.5 brings VR game patches, which put your hands and your head into the games themselves, an in-game menu you use without taking the headset off, a large round of Meta Quest performance work, and automatic updates on Windows.

## Highlights

- **VR game patches.** The arm cannon follows your controller in the Metroid Prime games, the gun and sword follow it in Red Steel 1 and 2, Skyward Sword reads your controller's true pose, and Twilight Princess, The Wind Waker, Wii Sports and Shadow the Hedgehog can be played in first person.
- **An in-game VR menu.** Click the left thumbstick during a game to pause, fast forward, change settings, rebind controls, manage savestates and hunt overrides, all inside the headset.
- **Faster on Meta Quest.** Super Mario Galaxy went from 42 to 60 fps and Super Mario Sunshine from 49 to 60 fps at native resolution in my tests with "Smart Foveation EFB".
- **Automatic updates on Windows.** This is the first version that updates itself. See "Installing" below.
- **Rebased on the latest Dolphin** development builds (October 2026).

## VR game patches

releases.name: DolphinVR Redux v0.4 — The Summer Update
releases.body:
DolphinVR Redux v0.4 introduces new graphics backends, major OpenXR improvements, Meta Quest passthrough support, expanded VR configuration tools, and a wide range of rendering and stability fixes.

Highlights

- Added DirectX 12 and OpenGL renderer support.
- Added OpenXR asynchronous mode for Vulkan and DirectX 12.
- Added passthrough support for Meta Quest headsets.
- Added foveated rendering to improve performance on Quest.
- Introduced a new VR configuration panel for binding controls directly in VR.
- Improved the Texture Override, Hide Code, and Shader Hunter tools.


OpenXR and VR

- Added OpenXR asynchronous mode for Vulkan and DirectX 12.
- Added an eager frame heartbeat for native VR frame-rate operation.
- Added a new VR configuration panel for controller bindings.
- Added new camera and controller anchor overrides.
- Added a new "Screen pane" override.
- Updated the Wiimote pointer to use absolute pointing.
- Fixed Wii MotionPlus gyroscope behavior.

Meta Quest

- Added passthrough support for Meta Quest headsets.
- Added foveated rendering to improve performance.
- Added a new first-launch screen for applying recommended Quest bindings.

releases.name: Dolphin VR Redux v0.3 — The Metroid Update
releases.body:
This update brings a major round of improvements, with a strong focus on Metroid Prime, element overrides, Vulkan rendering, and overall performance.

- All major Metroid Prime fixes from the 2016 DolphinVR-Hydra branch have now been ported and integrated, including: Detect Skybox, Remove Cinematic Bars, 3D HUD, Visor EFB Skips...

- These fixes have also been improved with additional work, such as the Layered Palette Conversion Path, which restores the thermal, X-Ray, dark, and scanner visor effects in Metroid Prime 1, 2, and 3

- Added Headlock HUD support for Metroid Prime Trilogy

- Fixed the Element Override Tool, which can now finally work with projection-based definition overrides

- Added a new Texture Element Override system that, unlike shader-based overrides, uses the texture hash to identify elements. It is easier to use and should remain persistent across versions

- Updated Vulkan with new fixes; it now uses full projection for every headset

- Improved performance through multiple bug fixes.

- Also includes an experimental release for Meta Quest 3 and Debian Linux

releases.name: Dolphin VR Redux v0.2 - Hotfix inputs
releases.body:
Removed /input/trigger/click and /input/squeeze/click from Oculus/Meta profiles that don't support them
Added FOCUSED session state tracking

releases.name: Dolphin VR Redux v0.2
releases.body:
- Improved VR controller support
- Added a VR input tester scene for OpenXR Wii Remote configuration when no game is running
- Updated the VR settings panel
- Added initial AR mode support by Clodo76
- Added a work-in-progress culling code finder
- Improved the Elements Hunting tool
- Force Immediately Present XFB is now disabled by default, with a new OpenXR toggle available
- Added a new Lock Head Pose Per Frame option for games that do not work properly with Immediately Present XFB, such as Zack & Wiki

releases.name: 1.4.0 test 3: Mangmi Air X Vulkan (pre-release)
releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** Made for the Mangmi Air X (Adreno 610) and other devices where "Vulkan could not be loaded" appears.

Some phones' graphics drivers advertise a debug extension (VK_EXT_debug_utils) without providing its functions. The app used to treat that as fatal and fall back to the slow OpenGL renderer. In this build that extension is optional, so Vulkan can start.

This build also contains the Retro Rewind login fix from test 2 (the game now waits up to 5 seconds for the login reply).

Install it over your current DriftDroid. Your settings and saves stay. Open the game, then press "Export Diagnostics" on the main screen and attach the zip, even if it works. If Vulkan still fails, the log shows what failed next.

It is built from commit f15608e. The Dawn change is not in the repository yet; it will be added as a patch file.

SHA-256: 17813ca5396f74759fac5d04396ceb353cc0cd5a18de51beb8a34fb380ab2ca5

releases.name: 1.4.0 login test 2 (pre-release)
releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** For people who got Retro Rewind error 20100 when going online. This replaces test 1, which did not work.

This is 1.4.0 with one change: when Retro Rewind logs in, the app now waits up to 5 seconds for the server's reply (before it gave up after a quarter of a second, which showed up as error 20100 on slower connections).

Install it over your current DriftDroid. Your settings and saves stay. Then try Online, and tell us whether it gets past the login. If it doesn't, press "Export Diagnostics" on the main screen and attach the zip.

Error 84020 or 94020 is a different problem (the game server not answering) and this build does not change it.

SHA-256: ac21c5ad08f6455d8454c483d85addf69d6ba7566b5ae795bf8aadccc462d755

releases.name: DriftDroid 1.4.0: a new settings menu, 14 languages, Retro Rewind 6.13.4, your own Switch icon
releases.body:
## DriftDroid 1.4.0: a new settings menu, 14 languages, Retro Rewind 6.13.4, your own Switch icon

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Android: no PC needed.** Install **DriftDroid-v1.4.0.apk** (over 1.3.0 if you have it: your saves, game data and Retro Rewind stay), open it and import your own Mario Kart Wii disc image (`.iso` or `.wbfs`) once, as before. The game code is included in the APK, the same as in 1.3.0; the game's own files (courses, music, textures) are never included: they always come from your own disc.
>
> **Switch needs a PC, once.** DriftDroid Builder (Windows or Linux) makes the Switch files from your own disc. It can also make an Android game pack with the newest Retro Rewind code (optional, see below).
>
> It was tested on a Huawei Nova 9 and a Nintendo Switch. The Windows version of the Builder was only tried under Wine (building for Android), and joining online rooms could not be tried on the day (see Known problems). If something breaks, please open an issue with **Export Diagnostics** attached.

### Setting up 1.4.0

**Android (no PC)**

1. Install **DriftDroid-v1.4.0.apk**.

emulators.latest_body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** Made for the Mangmi Air X (Adreno 610) and other devices where "Vulkan could not be loaded" appears.

Some phones' graphics drivers advertise a debug extension (VK_EXT_debug_utils) without providing its functions. The app used to treat that as fatal and fall back to the slow OpenGL renderer. In this build that extension is optional, so Vulkan can start.

This build also contains the Retro Rewind login fix from test 2 (the game now waits up to 5 seconds for the login reply).

Install it over your current DriftDroid. Your settings and saves stay. Open the game, then press "Export Diagnostics" on the main screen and attach the zip, even if it works. If Vulkan still fails, the log shows what failed next.

It is built from commit f15608e. The Dawn change is not in the repository yet; it will be added as a patch file.
