releases.body:
# Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1

A fixes-and-polish update to 1.2.

## ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
Uninstall the old version and install 1.2.1 fresh. Back up your game saves first (Save Manager, or copy them out of your container). Containers made on 1.2 are not carried over.

## Fixes for 1.2 user reports
- Fixed a reboot on some MediaTek Mali phones (JM Mali).
- Fixed a crash when opening a shortcut.
- Fixed the controller binding editor.
- Fixed the stutter when holding D-pad right.
- Fixed File Manager not opening (it needed `libcdio.dll`), and File Manager hanging on x86_64 Wine (replaced with Bannerlator's newer `wfm.exe` / `winhandler.exe`).

## Graphics and performance
- **Fullscreen modes:** Fit, Stretch, Fill and Integer, plus screen alignment (Center, Top, Bottom half), set per container or per game and changeable live in Display & Session.
- **EGL stripes fixed:** CPU writes into the window buffer are flushed per X batch.
- **ZeroFG:** the default multiplier is capped at the display refresh rate (40 fps on a 60 Hz screen now gives 1.5x instead of 2x with dropped frames).
- **Gladio:** refuses OpenGL contexts above 3.3 again; libGL stripped of debug info (1.48 MB to 488 KB).

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 Winlator Mali Bionic v1.2 is a major architectural overhaul over v1.1, introducing a native EGL rendering engine, ZeroFG Vulkan compute frame interpolation, a redesigned UI with Madeira Liquid Glass touch controls, two selectable BCn layers, hardware performance tools, kernel-direct telemetry, and a cloud-powered community configuration ecosystem. ⚠️ Reinstall Required!
🖥️ Native EGL Rendering Engine & Gladio Integration
  • High-Performance Native EGL Architecture: Migrated from the legacy v1.1 rendering stack (GLRenderer, DisplayX, VirGL, blit_converter, and Java EffectComposer) to Pipetto-crypto's native C++ EGL renderer at app/src/main/cpp/winlator/renderer/egl.cpp.
  • Elimination of Legacy Overhead: Removed the legacy DisplayX layer (displayx.cpp, DisplayXView), VirGL (VirGLRendererComponent), and blit_converter.cpp, eliminating over 3,500 lines of redundant CPU blit and synchronization code.

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.1
releases.body:
Winlator Mali Bionic v1.1

🚀 New Features

- Added Fake HDR.
- Added a Universal FPS Limiter.
- Added a Sharpness option.
- Added GTA V Optimization toggle in Shortcut Settings.
- Added DXVK Config toggle with built-in pre-made configuration presets.
- Automatically generates a dxvk.conf file for each container based on the selected preset.
- Added new DXVK versions.
- Added the new GameNative Vulkan Wrapper.
- Added new Box64 and FEX presets.

---

🎮 Unreal Engine 3 Preset

- Added a dedicated Unreal Engine 3 preset.
- Tested with X-Men Origins: Wolverine for improved compatibility and performance.

---

⚙️ Hybrid x86 FEXCore

- Added a custom Hybrid x86 FEXCore.

What does it do?

- Improves compatibility while maintaining high performance.
- Fixes physics issues in supported games that normally require x86 Reduced Precision to be completely disabled.

Why is it better?

Normally, disabling x86 Reduced Precision forces software emulation for all x86 code, which can significantly reduce performance.

Hybrid x86 only uses software emulation where it is actually needed (such as physics calculations), while allowing the rest of the game to run natively for much better performance.

releases.name: Winlator Mali Bionic 1.0 ( Updated Again )

- ETC2 Transcoding — Native ETC2 texture transcoding using a modified version of leegao's bcn_layer with improved performance, memory usage, and stability.
- Apex Frame Generation — Based on Motion Compute Frame Interpolator (MCFI), with additional implementation and optimizations for improved performance, stability, and compatibility. Apex also utilizes GPU resources alongside the game and may impact performance depending on your device.
- Advanced HUD — Enhanced in-game overlay based on Winlator Ludashi's HUD with additional refinements.
- Unified Control System — XInput, DInput, and Exclusive input modes have been unified into a single control system.
- Graphics Driver Manager — Install and manage Vulkan Wrappers and bcn_layer directly from local storage. User-installed drivers automatically take priority over bundled versions.

  characters Windows refuses) keeps `[<8 hex digits>]`. A second game with
  the same names, or a new revision of an image, gets its own copy,
  `<disk> [<8 hex digits>]`, instead of booting the first one's save. A copy

releases.body:
Android pre-release of OpenSmash Ultimate, built from commit 9a6f980 on the android-port branch.

**This APK does not contain the game.** Set up the game from your own Switch files on the device: base game (.nsp or .xci), update 13.0.4 / 13.0.5, prod.keys, and optional add-on content (.nsp or .xci). The port is still under test; most devices have not been tried.

What is new since pre.1:
- Setup and add-on import accept .xci as well as .nsp.
- Controller panel: both volume buttons together open it over the launcher and the game; it connects Switch 1 Pro (Bluetooth Classic) and Switch 2 Pro (through Procon2 Bridge).

Requirements: arm64 Android with Vulkan 1.3 (a custom Turnip driver can be installed from the launcher). See docs/ANDROID.md.

Install: enable installing from unknown sources, then open OpenSmash.apk. It is signed with a debug key, so updates need the same signing key.

releases.name: Hitode 0.2.9
releases.body:
Hitode 0.2.9 improves performance in heavy scenes with multicore execution and GPU-side Direct3D 9, adds mobile custom keys, and expands video, audio, and text compatibility. / Hitode 0.2.9 提升了高负载场景的性能（支持多核计算与 Direct3D 9 GPU 渲染），移动端新增自定义按键，并扩展了音视频与文字兼容性。

## Changes / 更新内容

- **Performance:** Improved frame rates and responsiveness in heavy scenes, effect animations, and audio decoding through multicore execution, a resident translation tier, and GPU-side Direct3D 9 rendering; fixed frame pacing for worker-thread GDI drawing.
- **Video & Audio:** Expanded movie playback and seeking compatibility for WMV/ASF and MPEG (DirectShow/VMR fixes), fixed window transitions around movie playback, and resolved DirectSound buffering, device enumeration, and `waveOut` playback issues.
- **Graphics & Text:** Fixed vertical (`@`-font) glyph alignment while keeping ASCII upright; added CoreText system font discovery and Apple glyph outline rendering on iOS; added D3D9 `L8` textures and front-buffer readback, and improved DirectDraw and Vulkan fallback stability.

It includes FreeType 2.13.3 (FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later).

releases.name: Hitode 0.2.8

Hitode 0.2.8 expands iOS and Android launcher support and improves video, audio, text, and UI compatibility across games. / Hitode 0.2.8 完善了 iOS 与 Android 端体验，并全面提升了音视频、字体渲染与界面交互的兼容性。

## Changes / 更新内容

- **Launcher & Library:** Added manual library sorting, an option to remove managed game copies when deleting a game, Traditional Chinese (Big5) encoding selection, pause-menu fast-forward key mode, earlier exit during loading, and direct settings links on launch failures.
- **iOS:** Enabled built-in JIT inside LiveContainer, improved StikJIT / RemotePairing connection discovery, and declared the increased-memory-limit entitlement with installation guidance when missing.
- **Android:** Added direct access to writable external storage, streamlined storage permission and folder import prompts, adapted touch controls to side gesture strips, added a hide-controls mode, refined the soft-keyboard text bar (with Backspace), and fixed startup IPC failures.

releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.7.1

An update to 0.7.0's two engines: Banana Native v0.3.45, game options you can now change from Hokkaido, smoother Pokémon Pokopia on the Hokkaido engine, and memory and stability fixes from Lichii.

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB), a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB) and a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), all on Android 17.

**Updating:** install the APK over 0.7.0 or 0.6.x. Your games, saves, settings and Banana Native packs stay. The first start of each Banana Native game after the update rewrites its code once more (a short Prepare, as Banana Native v0.3.45 asks); your shaders are kept.

## Banana Native v0.3.45

Banana Native inside Hokkaido is now v0.3.45 (from v0.3.41). From its v0.3.42 to v0.3.45 releases:

- **Pokémon Pokopia:** native 4:3 UI and rendering for v2.0.1.
- **Donkey Kong Bananza:** the gameplay camera fills screens wider than 16:9, and its dynamic resolution snaps to the game's own sizes.
- **Mario Tennis Fever:** a frame cap that keeps the game at full speed.

releases.name: Hokkaido 0.7.0
releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.7.0

The biggest Hokkaido release so far: a second engine. Next to Hokkaido's emulator, the APK now carries [Banana Native](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative), which runs a Switch 2 game's code natively on the phone and draws its graphics through Vulkan. You choose the engine per game, and Banana Native runs behind Hokkaido's own screens, with Hokkaido's GPU driver, saves and settings.

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB), a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB) and a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), all on Android 17.

**Updating:** install the APK over 0.6.x. Your games, saves and settings stay. Every game keeps running on the Hokkaido engine unless Banana Native has a playable profile for it (see Auto below), and you can switch any game back in Game properties.

## Getting started with Banana Native

1. **GPU driver.** On an Xclipse GPU (Exynos), install a custom RADV driver in Hokkaido's GPU driver manager, globally or for the game. Banana Native uses the same driver as Hokkaido.

releases.name: Hokkaido 0.6.5
releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.6.5

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and, for the first time, a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), both on Android 17. The performance work tested on the S26's Exynos carries over well to Snapdragon.

## Highlights

- **Fast Fusion** now gets past its title screen and into races, but at low frame rates (the game runs in slow motion) and with a shimmering image. Before, it crashed right after the splash screen on every phone tested: at 0.5x resolution, render targets were freed while a cached scaling helper still used them.
- **Ocarina of Time on 12 GB phones:** Ocarina of Time will no longer be optimized for 12 GB devices. It needs more memory than a 12 GB phone has free and can be closed for low memory there. 16 GB of RAM is recommended.
- **Speed and memory** (upstream)
  - GPU address space is reused and given back when the allocator runs out.
  - Command list copies are reused instead of made again.
  - Occlusion query lookups, frees and locks are cheaper.
  - Game file sections open when they are first used.
  - Memory write traps skip the texture cache on pages that hold no texture.

releases.name: Hokkaido 0.6.4
releases.body:
# Hokkaido 0.6.4

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB), both on Android 17.

## Highlights

- **Game compatibility** (upstream)
  - A texture slot that is still empty when a shader is built now compiles as a 2D texture. Upstream this fixed Pokémon Legends Z-A's blank screen.
  - Shader translation no longer runs out of stack on Kirby Air Riders' loops.
  - More shaders translate: shifts with a uniform shift amount (SHF), and more texture gather and call forms.
  - Ocarina of Time 1.0 (without the update) works with the "No Sharpening" anti-aliasing setting.
- **Snapdragon:** Adreno's early depth test (LRZ) is turned off where it drew wrong, on Qualcomm's own driver (upstream).
- **Memory** (upstream)
  - ASTC textures with uneven mip levels stay compressed on phones and other GPUs with shared or small memory.
  - A new buffer no longer joins a large buffer it only shares a page with. Upstream this caused slowdowns and a crash on Yoshi's book pages.
  - Memory hints skip placeholder addresses.
- **Stability** (upstream)
  - Closing a game while its shaders load no longer hangs, and the next launch works.

emulators.latest_body:
# Hokkaido 0.7.1

An update to 0.7.0's two engines: Banana Native v0.3.45, game options you can now change from Hokkaido, smoother Pokémon Pokopia on the Hokkaido engine, and memory and stability fixes from Lichii.

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB), a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB) and a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), all on Android 17.

**Updating:** install the APK over 0.7.0 or 0.6.x. Your games, saves, settings and Banana Native packs stay. The first start of each Banana Native game after the update rewrites its code once more (a short Prepare, as Banana Native v0.3.45 asks); your shaders are kept.

## Banana Native v0.3.45

Banana Native inside Hokkaido is now v0.3.45 (from v0.3.41). From its v0.3.42 to v0.3.45 releases:

- **Pokémon Pokopia:** native 4:3 UI and rendering for v2.0.1.
- **Donkey Kong Bananza:** the gameplay camera fills screens wider than 16:9, and its dynamic resolution snaps to the game's own sizes.
- **Mario Tennis Fever:** a frame cap that keeps the game at full speed.

releases.body:
**RedU v1.0.5** — el port para Android de *New Super Mario Bros. U*: recompilación nativa, no es un emulador.

### Qué hay de nuevo

- **Reloj al 100%**: un botón en Ajustes → Android que le pide al teléfono correr a su frecuencia máxima y dice exactamente qué permitió el teléfono. En un teléfono sin root el botón informa y apunta al modo de juego del teléfono o a `adb shell cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true`.
- **Aviso de refresco**: los ajustes avisan cuando los cuadros por segundo están por encima de los de la pantalla (esas imágenes nunca se ven y le roban la GPU al juego).
- **Nota sobre los drivers propios**: los ajustes explican que se puede instalar un driver Vulkan propio (Turnip) para el Adreno, que arregla errores gráficos y puede ir más rápido.
- **Guardia de calor**: ahora lee el estado térmico del teléfono cuando este no informa cuánto margen térmico queda; antes no pausaba nunca.
- **Arreglo del enlace**: la preparación ya no se cae al enlazar el juego en el teléfono.

emulators.latest_body:
## Endemic life is visible

Small creatures in the field (Stinkmink, Clothfly and the rest of the endemic life) were invisible in the port: you could still pick them up and get their buffs, but nothing was drawn. The game decides whether to draw them from a visibility test it runs on the GPU and then reads back on the CPU; the port never copied that result back, so the game always read "not visible". Now it does. Only that small result is copied, so the frame rate stays at a locked 30 fps.

- An empty file `sin_devolver_copias` in the game folder brings back the old behaviour.

Thanks to the player who reported it in issue #8.

Nothing else changes: shader caches are the same as in 1.6.0, so your existing caches keep working.

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/mhrise-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

## En español

Until now your hunter was always called "Flip", because the console's on-screen keyboard did nothing in the port. Now, naming your hunter, Palico or Palamute opens a text box with Android's keyboard:

releases.name: MH Rise port v1.5.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.name: MH Rise port v1.4.0
releases.body:
## Save report and update notices

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/mhrise-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

## Installing

releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.1 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 — Release Notes

**2026-11-14 · Windows x64 · Linux x86_64 · macOS Intel**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 is a performance release. Nothing in the emulation model changed: every
game still renders the same picture it did in v0.9.9.6, and the same save states still load. What
changed is how much work the CPU and the GPU have to do to get there.

The headline is that the hybrid JIT now translates **more than 80 % of the guest instruction
stream to native x86-64**, the Vulkan renderer stopped paying for a redundant depth write that was
silently disabling hardware Early-Z / Hi-Z culling, and UMA GPUs finally get zero-copy geometry
upload. Together those turn the integrated-GPU experience from "lock it to 496×384" into a picture
that can actually be played at native resolution.

releases.body:
# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.8.6a — Windows hotfix

**Windows only.** This release contains a single asset for Windows x64. Everything else is
v0.9.8.6 unchanged.

---

## Why the v0.9.8.6 Windows package refused to start on AMD graphics cards

On Windows, AMD's Vulkan driver reports **128 bytes** of push constants — the amount Vulkan itself
guarantees. Every driver this renderer had been developed against reports 256.

The 3D scene shader packed 208 bytes into that block: the projection matrix, the light parameters
and the fog colour, re-sent on every single draw call. The renderer's device selection therefore
required 256 bytes, found 128, rejected the GPU, and the program exited — the start-up artwork
flashed and disappeared, no settings window, no game, no message. Nothing in the picture was wrong;
the renderer simply refused to open the device.

The report that surfaced this was a Steam Deck running Windows 11, whose AMD APU driver reports 128
as well — but the same limit applies to Radeon cards and Ryzen APUs on Windows generally, not to one
machine.

## What is fixed

**The scene shader now fits in the 128 bytes Vulkan guarantees.** The projection matrix, the light

releases.body:
# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.8.6x — Linux and macOS

**This release replaces both `v0.9.8.6l` (Linux) and `v0.9.8.6m` (macOS).** It contains three
assets: Linux, macOS for Apple Silicon, and macOS for Intel Macs. There is no Windows package: the
Windows build is unchanged since v0.9.8.6 and does not need this update.

---

## Fixed in both packages

**The in-game settings panel ignored the mouse and the keyboard on Linux and macOS.**

Press Tab and the panel opened, but nothing in it responded: no hover highlight, no clicks, no arrow
keys, no Enter. The panel's input feed was Windows-only — the whole block that reads the pointer
position, the mouse buttons and the key states sat behind `#ifdef _WIN32`, with no equivalent for the
other platforms, so on Linux and macOS only the mouse wheel was ever delivered. It now reads the
platform's per-frame input snapshot, which both backends already maintain: pointer position, three
mouse buttons, Ctrl/Shift/Alt and a full key table (arrows, Tab, Enter, Escape, Home/End, Page Up/Down,
Insert/Delete, Backspace, Space, A/C/V/X/Z, digits and the keypad).

# WWE '12 PC 1.4.0

The match-options update: new match rules in the menus (starting finishers, squash, I QUIT, Special Guest Referee), a Universe chaos level, Mod Maker additions and fixes for what you reported after 1.3.0.

## New match options

- **Starting finishers (as in WWE 2K14).** On the character select, press **LT / RT** on a place to choose how many finishers that wrestler starts with: NONE, 1, 2, 3 or INFINITE. It shows in the title of the attire frame (or in the READY banner for wrestlers with only one attire). Left on NORMAL, nothing changes. *Limit:* in a few match types the game skips the attire frame, so the option is only offered in a normal 1 on 1.
- **Squash matches.** In **OPTIONS > GAMEPLAY > BALANCING > DAMAGE** (the page now has three new lines): **SQUASH CHANCE** (0-100 %, the chance that a 1 on 1 match is a squash; 0 = off, the default), **SQUASH: JOBBER HEALTH** (starting health of the lower-rated wrestler, 20 % by default) and **STARTING FINISHERS** (default for every match). The lower-rated wrestler is the jobber; the other one starts with a finisher. The labels of the three new lines are in English only.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.
- **Launcher: the MUSIC page closed the launcher** when a file in the `music` folder had an odd name.

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.body:
# PS5PCEM 0.3.4

**This release fixes a launcher regression that prevented games from starting
in packaged installations. Updating both the launcher and runner is recommended.**
It also adds working font rendering, fixes Jurassic Park's font-atlas startup,
implements MemoryPool and AMPR counters, and expands RDNA2 shader support.

These are the changes since **0.3.3**, covering the October 7–9 development
commits. The portable ZIP and per-user installer include the updated launcher,
runner and PKG extractor. All three applications and the installer carry
timestamped SHA-256 Authenticode signatures using the same
**Artur Strazewicz / PS5PCEM** certificate as the previous release.

## Important launcher fix

The launcher could pass its own executable path as the runner's working
directory because a shortened Windows path lacked its terminating zero.
Windows rejected `CreateProcessW` with `ERROR_DIRECTORY` before the game
started. The development `zig-out\bin` layout masked the defect, while ordinary
portable and installed layouts exposed it. The directory is now correctly
terminated.

releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.
- **A libretro core** runs izapple2 inside RetroArch and the other libretro frontends, with diskette swapping from M3U playlists and saves as overlays. It is built from source and is not in the release archives. See [the libretro page](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro.md) and [the Mac guide](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro_macos.md).

releases.name: v2.4.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

* **Reset without Ctrl-F2**: press F1 to show the help, then F2 to reset. Handy when the window manager captures Ctrl-F2, as KDE does. Ctrl-F2 still works as before ([#38](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/issues/38))
* **Install with Homebrew** on macOS and Linux:
  ```
  brew install ivanizag/tap/izapple2
  ```
  The formula is now updated automatically on every release

## Other changes and fixes

* Mockingboard listed among the supported cards in the README
* Updated dependencies and npm packages of the WASM frontend
* Hardened the GitHub Actions workflows: pinned permissions and updated actions

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0

releases.name: v2.3.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

* **Cassette tape support**: load WAV tape recordings through the cassette input with the `-tape` flag, then `LOAD` from the emulated machine
* **Mockingboard card** emulation
* **Improved speaker emulation**
* **Easier command line usage**: mount disks and block devices directly as arguments without configuring slots, aliases for the most common internal disks, and new [command line documentation](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/v2.3.0/doc/command_line.md)
* **Text pasting** into the emulator with shift+insert or cmd+V
* **Custom machine models** with the `IZAPPLE2_CUSTOM_MODEL` environment variable
* New preconfigured model with **Apple Pascal**
* Experimental **WASM frontend**
* Initial support for the **Apple II Profile Interface Card**
* Tracing of Apple II **monitor calls**

## Other changes and fixes

* Support for ProDOS block images not defined as Smartport
* Fix for double key presses
* Drives no longer change position while powered off
* Improved disk image handling
* Updated to Go 1.26 and refreshed dependencies

releases.name: IZPSX emulator 0.5.3
releases.body:
# IZPSX emulator 0.5.3

IZPSX runs PlayStation games on Nintendo Switch 2 through [IZ2S](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZ2S-Platform).

## Install

### Through IZ2S App library

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza).
2. In IZ2S, open **App library**, import the `.iza` file, and install it to the Switch 2 SD card. IZ2S installs the emulator in `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`. The installer includes the launcher, engine, shaders, font, and interface assets.

### Directly to the SD card

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip).
2. Extract the ZIP to the root of the Switch 2 SD card so `iz2s/` sits at the top level. The archive includes the emulator files and empty `bios/`, `games/`, and `saves/` folders under `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`.

Preserve your BIOS, games, memory cards, and settings when updating.

## BIOS and games

| File | SD card path |
| --- | --- |
| Your own PlayStation BIOS, exactly **512 KiB (524,288 bytes)** | `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/bios/bios.bin` |

IZPSX emulator **0.5.2** for the current **IZ2S** console menu.

- **izpsx-emulator-0.5.2.iza** — import through IZ2S Platform → App library, then install to the console.
- **izpsx-emulator-0.5.2-sd.zip** — for a mounted SD card, extract the complete `iz2s/` folder into the card root. The entry is `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/launcher.iza`. Keep `sd-bundle.json` and every `asset-*.izdata` companion beside it.

releases.name: IZPSX emulator 0.5.1
releases.body:
PlayStation emulation on **Switch 2**, with native ARM64 execution, an SD game library, persistent memory cards and individual control profiles for up to four players.

**Requires [IZ2S Panel / IZ2S Platform](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZ2S-Platform) and successfully acquired Filesystem access (FS).** Enable FS before starting the launcher and wait for confirmation in the panel.

## Controller switching fix

In **Controls → Player 1 → Device**, choose **AUTO**. Attached Joy-Con take over in handheld mode even if a wireless Pro Controller remains connected; docking returns Player 1 to the first external controller. The change applies to both gameplay and menus. Manual device choices and the other players keep their assignments.

This updates the existing **0.5.1** release. **Reinstall the updated package even if 0.5.1 is already installed** to receive the fix.

## Downloads

- **izpsx-emulator-0.5.1.izm** — install through the platform's App library; choose RAM or SD.
- **izpsx-emulator-0.5.1-sd.zip** — native SD entry and matching engine asset for an already initialized compatible launcher.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8
Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8-test1 (test build for issue 39)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test4 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test3 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It does not fix the crash. It records it. [1.1.7-test2](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test2) answered the first fault on the Thor, a table of textures the driver refused. The app still closes a moment later, and the log has no line for it. This build writes the reason into `snap64.log`:

- When the app closes on a fault, it writes the signal, the thread, the graphics call that thread was in, and the code addresses.
- At the next start, it copies in Android's own report of how the last run ended.

To help: install it over what you have, open it, let it close, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test2 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is 1.1.7 with one file of the renderer changed. On a Qualcomm graphics driver, the renderer's table of textures now gets its full declared size, and on any driver a table that is refused is asked for once more. Three guards came with it: a refused table is no longer written to, and clears and scissors are kept inside what Vulkan allows. The log says more about what the driver answers. The change is attached as `plume-issue36.patch`.

The APK is signed with the project's key, so it installs over 1.1.7 and saves stay. Android's app info shows it as 1.1.7-test2.

It has been checked on Android's emulator only. The same game code passed the Android checks, 114 of 114. The signed file installed over 1.1.7 with its files kept, and passed the fix's own check, which plays the Qualcomm driver's rule, 23 of 23. It has not run on a Thor yet. That is what this build is for.

releases.name: LibertyDroid 1.0.0
releases.body:
Primera versión de LibertyDroid: port nativo y no oficial de GTA IV y Episodes from Liberty City (Xbox 360) a Android, con launcher propio.

**Descarga:** `LibertyDroid-1.0.0.apk`, en los archivos de esta versión. El APK trae el código de los juegos recompilado a ARM64, pero no sus datos: para jugar hace falta una copia legal propia del juego, que se importa como ISO desde el launcher. Los requisitos y los pasos para compilarlo están en el [README](https://github.com/Jauidev/LibertyDroid#requisitos).

## Qué incluye

- Launcher nativo: importar ISO, elegir juego, perfiles gráficos, drivers en Adreno, copias de partidas, controles y cinco idiomas.
- Recompilación estática de los dos juegos a ARM64 y kernel de Xbox 360 reimplementado.
- Renderizador nativo Vulkan para Mali y Adreno, con Turnip cuando el driver del móvil no basta.
- Sombras estabilizadas al conducir, luces locales en GTA IV y fuentes vectoriales.

## Limitaciones

- Solo admite las ISO de la versión USA, sin actualizaciones.
- El APK es una compilación de depuración, firmada con una clave de desarrollo.

---

## Eden NX2 Android v0.3.3

  ### What's new

  - **New NUP container system**: Eden now reads NUP v1 packages natively, with the current record layouts and checks that reject malformed directories and
  extents.
  - Loose ExeFS dumps in game folders are detected and shown with their name and icon.
  - AV1 movie decoding.
  - Frame presentation: pacing by swap interval, cropping to the 1920x1080 handheld panel, and correct output format for RGB10A2 images.
  - Sparse texture memory: mapping and unmapping of tiles, shared blocks.
  - Expanded shader lowering: 64-bit integers, atomics, warp reductions, conversions, bindless descriptors, and FSEL with floating operand modifiers.
  - Audio: Switch 2 renderer revision accepted, with cleaner input/output manager lifetimes.
  - System keyboard: swkbd config decoding for library version `0x160012`.
  

  ### Fixes

  - Duplicate HSETP2 lowering case

And a lot more....

releases.name: v0.3.2
releases.body:
## Eden NX2 Android v0.3.2

  ### New: [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) Container Format Support

  Added support for the [`.nup` (NX Package)](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) file format — a clean-room container for unencrypted Nintendo Switch and Switch 2
  game dumps.

  **What it does:**
  - Load games directly from `.nup` files — base, updates, and DLC bundled in a single file
  - Supports raw and zstd-compressed content
  - Game metadata (title, icon, publisher, version) extracted automatically from [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) packages
  - `.nup` files appear in the game library like any other supported format

  **Supported features:**
  - ExeFS + RomFS loading from [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) packages
  - Per-package metadata via TLV blocks (NPDM, NACP, icon, title, version)
  - Zstandard decompression for compressed extents
  - Full integration with the Android game scanner

  **Technical details:**
  - [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) format v1 spec compliant (magic `NUP\x01`)
  - New `AppLoader_Nup` loader with `DeconstructedRomDirectory` delegation
  - Container validation (superblock, TOC integrity, codec checks)

releases.body:
# RMG-K v0.9.16

## Jump into games already in progress
- **Late join:** if a match has an open seat, you can join the room mid-game. The host clicks **Add to Game** and you're in after a pause of a few seconds. Nobody else's game restarts.
- **Rejoin after a drop:** if you get disconnected, the host can add you back the same way.
- **Start solo:** hosts can start a match alone and add friends as they show up.
- Hosts can turn late join on or off for each room.

## Save files
- Matches now start from the host's save file, so everyone has the same unlocks.
- You can also start from a fresh blank save without picking a file.

## Better replays
- **New playback controls:** a timeline you can click or drag to skip anywhere, 10-second jump buttons and playback speed from 25% to 400%.
- **Bookmarks:** mark your favorite moments. They're saved inside the replay file.
- **Faster video export,** with the option to show chat in the exported video.
- **Faster catch-up** when you start watching a live match partway through.
- Spectators now see the right player names, even when people join or leave mid-match.
- Everyone in the room when a game starts can save a replay of it.

## Arceus Recomp for Android – Update

### Highlights
- **Game code is now built on your phone.** The APK no longer ships any game code. After you pick your own `prod.keys`, game (`.nsp`/`.xci`) and update in **Game Files**, the app translates and compiles `libgame.so` on the device using a bundled Python, translator, clang and lld. It takes about 10 minutes on an Odin 3, and if it's interrupted it picks up where it left off. When it finishes, **Play** appears and you can delete the game files from your phone.
- **Music and voices work.** The Switch's Opus decoder service (hwopus) is now implemented with libopus 1.5.2.

### Better support for other phones
- **Automatic performance profiles.** On first start the app picks a profile from your GPU (Adreno, Mali/Immortalis, Xclipse, PowerVR) and your RAM. You can change it under *Video > Android > Performance profile*.
  - **High:** 100% resolution, 60 fps (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and newer).
  - **Medium:** dynamic resolution (never below 60%), 60 fps.
  - **Light:** 75% resolution, 30 fps, half-size shadows.

releases.name: Pokemon Legends Arceus Android First Release
releases.body:
# Arceus Recomp for Android — v1.0 

Android port of **PokeL-ARecomp**, the static recompilation of *Pokémon Legends: Arceus*. Tested on the AYN Odin 3 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830).

> ⚠️ This repository **does not include the game, keys or game code**. Every player uses their own legal copy.

## ✨ What's new

### Performance and heat
- **60 fps at 60 Hz with 100% resolution.**
- **Much less heat:** CPU went from ~84 °C to ~52 °C and the fan is barely audible.
- **CPU cores:** the game uses 4 cores and leaves the rest free. You can pick All / 4 / 2.
- **Clock speeds:** the port tells Android how long each frame really takes, on the CPU and the GPU. The CPU no longer sits at max clock, and the GPU clocks up when it needs to.
- **Less data copying:** GPU constants are read straight from shared memory, so about 80% less data is copied per frame.
- **Pause in the background:** the game pauses when you leave the app.

### Graphics
- **Vulkan on Adreno**, with support for the **Turnip** (Mesa) driver, which you can import and pick from the menu.
- **"Soft" anti-aliasing** (new, default): blends the dithered pattern on hair, leaves and grass at no fps cost. SMAA is also available.

releases.name: Bachata S4 v0.2.5
releases.body:
PanVK V3, a global patch library, native NGS2 audio, and wide performance and compatibility fixes

## Highlights

- PanVK V3 3.2.0 ships for supported Mali GPUs, with faster God of War III textures.
- Global patch library with XML import, and new patches for more than a dozen games including P.T., Driveclub, UFC and Uncharted.
- Native NGS2 audio fixes Gravity Rush 2 audio glitches and silent dialogue, with a rewritten AJM path.
- Games folder prompt with autosync, a default save data location and in-game Pause.

## Game Compatibility & Patches

- Gravity Rush 2 audio now works properly: native NGS2 fixes the glitches and the silent dialogue
- P.T. renders streamed textures correctly, with checked 60 FPS, resolution, half-resolution shadow, lens flare, camera blur and SSR patches
- Driveclub 540p, 360p and high performance presets, with smoother frame pacing
- Second Son quality floor with a longer view distance and correctly lit scenes
- Galak-Z boots reliably and no longer deadlocks, and Elden Ring, UFC and Uncharted receive rendering and stability fixes
- Horizon Zero Dawn no longer runs out of memory when large buffers grow

releases.name: Bachata S4 v0.2.4
releases.body:
Uncharted and The Order: 1886 boot, Gravity Rush 2 optimizations, and PanVK for Mali

## Highlights

- Uncharted and The Order: 1886 now boot, with new graphics and resolution patches.
- Gravity Rush 2 optimizations and patches, including guarded low-resolution presets.
- PanVK driver support for a limited set of Mali devices.
- A proper two-finger touchpad, off by default and enabled from the in-game menu.

## Game Compatibility & Patches

- Uncharted boots, with fixed character rendering and new graphics and resolution patches
- The Order: 1886 boots, with rendering and stability fixes
- Gravity Rush 2 optimizations, guarded low-resolution presets, and a fixed mining movie transition
- Dark Souls Remastered and God of War III performance improvements
- Restored Bloodborne performance on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, and precise readbacks for Driveclub
- Synced the published patch catalog

## GPU Drivers

- PanVK V2 2.2.0 bundled as the production driver for supported Mali GPUs
- MediaTek devices default to PanVK where supported
- Faster memory budget queries and fewer redundant GPU barriers on PanVK
- Simplified Drivers screen with a single PanVK entry

The order of a frame, the monsters' moves and the bot partner, checked frame by frame against the original game.

  lands on the same frame as in the original, and its reaction starts a frame sooner.

  as in the original. Its animation starts at once, as before; a press during those 2 frames picks from the old

  path.
- A monster walking or knocked into a building front is held off it before it picks its next move. It used to end
  up inside the front for a frame.
- A walk that turns into a punch stops where it is, and a punch that ends in the idle pose no longer slides the
  monster back a little. The idle after a punch now stands where the original's does.

Buildings falling by themselves, grabbing and eating, and a few smaller things from the same report.

releases.name: Joycon2Android 3.1.0
releases.body:
Feel the game through your Joy-Cons, remap buttons for Android games, and pick your output by what you're playing. Run **Auto set up** again to apply them.

## What's new

- **Game rumble reaches your controllers.** Each player sets their own strength in the mapping's Rumble section.
- **The Output card follows what you're playing.** Pick Eden, Dolphin, another emulator, Android games & apps or Mouse & keys, and the app runs what that needs.
- **Android games and apps can be remapped.** Move any button or stick in Mapping, or pick the **Xbox** layout to swap A/B and X/Y.
- **The mapping screen is easier to read.** Sections start collapsed, changes in a Custom mapping show in teal, the app asks before replacing them, and Wii motion has its own section.
- **Mouse buttons follow the Joy-Con.** On a surface they click and scroll, and in your hands they go to the game.
- **Mouse & keys runs just the keyboard and mouse.** Switch on **Gamepad** in its mapping to run the virtual gamepad as well.
- **Each player can switch their mouse on and off.** Hold the Toggle combo for a second while playing; C is the default.

releases.name: Joycon2Android 3.0.0
releases.body:
Use your Joy-Con 2 as a mouse and keyboard, pick your output from one simple card, and map buttons by pressing them. Run **Set up** again to apply them.

## What's new

- **A Joy-Con 2 works as a mouse.** Stand it on its rail on a flat surface and it moves the pointer, with clicks and scroll from your mapping.
- **Buttons can press keyboard keys and mouse clicks.** Each player's mapping has Keyboard and Mouse sections, and a stick can walk on WASD, for PC games under Winlator and the like.
- **One Output card runs everything.** Pick Virtual gamepad, Motion (DSU) or Mouse & keys, choose your emulator, and the app starts what that needs.
- **Map a button by pressing it.** Tap a row, then press the button or push the stick you want; **Choose from list** binds several at once.
- **Choose your Wii controller.** Each player picks Wiimote, Sideways or Classic, and Classic keeps the remote's pointer and motion.
- **New Mouse & keys layouts.** **WASD + Mouse** for games, **Mouse only** for clicks and scroll, on a pair or a single Joy-Con.
- **Layouts apply cleanly.** Picking a layout sets exactly its own bindings, with nothing left over from before.

releases.name: Joycon2Android 2.2.0
releases.body:
Play Wii games with a Classic Controller, set a saved layout for everyone at once, and enjoy a smoother app. Run **Set up** again to apply them.

## What's new

- **Wii games can use a Classic Controller.** Pick the **Classic Controller** layout on any controller — Joy-Con, pair, Pro Controller or GameCube controller — and Dolphin gets a Classic Controller in place of the Nunchuk, with every button where a Pro Controller has it.
- **Pro and GameCube controllers set up for Wii.** On the Classic Controller layout, **Set up** for Dolphin (Wii) maps them for you.
- **Saved layouts work as group layouts.** A layout you save for one player appears under **Group layout** and sets everyone holding the same controller.
- **The app feels faster.** Everything stays smooth and responsive, however many controllers you have connected.

## Install

Download `joycon2android-2.2.0.apk` below and install it over your existing copy. See the [README](https://github.com/JoeGeC/joycon2android#setup-guide) for the full setup guide.

## Notes

releases.name: Joycon2Android 2.1.2
releases.body:
Motion sensitivity works in Dolphin on every phone. Run **Set up** again to apply it.

## What's new

- **Motion sensitivity works with the Wii pointer on every phone.** The pointer stays steady at any setting on phones such as the Galaxy S25 and Pixel 9, so every layout starts at 110% again, which suits Wii Sports swings. If you set the slider to 100% for 2.1.1, move it back to 110% before running **Set up**.

## Install

Download `joycon2android-2.1.2.apk` below and install it over your existing copy. See the [README](https://github.com/JoeGeC/joycon2android#setup-guide) for the full setup guide.

## Notes

- **SYNC is required for every connection.** Switch 2's button-press reconnect is console-exclusive at the link layer and can't be reproduced through Android's BLE API.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nintendo. The BLE protocol was reverse-engineered by the community; this project contains no Nintendo code. See the [credits](https://github.com/JoeGeC/joycon2android#credits).

releases.name: Pocket Foundry 0.9.5-beta.2
releases.body:
**Beta, for testing.** Install it by hand, or turn on Include prereleases for Pocket Foundry in Obtainium. It updates to the release once that's out.

Play your own copy of Factorio on Android: the official Linux ARM64 build, run without emulation on the phone's GPU.

**Install:** open `pocket-foundry-0.9.5-beta.2.apk` on the phone (Android 10 or later) and import the Linux (arm64) .tar.xz from [factorio.com/download](https://factorio.com/download). Pocket Foundry then asks before downloading a driver for your GPU from pocket-foundry-drivers: Turnip on Adreno 6xx or newer, experimental builds on some Mali and Xclipse GPUs, Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues) or the CPU elsewhere. Without downloads it plays through Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues), which comes with the app, Phone's Vulkan (experimental) or an imported one. The app holds no part of Factorio: you bring your own copy. A new version installs over the last and keeps the game and saves; from 0.8, 0.9 installs as a new app next to the old one and brings its saves, mods and config over.

Play your own copy of Factorio on Android: the official Linux ARM64 build, run without emulation on the phone's GPU.

**Install:** open `pocket-foundry-0.9.5-beta.2.apk` on the phone (Android 10 or later) and import the Linux (arm64) .tar.xz from [factorio.com/download](https://factorio.com/download). Pocket Foundry then asks before downloading a driver for your GPU from pocket-foundry-drivers: Turnip on Adreno 6xx or newer, experimental builds on some Mali and Xclipse GPUs, Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues) or the CPU elsewhere. Without downloads it plays through Phone's OpenGL ES (MobileGlues), which comes with the app, Phone's Vulkan (experimental) or an imported one. The app holds no part of Factorio: you bring your own copy. A new version installs over the last and keeps the game and saves; from 0.8, 0.9 installs as a new app next to the old one and brings its saves, mods and config over.

releases.name: v0.1.9-alpha
releases.body:
### Fixed

- The Linux release plays game movies: it links a small static FFmpeg (FFmpeg's own H.264, HEVC, VP8/VP9, AAC, Opus, Vorbis and MP3 decoders, no other libraries), so it needs no FFmpeg on the system and works whatever FFmpeg version the distribution has. The 0.1.8 archive was built without FFmpeg, and Astro Bot crashed at its first movie (#7).

releases.name: v0.1.8-alpha
releases.body:
### Changed

- The emulated display is 1080p by default (it was 2160p), in the launcher, `rps5e-cli run` and the test scripts: games that size their output to the display render a quarter of the pixels and the window scales the picture, which is much lighter on the GPU. 2160p (and 720p) stay selectable in the launcher's settings, per game, and with `--display-resolution` / `RPS5E_DISPLAY_RESOLUTION`. Games that do not ask for the display's resolution are shown a 2160p display as on the console.
- System functions answer as measured on a PS5 in a game process: a trylock of an adaptive mutex by its owner returns EINVAL (was EBUSY); `sceKernelAddAmprEvent` on a deleted or null event queue returns EBADF (was success); `sceSystemServiceReceiveEvent` with no event pending returns "no event" for any pointer and leaves the buffer untouched (it wrote an empty event first, and a null pointer was a parameter error); the `sceNetGetSockInfo` record carries the socket priority 0x10.
- `sceVideoOutSetFlipRate` checks the handle before the rate and accepts rate 3 (a flip every fourth vblank), as on a PS5.

releases.name: 0.1.7-alpha - 2026-11-13
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Ghost of Yōtei no longer freezes after its shaders are compiled (#3). Two causes:
  - Planning the resources of a shader walked the shader's whole value graph again for every word of every buffer descriptor; on this game's largest shaders that took minutes on the GPU command thread, with nothing submitted meanwhile. Each value is now walked once per shader.
  - A few compute shaders became SPIR-V modules of 2.7-3.2 million words that the GPU driver compiled for 15 minutes and more while the game waited (the driver keeps the result, so only the first run on a machine stalled). The largest is now 0.6 million words and builds in about 40 s on an RTX 5090, once; the results are the same, bit for bit (device tests over every buffer format, page-crossing elements and partial EXEC):

releases.name: 0.1.6-alpha - 2026-11-12
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Windows: controllers work out of the box. The release archive now carries `SDL3.dll`: the emulator loads SDL at run time and Windows has none of its own, so no controller was found ("SDL3 not available") unless the file was added by hand. The message for a missing library now says where to put it ([#4](https://github.com/keklick1337/rps5e/issues/4)).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/keklick1337/rps5e/compare/v0.1.5-alpha...v0.1.6-alpha

releases.name: 1.0.5-alpha
releases.body:
### Changed

- The automatic choice of the recording thread (`RPS5E_GPU_RECORD_THREAD=auto`) no longer turns it off while the command interpreter also has to wait for room in its queue (`RPS5E_POLICY_FULL`). SILENT HILL: The Short Message's heavy room about 10 fps instead of 8; GTA V with `RPS5E_BDA=1` 47 fps instead of 42.
- `RPS5E_BDA=1` (experimental direct guest memory reads) no longer changes the default of `RPS5E_LABELS_AT_EOP`: with its old default (`1`) GTA V never left its start menu. GTA V's city in Performance mode with `RPS5E_BDA=1`: 47-48 fps against 37 without it; still off by default.
- The emulator's own small writes into GPU-watched guest memory (memcpy/memset inside one page, packets of the command-buffer builders) mark the page written before the store instead of taking a page fault (`RPS5E_PREMARK_SMALL`). GTA V's city in Performance mode: write faults per frame ~1550 → ~320; over the same stretch of the scene the frame rate rises by about 2.5 % (36.6 → 37.4 fps).

releases.body:
### English

On a phone, install it over the app you have: your save, your settings, your control profiles and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again).

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0.2 brings **MH4U for PC**, fixes for what you reported since 1.0.1.1 and a big batch of your suggestions, most of them in both ports.

#### New: MH4U for PC

**MH4U for PC is here.** The same game folder you use with the app now plays on a Windows PC: `MH4U.exe` runs your own
copy of Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate natively, with the same runtime, settings, saves, mods and multiplayer as the app,
and what a PC adds. Download `MH4U-PC-1.0.2.zip` below, unzip it into a folder of your own and open `MH4U.exe`. The
guide: [PC (Windows)](https://github.com/khorne-hub/4u-native#pc-windows).

The zip has the program only, nothing of the game: the first time, the program builds the game code from your own game
and update, on your PC (it downloads Python and Zig, about 90 MB, then 10 to 40 minutes). Your phone's code library
stays as it is: the PC makes its own. Check your zip with `certutil -hashfile MH4U-PC-1.0.2.zip SHA256` against

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again).

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0.1.1 is a small update after 1.0.1: fixes for what you reported, the PS1 filter you asked for, and quick items on the main screen.

#### Fixes

- **"Gather everything in one press" closed the game** ([#71](https://github.com/khorne-hub/4u-native/issues/71)) at gathering points with more than one use and when carving, with the European version of the game whose code had been built with 1.0: that code lacked the places in the game that 1.0.1 added, and the option called a wrong one. The app now fills them in by itself, with no rebuild, and if one were ever missing the option would do nothing instead of closing the game.
- **The monster's name on the health bars** didn't show on phones: it is now read from the game's files the way the game reads them.

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again).

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0.1 fixes problems you reported after 1.0 and adds some of your suggestions. Its first fixes were also tried on our phones (Mali-G57, Mali-G52 and Adreno 830); the rest only on a PC so far: where a line says "should", please tell us how it goes on yours (the Discord or an issue, with the log).

- **PowerVR GE8300, GE8320 and other PowerVR Rogue GPUs:** 1.0 closed at every start after the first one: it built the shaders you had already seen in the background, and this GPU's driver crashes when shaders are built in two places at once. These GPUs go back to how 0.1.9.2 built them: one at a time, when they first show up, with nothing in the background. That should end the closes; the short stutter the first time an effect shows up is back to 0.1.9.2's. PowerVR BXM GPUs keep 1.0's way (Discord).

### English

Install it over the app you have: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are (no need to build it again). Your touch layout becomes control profile 1.

Questions or help: the community's Discord, https://discord.gg/sk5xEjEMwF

1.0 was tried on a PC and on our phones (Mali-G57, Mali-G52 and Adreno 830), but not every part of it on a phone: where a line says "should", please tell us how it goes on yours (the Discord or an issue, with the log).

**New in 1.0**

- **A new settings menu:** six sections down the left, **Controls**, **Graphics & Audio**, **Gameplay**, **Multiplayer**, **Mods & Cheats** and **System**, with **Credits & Licenses** under them. Each section's page has its main options, and the rest is one level down (**Touch controls**, **Controller**, **Screen and HUD**, **Advanced**, **Join a room**...). Each row's explanation is behind its **?**. Your options keep their values; only their places changed: **Display** is now **Graphics & Audio**, **Screen and HUD**; the **Comforts** are in **Gameplay**; **Menu Options** is **System** (with **Your game** for the folders, **Import save**, **Export save** and **Share log**).

### English

Install over 0.1.9.1: your save, your settings and your code library stay as they are.

- **Combined buttons on a controller:** each combined button can go on a controller's button (L3, R3, SELECT, Guide, Misc, the paddles or the touchpad). Gear, **Controls**, **Controller**: a **Combined buttons** row shows there while a controller is connected. A player's suggestion on Discord.
- **More in the log for slow phones** (#43): `log.txt` now tells how the game's list of shaders is coming along while it is built and how long it took, and has a performance line once a minute.
- **The single-screen mod** is made for the USA game in English: with the game in another language its menus overlap (#30). The README says so now.

**Installed it from another website** (apkvision or the like) and Android says "App not installed"? That copy was signed by someone else, and Android only installs the official APK over the official one. Your save comes with you:

1. In the old app: gear, **Menu Options**, **Export save**, and choose a folder such as `Download`.
2. Uninstall the old app.
3. Install the APK from this page.

emulators.description: 基于 ARMSX2 核心的安卓 PS2 模拟器。

releases.name: Ametrine 1.0
releases.body:
The first release of Ametrine, a PS2 emulator for Android built on the [ARMSX2](https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2) core.

## Features

- Game library from a folder you pick, with favorites, search and play time
- Global settings with per-game overrides
- Touch controls you can rearrange and resize, and physical controllers
- Save states, memory card manager, cheats, input macros
- Backup and restore of settings and saves
- Custom Vulkan drivers (adrenotools) on Adreno GPUs
- Optional: ask Google Gemini about the current screen (needs your own API key)

## Requirements

- Android 10 or later, arm64-v8a, 4 KB memory pages (16 KB page devices are not supported yet)
- A BIOS dumped from your own PS2. Ametrine does not include any BIOS or games.

## Files

|---|---|
| `Ametrine-1.0.apk` | `42b91b154e7ed34e597ca5e720c9abc91970b12fc6986a34b931c5960da32cc1` |

releases.name: KytyPS5 Android v0.1.0-alpha
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> Superseded by the automatic **Nightly** builds. Nightlies use a new signing key, so uninstall this alpha once before installing one.

First public alpha of **KytyPS5 Android**: PS5 games on Android ARM64 (FEXCore JIT + Vulkan on Mesa Turnip / Adreno).

> [!WARNING]
> Experimental. Developed and tested on one device only (OnePlus Pad 3, Adreno 830, 16 GB). Other Adreno devices are untested. Use only game dumps you own.

## Download
- **KytyPS5-Android-v0.1.0-alpha.apk**: install it and open **KytyPS5**. The Mainline Turnip v32 GPU driver (by whitebelyash) is bundled and selected by default.
- SHA-256: `d63e81a68844717ae99ff3b392e9760c4e1efaa5d783bca5501ef49a31a3492c`
- This build is debug-signed (it is an alpha). Later alpha builds will install over it.

## What runs (OnePlus Pad 3)
| Game | State | Speed |
|---|---|---|
| Vampire Survivors | Playable | ~60 fps |
| Totally Reliable Delivery Service | Nearly playable | 28–35 fps |
| Astro Bot | Runs, slow | 13–17 fps; 16–20 fps with the Performance mode preset |
| Commandos: Origins (UE5) | Boots, very slow | ~2 fps (turn on the `res50` preset) |

## Highlights

emulators.name: SavedataSync
emulators.description: 局域网内跨设备快速同步存档文件夹，用于视觉小说进度接续。
emulators.latest_body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。
emulators.note: 需在同一局域网内的设备间配对。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。
> 直接升级将导致旧备份永远保留在设备上。
> 卸载会清除应用数据和旧备份，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。

- **旧备份不能带到 0.3.0。** 如果还要用旧备份里的存档，请在升级前先恢复。
- 电脑端的旧备份不再显示，也不会自动清理，可以点备份页的“打开文件夹”手动删除。电脑端的备份开关和保留份数会恢复默认。
- 电脑端和移动端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。
- **备份页可以删除单份备份。** 备份页还会显示实际文件数和不完整备份的占用，并可以清理不完整的备份。
- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。
- **开屏动画从后台返回时也会播放。** 回到桌面或切换应用后再打开都会播放。为了不闪过离开前的页面，Android 13 及以上的最近任务不再显示页面缩略图。

## 改进

- **移除游戏时会一并删除这个游戏的备份。**
- 启动时进入设备页；从后台返回时留在原页。
- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。
- 两端分别统一动效。移动端切页改成两页一起整屏平移，按钮和列表项使用相同的按下反馈；电脑端的列表项和卡片使用相同的悬停和按下效果。
- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。
- 比较结果过期后不再报错，会显示黄色提示并自动重新比较，确认后才开始传输。

emulators.latest_body:
**Headlight beams in both games, and the first Android beta.** At night your car finally lights up the road ahead and we're releasing the Android version for further testing.

## Features

- **Headlight beams.** Turning your lights on at night now throws a beam of light onto the road ahead, as on the original Xbox: it brightens the street, cars and walls it reaches and stops where it meets them ([#10](https://github.com/laureladastra/mcdub3-nx/issues/10), thanks for the report). Before, the lights worked in the game but no beam was drawn. Other emulators (i.e. xemu → https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu/issues/996) show a solid white shape instead. The game builds the beam in a small hidden picture using two tricks of the Xbox's graphics chip that the port did not reproduce yet: it reuses a picture as a depth map, and it counts the beam's layers with a special blending mode that works with negative numbers. Both are emulated now. Tested in the DUB Edition and the Remix. The WHITE button flashes your high beams while you hold it. The main headlights are on by themselves at night.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v1.0.0
releases.body:
**Version 1.0 for both games on the Nintendo Switch.** This release removes the last annoyances: races that felt slow when the frame rate dipped, random zoom-in or out during loading screens, and vertical lines during upscaling.

### Features

- **Races keep their real speed.** The original game moves the race forward by a fixed step every frame, which was fine on the Xbox, where it runs on a fixed 30 FPS. On the Switch, in rain, with nitrous or in the busiest streets, the frame rate can dip and the whole race then went into slow motion. The race now proceeds by the time that really passed. Racing in the rain and with nitrous feels much steadier.
- **No more random zooms during loading screens.** Menus and loading screens are drawn for 4:3 TVs, with black strips at the sides, and the port enlarges them to fill your 16:9 screen. When something briefly reached those strips (the circle animation on loading screens for example), the picture behind it jumped in size for a brief moment. The size stays put now.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.5.0
releases.body:
**A big speed update for both games on the Switch.** Races, especially in the rain, now run close to the game's own top speed of 30 FPS most of the time. Freezes during races are minimised.

### Features

- Measured in rain races on the Switch (at the default 1x picture size):

  |                                    | v0.4.0                 | v0.5.0   |
  | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition       | 23 frames per second   | **28.5** |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix | 20.5 frames per second | **27.5** |

  The game itself never runs faster than 30, as on the original Xbox, so most of the time you are now at or near full speed.
- **No more half-second freezes in races.** The game stopped for about half a second now and then during a race, most often right after the start.
- **Sharper look for less effort (Remix).** The Remix's glow and blur effects are drawn at normal size even when you raise the picture size, which cost a lot of speed for something that is blurred anyway.

### Other changes

- Each game now has its own tuned graphics settings, so improving one game does not change the other.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.4.0
releases.body:
**This is the first release of Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix**. Runs from boot to the finish line: intro movies, menus, garage, career and races, with music and sound. It ships next to the DUB Edition as its own app, `mcdub3remix-nx-eur.nro`.

### Features

- **Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix.** A new app for this game: `mcdub3remix-nx-eur.nro` on the Switch (in `sdmc:/switch/mcdub3remix-nx/`, disc in `game-eur/` or `game/`), and a Mac app built with `make mac-app GAME=remix`.
- **Remix races play as they should.** From the countdown on, the camera no longer turns into a spinning top view, you can drive, and the pause and options menus appear centred with their list shown once.
- **More of the game converted correctly.** Floating-point comparisons now give the same answers as the Xbox's processor, also when a value is not a number. The Remix's code relies on this throughout (it was compiled for the Xbox's SSE unit, the DUB Edition mostly for the older x87 one).

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.3.0
releases.body:
## Features

- **Smooth loading screens.** The circles on the career loading screen now turn smoothly and close, on every platform. The game copies each frame into the next one with the Xbox GPU's 2D engine and only draws what changed.
- **Faster menus on the Switch.** Moving through the main menu and its city flythrough went from about 20 to 27-30 frames per second. A background thread of the game checked a one-second timer thousands of times a second and kept interrupting the main thread. It now checks every few milliseconds.
- **More of the game lifted correctly.** Functions that end in a switch table were sometimes cut into pieces when the game's code was converted. They are now kept whole.

## Other changes

- On the Switch, the previous run's log is kept as `mcdub3_log_prev.txt` next
  to `mcdub3_log.txt`, so a hang can still be reported after the game was
  started again.
- We're preparing to port Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition Remix and integrate its code into this repo. Tools and scripts have been updated and the repo has been reorganised to support parallel builds for these different games.
- Generated files now live in `work-dub/` instead of `work/`. The first
