releases.name: v1.2.6: save backups, movies keep their shape, every controller works
releases.body:
**Save backups, movies that keep their shape, and two controllers at once.**

- **Save backups** (*CTRL → Game → Save backups …*): copies of all your save slots in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game doesn't delete them. A copy is made after the game saves, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always). A backup can be restored from the same screen; it takes effect at the next start, and the saves it replaces are kept aside.
- **Movies are never stretched.** They keep their 16:9 shape with **Wide screen** on, and now also with **Stretch to fill wide screens** on. A movie whose own picture has black bars at the top and bottom as well (bars on all four sides) is zoomed in, centred, until one pair of bars is gone, without cutting anything off.
- **Controllers:** every connected controller now controls the game. Before, with two connected (for example a handheld's built-in controls and an external pad), the second one's buttons were ignored.

releases.name: v1.2.5: render resolution and true wide screens
releases.body:
**Choose the render resolution, and true wide screens.**

- **Resolution** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): **540p**, **720p** (as on the Xbox 360, the default) or **1080p**. The 3D world is drawn at that size; menus and the HUD stay sharp at 720p. 540p is faster and a little softer. 1080p is scaled down into the 720p picture, which smooths edges rather than adding detail, and needs a fast GPU.
- **Wide screen** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): on screens wider than 16:9 (most phones), the 3D world fills the whole screen, with more to see at the sides instead of black bars or stretching. Menus, the HUD and the minimap stay in the middle, laid out as on a 16:9 screen, and movies keep 16:9 with black bars. It costs some speed: on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) the field runs at about 24.5 fps instead of 28. Off by default.
- With both left at their defaults, the picture is the same as in v1.2.4.

releases.name: v1.2.4: tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, fixes for more phones
releases.body:
**A tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, and fixes for more phones from the Dark Souls II port.**

- **CTRL menu:** the options are now in sections that open one at a time: *Controls*, *Frame rate and performance*, *Image*, *Second screen*, *Game* and *Troubleshooting*. **Exit game** (top right) closes the game after asking; save in the game's main menu first. After changing an option marked *, the menu offers to restart the game so it takes effect.
- **CTRL button:** under *Controls* it can stay on screen, slide into a small tab when not in use, or go away 30 seconds after the game starts. Once it's gone, Android's Back button or gesture opens the menu.
- **Frame rate:** one list with 30, 40, 60 and *60 fps, smoother* (the former 120 Hz option).
- **Mali GPUs (Dimensity, Exynos, Tensor):** the app now starts on Arm's own driver, with the renderer settings that fixed Mali players' glitches in the Dark Souls II port, which shares this renderer. Still untested on a real Mali phone: reports with logs are welcome.
- **Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite):** Turnip now runs in sysmem mode there, which fixed GPU hangs on these chips in the Dark Souls II port.

releases.name: v1.2.3: fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs
releases.body:
**Fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs (Snapdragon 855 / 865 / 870 / 888 and similar).**

- **Adreno 6xx:** the renderer no longer loses work on these GPUs. Missing menu text, garbled or black pictures and wrong colours came from the Turnip driver on Adreno 6xx dropping some of the renderer's compute work (texture loads and render-to-texture copies) when it was set up while a drawing pass was still open. The fix closes the pass first. It was found by the Dark Souls II port's frame capture on an Adreno 640 and tested here on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) (#4). Adreno 7xx/8xx draw the same as before, at the same speed.

**Updating from v1.2.2:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

releases.name: v1.2.2: infinite HP, stretch to fill wide screens
releases.body:
**Infinite HP, and a stretch option for wide phone screens.**

- **Infinite HP (in battle):** a new cheat under **CTRL → Cheats**. Lightning's HP goes back to its maximum after every hit. A single hit larger than her maximum HP can still knock her out (#5).
- **Infinite EP** checked in battle, including the first tutorial battle: Overclock and the other EP abilities are refilled at once (#5).
- **Stretch to fill wide screens:** a new option under **CTRL → Image**. On phones wider than 16:9 it removes the black bars at the sides by stretching the picture sideways. It applies the next time the game starts (#6).
- **Regression tests:** a battle test for both cheats on the Thor.

**Updating from v1.2.1:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

releases.body:
# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

* Controller buttons can now be assigned to one of 4 hotkey commands in the iOS frontend
* Periodic saves were added to the iOS frontend
* A new screenshot hotkey was added to the SDL frontend
* Controller UI hiding in the iOS frontend can now optionally disable the centering of the game screen

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.2
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* New `usage` debugger command, displaying the Game Boy CPU's time outside of halt/stop modes
* The debugger window in the Cocoa frontend now has a CPU usage graph
* The debugger `print`/`eval` command no longer adds zero padding by default
* The Cocoa frontend now has an option to force an integer scaling factor with black borders, similar to the SDL frontend
* The iOS frontend can now configure rapid A and rapid B buttons on a controller
* The SDL frontend now supports two optional V-sync modes
* The Cocoa and iOS frontends were updated with UI and UX improvements for macOS and iOS 26, respectively
    * This also includes new icons when using on these operating systems, as well as on watchOS 26
* Minor UI improvements were also done for older versions of macOS and iOS
* SameBoy now supports the new menu bar on iPad OS 26
* Improved frame skipping during turbo mode
* Turbo mode can now have a configurable speed cap on all frontends

releases.name: SameBoy v1.0.1
releases.body:
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator

## New/Improved Features
* UI improvements to the Cocoa palette editor
* Improved audio quality on libretro; audio is now rendered by SameBoy at 2MHz, and downsampling is now handled by the libretro frontend itself
    * In the Wii U build, downsampling is still done by SameBoy
* With the meaning of register `$FF75` discovered, it is now referred to as `rPGB` in the debugger
* The output of the `watchpoint` debugger command now includes the watchpoint type (read-only, write-only, or read-write)
    * This makes the default watchpoint type (write-only) more obvious
* Windows 11 users can now optionally disable rounded corners in the Graphics Options menu
* Official Windows builds no longer require installing MSVC runtimes by linking against `mvscrt.dll`
* Major improvements to debugging in the SDL frontend:
    * The main emulator window is no longer unresponsive when the debugger is stopped
    * Pressing keys in the emulator window while the debugger is paused now triggers a terminal bell

## English

**Highlights**

1. **Multi-engine workbench (#1368, #1370, #1372, #1374, #1405, #1455, #1473, #1474, #1498)**: Switch engines in one click from the top of `Builds` or `Settings` between `nxnative`, self-updating `nxkit 0.10.3 (Beta)` with Ed25519 signature verification, and turnkey `MacNativeGames` guarded to its 5 maintained titles (`MNG` badges) for first-party Mac play, with `S2Arm` behind `NX2APPLE_ENABLE_S2ARM=1`.

3. **Install new games without reinstalling the shared shell IPA (#1217, #1305, #1437, #1493, #1495)**: Export signed or unsigned `DmGame.framework` bundles into `Documents/Frameworks`, import a `.p12` sideload certificate on iOS for on-device framework signing (#1493), or hot-push directly on iOS 27 (`glueVersion: 2`), with no shell IPA reinstall required.

releases.body:
## What's New
#### Added
- Added **MIDI** support, allowing some games to play MIDI audio. The software comes with an open-source soundfont by [default](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/1517), and you can also install your preferred soundfont in the `Settings` (currently, only SF2 format is supported). Download Windows MIDI Soundfont [here](https://musical-artifacts.com/artifacts/713).
- Improved **OpenXR** suooport. Many thanks to **Luboš V.** , his work making OpenXR support possible and better.
- Improved Game Controller Support, you can now selectively use **XInput** or **DInput** mapping. Linear triggers now work with both mapping modes. For trigger button, if it’s not working correctly, try adjusting the trigger button mode in the `Settings` to match your controller.
- Added the feature to automatically set the container's **Locale**. You can now also adjust `LC_ALL` settings in the container editing interface.

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.2 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added support for `Box64rc`, allowing different Box64 parameters to be set for each process.
- Added `virtual touchscreen` support, also referred to as `direct cursor` support. True touchscreen support requires implementing the XInput2 extension.
- Added support for Chinese. And any corrections to the translation are welcome.
- Added an `content manager`, allowing you to install Wine, graphics drivers, or DX wrappers externally.
- Added the ability to reinstall system files, allowing recovery even if the system files are accidentally damaged.
- Added more VKD3D feature level options.
- Added android `file provider` feature, allowing access to the Winlator data directory through the file manager.
- Added the ability to add `shortcuts` to the home screen, allowing you to launch your programs directly from the desktop. Shortcut changes will be synced in real-time.

#### Fixed
- Fixed the crash issue that occurred when running programs with long Japanese or Chinese titles.
- Corrected the button styling in the DXVK configuration dialog.
- Fixed certain abnormal issues on some SoCs (such as 870), by compiling Box64 with the `BAD_SIGNAL` parameter enabled.

releases.name: Winlator 7.1.1 with Native Glibc
releases.body:
#### Added
- Added `dxvk-2.4` and `dxvk-gplasync-2.4`, and set dxvk-2.3.1 as the default dxvk. 
- Added version switching and configuration support for `vkd3d`.
- Added `vkd3d-2.13`.
- Added an older version of `box64` (`box64-2.8`).
- Added support for linear triggers. (currently only for Xinput)

#### Fixed
- Fixed the path for the dxvk configuration file.
- Fixed the path for the Virgl server; `VirGL` is now working.
- Fixed keyboard input issues for some games.

#### Changed
- The `AVX` extension for box64 is **disabled** by default. It needs to be manually enabled by creating a new `box64 preset` in the settings.
- Enabled all cores by default for experimental wow64.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1

**Note**: Please uninstall previous versions before installation to avoid potential errors. Remember to **back up** your data.

## OpenROM v4.1.0

Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit for retro gaming enthusiasts.

Each download includes:
- **OpenROM** — Flutter desktop GUI
- **openrom-core** — headless CLI (used internally by the GUI)

### CLI usage
```
openrom-core --detect game.iso
openrom-core --input game.iso --format CHD
openrom-core --folder /roms/ --format CHD --compression Max
openrom-core --list-formats
```

### Supported Formats
- PS1/Dreamcast/Saturn/Sega CD: BIN/CUE → CHD (createcd)
- PS2/GameCube/Wii: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO, RVZ
- Xbox: ISO → CHD (createdvd), CSO (XISO via community extension)
- PSP: ISO → CSO
- Universal: ZIP/7Z compression, IPS/BPS/xdelta3/DCP patching

### Downloads

|----------|------|
| 🪟 Windows (Portable) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0_Windows_Portable.zip` |
| 🪟 Windows (Installer) | `OpenROM-v4.1.0-Setup.exe` |

releases.name: 0.2.7-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
Translation mods for Awakening and the DLC.

### Mods

- **Translations of Awakening and every DLC** (issue #7). A translation's talk tables
  (.tlk) for Awakening and the DLC replace the game's own of the same name, as the main
  game's do.
  - Put them in a mod like any other files, then choose **Convert for this version** if they
    were made for the PC.
  - Tested with a Korean translation in the main campaign, Awakening, Leliana's Song, The
    Darkspawn Chronicles, The Golems of Amgarrak and Witch Hunt, and in the DLC played from
    the main campaign.
  - A language whose letters the game's font does not have (Korean, for example) also needs
    a font made for the Xbox 360 version. Without one, its text shows as boxes.
- **A mod that patches Awakening or a DLC** now works. Such a mod has an add-in with the
  game's own id, for example `DAO_PRC_EP_1` for Awakening.
  - **Convert for this version** now puts its files in the mod's override folder, where they
    replace the add-in's own.
  - Before, it was installed as a second add-in, and the game did not use its files.
  - If you converted such a mod with an earlier version, delete it in **Mods** and add it
    again.

releases.name: 0.2.6-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
A small fix.

### Fixed

- **An external controller can play** (issue #6). Pressing Start on it used to bring up a
  profile sign-in that never finished, because the game only took the handheld's own
  controller as player 1.
  - Now the controller you use is player 1: press a button on it, or push a stick or trigger
    firmly, and it takes over. The handheld's own controller takes it back the same way.
  - A controller connected while you play works too.
  - Tested on the AYN Thor with its own controller. If you play with an external one, please
    tell us in issue #6 how it goes.

### Installing

- **From 0.2.0-alpha to 0.2.5-alpha:** the launcher installs this update under **Launch Dragon
  Age**. No Build again is needed. Your saves, game data and settings stay.
- **From 0.1.9-alpha or earlier:** the launcher installs it too, and then shows **Build again**.
  Choose it once (about eight minutes).

releases.name: 0.2.5-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
A small update.

### Fixed

- **A texture that the game uses twice in one draw is loaded once.** It used to be prepared
  twice when it was out of date. This only happens while an area loads, a few times each, so
  loading does slightly less work. Frame rates in play are unchanged.
  - Checked in Circle Tower, Denerim's market, Orzammar's commons, the ruined temple of the
    Urn and Lothering's chantry, on the AYN Thor.
  - The fix comes from the Xenia Edge emulator project.

### Installing

- **From 0.2.0-alpha to 0.2.4-alpha:** the launcher installs this update under **Launch Dragon
  Age**. No Build again is needed. Your saves, game data and settings stay.
- **From 0.1.9-alpha or earlier:** the launcher installs it too, and then shows **Build again**.
  Choose it once (about eight minutes).

releases.name: 0.2.4-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### Faster

- **Up to 7% more frames a second, with nothing to set.** The renderer copies less between its
  render targets: when a draw is about to cover an area completely, the old picture there is no
  longer copied in first. The picture is unchanged.
  - At the King's Camp, the game went from 42.0 to 44.8 frames a second.
  - With FSR 3.1 Balanced, it went from 34.0 to 35.3.

### New: Eco shading

**Options -> Visual -> Eco shading** trades a little sharpness in the 3D scene for speed: the
scene's colours are worked out once for each two pixels (**Light**) or each block of four
(**Strong**). It is off by default and takes effect from the next start.
- **The HUD, text and the edges of leaves and grass stay sharp.** So do shadows and the
  post-processing.
- **Light** looks all but the same as off. **Strong** softens fine textures such as stone
  and cloth.
- **It needs a GPU driver with variable-rate shading.** The Thor's own driver has it. On a
  driver without it, the option changes nothing.

**Measured on the AYN Thor: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740), Android 13**, the system's driver:

| Eco shading | FSR 3.1 off | FSR 3.1 Balanced |
|---|---|---|

releases.name: 0.2.3-alpha - Open Alpha
releases.body:
### New: other Vulkan drivers (experimental)

You can now run the game on a Vulkan driver package other than your handheld's own: the
Adreno driver packages (`.zip`) made for AdrenoTools, as Android emulators use. This is an
experiment, closed away by default (issue #4).
- The handheld's own driver is never changed, and choosing **System** puts everything back.
- The game is tested on the system's driver. Another driver can be faster, slower, draw
  wrongly or not start.

**Loading a driver package:**
1. Put the driver package (`.zip`) somewhere on your handheld, for example in Download.
2. In the launcher, open the **Visual** tab and set **Experimental** to **Show**.
3. On **Import a driver package**, choose **Choose…** and pick the `.zip`. It is imported and
   chosen under **Vulkan driver**.
4. Close the app completely and open it again: a driver takes effect from the app's next
   start.

To go back, set **Vulkan driver** to **System** (from the next start too), or use **Remove
the chosen driver**, which deletes the package and what the app kept for it.
- **If something fails, the app goes back to System by itself and says why.** That covers a

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.17.1 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.17.1 Alpha

## Online Name Sync Update

BluBox profile names and BluBox online names now stay together.

### New

- Added **Edit Name** directly inside Friends & Online.
- Your BluBox profile name is now also shown as your online name.
- Changing the name from Friends & Online updates the active BluBox profile.
- Your BluTag automatically changes its name part to match the new profile name.
- The four-number BluTag suffix stays linked to the same BluBox profile.
- Existing saves, achievements, friends, profile photo and library stay attached to the same profile.

### Online beta status

Friends and presence are still stored locally in this alpha. Remote account syncing and real internet friend requests need the future BluBox online backend.

This is a BluBox social system and does not sign into Xbox Live.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.17.0 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.17.0 Alpha

## BluBox Social Update

BluBox 360 now has the first Friends & Online beta on Android.

### New

- Friends & Online screen in the BluBox side menu.
- Every local BluBox profile gets its own shareable BluTag.
- Copy your BluTag from the social screen.
- Add friends by BluTag.
- Friends are kept separately for each BluBox profile.
- Remove friends from your list.
- Online presence control with Online, Away and Offline states.
- Online Beta on/off control.
- Existing profiles, saves, achievements and game library stay separate from the social data.

### Online beta status

This alpha is the first social-system test. Friend entries and presence settings are stored locally on the Android device. Internet friend syncing, remote friend requests, game invites and emulator multiplayer are not live yet. Those features need a BluBox online service/backend before they can work between separate devices.

This release does not sign into Xbox Live and does not pretend to be Microsoft's Xbox network.

releases.name: BluBox 360 macOS 3.0.2 Preview
releases.body:
## BluBox 360 macOS 3.0.2 Preview

This Mac preview fixes the update experience and keeps the 3.0.1 Xenia launch hotfix.

- Adds **BluBox 360 > Software Update…** inside the app.
- Shows your installed version, the latest available Mac version, status, and release notes.
- Shows an in-app update banner when a newer Mac preview is available.
- Checks for a newer Mac preview automatically after launch.
- Adds **Update Now** for future Mac updates.
- Downloads the Mac ZIP from GitHub Releases and verifies it against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before installing.
- Replaces the existing app in place when macOS permits it, so the older version does not need to be uninstalled first.
- If macOS requires extra permission, BluBox opens the DMG so you can drag the new app over the old one and choose **Replace** instead of uninstalling.

**Preview warning:** this remains experimental macOS emulator software. CI verifies the app, bundled engines, launch sanitizer, signatures, update payload checksums, and startup self-tests. It does not prove that every Xbox 360 game boots or runs correctly.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.3 focuses on easier updating and safer sustained performance on Android handhelds such as the AYN Thor.

## Check for updates

- Added a **Check for updates** button under **Settings > App**.
- Automatic update checks keep the existing 15-minute cooldown.
- A manual check runs immediately and ignores the automatic cooldown.
- Manual checks now confirm when BluBox is already up to date.
- Manual checks show an error message if GitHub cannot be reached instead of silently closing.

## Smart Heat Guard

- Low Heat Mode remains available and still avoids maximum-clock requests.
- BluBox now checks Android thermal status and thermal headroom when a game launches.
- When Android reports thermal pressure, BluBox uses the low-heat launch preset even if Low Heat Mode was switched off.
- A 60 FPS target can be reduced to a 30 FPS safety ceiling when the device is already approaching thermal throttling.
- Shader creation is reduced to one worker under thermal pressure to lower sustained CPU load.
- Fable II keeps its existing 24 FPS safety ceiling.
- The existing severe-heat protection remains enabled during gameplay.

releases.name: BluBox 360 0.16.2 public alpha
releases.body:
# BluBox 360 0.16.2 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.2 is the Flat Cover Library Update, focused on making the game library cleaner and easier to browse.

## Flat cover library

- Flat front-cover artwork is now the default library style.
- Removed the plastic Xbox 360 case frame from game covers.
- Removed the green case border around cover artwork.
- Covers display the artwork itself without a fake box around it.
- Increased cover size so artwork is easier to see on handheld screens.
- Improved spacing between games for a cleaner library layout.
- Recently Played uses the same flat-cover style as the main library.
- All Games uses the same flat-cover style for a consistent look.

## Existing features

- HD+ graphics mode remains available.
- Retail cover import support remains available.
- Profiles, achievements, save-game progress and second-screen features remain included.
- Permanent BluBox signing and SHA-256 verification remain enabled.
- The updater fixes introduced in 0.16.1 remain included.

## Update notes

BluBox 360 is still in public alpha development. Back up important profiles and save data before installing a new alpha build.

Version: 0.16.2-alpha

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.13 (beta 45): correção para o travamento da Mali nas lutas
releases.body:
**Beta 45.** Uma correção para o travamento depois de alguns minutos de luta na Mali, e três mudanças de desempenho para a Mali.

## O travamento da Mali (#401)

Na Mali-G1 Ultra do #401, o jogo travava depois de alguns minutos de luta (com muitos efeitos), no modo Nativo e no Recompilado. Os logs mostravam uma thread do jogo presa percorrendo a lista de blocos livres do alocador de memória do jogo, que dava a volta.

- **A causa provável:** na Mali, o que um shader grava na memória do jogo é copiado de volta quando a GPU termina. Fora da "arena" de memória global, essa cópia era da faixa inteira, e desfazia o que o jogo tinha escrito ali no meio-tempo, inclusive os cabeçalhos e os links da lista de blocos livres, que ficam logo antes dos buffers. A 0.4.10 já fazia a cópia certa, mas só dentro da arena, que nunca liga nas Malis cujo driver oferece a importação de memória (como a G1 Ultra).
- **O que muda:** agora volta só o que a GPU mudou, palavra por palavra, e o que o jogo escreveu no meio-tempo fica. Quando isso acontece, o log diz `copy-back: a word the game wrote meanwhile kept`.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.12 (beta 44): eixos do giroscópio do controle e FIFO no Adreno 7xx
releases.body:
**Beta 44.** Duas opções novas, uma correção do HUD nos santuários e duas mudanças para a Mali.

## Novidades

- **Eixos do giroscópio do controle** (Configurações > Controles; #511, #521): para controles cujo giroscópio informa os eixos em outra ordem, como o DataFrog B01 e o Flydigi Direwolf 4, e a mira anda de lado quando você levanta o controle. As opções são "Como o controle informa", "Trocar esquerda-direita e cima-baixo", "Trocar cima-baixo e inclinação" e "Trocar esquerda-direita e inclinação". A troca vale na hora.
- **Esperar a tela (FIFO)** (tela inicial, em Compatibilidade do driver; #367): num Adreno 730, a imagem congelava por segundos enquanto o som e o jogo continuavam. Esperar a tela resolveu. A opção tem Automático, Ligado e Desligado. O Automático liga no Adreno 7xx e deixa desligado nas outras GPUs, como antes. Se a imagem congelar assim no seu aparelho, ligue.

## Correções

- **Minimapa em cima, nos santuários** (#261): com o minimapa em cima, as barras de som e temperatura subiam e desciam a cada segundo dentro dos santuários. Uma peça do HUD que aparece e some ali era tomada pelo disco do minimapa. Agora só o disco conta.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.11 (beta 43): o jogo não fecha mais por falta de memória no Adreno 640
releases.body:
**Beta 43.** Uma correção para o jogo que fechava depois de alguns minutos num Adreno 6xx com 8 GB de RAM.

## Adreno 6xx com 8 GB de RAM (#520)

O log do OnePlus 7 Pro (Adreno 640, 8 GB) mostrou que a GPU ficava sem memória: depois de 8 a 28 minutos, o driver não conseguia mais criar os pipelines (os "programas" que desenham cada tipo de objeto), e o jogo fechava logo depois.

- **A causa:** no Turnip, a opção **Memória do jogo na GPU (Turnip)** no Automático coloca os ~3,1 GB da memória do jogo direto na GPU. Num aparelho com 8 GB, isso deixava pouca memória para o próprio driver.
- **O que muda:** num Adreno 6xx com 8 GB de RAM ou menos, o Automático agora deixa essa opção desligada, e o jogo trabalha com cópias. A tela inicial avisa isso embaixo da opção. Com cópias, o mesmo aparelho jogou 2 horas sem fechar, com o texto certo e de 13 a 16 fps (antes, de 10 a 14). Quem quiser pode ligar a opção na mão.
- **E se a memória acabar mesmo assim:** antes, um pipeline que falhava por falta de memória ficava perdido até o fim da sessão, e o que ele desenhava sumia. Agora os pipelines sem uso são liberados na hora, e o que falhou é criado de novo 5 s depois.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.10 (beta 42): uma correção para o travamento na Mali
releases.body:
**Beta 42.** Uma correção para o travamento depois de alguns minutos nas GPUs que trabalham no modo cópia (Mali e o driver de fábrica da Qualcomm).

## O travamento depois de alguns minutos (#401, #489)

Os logs da 0.4.9 mostraram que o problema não era a ordem das threads nos núcleos: com a opção nova ligada, o jogo travou do mesmo jeito, e o laço estava no **alocador de memória do jogo**, que percorria uma lista de blocos livres danificada.

- **A causa provável:** nessas GPUs, o que um shader grava na memória do jogo volta para ela depois que a GPU termina. Cada pedaço era conferido ("a GPU mudou, o jogo não") e depois copiado inteiro. Se uma thread do jogo escrevesse no mesmo pedaço entre as duas coisas, por exemplo nos dados que o alocador guarda ao lado de cada bloco, essa escrita se perdia. Uma escrita perdida ali deixa a lista de blocos livres em laço, e o jogo para.
- **A correção:** só volta o que a GPU mudou, palavra por palavra, e cada palavra só é escrita se o jogo não a mudou nesse meio-tempo. A escrita do jogo nunca se perde.

  - Usa meia precisão e o limiar padrão do FXAA 3.11, em vez do "ultra".

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

New in 1.38.3: Controller rework: 10 buttons per player, numbered naming and savestate fixes

- Two extra gamepad buttons per player (10 total), for pads with back paddles
  or a full face cluster.
- Buttons renamed from letters to numbers (BTN1..BTN10) in the mapping screen,
  the on-screen art and the OSD, so they no longer clash with the pad's A/B/X/Y.
- Deleting a savestate now goes through SAF, so it really disappears from
  MAME's list instead of lingering as a stale cache entry.
- Save/load state menus: every face button can name a slot, BTN1 and BTN2
  included.

NOTE: custom controller mappings reset to defaults on upgrade, since the
  added buttons shifted every stored index.

****

New in 1.38.2: Netplay menu/Lua, touch lightgun fixes, full emulation area and vector polish

Netplay
- MAME's menu and Lua plugins now work during netplay: the menu combo is
  intercepted through a side channel and stripped from the synced input.
- New "Allow Lua plugins in netplay" preference, off by default

Touch lightgun
- Aiming maps to the game screen inside the canvas instead of the whole view,
  fixing the drift towards the edges with artwork or the full emulation area.

New in 1.37.3: NetPlay IPv6 support — connects straight through CGNAT, ideal for playing over mobile networks (4G/5G)
****
New in 1.37.2:   SAF concurrent persistent cache with lazy loading for improved start time
****
New in 1.37.1: i18n & fixes
****

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

### Two sync modes:
- **Rollback** — save-state resimulation for near-zero input lag, ideal for fighting games and fast action titles. Boot is fully deterministic (RTC, samplerate, disk/NVRAM state pinned), so only inputs ever cross the network — nothing bulky to transfer at connect time.
- **Lockstep** — simple guaranteed sync for titles where rollback doesn't apply cleanly.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.288) 1.36.6
releases.body:
New in 1.36.6:

- Added Full-Screen Vector CRT Monitor Glow. Simulates the physical off-screen light scattering of the original arcade hardware (Starwars).
- Optimizations.

****

New in 1.36.4:

Replaced the vector CPU-generated geometric glow with a pure GPU optical post-processing pipeline (Dual-Filter Kawase 13-taps/9-taps via FBOs). This shift in vector rendering unlocks the true potential of the HDR engine. By physically scattering raw light energy rather than faking it with geometry.

****

**Core Update:**

- Updated to MAME 0.288 (For a full list of changes, visit the official MAME website).

**Major GLES Graphics Overhaul:**

Major overhaul of the MAME4droid GLES graphics pipeline, introducing a significantly improved rendering architecture for both raster and vector games.

1. Advanced Vector CRT Simulation:

    - Complete rewrite of the vector rendering engine to replicate the physical and optical properties of classic arcade CRT monitors.
    - Physically-inspired electron beam simulation with enhanced optical bloom and light diffusion effects.
    - Improved phosphor persistence, realistic color blending, and accurate crosstalk behavior.

emulators.description: 专为《魔兽世界》3.3.5a 定制的 Winlator 分支，内置触屏操作方案。
emulators.latest_body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

releases.name: WoW Mobile v0.1.1
releases.body:
First public release.

**WoW Mobile** runs World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) on Android with touch controls designed for [ConsolePortLK](https://github.com/leoaviana/ConsolePortLK). It is a single-purpose fork of [Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) (LGPL-2.1).

## Install
1. Download and sideload `wow-mobile-v0.1.1.apk` (installs alongside stock Winlator — separate app id `it.wowmobile`)
2. Put your own WoW 3.3.5a (build 12340) client folder on the phone's storage — **no game files are included**
3. Open the app → allow storage → *Select game folder* → PLAY

On first launch the app installs the bundled ConsolePortLK addons, calibrates the bindings, sets the realmlist (changeable in WoW Settings) and creates a tuned Wine container. After your first login, log out once so it can finish per-account calibration — then everything just works.

## Highlights
- One-tap play: folder validation, addon install, key bindings, realmlist and graphics config are all automatic and idempotent — an already-configured folder is never damaged

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ3
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ3** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ3 — Graphics API option, shader optimizer, crash fix, the Mali regression and the frame-drop round (same graphics)

- **New: Graphics API setting (Vulkan / OpenGL ES) — the compatibility backend.** Settings → Graphics (also per game). Vulkan remains the default: it renders and presents directly, the fastest path. The new OpenGL ES mode is for devices whose Vulkan present path is broken while offscreen Vulkan and EGL work: the final frame is drawn into a 3-image AHardwareBuffer ring (`VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer`) and a fully runtime-loaded EGL/GLES renderer (no build-time EGL dependency) presents it to the same SurfaceView — same pixels. Frames stay in the UNORM variant of the guest format so sRGB-encoded bytes reach the screen untouched. The core falls back to the Vulkan swapchain automatically when the device lacks AHardwareBuffer import, EGL fails at runtime, or after five present failures; the Vulkan path is untouched while the setting stays on Vulkan (`debug.capy.gl_back

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ2
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ2** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ2 — heavy-game crash fix, 90/120 Hz unlock, hot-pipeline compilation, deeper Snapdragon + Mali profiles (same graphics)

- **Fixed: heavy Unreal Engine titles no longer crash seconds into gameplay.** GPU-driven draw batches (DrawIndirectMulti) read their draw counts and argument buffers from game memory that the game is free to release; a read that landed on freed memory faulted inside libc and ended the session with "Unhandled host exception ... in DrawIndirectMulti". Every such guest read is now guarded: the count goes through the fault-safe reader, and the two raw copies of the guest read path run behind a fault guard that unwinds cleanly - a batch whose arguments vanished is skipped, exactly like a real GPU reading zero from an unmapped address, and the page is evicted from the thread's cache so the next read probes instead of faulting. GPU-tracker-protected pages still download and resume first; only truly unreadable memory takes the recovery. `debug.capy.guarded_reads=0` restores the raw copi

releases.name: Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ1
releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ1** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ1 — crash fixes, import/storage fixes + much deeper GPU optimization (same graphics)

- **Fixed: the app could crash right after importing a game.** Importing the same executable twice (typically a retry after the game crashed) added two library entries with the same key, which the game grid cannot render — the app died with "Key ... was already used". Imports now run one at a time (a second pick while a multi-GB copy is still running no longer races the first), a completed import reuses the existing library entry instead of adding a twin, and the grid list itself is deduplicated as a last line of defence.

releases.name: v2.0.1
releases.body:
v2.0.1 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

A stability and hygiene patch for v2.0.0, focused on the crash and antivirus reports from the first few hours.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Stability

- Fixed a crash on Linux and macOS where the game could die suddenly during gameplay when world streaming revoked memory the renderer was reading
- Fixed distant demoted tree trunks rendering with a flat blue texture

#### Antivirus false positives

- The Windows executable and runtime DLL now carry proper version metadata, and the runtime no longer contains any ability to create executable memory (it never used it - all game code is compiled at build time); both changes target the machine-learning heuristics some antivirus engines were tripping on
- A false-positive report has been filed with Microsoft for the v2.0.0 files; if your antivirus quarantined the runtime, restore it or re-download this release

#### Diagnostics

- The game now logs its exact build version at startup, so support logs identify the build they came from

releases.name: v2.0.0 (use new v2.0.2)
releases.body:
Use the new v2.0.2 release for critical fixes.

v2.0.0 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

Skate 3 now renders natively. This release replaces the emulated Xbox 360 GPU with a new renderer built directly on Direct3D 12 and Vulkan: more than double the frame rate at around a quarter of the GPU power draw, and on macOS a jump from roughly 25 FPS to 250 FPS at 4K. The entire game renders natively at close visual parity with the console output, with a set of optional modern graphics enhancements that seek to go beyond it.

The new native renderer is early and is likely to have issues, I haven't tested the game all the way through.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Native renderer

- New native renderer on Direct3D 12 and Vulkan, enabled by default, replacing the emulated Xbox 360 GPU
- More than 2x the frame rate at about a quarter of the GPU power draw; macOS goes from ~25 FPS to ~250 FPS (at 4K render scaling, excluding the optional enhancements like PCSS shadows)

releases.name: v1.0.5

## Notes

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.9
releases.body:
hub 联邦新增传递式广告、会话代码 FIND 与逐跳加入：开启 `-federation-transitive N` 后，多台服务器可以共享更远的集会所，列表、代码搜索和 TCP/UDP 加入都沿同一路径转发，老 peer 自动退回普通直连模式。已用 50 台服务器的 49 跳链路测试列表、FIND、加入、TCP/UDP 和好友状态。

好友在线状态也支持传递同步与自然离线：presence 记录带 origin/hops 逐跳转发；新增 `-presence-ttl`（默认 90 秒），玩家停止上报或中间服务器记录到期时立即广播 tombstone 清理远端记录，不再等下游完整 TTL。

同步 MHGURecomp 0.20.1：链路协议 v4（集会所代码、按代码加入、好友在线/请求/删除、HUBS4 与 3-4 人链接池）、上游修复、Mod 互操作与调试改进；设置菜单按显示/图形/音频/控制/在线/玩法/系统/模组/金手指重构；跨平台联机修改 RyuLdn 地址后下一次搜索立即使用新地址。

兼容 ID 更新为 `3bfb26af6be3424b`：`libmhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.dll` 必须用本版工具重新生成；旧游戏代码库会被启动时明确拒绝。0.2.9 的三平台游戏代码库以压缩包分装，放在私有仓库 `MEKCCK/MHGU-Relink-GameLibs` 的 `v0.2.9-libs` 发行中。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.8
releases.body:
设置里新增 HUD 大小（60–100%），整个狩猎 HUD 朝各自角落缩小；低端模式新增「最低配」档，3D 分辨率下限放宽到 10%；新增粒子特效开关；内存低于 3.5 GB 的设备再丢一层纹理，低于 5 GB 可开「完整纹理」；3D 分辨率低于 100% 时可选锐利（最近邻）放大；帧率上限为刷新率整数分之一时改用 FIFO 呈现；PC 低端模式改按画面行数换算分辨率。

帧率／温度面板的位置只能在设置里改：设置 → 触控 → 「自定义触控按键」，在布局编辑器里拖动它自己的框，松手即保存（`[Performance] StatsX / StatsY`）；游戏里直接拖面板不会移动。设置 → 显示里原本的横向／纵向两行百分比已移除。

安卓：设置里新增「检查更新」，可自行选择是否下载新版本 APK；修复开关道具箱后狩技槽由 1 个变成 3 个（其中两个空槽）。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.7
releases.body:
- 触控（Android）：修复物品栏滑动与触控按键冲突——从仅落入按键隐形热区（拇指扩大的判定范围）的位置开始的滑动，现改为驱动物品栏或狩技面板；可见的按键区域仍保持原优先级（#9）。
- 狩技面板（Android）：修复第三行点击识别在画面密集时丢失——每帧猎技部件不再受 32 片上限影响，行按游戏坐标预分组，触控区域与显示同步（#9）。
- 应用图标更换为狩技／武器类型徽章面板（Windows、Linux、Android 及更新器），矢量源 `extras/icon/mhgu-relink.svg`。
- 游戏代码库自 0.2.6 起无变化，兼容 ID 仍为 `3bfb26af6be3424a`；旧 `libmhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.dll` 继续可用。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.6
releases.body:
- 奖励箱（结算画面）：修复「按住 A 连续发送」在 0.2.5 中失效——初始化钩子在版本合并时丢失，现已恢复接线。结算界面按住 A 逐件把奖励送入道具箱，松手即停，单点仍只送一件，走游戏原生按键。
- 集会所村庄任务：补上离开集会所／酒场时释放村庄任务文本包的每帧检查（uScheduler 更新处，0.2.5 合并时同样丢失）。此前从集会所或酒场开村庄任务，文本包会被带进任务，导致帕利科半透明白模、地形变黑并在换区时崩溃（2026-11-13 报告，仅中文版）。
- 兼容 ID 更新为 3bfb26af6be3424a：`libmhgugame.so`／`mhgugame.dll` 需随本版用 `tools/build_game.py`／`build_game_windows.py` 重新生成，旧游戏代码库会被启动时明确拒绝。

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.5
releases.body:
- 内置 Forge 升级到 2.0.0：新增 NVN 回调/纹理接口、按内容校验资源，并保留旧 1.5.1 资源。
- 自动跑步（Android）：收刀动画结束前不注入 R，修复勇气风格特殊纳刀/收刀期间被判定为收刀而触发自动 R；新增“完全收刀”判定，读取游戏在动画结束后才清除的状态字节。已完全收刀时按住 Y（道具键）不会拦截跑步；村庄、集会所等没有猎人对象的场景恢复可用。
- 右摇杆：修复显示右摇杆后无法转视角（原生相机处理被误跳过）；默认隐藏且隐藏时不接收触摸，放出来后按原生右摇杆转动镜头。
- Android 控制页新增“手柄按键提示”（Switch／Xbox／PlayStation）：默认 Switch 使用游戏原版，Xbox 与 PlayStation 由本程序重绘游戏内提示纹理（面键字母/图形、LB/RB/LT/RT、L1/R1/L2/R2）；手柄与键盘提示统一为黑字白底，提高对比度。设置菜单的“Button icons”仍单独控制自身图标。
- 设置菜单重新分区：显示、画面与音频、控制、网络、杂项、菜单选项按用途分组（音频、语音聊天、画面、HDR、手柄、键鼠、触控布局、镜头、集会所、跨平台、外观、通用、存档、应用）；`加号 + 减号` 与确认键归入菜单选项，Android 存档导入/导出移到“存档数据”。
- 汉化统一：Hub 统一为“集会所/集会所服务器”，怪物生命统一为“体力/体力倍率”，并统一道具、回避、作弊码、低配模式、标签页、涂瓶、猎人等级等术语；修正缺失文件提示的占位符顺序、RyuLdn 口令、跨平台说明和 Android 导入界面的“金手指”残留。
- 狩技触屏锁定：右摇杆型狩技点按注入的短暂轴输入不再被当作手动视角，锁定跟随不会中断；物理右摇杆仍按原意暂停跟随。
- Forge 插件回调串行化：`forge_onNvnRender` 在呈现线程、其余回调在更新线程，统一加锁避免 Forge 2 插件跨线程竞态；文件适配器导出名也纳入回归断言。
- Android 内置 Forge 2.0.0 资源按内容校验修复：长度相同但内容损坏的文件也会重写；补充西语“暂停调和”，并约束 Forge 纹理视图拷贝大小。
- 调和一键连续：触屏点击一次“调和”后连续进行，再点原来的调和位置可随时暂停，已开始的一次正常完成；连续过程中不反复显示“调和／停止”确认框，保留原生结果动画。首次新配方的结果确认自动衔接；未手动暂停时，材料不足或数量已满会停止并关闭弹窗，返回配方列表。取消、停止、导航、切换菜单、布局编辑或切后台立即撤销自动输入，保留原生按键和物品数量判定。

releases.name: melonRA 0.5.1
releases.body:
# Changes (**Mainly bugfixes!**)
- Linux: Accepting a Netplay invite through Discord without having melonRA open would show an "Unknown protocol" error message, this was because it wasn't registered properly with the rest of apps in the OS, it now handles it properly.
- Netplay: Errors whilst syncing up instances and saves with the "hidden consoles" used for Netplay.
- Netplay: Closing the room closes the open UDP port after a while.
- Netplay: Closing a room with nobody connected is now instant.
- _Other minor Netplay fixes._
- Rewind kept its history after inserting a cartridge or booting up firmware. Meaning that, rewinding could make you rewind to a previous game. This has been patched.
- _Other general fixes._
- Casual mode offline unlocks were dropped if the saved login expired when its sent, now it is kept for the next login. And now the text is clearer when you play offline.

releases.name: melonRA 0.5.0
releases.body:
# Additions and changes
- There's a new and more concise **settings window** which shows all categories of settings in the same window without having to close and open them separately.
- **The name of the game is shown in the window title now, as well as its icon in the taskbar.**
- **"Hybrid Single"** as a new screen layout mode, literally the same as _Hybrid_, but without the mirroring of the top screen. _(Perfect for dyslexic people, like me! :D)_
- New **Time Played** and **Last Played** columns on the game list.
- **New option to mark games as "Favorite"** (it shows with a little heart besides the title, same place as the mastery and game settings cog) and a new tab for all favorite games.
- The ability to **make a desktop shortcut** for any game, which uses the actual icon of the ROM.
- **Thumbnails** for every save state slot.
- New option to **resume where you left off last session.** (Found in _Interface Settings_)
- New Rewind hotkey, must be enabled also in _Interface Settings_ alongside the amount of seconds you can rewind back to.
- **Trimmed the executable** so its a smaller download overall.

releases.name: melonRA 0.4.0
releases.body:
**NOTE:** As of today, 28/10, the emulator isn't yet verified for Hardcore completions in RetroAchievements' side. Some features might not be available just yet.

# Additions and changes
- **Discord Rich Presence** is now available, shows the emulator's name, the logo and header name of the ROM you are playing. When paired with RetroAchievements, shows details of their own Rich Presence on Discord (showing what you are doing in the game, the icon of the game's set, etc.)
- Some game list changes, including a new option **to display an achievement completion bar**, it'll turn gold when the game is Mastered. And it will show a little star in the title of the game, or in the cover when in grid mode.
- You can now right click games in the list and click "Achievements..." **it'll take you to that game's achievement page** where you can see your progress.
- A **hotkey to rotate the screens has been added** under Input and Hotkeys > General Hotkeys. Useful for games that require a lot of screen layout changes and rotation.

releases.name: melonRA 0.3.0
releases.body:
**NOTE:** As of today, 10/27, RetroAchievements hasn't yet verified the emulator for Hardcore support. So some features might not completely work as intended.

**NOTE 2:** Version no longer available because of updater changes for security reasons.

# Additions and changes
- **You can now unlock achievements whilst offline**, it will save the achievement data and will unlock them once it can reach the server again. (Both _Hardcore_ and _Casual_)
- Challenge indicators in the overlay are able to be **hovered on**, showing the requisites for the challenge itself and how many points its worth.
- **Quick screen layout and sizing hotkeys** (under _General Hotkeys_ in _Input and Hotkeys_ tab)
- **Game list has been optimised** so that it remembers your games already attributed, and only updates when it detects new ones or deletes when it doesn't see them in the directory.
- **Settings can now be exported and restored** from one system to another (excluding RetroAchievements login info)
- _Kaeru WFC_ and _Wiimmfii_ support in the **online play server picker** under _Wi-Fi Settings_

releases.name: melonRA 0.2.0
releases.body:
**NOTE:** Version no longer available because of updater changes for security reasons.

# Additions and changes
 - **Game list:** Now instead of the default melonDS starting screen, the emulator will prompt you to add a path for your games, and thus will put them in a modern, slicker game list that shows you the title of the game, its icon, region (and a flag!) and developer. 
 - The game list can be set to a **grid mode**, which will parse the covers of your downloaded library and make them appear uniformly in a square grid, you are able to change the sizing of this grid with a slider.
- **RetroAchievements sets** from your populated game list can all be viewed under "Achievements..." on the "RetroAchievements" tab. Your currently playing sits at the top showing all the subsets, whilst the rest are in a list to the side.
- **Overlay customisation:** you can now choose where elements are positioned in the screen under "Settings..." on the "RetroAchievements" tab. You will be able to choose where certain elements appear, and their visuals (such as having bolded text, making them smaller, or changing the colors to a simpler scheme)

releases.body:
# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.2.0

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders, SDL3.dll and vcruntime140.dll beside it. If you're updating, unzip over your old folder; your saves and settings stay.
- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over the previous version. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Languages.** Options > Gameplay > Language. English is built in. For Japanese, French, German, Italian or Spanish, choose it, then Language pack: it asks for your Japanese (S2LJ01) or European (S2LP01) disc image and makes a language pack from it. The game still runs from the USA disc. The port's own menus are translated too.
- **Audio options.** Options > Audio: music, sound effects and voices volumes, and the voices' language (English, Japanese, French or German), chosen apart from the text's.
- **Controls overhaul.**
  - Menus and minigames can be bound apart from the park.
  - Inverted look, stick dead zone and stick speed.

releases.name: PokePark 2: Wiicompiled, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2
releases.body:
# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders, SDL3.dll and vcruntime140.dll beside it. If you're updating, unzip over your old folder; your saves and settings stay.
- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over the previous version. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Many more controllers on Windows.** PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro, 8BitDo and most other controllers now work over USB or Bluetooth, read through SDL3, alongside Xbox ones. Buttons go by position: the bottom face button is A (cross on a PlayStation controller). With more than one connected, they all control the game.
- **Aiming with the stick.** Where the game uses the Wii Remote's pointer, the right stick now moves it slowly near the middle, for aiming, and much faster at full tilt, for turning.

## Known issues

- The Wii Remote speaker, pointer and Nunchuk aren't supported; the game doesn't need them.

releases.body:
# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.1

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over 0.1.0. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Bring your Wii or Dolphin save.** On the save files screen, Options > Gameplay > Import Wii save takes a Wii's `data.bin` straight from its SD card, the files in Dolphin's save folder, or a zip of them. The save you had is kept beside it, in a `data before import` folder. **Export Wii save** writes your save as a zip, to import on another PC or phone or unzip into Dolphin.
- **Skip movies.** Hold + (P, or Start on a controller) to skip a story movie.
- **Smoother on Android.** Scenery the game keeps several copies of is now drawn from one: on an AYN Thor, graphics memory fell from about 320 MB to 185 MB, and stutters (frames over 20 ms) from 20–40 to 5–9 in a two-minute run.

The first release: a native Windows and Android version of the game, recompiled from the Wii original. No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01), as an ISO, RVZ, WBFS or the like.

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; a graphics card with Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders beside it.

Fixes from the first problem reports sent from the app, plus the performance work since 0.19.0.

releases.name: XRecomp v0.19.0
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.19.0

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A second Xbox 360 performance night, measured headless on Warhammer: Battle March. Frames and save states are byte
identical to 0.18.0, except where a change is opt-in or per title (below).

- **Guest CPU**: `MmQueryStatistics` keeps a page count instead of scanning (it was half of the boot's host CPU). The
  VMX helpers work on 16- and 8-bit lanes, use the compiler's vector extensions and are inlined. Host CPU: the boot
  is 3× faster and in-game play 1.8× (141 → 79 ms of guest time per swap). The scheduler turn is cheaper and makes
  the same decisions. Prepare is not slower: the VMX-heavy files compile 27–41 % faster with NDK clang.
- **Renderer**: 16-bit resolve formats take the fast path, and the stencil is read back in 2 passes instead of 8.
  Tiled addressing is worked out per tile row, texture rows are read 16 bytes at a time, texture memory is hashed in
  8 lanes and packed vertex formats use tables. Renderer CPU per swap is about half of 0.18.0's.

releases.name: XRecomp v0.18.1
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.18.1

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

Fixes from the first Fold8 problem report on Adventure Time (Xbox 360).

- **Screenshots of GPU pictures**: « Report a problem › Add a screenshot », the companion panel's screenshot and the
  automatic cover shot had no frame for a game presented as a GPU texture (Xbox 360, GameCube with GX or GPU-YUV).
  The window now draws the picture it shows into a picture of its own when one is asked, also while the game is
  paused behind the menu, with the right colours (the Xbox 360 swizzle and float frames). F12 uses the same grab.
- **Frame generation on the Xbox 360** reads the picture as the window shows it (no red / blue swap, float frames
  readable).
- **Frame generation without Lossless.dll**: a game's « On » is dimmed in its Options with the reason, and the game
  starts without frame generation instead of logging « no shader cache »; the choice applies once the DLL is imported.
- **Logs**: console games (GBA, PS1, N64, GameCube, Xbox 360) no longer log « the disc image cannot be read »; one line
  says the game goes to its own runtime.

releases.name: XRecomp v0.18.0
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.18.0

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A speed night on every console but the Xbox 360. Every change is bit-exact: frame, RAM and audio hashes over 600
frames or more are identical to 0.17.0, and lockstep with the interpreters holds.

| Console | x86-64 instructions per frame (bench) | Prepare again? |
|---|---|---|
| GBA | 9.06M → 7.09M (−22 %) | yes |
| PS1 | 8.08M → 6.49M (−20 %) | no |
| N64 | 6.58M → 5.65M (−14 %) | yes |
| GameCube | audio mix −24 %, GX front end −14 % | no |
| Xbox | float stack code −30 % on arm64 (`fistp` without libm) | yes |

- **GBA**: the prefetch model charges a run of plain instructions in one call, and exact segment cycles keep lifted
  code running (instructions handed to the interpreter −43 %).
- **PS1**: the SPU skips idle voices and silent reverb; handed instructions run in one loop; the HLE interrupt entry
  and exit copy registers in blocks.
- **N64**: COUNT reads stay in lifted code (polling screens 7× cheaper); one range test per store; the AI resampler
  skips silence; a cheaper dispatcher hit.

**Preview build: please test it and tell us what you find. This is experimental and not for everyone. Install it only if you accept that.**

This preview takes in 42 community pull requests in one step. The stable release stays v0.3.51, and this preview is offered only to players on the Preview channel (Settings › Updates › Update channel).

- **Things may break.** Games, settings and the launcher can behave differently. Back up first; your saves and settings are kept.

releases.name: v0.3.51
releases.body:
**A small fix update.** Update in the app or install over any older version. Your games, saves and settings stay. Shaders don't change.

Update type: hotfix

More guides on the [wiki](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/wiki).

## What's new

- The Home screen shows a **Preview** or **Hotfix** chip when you run such a build, and Settings › Updates says which build you run.
- The touch hint strip at the bottom of Home is gone. Controller hints stay.

## From the community

Thanks to everyone who sent these:

- Fast Fusion (`040041E0212AE000`): Prepare no longer stops on its 62 task/mesh shaders ([#566](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/issues/566), [#308](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/issues/308)): [#569](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/pulls/569) (cr1stian)
- The GPU clock floor and the power hint follow an active frame rate cap, so there is less heat with a 30 or 40 fps cap: [#548](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/pulls/548) (ts-miller)

releases.name: v0.3.50
releases.body:
**Our first weekly release.** Update in the app or install over any older version. Your games, saves and settings stay. Shaders don't change. After the update, the app rewrites each game's code once in the background, so let that finish before you play.

Update type: major

## You choose how often you update

From now on there's one main release a week. Pick your channel in **Settings › Updates › Update channel**:

- **Stable** (default): the weekly release, plus critical fixes.
- **Hotfix**: also the small fixes between weekly releases, as soon as they're out.
- **Preview**: also early builds of bigger changes, about a week before Stable. They can break things, so pick this only if you want to help test.

The channel list shows which version each channel would give you right now. When you switch, you see the release notes before anything installs. Critical fixes reach every channel and are marked **Important fix**. A dot on the Settings button tells you an update is waiting.

releases.name: v0.3.45
releases.body:
**Fixes v0.3.44's crash at boot in every game.** Install over v0.3.44 or update in the app. Games, packs, saves and settings are kept. The app rewrites each game's code once more in the background; wait for it to finish before you start a game.

Update type: critical

## What changed

- Every game crashed about a second after start on v0.3.44 (`SIGSEGV`, `addr=0`). The new rewrite for conditional selects read a register that is always 0 on Android. Thanks to LemuelDayrit for finding the line ([#481](https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/issues/481)).

releases.name: Open Amalur for Android v0.1.35
releases.body:
- **Faster gameplay.** Eleven engine optimisations that were only switched on during development are now on for everyone. In two test scenes on an OPPO Pad, frame rates rose by a third to a half (for example from 40 to 60 FPS). Devices whose processors lack the required instructions skip those optimisations automatically.
- **Dynamic Resolution recovers on 60 Hz screens.** On a 60 Hz display, once Dynamic Resolution lowered the resolution it couldn't raise it again. It now tries a higher resolution after about 10 seconds of steady play, and waits longer if that proves too demanding.

releases.name: Open Amalur for Android v0.1.34
releases.body:
- **Aggressive Mode.** Tap **Sneak** near a friendly NPC. When the skull appears, tap **Aggressive Mode** above Sneak to turn it on or off.
- **Map waypoints.** On the local or world map, hold a point-of-interest icon for half a second, then lift to place a red X. Repeat on the same icon to remove it.
- **Map zoom.** Spread two fingers to zoom in or pinch them together to zoom out on either map.
- **Sliders.** When choosing sleep hours or an item quantity, tap the track, drag the handle, or tap **−** or **+**. Tap **Select** to confirm or **Close** to cancel.
- **Cast and Run/Leap.** You can now cast or sprint near a friendly NPC without starting a conversation. Tap **Interact** when you want to talk.

releases.name: Open Amalur for Android v0.1.33
releases.body: - Fixed touch spell casting while moving. Tap a numbered slot to cast its assigned spell, or tap **Cast** to repeat the last selection. Tapping an empty slot keeps your current spell selected.

releases.name: Open Amalur for Android v0.1.32
releases.body:
- **Assign and cast spells by touch.** Open **Game Menu → Abilities**, tap a learned active ability, then tap the numbered slot where you want it. Back in gameplay, tap that slot **once** to select and cast the spell. The separate **Cast** button casts your last selected spell again. Empty slots leave your selection alone. Normal mana costs and cooldowns apply.
- **Customize your touch controls.** Open **Edit Layout** and tap a button or stick. Use **Opacity − / +** to make it fainter or more visible. At 0%, the control is hidden during normal gameplay and stays visible in the editor so you can bring it back. Every gameplay touch button and both sticks can be moved and resized. Drag a control to move it, use **Size − / +** to resize it, then tap **Done** to save your layout.
- **Quick Save.** Tap **Quick Save** during gameplay whenever the game allows saving. To resume, open **Load Game** and tap the entry marked **Quick Save**. Your spell assignments are saved with your character.
- **Weapons and Armor.** Item details now appear beside the inventory list so you can read both panels without overlap.

releases.name: Winlator-Glibc v2.0
releases.body:
# 说明
从Winlator-Glibc v2版本开始项目将使用全新命名空间，这意味着你可以无需删除曾经的v1或者7.1.6版本即可安装此版本，但是我依然推荐你将曾经的版本删除，以后我将只为拥有新命名空间的版本进行软件包的更新与维护，新旧版本的 Wine、Box64、Turnip 等组件不再兼容，也无法混用。
# 更新内容
- 使用全新安卓命名空间
- 重新编译rootfs
- 支持 Vulkan 1.4+ API
- 弃用X Server服务，使用Termux-X11作为显示后端（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 升级Zink版本，Zink版本将与Turnip版本同步更新
- 添加Freedreno驱动支持
- 补全GStreamer环境，当前版本：稳定版 v1.28.3（来自[Waim908](https://github.com/Waim908)）
- 升级MangoHud版本，当前版本：正式版 v0.8.4
- 优化安卓层面的性能监控，GPU采用获取真实数据逻辑
- 添加KDE桌面鼠标主题，可在编辑容器界面中的Wine配置选项中切换主题与鼠标大小
# Bug修复
- 修复启动容器与退出容器有几率崩溃的问题（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 修复摇杆无法自由移动的问题
- 修复快捷方式中"添加到主屏幕"功能不可用的问题
- 修复虚拟控件手柄摇杆有几率卡住的问题
- 修复使用桌面快捷方式启动容器应用时无法启动的问题
# 常见问题说明
- 由于Termux-X11的渲染问题，在容器中使用"创建快捷方式"功能的时候会触发渲染错误，退出容器后重新启动即可解决，此问题并不影响快捷方式的创建
- 由于a8xx架构处理器将路径锁死，用户态没有权限读取GPU的实时数据，所以a8xx设备在使用MangoHud和安卓层面的性能监控的时候GPU占用会显示N/A，大部分a7xx设备都可以正常读取GPU占用率，因为我没有a6xx所以无法获取测试数据

# 说明
Winlator-Glibc v1.0正式版发布
# 更新内容

# 常见问题说明

releases.name: Winlator-Glibc v1.0-RC1
releases.body:
# 说明

此发布包为 RC1 版本，作为 Winlator-Glibc 项目的第一个测试版。本项目基于[原 7.1.5-glibc 版本](https://github.com/longjunyu2/winlator)更新而来，我们决定将 glibc 版本独立出来作为新项目开发，因此软件已更名并重置版本号。

---

> **提示**：如果你之前已安装我们的 7.1.6-beta1 测试版本，建议替换为本发布页面的 v1-RC1 版本。7.1.6-beta1 将不再维护，我们不再使用 7.1.x 命名版本号，今后将基于 v1 版本长期更新与维护。

# 更新内容
- 添加Arm64ec架构的wine（10.14）
- 添加FEX-PE模拟
- 更新Box64-0.4.1和Box64-0.38
- 更新Turnip-26.1.0
- 更新DXVK-2.7.1
- 加入终端支持
- Gstreamer更新至1.28.1
- 加入Termux-x11的显示后端支持
# 常见问题说明
- 由于Winlator-Glibc的结构特殊性，目前仍无法实现与Winlator原版的共存
- 在原生x server的显示模式中部分wine会出现虚拟控件无法使用的情况，解决办法是去到设置界面启用Termux-x11的显示模式
- 使用Termux-x11显示模式时如果遇到视角卡死受限的情况请在操控选项中启用相对光标移动
- 编辑容器中的"显示FPS"功能所展示的GPU占用性能数据是不准确的，仅供娱乐使用，由于我们无法找到在设备未root的情况下能正常读取GPU数据的办法，所以此项功能仅仅只是基于已有数据推测，如果你需要准确的性能占用情况，请在容器中使用DXVK_HUD的变量开启性能监控
- Gstreamer在对部分游戏解码的时候仍存在问题，请等待正式版修复
- Turnip-26.1.0驱动对于Snapdragon 8 Elite以上处理器的支持仍不完整，目前仅供测试使用

releases.name: D2Android 1.6.2
releases.body: - Assign Keys: a skill that was already selected in the game could not be put on a button, for example Fire Bolt from the Sorceress's starting staff, a running aura or a skill from an item. This is fixed.

releases.name: D2Android 1.6.1
releases.body: - Start: on many phones and tablets with MediaTek and Mali graphics the game stopped at a black screen or with "D2DX Fatal Error". This is fixed.

releases.name: D2Android 1.6.0
releases.body:
- Skill buttons: every button casts its own skill, there is no left or right any more. Put skills on the buttons with **Assign Keys**: tap a button and pick its skill from the list, **Clear** empties it. The buttons are kept per character and taken over once from your game's hotkeys; your saved game is not changed. An aura's button switches the aura on, and it keeps running while you attack.
- Skills from items work on the buttons too, such as Teleport from Enigma or a staff, and charges.
- Teleport at once is now on by default: a tap jumps right away, holding keeps jumping, like Diablo II: Resurrected on a controller. Switched off (Settings › Controls › Skill buttons) you aim with the ring and jump when you let go, now without a pause.
- Joystick: it now stays where your thumb comes down. "Follows the thumb" is still there and no longer wanders off to the right; its dead zone can be set.
- Opacity: the joystick and the game buttons can be made see-through, from 20 to 100 %.
- Taps on the game's own buttons, such as its skill buttons at the bottom, land where you tap. The pointer no longer ends up in a corner of the screen.

emulators.description: 2009 年《虐杀原形》的原生安卓移植。

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.15
releases.body:
- Restored the original pre-WebView native Android launcher and its `javac`/`d8`/`aapt2` packaging, removing the rejected Compose/Web presentation stack without changing game settings, drivers, mods, saves, touch editing, updates, or the diagnostic-tour gesture. A native **Diagnostics** screen retains read-only logs and factual About/device information.
- Matched SDL2 Java and native sources at 2.30.9 and added source, compiled-class, native-library provenance, and signed-APK byte checks for the reported startup version mismatch. The corrected artifact subsequently reached gameplay in user testing; controlled performance and broad-device outcomes remain separate questions.
- Added default helicopter **DESCEND** (`V`), an independent numbered **123** touch pad, and **ABC** paged PC keyboard input through SDL. Existing custom-layout indices and Extra buttons behavior are preserved. Added optional fixed Landscape/Reverse recovery while keeping Auto orientation by default.

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.14
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **Disposable signing identity:** this APK's certificate differs from v0.13. Android requires a one-time uninstall before installing it over v0.13; back up important app-private settings/data first. Shared game files and saves under `/storage/emulated/0/Prototype` remain separate. A later build with another certificate will also require a one-time uninstall.

- Added an optional local mod platform with staged ZIP/single-file imports, prioritized read-only file overlays, same-format DDS replacement/dumping, and a source-built AArch64 plugin ABI v1. The Prototype-style Mods library includes covers, descriptions, installed/active state, background imports and lifecycle operations, next-Play enable/disable, confirmed removal, and native-plugin trust confirmation. Unchanged Windows x86 ASI/DLL plugins are not compatible; physical mod behavior remains unverified.

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.13
releases.body:
- Fixed the Drivers screen's **BACK** crash: touch tracking is now released before closing the screen can detach its view, with null-safe cleanup shared by touch cancellation and detachment. Both the on-screen BACK action and Android system Back return to the existing launcher homepage instead of terminating it. Added entry/exit and cleanup-order regression coverage; gameplay and native driver behavior are unchanged.
- Brings the validated 0.10–0.12 driver updates into this release: the dedicated driver center and verified custom packages, Adreno 825 Turnip selection, Qualcomm unified-memory correction, and automatic startup recovery. Device-specific compatibility still requires physical testing; see the sections below for full details.

## Verification

Version 0.13 (versionCode 13), built from exact main commit ea2ba6c9f1e9c9114bcf37f1bcc796071deab4eb.
Real ARM64 compilation, APK signing, and packaged verification passed in https://github.com/Nazatric/ProtoDroid/actions/runs/41226895748.

APK SHA-256: `150c345f54c21d9c1b5422c54766d16031d651cd14c581cce353e6008ef8fdc6`
Signing certificate SHA-256: `9dd0c4ac2bba6907f4f7953e775724c7cbbdbfdb6b7347762ed3c16aed3699ec`

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.8
releases.body:
- Grouped launcher Settings into **Graphics**, **Game Video**, **Controls**, and **Interface** while preserving every existing option.
- Added functional launcher access to the game's own **Anti-Alias Level**, **Shadow Detail**, and **Graphic Quality** settings through GameDB and its original render application path.
- Added **Game default** choices to preserve device-dependent engine defaults until an explicit level is selected. All settings continue to share the same preferences and `protodroid.ini` persistence.
- Expanded **Low**, **Medium**, and **High** presets to cover the game's AA, shadow, and quality levels as well as the existing port graphics options. FPS and control choices remain independent.
- Moved active shared saves into `/storage/emulated/0/Prototype/Saves/`, with one-time no-overwrite migration from the previous shared root and app-specific layouts. External save management and deletion behavior are preserved.

releases.name: ProtoDroid v0.7
releases.body:
- Turned the setup screen into a launcher: **Settings** and **Play** replace the permission actions after access is granted. Game detection remains automatic, while Play starts the game deliberately and rechecks for newly copied files.
- Added a matching settings page with scrolling, full touch feedback, and **Low**, **Medium**, **High**, and **Custom** graphics presets.
- Included every existing graphics, performance, and touch-control option. Presets change only resolution, textures, and anisotropy, leaving FPS and controls untouched.
- Unified the launcher and in-game settings through the same saved preferences and `protodroid.ini` values. Launcher changes save automatically and engine options apply on Play.

## Verification

Version 0.7 (versionCode 7), built from exact main commit 374469600d1a0fd558c4b364f945fd1021dfbc78.

Real ARM64 compilation, APK signing, and packaged verification passed in https://github.com/Nazatric/ProtoDroid/actions/runs/41069249237.

Use protodroid.ini for configuration. CI does not replace physical-device testing.

APK SHA-256: `159d1d241c07ea05a78a62577af2e7fe834ed58de42c0879ab3005eb8a283038`

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.5
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.5

Rewind, a cleaner Shifter and DMA sound, smoother audio recovery, and many usability fixes.

Try it in the browser, nothing to install: **[habib256.github.io/neost](https://habib256.github.io/neost/)**.

**What's new**
- **Rewind**: Ctrl+Alt+R steps back in time, floppies included (off by default).
- **Accuracy**: Closure runs clean (no stray black frames, no flickering borders); STE DMA sound, Shifter hardscroll, IKBD and serial chips closer to the real hardware; selectable master crystal.
- **Games**: Lemmings, Pacemaker, Obsession and Extase join the games replayed against Hatari (27 in total); TOS 1.06 US boots.
- **Usability**: picking a machine model also picks a matching TOS, and picking a TOS adjusts the model; a quieter terminal (`--verbose` for the full log); adaptive zoom fixed on Enchanted Land; a warm reset or a config change no longer scrambles Spectrum 512 pictures; twelve more keyboard layouts; keyboard joystick fires with right Alt/Option instead of right Ctrl (MacBooks have none); joystick dongles offered only on the port their game reads; bitmap explorer in the debugger; MIDI split and Time Code.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.4
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.4

**What's new**
- **Accuracy**: MFP timers start on their own clock edge (Lethal Xcess on STE gets its top border back); MFP, ACIA, SCC and WD1772 closer to their datasheets.
- **Mouse**: drag-and-drop works in games and on the desktop; Chessmaster is now playable.
- **Games**: Lethal Xcess, Golden Axe, Rick Dangerous and Pang join the games replayed against Hatari (23 in total).
- **Verification**: a wider regression net (reference screens, game replays, the whole disk collection, Mega STE at 16 MHz) and a 68000 bench that now covers bus errors and double faults.

**Save states**: format v59, unchanged since 0.6.3.

Packages contain no Atari ROM: EmuTOS is the default. Licences included.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking

- **NetUSBee USB devices:** connect a virtual USB keyboard, mouse or disk image
  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers
  have been tested with keyboard input, mouse packets and file reads/writes.
  Disk images support read-only mounting. Native ST-side USB drivers are required.
- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.
- **Hardware accuracy:** further CPU, video, floppy, serial and sound fixes,
  backed by chip documentation and regression benches. Vroom Elite starts on STE.
- **Issue #44:** missing Atari ROMs are reported as skipped Spectrum 512 tests;
  available machines still detect regressions, and partial runs cannot overwrite
  the reference set.

**Save states use format v59. Older states cannot be loaded.** Disk image contents
remain external to save states. USB passthrough and isochronous transfers are not
implemented.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.2
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.2 — closer to the metal

Seven weeks of hardware fidelity work since 0.6.1.

**Deterministic external control.** A `--server` mode, joystick scripts, memory probes
and state exploration: the same script replays the same game down to the cycle. Disks
can be swapped while running and drive B unplugged from the server.

**Serial and keyboard chips rebuilt to match the hardware.** The MFP USART, the Mega STE
SCC, the MIDI and keyboard ACIAs, the IKBD protocol and the real-time clock. Custom 6301
keyboard programs are now recognised: *Froggies over the Fence* runs on all three disks.

**Floppies and hard disks.** More faithful STX copy protections, WD1772 write-protect
timing, and ACSI transfers that honour the DMA sector count.

**68881 FPU.** Transcendental functions are bit-exact.

**Video and memory.** STE 336-pixel mode, the 22-bit video counter wrap, the
"stopped Shifter" trick (resolution 3), and two new RAM sizes: 2176 KB and 2.5 MB.

**Sound.** The PSG crackle in *Super Hang-On* is gone, and STE DMA sound starts on the
exact sample of the PLAY write.

**Comfort.** Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen with mouse capture, mouse sensitivity is

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.1
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.
