releases.body:
## Mario Kart 8 Deluxe online fixed (2306-0502)
- 1.10.0 started deferring every Bsd poll with a finite timeout. That broke the NEX connection of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, which failed with error 2306-0502. MK8's ordinary NEX polls now use the blocking path again, as in 1.9.9; eventfd polls and the finite-timeout optimization of other games (Portal 2 and others) are unchanged (#75)

## New online games
- SpeedRunners 2: Nextendo routes scoped to the game, and a TLS peer reset during the handshake is now returned to the game as an SSL error instead of stopping the emulator (#79)
- Just Dance 2022: Nextendo routes, exact-build TLS trust patch with native certificate verification kept on, and blocking UDP receives no longer hold the shared socket thread (#74)
- Ultimate Chicken Horse 1.13.13.765: online support (#68)
- Guilty Gear Strive: online services redirected to Nextendo (#77)
- Nintendo Switch Online Classics: versions set for NES, SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo 64 and SEGA Genesis, plus a Windows JIT fix (#69)

## Other fixes
- Steam Deck: touchscreen, rumble and gyro input (#76)
- NPLN online patches are loaded from the signed patch catalog (#73)
- nim: the IShopServic

emulators.latest_body:
What's new in 0.78

For players
- **32-bit devices:** one APK now holds both ARMv8 (arm64-v8a) and ARMv7
  (armeabi-v7a). Android picks the right one on install, so 64-bit devices
  always run the 64-bit version. OpenGL ES 3.0 is still required.
- **Screen orientation:** the setting now applies to the launcher as well as
  the game and takes effect at once. Auto respects the system rotation lock.
- **Sound:** the audio buffer margin now adapts to the device.
- **Launcher:** new Advanced screen with a Debug mode switch. With it off,
  nothing is written to the log.
- **Logs:** new screen under Data to export, share or send logs to the
  developer, or clear them.

Under the hood
- **Most of the game is now ported C++:** - game code is moving from recompiled to ported native ARM code.
- **Old processor code removed:** x87 emulation is gone from the generated
  code, and the whole game runs in 24-bit floating point. MMX, CPU detection
  and the Pentium FDIV workarounds are removed too.

Known limits
- ARMv7 has only been tested in the 32-bit mode of a 64-bit phone, not on a
  real 32-bit device, so speed on older hardware is unknown.

releases.name: v0.77

### For players
- **Dynamic Fullscreen for races.** A new Screen Size option that fits the race to your phone's shape (20:9, 16:9, tablets) with no black bars, you can find it in Resolution tabs in-game Graphics settings. The view widens to the sides and the HUD keeps its proportions. It is the default for new imports.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.6.0
releases.body:
This one is mostly about what happens *under* the 3D. The emulator itself got a lot better.

## New

**Accuracy: 147 of 147 on AccuracyCoin.** 0.5.0 passed 128. Zaxnes was also compared cycle by cycle with a transistor-level simulation of the NES chips (421,901 CPU cycles, DMA included), and the timing matched. Where the two still differ, tests made on real consoles side with Zaxnes.

**Over 400 mappers.** Up from 144. That includes the **Famicom Disk System**, the **VS. System** with its cabinet buttons, and newer boards like the Rainbow.

**A fast core.** It skips work the screen doesn't need, but gives the same results as the accurate core. We checked that frame by frame on 320 ROMs. Handhelds use it by default.

**New options window.** One slider goes from *Fastest* to *Most faithful* and sets everything that costs speed. A simple mode shows only what most people need, and an advanced mode shows everything. It works the same on the PC and on the console screen.

releases.name: Zaxnes 0.5.0
releases.body:
Zaxnes is an independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo.

## Highlights

**3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 compatibility.** Profiles from 3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 import and play, with what the new versions brought: reflections, bend, the new camera and Lua features.

**A real NES emulator, not just a gimmick.** Mapper support goes from 85 to 144, and AccuracyCoin from 89 to 128 tests out of 147. More accuracy work is coming in the next releases.

**New widescreen hacks: Kirby's Adventure and Faxanadu.** Every regional version of each. Faxanadu already has its 3D profile in this release; Kirby's is on the way.

**Smooth scrolling at 120 Hz (experimental).** On a 120 Hz screen, the playfield is drawn between two emulated frames, from the run-ahead.

**RetroArch shaders.** Slang shaders (through librashader) on the Vulkan / DirectX 12 renderer: CRT, scanlines, LCD, Mega Bezel TV frames. A pack of presets is built in, separately for 2D and 3D. Available on Android too.

**Editor mode for 3D profiles (work in progress).** An AI-assisted editor: it gives an AI agent a harness through a local MCP server, and a prompt ready to copy and paste. Expect more on it in the next release.

# Zaxnes 0.4.1

Independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo. NES is a trademark of Nintendo.

Widescreen fixes.

## Ninja Gaiden III

- The enemies, lanterns and items the game places on the screen when the camera reaches them now wait in the margins, where they will appear, instead of popping in at the edge of the 4:3 picture.
- The desert of 2-1: the rock platforms no longer vanish from the margins and the sand no longer goes out of step with the screen.
- Past the ends of an area, where the game has nothing to show, the margins stay black, cut straight, instead of repeating its edge (boss rooms, ends of levels).
- Cut scenes no longer show their portrait and text a second time in the margins.
- New testing aids, off by default, in the USA and Japanese packs: *Invincible*, and *Level select* (Select during play goes on from the next checkpoint).

## Super Mario Bros. 3

- The world map keeps its frame whole, with black margins.
- A piranha plant coming out of a pipe in the margins is hidden by the pipe, as on the screen.

## All games

- In the widescreen margins, a sprite behind the background hides the sprites of lower priority there, as the NES does.

Release Notes for openMSX 22.0 (2026-10-28)
===========================================

Thanks to many contributors (who make good use of modern AI tools), we
have a very long list of changes again. Major features are found in the
debugger GUI, with a new Raster Beam Viewer and Tracer functionality. We also
have the Quick Setup Editor, for one-window access to all major setup
settings.

Then AI hit us with dozens of Pull Requests with new and improved
functionality... Not all purely AI-generated, but also using AI to analyse
bulk measurements. This led to many VDP accuracy improvements and emulation of
new devices like plotters, Panasonic FS-JH1 Joy Handle steering wheel (that
came with Konami's A1 Spirit), light guns, Franky, Makoto, SD Mapper V1 and
SM-X WiFi. There's even a synthetic TCP/IP UNAPI device to be able to try out
network programs in openMSX.

And many, many more things...

Special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core
team! Keep those pull requests coming!

Here's the list with all highlights and details:

MSX device support:
- fixed Yamanooto SCC register visibility

releases.name: openMSX 21.0
releases.body:
openMSX 21.0 has many improvements on the new GUI introduced in openMSX 20.0 (especially the debugger) and several other smaller features. It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). These can be created, loaded, and automatically started. They can also be saved automatically when you exit.

Furthermore, flash chip emulation has become a lot more accurate, thanks to Laurens Holst.

releases.name: openMSX 20.0
releases.body:
openMSX 20.0—Autumn Spring—is a major release, in which we introduce the new Graphical User Interface, replacing the OSD menu. A faster and more powerful debugger is now included in openMSX itself. Configuration for MSX joystick/JoyMega has been improved drastically using the new GUI. If you still want to use Catapult, you can use the Catapult release that came with openMSX 19.0. Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_20_0/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

As always, special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core team! Keep these pull requests coming!

Please note that as of now, a system with OpenGL 2 support is required to run openMSX.

releases.name: openMSX 19.1
releases.body:
openMSX 19.1—Reflection—is a bug fix release for openMSX 19.0, as we found some rather nasty issues after releasing, mostly that LaserDisc support was broken. No new Catapult will be released, as it has no changes.  Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_19_1/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

Thanks for those who gave us the feedback so that we found out about these issues.

Please note that this will be the last openMSX release that supports systems without OpenGL 2 or higher.

releases.name: Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows ONLY antivirus fix
releases.body:
# Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows antivirus fix

### **Windows only.** 

Linux, macOS and Android stay on
[1.0.9](https://github.com/SSunnKing/Open-Nectar---Pikmin-Native-PC-Mobile-Port/releases/tag/1.0.9).
Download those from there. Nothing changes in the games themselves.

**Updating:** press **Update** in your launcher. Saves, settings and texture
packs carry over.

## Windows Defender flagged the launcher as a trojan

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,
not from a real malware match.

The launcher was doing things that look suspicious to an antivirus: it
started `curl.exe` and `tar.exe` in the background to download updates and
texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release
changes that:

* Downloads now happen inside the launcher instead of through `curl.exe`.
* Update zips are unpacked inside the launcher instead of through `tar.exe`.
* `nectar.exe`, `nectar-pal.exe` and `nectar-launcher.exe` now have
  publisher and version information (right-click → Properties → Details).

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.5
releases.body:
- **BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger** no longer crashes after a few fights
  ("vm_alloc ... heap-large failed", then a host fault,
  [#6](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/issues/6)). A released
  texture kept its pixels in the game's memory, and Calamity Trigger, which
  loads each fight's textures anew, used up its 2 GB. Every game frees them
  now.


**Known issues:** [docs/Known-Issues.md](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/blob/main/docs/Known-Issues.md)

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.4
releases.body:
- **Launcher on Windows:** compiling a game no longer fails with
  `'x2/recomp.h' file not found`. The launcher handed the compiler its own
  folder in a form (`\\?\C:\...`) where Windows doesn't read `/` as a folder
  separator.


**Known issues:** [docs/Known-Issues.md](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/blob/main/docs/Known-Issues.md)

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.3
releases.body:
- **Android app:** "Allow access" opens Android's "All files access" page again
  (it failed with "Java exception was thrown" on every device,
  [#4](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/issues/4)); where a device
  lacks that page, it opens the list of apps with that access, or the app's info page.


**Known issues:** [docs/Known-Issues.md](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/blob/main/docs/Known-Issues.md)

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.2
releases.body:
- **Vulkan (Android):** SSF4's small text (CREDIT(S), INSERT COIN(S)) no longer shows
  stray marks around the letters: a texture filled a piece at a time starts out
  zeroed, as with OpenGL and Metal, not holding what a freed texture left.

**Known issues:** [docs/Known-Issues.md](https://github.com/PabloVSouza/typex2-recomp/blob/main/docs/Known-Issues.md)

releases.name: typex2-recomp 0.6.1
releases.body:
- **RetroArch on Android:** two buttons pressed together (SSF4's Focus Attack,
  throws) need RetroArch's Input Block Timeout at 2 ms; the docs and known
  issues say how.

releases.name: Panda3DS pre-Halloween edition
releases.body:
Periodic release cause it's been a while since the last one and there'll be a lot of changes for Qt/Android/etc frontends soon, so it's best to make one now

New features:
- Lua scripting support
- Work-in-progress GUI using Qt (Not included in this release, but will start shipping builds as soon as possible)
- Compatibility fixes (Fixes various games and some OS apps. Various improvements in the BOSS, FS, NS, CFG, and more services, shader emulation fixes, etc)
- There's now a website: https://panda3ds.com/
- Support for portable builds (Save data and such is in the emulator folder when enabled rather than being in %APPDATA% or the Linux/Mac equivalents)
- Fix Android compilation for future Pandroid app
- Fix shader bugs that may have broken the app on some drivers
- Hydra multi-system emulator core soon
- Other stuff I'm forgetting

releases.name: PPSSPP Turbo 1.20.4-r4
releases.body:
**Mod tidak resmi** untuk PPSSPP 1.20.4 (Android 10+, arm64). Tidak berafiliasi dengan tim PPSSPP.

### Baru di r4
- Frame generation GE-MVFG dengan tuning lengkap: mode adaptif (hanya di bawah 55/45/35 FPS), blend position, motion smoothing, batas gerak, proteksi HUD, sensitivitas scene-cut, debug view.
- Shader **Turbo Enhance** (sharpening ala CAS, vibrance, kontras, kecerahan).
- Tab Image Quality: AA, upscaler FSR 1.0, color look, upscaling tekstur GPU, anisotropic filtering, resolusi, semuanya diterapkan langsung tanpa restart game.
- Performance: clock CPU PSP, thermal guard, refresh rate layar, sustained performance, speed hacks.
- Menu Turbo bergaya PPSSPP (tombol **PPSSPP Turbo** di menu utama, atau tap 3 jari saat bermain), logo dan theme merah.

Riwayat lengkap ada di [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

### Instalasi
Package `org.ppsspp.turbo` bisa dipasang berdampingan dengan PPSSPP resmi.

### Catatan
Kualitas visual frame generation dan shader baru belum diuji di banyak game. Driver PanVK masih eksperimental. Laporkan masalah di Issues repo ini.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## Changes

- Fixed a launcher crash when Vulkan compatibility checks reported an unsupported Qualcomm system driver or a driver with no supported texture formats.
- Added the missing compatibility messages in all 15 launcher languages. The launcher now falls back to English if a translation is missing.
- Fixed integrity checks for uncompressed game ZIPs. The launcher now remembers a successful check only after verifying the CRC-32 of the archive entries. Archives with older verification records are checked again.

## Installation

Requires Android 11 or later, an ARM64 device, a compatible Vulkan driver, and supported Frostpunk Steam game files. Android version code is 8.

APK SHA-256

`442f1c649dff76b189da77e4a6ceaa152b9323b78b3d9a5d687327e0b6f0ef94`

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3.2-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3.2-dev makes native Vulkan the default, adds an in-game performance overlay, and improves touch controls and memory use.

## Gameplay and performance

- Pinch to zoom and rotate the camera in the same gesture. The construction cursor can now reach the edges of the map.
- Enable a configurable overlay for FPS, frame times, CPU and GPU information, memory usage, temperatures, and more.
- Reduce CPU work in busy cities with native ARM64 routines for scene visibility and object processing. Both renderers also reduce the memory used by some oversized interface textures.

## Rendering and compatibility

- Native Vulkan now has separate system, Turnip, and PanVK modes. The launcher checks the selected driver and explains why a mode is unavailable. DXVK remains available as a fallback.
- Improve frame synchronization, Vulkan device-loss diagnostics, and driver handling on supported Mali and PowerVR devices. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages.
- The launcher checks whether the selected driver can read the original textures. If ASTC conversion is needed, it can prepare the cache and continue launching afterward. The original game files are preserved.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev fixes crashes triggered by some achievements and events, improves native Vulkan and PanVK compatibility, and expands launcher localization and crash reporting.

## Gameplay and stability

- Fix a crash triggered by achievement and event names containing a colon, including `Endless: Backup Plan`. The offline Steam bridge now handles those names and returns errors for individual rejected storage operations.
- Fix parsing of numbered save names such as `Name-3`. Add Win64 runtime support for wide-string integer parsing, numeric conversions and C++ exception-message handling.
- Handle requests for the offline Steam store overlay and external menu links without launching a browser.

## Rendering and touch controls

- Extend experimental Native Vulkan (PanVK) and DXVK (PanVK) checks to Mali and Immortalis devices on Android 11 or newer. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages. Devices with other page sizes can import a compatible driver and run the launcher check.
- Restore missing ground snow when starting a new game in native Vulkan by correcting how the renderer caches texture bindings.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3-dev adds experimental native Vulkan rendering, touch construction improvements, and a smaller APK.

## Rendering and compatibility

- Select Native Vulkan alongside DXVK in the launcher. Compatible devices are offered Native Vulkan on their first DXVK launch. If the native renderer crashes, the launcher reports the problem and selects DXVK for the next launch. Native Vulkan uses FSR 1 for upscaling.
- Use PanVK with either renderer on supported Mali devices. Import a custom driver from a ZIP or an ARM64 `.so`, or restore the bundled driver. Fix yellow-tinted snow and buildings under PanVK, fullscreen display artifacts on the Lenovo TB373FU, and missing scout portraits and a stray temperature-indicator arc on Mali-G615.
- Fix bundled Turnip selection and support the Qualcomm system driver on compatible Adreno 830 devices. Improve Vulkan upload synchronization and surface recovery, DXVK fullscreen handling, and diagnostics for stalled frame presentation.

## Touch controls and interface

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Android ARM64 update focused on memory controls, graphics settings, driver management, and crash diagnostics.

## Changes

- Add Auto, Normal, Reduced, and Minimum memory modes. Automatic selection adapts to available device RAM without overwriting saved graphics preferences.
- Show a one-time low-memory warning when Android reports 7.5 GiB of RAM or less.
- Add model detail and building model quality controls, with both defaulting to their lowest levels. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Improve geometry simplification and graphics profile handling, and show output resolution in pixels and percentages.
- Restore normal city updates and rendering while paused by removing forced update suppression and frozen-frame reuse.
- Support landscape and reverse landscape only, including gamepad attachment and the crash monitor.
- Bundle one shared purple-turnip T30 driver for GPU checks and gameplay, with Mesa license text and driver provenance included.
- Add Turnip release browsing and downloads with byte progress and cancellation. Cache verified downloads for offline reuse and allow removal of unused external drivers while preserving the active driver.

releases.body:
# Heroes V for Android 0.8.2-dev

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1. Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code **15**.

## Startup and launcher

- Added **3D main menu** and **Fast main menu** options. Turn off the 3D background to use a solid color, or enable fast startup to use the menu while the 3D scene loads between frames. Both options take effect on the next launch.
- Selecting a parent folder containing GOG Gold and Tribes of the East can set up all three editions in one step. The launcher keeps existing working game paths.
- ZIP imports now check the MD5 when the checksum is included in the archive filename and report mismatches.
- The launcher adapts to wide windows with a two-column layout and accepts custom Vulkan drivers in ZIP or `.so` format.
- On Xiaomi HyperOS, the launcher offers a shortcut to Game Turbo before autostart. The tip can be dismissed and reopened from About.

## Touch controls and interface

- Interface scale is now a dropdown from **50% to 200%** in **25%** steps. A value saved by the old slider stays in effect until you select a new value.

releases.name: heroes-v-0.8.1-dev-eda317d2
releases.body:
# Heroes V for Android 0.8.1-dev

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1.

- Added original loading artwork, launcher shortcuts for each edition, and frame-rate caps at the screen refresh rate or one-half or one-third of it.
- Added optional army split buttons for moving one creature, splitting a stack in half, or distributing it evenly. Improved recruitment number entry, first-load console focus, and scaled hero and construction layouts.
- Fixed profile creation, shadow redraw after deferred textures load, OpenGL ES MSAA depth and stencil, and font sampling with bicubic filtering and FSR.

Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code: 14.

This APK was built before the town army row fixes in the release source commit. The later fixes are present in the source.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.8-dev
releases.body:
Speeds up AI turns and dense OpenGL ES map views, improves graphics and saves, and restores optional DXVK/Turnip rendering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.8-dev` / code `13`, signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.7-dev:

- Enable **Fast AI turn** by default. AI estimates avoid repeatedly serializing and checksumming the map's object-name table during rollbacks. Restored entries are checked; a mismatch disables the shortcut for the process. The original path is used after the first network socket opens. Find the switch under **Settings > Additional > Controls**, between Split zones and Order confirmation. This speeds up calculations, not hero animations or AI difficulty.
- Grow the OpenGL ES upload ring when consecutive frames outgrow it, avoiding repeated per-draw allocations in dense adventure views.
- Move common DLL code into `libhomm5_common.so`, saving about 43 MB after all three engines have been unpacked. Add native vertex, lighting, battle-grid and byte-compatible deflate paths.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.7-dev
releases.body:
Adds native battle route previews, optional order confirmation and contextual alternative-attack tips, and fixes save-list refresh and repeated streaming audio. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.7-dev` / code `12`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.6-dev:

- Preview movement paths and destination cells before issuing a battle order. Paths follow the original prepared command, preserving obstacle detours, terrain height and flight paths. Strike and Return shows separate outgoing and returning lanes. Route previews are enabled by default and work independently of confirmation.
- Add optional battle order confirmation. Taps and gestures select movement, melee attacks, shots or spells; a separate button above the right-side action panel executes the selected order. Wait and Defend retain their immediate buttons. Confirmation is disabled by default.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.6-dev
releases.body:
Fixes Sanctuary-related AI turn stalls and improves touch controls, camera handling, interface scaling and audio buffering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.6-dev` / code `11`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.5.1-dev:

- Prevent the reproduced AI turn stall with Quick Combat enabled when a hero is sheltered in a Sanctuary. Exclude that hero from quick resolution while preserving the global setting and other heroes' behavior.
- Cancel spell or creature-ability targeting with a two-finger tap, including over the interface. On the adventure map, the same gesture stops a moving hero.
- Restore the original camera with a three-finger tap in adventure, battle, deployment and town, including over the interface. Deployment accounts for the current phase and player side.
- Skip the town camera flyby with the first tap on the town view, without selecting a building.
- Show the native attack or shot icon above the damage and retaliation forecast, including when the ordinary touch cursor is disabled.
- Correct the font scale of new multiplayer-list rows after filter changes.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.5-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4.1-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; compatible Adreno devices can use Turnip.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.3-dev
releases.body:
The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 0.2-dev
releases.body:
The second release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 adds optional texture conversion, more flexible touch controls, OpenSpy compatibility and save/profile fixes.

### Changes

- Added optional ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion in the launcher, including games played directly from stored ZIP archives. Original packages are retained; runtime DXT decoding remains available for cache misses and mods.
- Added a touch layout editor to move, resize and hide individual controls. Hold the on-screen Pause button to open it; a short tap opens the original pause menu.
- Expanded touch settings with a fixed joystick, weapon tap/swipe selection, separate weapon bar/wheel sizes, control visibility, movement while holding primary fire and horizontal gyro reversal.
- Added OpenSpy service and authentication compatibility, and fixed a registry-call crash during online play.
- Prevented startup defaults from overwriting saved profiles and campaign progress before sign-in. Fixed creation of save directories beneath virtual ZIP folders.

releases.name: Playden for PS5 0.12.0-beta.5
releases.body:
Games that draw with OpenGL are now recognised and started on OpenGL: Ren'Py visual novels, MonoGame games such as Stardew Valley, packaged ScummVM games such as Myst: Masterpiece Edition, and Godot games made with the Compatibility renderer. Unreal 3 games no longer start their Lightmass tool instead of the game, and Left 4 Dead 2 downloads its Workshop add-ons. New runtime kit 0.36 brings a built-in AMD GPU Services library, so UNCHARTED: Legacy of Thieves Collection starts, and lets a game see a controller that connects after it started.

Beta 5 also installs Visual C++ MFC and PhysX from Steam's own redistributable depots, so more older games get the libraries they need, and lands Home on the game you played last.

> [!WARNING]
> Beta of alpha software. Betas can have new bugs. Playden signs in to your real Steam account and reads and writes your Steam Cloud saves. Read [Before you use it](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5#before-you-use-it) first.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `playden-ps5-0.12.0-beta.5.zip` | The Playden app (the `FAKE77031` folder), the console tools (`tools/`), the README, the compatibility list and the license files. |

releases.name: Playden for PS5 0.12.0-beta.4
releases.body:
Games can now have their own controller layout: map every button, stick and trigger to what you want it to send, right on the PS5, and keep layouts as your own templates. Grand Theft Auto IV and Grand Theft Auto V Legacy run through Rockstar's launcher once you sign in to your Rockstar Games account. New runtime kit 0.35 draws a performance overlay with frame times and more on Direct3D 8–12 and OpenGL games, and fixes Slay the Spire, Order of the Sinking Star and Fahrenheit Remastered.

Beta 4 also updates a game's last played date whenever you play it, so Continue playing on Home keeps your games in order, and reserves only an update's changed files on the drive.

> [!WARNING]
> Beta of alpha software. Betas can have new bugs. Playden signs in to your real Steam account and reads and writes your Steam Cloud saves. Read [Before you use it](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5#before-you-use-it) first.

releases.name: Playden for PS5 0.12.0-beta.3
releases.body:
Playden can now install Steam Workshop items and fixes corrupted Steam Cloud saves. XNA games such as TowerFall Ascension, which played their music on a black screen, now draw. New runtime kit 0.32 makes Unity games such as Turbo Overkill show up on their first start, fixes Killer Instinct's match search, and keeps a button mapped to a key off the game's controller.

Beta 3 also gets Fallout: New Vegas and Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition going, lets you skip a Playden version, and says what each Cloud saves choice will do. Imported games can bring their own title art.

> [!WARNING]
> Beta of alpha software. Betas can have new bugs. Playden signs in to your real Steam account and reads and writes your Steam Cloud saves. Read [Before you use it](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5#before-you-use-it) first.

releases.name: Playden for PS5 0.12.0-beta.2
releases.body:
Games can now use the controller's or a headset's microphone for voice chat. Older Japanese games can get a Japanese system locale. New runtime kit 0.31 brings both.

Beta 2 also adds a Compatibility filter from the community's compatibility list, keeps the artwork you set with ArtSwap, and makes installs 337 MB smaller. A DualShock 4 bridged by PoorDS4 drives Playden and games, and Chicory: A Colorful Tale and UNBEATABLE can be installed again.

> [!WARNING]
> Beta of alpha software. Betas can have new bugs. Playden signs in to your real Steam account and reads and writes your Steam Cloud saves. Read [Before you use it](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5#before-you-use-it) first.

releases.name: Playden for PS5 0.12.0-beta.1
releases.body:
Online play is here, for everyone who wants to try it. Set a game to Online and Playden runs Valve's own Steam client next to it on the PS5, signed in as you, so the game reaches official servers, Steam lobbies and your Steam friends as on a PC. It is experimental, chosen per game, and off by default.

Beta 1 also brings GOG as a second store, Steam collections in the Library, a regrouped Settings, and new runtime kit 0.29, which fixes Unreal Engine 5 games on Direct3D 12 that stopped with "Fatal error!".

> [!WARNING]
> Beta of alpha software. Betas can have new bugs. Playden signs in to your real Steam account and reads and writes your Steam Cloud saves. Online play signs that account in to Steam from the console, and a game with Valve Anti-Cheat could get it banned from that game. Read [Before you use it](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5#before-you-use-it) and [Online play](https://github.com/leolobato/playden-ps5/blob/main/docs/online-play.md) first.

| --- | --- |

releases.name: Pocket2Droid v1.0.2
releases.body:
Pocket2Droid 1.0.2 adds Windows Mobile 5.0 support, Internet access and more customization.

- **Windows Mobile 5.0:** Added support for compatible Device Emulator ROM images.
- **Internet access:** Connect to the Internet inside Windows Mobile through your Android device’s connection. Internet access is enabled by default for new ROM profiles.
- **If Internet access doesn’t work:** Make sure Internet access is **On** in Pocket2Droid’s ROM settings. Inside Windows Mobile, open **Network Cards** settings and change **“My network card connects to”** from **Work** to **The Internet**. Tap **OK**, then try browsing again. Some network configurations still require manual setup, and older browsers may not support modern HTTPS websites.
- **Custom resolutions:** Set your own guest screen width and height alongside the existing presets. Compatibility varies by ROM. Custom resolutions may cause display glitches or require touchscreen recalibration inside Windows Mobile.
- **Restart option:** Restart Windows Mobile directly from the session menu.
- **Per-ROM StorageCard folders:** Choose a separate StorageCard folder for each ROM while keeping the general StorageCard folder unchanged.

releases.name: Pocket2Droid v1.0.1 — First Public Release
releases.body:
First public release of Pocket2Droid, a Windows Mobile emulator for Android that runs the complete operating system, including compatible applications and games.

### Features
- ROM library with individual settings and persistent storage.
- Shared StorageCard folder with file importing.
- On-screen controls with adjustable transparency, vibration feedback and multi-key support.
- Global button mapping for keyboards and wired/Bluetooth controllers, including sticks and triggers.
- Display scaling, orientation, screen position and fullscreen options.

### Requirements
- ARM64 Android device running Android 7.0 or newer.
- A compatible Windows Mobile `.bin` ROM.

ROMs, games and applications are not included.

### Getting started
1. Install the APK attached below.
2. Open Pocket2Droid and grant storage access.
3. Tap **+ → PPC Rom** to import your ROM.
4. Tap the ROM to start Windows Mobile.

To copy files into the guest’s storage card, use **+ → File to StorageCard**.

### Please note
- Compatibility and performance vary by device, ROM and game.

[Discord](https://discord.gg/cVHYSwn9Bq) · [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Pocket2Droid)

# Release Notes: v1.6.1

## What's New - controller support tested and working on both platforms for gameplay, test out the app on your android handhelds now! - fixed rescan library on every home page visit - added manual rescan library to settings (try this if 1.6 messed with your library) - added pull from top to refresh in library. - File transparency: All app files will be stored in 'Documents/Pocket8' for Android and 'On My iPhone > Pocket8' for iOS. - (android) added import existing folder for those with existing game libraries. this indexes the game locations from your external folders to the app's library. - added file/library cleaning settings: clear external games, factory reset library. - fixes to controller support on home page- should be fully navigable with controller. - css optimizations for dpad, attempting to address issue #16 but still need feedback for those on older iOS hardware. - visual branding updates to align with PICO-8 licensing and aesthetics

releases.name: v1.6 - Gamepad (Setup), QoL, UI
releases.body:
**KNOWN ISSUE:** Physical controllers are currently still broken in this build. Directory fixes are working. Recommended for touch-screen users only

Hey everyone, v1.6 is live.

I got a hold of an Android device to test with, which brought a lot of bugs to my immediate attention. I’ve done some work cleaning up the codebase to make this actually usable on devices like the Retroid, Thor, Ayaneo.

Just to be transparent: Since I'm working with Zep on the official iOS release, the Android version is going to remain an unofficial side project. However, I still want it to be a quality experience for those of you using it, so I'm pushing these QoL updates to get it stable.

**The Big Fixes:**

**Android Storage Fixed:** Closed issue #18. The directory picker now actually works. You can point it to your external SD card or any ROM folder, and it won't crash or fail to import. It respects your folder structure and keeps the app data separate.

**Immersive Mode:** Closed issue #19. The Android navigation bar now hides correctly, giving you full-screen real estate for the games. There's also a setting to remove the virtual controls completely for a true full screen mode.

releases.name: v1.5 - Cross-Platform, Multi-Carts
releases.body:
[[IMPORTANT]] Android has been sunsetted until further notice. see [the future of pocket8.](https://www.reddit.com/r/Pocket8/comments/1rerp4t/the_future_of_pocket8_important/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) One of my biggest updates so far. Pocket8 is now officially running on Android! **New Features:** - **Android Support:** There was a huge demand for this. I'm listening! I don't have an Android device to test on currently, so please leave feedback. - **Multicart Support:** .p8.png Multi-Cart titles are now supported. **Note: .p8 Multi-Cart titles are not.** The current engine is a web-build, and does not usually support .p8 files or multicart titles at all. However, games that use absolute file names when loading carts in their code work fine. An example of a working multicart game is [Golf Monday](https://johanpeitz.itch.io/golf-monday). - **Library Management:** You can now rename and favorite your carts. Long-press to organize your collection.

**Coming Soon:**

releases.body:
The first release of the unofficial Android port of *Resident Evil 4 Wii edition* (NTSC-U, `RB4E08`). The main game plays from the start with sound, saving and loading, and Separate Ways runs too. The game's PowerPC code is recompiled to native code ahead of time: nothing is emulated on the phone.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This app contains no game data. You need a dump of **your own** disc (`.iso` or `.rvz`, Wii NTSC-U `RB4E08`). Download the app only from this Releases page.

> [!TIP]
> **Little free space?** When you choose the game file, play it straight from your ISO or RVZ instead of unpacking it (about 4 GB). Keep the file where it is, or choose it again after moving it.

> [!WARNING]
> **Android 10:** phones with an Adreno 5xx GPU (Snapdragon 625, 630, 660, 835 and similar) on Android 10 are not supported: their Vulkan driver stops the game on its first screens. Android 11 or newer is recommended.
>
> **PowerVR GPUs** (some Samsung, OPPO and Helio phones, e.g. Samsung Galaxy A04 with the PowerVR GE8320): the game plays, but the inventory background shows only in its top-right quarter. Not recommended; use the Low-End or Ultra Low preset if you try.

emulators.latest_body:
## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.7
releases.body:
Frame generation (thank you The412Banner for your contribution.

This was the first (and last) contribution made with AI. Very thankful that Banner had the patience to deal with the amount of changes we requested for this to get merged. That said, future AI PR's will be closed automatically (and have been closed). Many are not willing to put in the effort that Banner did and I don't have the energy to review everything. **If it is not worth writing/understanding the code, it is not worth reviewing the code.**

### App changes

  - Added AI Frame Generation toggle + gear settings dialog to the in-game sidebar (Performance tab).
  - 6 presets (Eco, Flow, Balanced, Boost, Clear, Max) and a flow-scale slider with live feedback.
  - Settings persist to SharedPreferences and re-apply on every `WineActivity.onCreate`/`onResume`.
  - Added a Vulkan ICD JSON writer so the framegen driver hooks correctly across all 5 package variants.
  - Fixed `Locale.ROOT` formatting for float values to avoid comma-decimal issues on non-English locales.
  - Fixed try/catch label collision in WineActivity smali patch — apktool rebuild now fails loudly on errors.

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.6
releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.5
releases.body:
This release is mainly here to make the backend work visible and add the addition off Japanese app translations, thank you @reindex-ot for your contribution!

Most of the recent fixes and updates happened server-side in the GameHub Lite backend, so existing installs already benefited without needing a new APK. Apparently that makes it look like nothing happened, so here is an app release too. I will make a useless release every time we improve something that gets served via the server. 

### Backend changes

The main work happened in:

- [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api)
- [gamehub-lite-worker](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-worker)

Recent backend-side work includes updated component manifests, new/updated container components, imagefs updates, corrected component counts, proxy/URL updates, and fixes around component list handling.

In particular, the worker/API side is where most compatibility and content fixes now happen. If something starts working without an APK update, that is why.

### App changes

- Added Japanese translation updates.
- Added/updated Japanese project documentation.
- Update apktool to 2.12.1

releases.name: GameHub Lite v5.1.4
releases.body:
GameHub Lite adds **RTS Touch Controls**. 

Massive thanks to @Nightwalker743 for their contributions!

**Changelogs**
- Add RTS Touch Controls - @Nightwalker743 
- Improve stability of `patch.sh` script - @sgumil 
- add APK build GitHub workflow  - @ObfuscatedVoid 

**RTS Controls feature list:**

**_Tap to Click_** - Tap anywhere to move cursor and click (Like move cursor to touchpoint on Winlator)
**_Drag for Box Selection_** - Drag finger to create selection box (left mouse button held during drag)
**_Long Press for Right-Click_** - Hold finger for 300ms to trigger right-click
**_Double-Tap for Double-Click_** - Tap twice within 250ms and 50 pixels to double-click
**_Two-Finger Pan for Camera_** - Drag with two fingers to pan camera
**_Pinch-to-Zoom_*** - Pinch two fingers inward to zoom out, pinch outward to zoom in (mouse wheel scroll)
**_Toggle Switch_*** - Enable/disable RTS controls in Settings > Controls tab (in the side overlay menu when you're in a game).

_The two gestures that have an asterisk can be customized in the RTS Gesture Settings menu._

This alpha keeps each game in a folder of its own with everything that belongs to it, gives cheats their own list, adds a speed limit and a second frame generation method, and fixes a lost graphics device and black boxes that spread over the picture. Performance and compatibility still vary by game.

### New and improved

- **One folder per game.** A game can sit in a folder of its own in `roms/`, together with its update and DLC files, its mods (`mods/`), its cheats (`cheats/`) and its own post-processing presets (`reshade/`). ProsperoEden tells the game from its update and DLC by what each file holds, so the files can have any names. **Delete from console** removes the folder's update and DLC too. Games downloaded from a source now go into a folder of their own the same way. Your files stay where they are and keep working. See [Game files folder](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md#game-files-folder).
- **Cheats in a list of their own.** A game's settings have a **Cheats** row next to **Mods**: every cheat of the game with its own switch, and an **All cheats** switch apart from the Mods one. **Mods** now lists patches and replacement files

releases.name: ProsperoEden v1.003.000
releases.body:
This alpha focuses on mod stability, controller support, graphics correctness and lower emulation overhead. Performance and compatibility still vary by game; these changes do not guarantee a particular frame rate.

### Fixes and improvements

- **TOTK + UltraCam startup crash fixed.** Large modded RomFS rebuilds could overflow the filesystem thread stack during cleanup and close the whole app. Cleanup is now iterative. Tested with TOTK **1.1.1** and an older UltraCam mod: the game reached its menu, and the user confirmed the free camera works in gameplay. Game/mod versions still need to match; this is not a claim that every UltraCam version or TOTK update works.
- **Memory size per game.** Choose 4, 6 or 8 GiB of emulated console memory under **Settings > Performance > Memory**, with game-specific overrides for demanding mods. This uses the PS5's existing shared memory pool; it does not add physical RAM. See [Console memory](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden/blob/v1.003.000/docs/SETTINGS.md#console-memory).
- **DualSense audio haptics.** HD rumble can use the controller's audio haptics path, with lifecycle and failure handling fixes.
- **Touchpad and controls.** Spl

releases.name: ProsperoEden v1.002.000
releases.body:
- **More free memory for demanding games.** The console's memory is one pool shared by the emulated console, the emulator itself and the graphics, and part of it was held without being used. The emulated console's memory, the code caches and a reserve on the system's side now take memory only when they need it. A large open-world game at 2x has about 3.5 GiB free during play instead of 2.2 GiB, at the same frame rate, so a long session runs out of memory far later.
- **PS5 Pro memory mode.** On a PS5 Pro, ProsperoEden asks for the larger memory pool the console offers: 13.5 GiB instead of 12 GiB. A line at launch (`memory:` in `stderr.log`) says whether it is active. Contributed by [OverkillLabs](https://github.com/OverkillLabs3).
- **"Ran out of graphics memory" less often above 1x.** The part that frees textures no game is using could stop looking before it had freed anything, so graphics memory filled up although much of it could be freed. Contributed by [mzet97](https://github.com/mzet97).
- **Vibration strength (new setting).** **Settings > Controls > Vibration strength** sets how strong the DualSense vibrates: 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of what a game asks for. The controller answ

releases.name: ProsperoEden v1.001.000
releases.body:
- **A new launcher.** The menu was rebuilt. Five sections sit on a rail at the left (Home, Library, Multiplayer, Settings, About): L1 and R1 go from one to the next, and Left from a screen's edge opens the rail. Home is built around the game to continue, with its cover and what it runs with. The Library shows your games as covers, with the chosen game's details beside them. A game's settings are a page of their own, and Settings is a board of tiles.
- **Themes.** The launcher's look is a theme, chosen in **Settings > Theme**. This version comes with one, Canopy; [docs/THEMES.md](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ProsperoEden/blob/main/docs/THEMES.md) says what a theme is made of.
- **An opening.** ProsperoEden appears out of the console's own launch picture without a cut: its mark comes forward over the picture, then goes to its place as the menu arrives. Any button skips it, and it plays only when the app is started.

NOTE: There is a known issue with Windows + AMD drivers.

If you are on Windows with an AMD GPU and run into stuttering issues / crashing, make sure your GPU driver is up to date and make the following configuration change to force using Vulcan.

Go to `%LocalAppData%/DK64Recompiled/graphics.json`

releases.name: recomp-launcher 0.3.0
releases.body:
### Added
- The installer shows its version (the game's tag, or the short commit for a
  build off a branch) in the window's corner and title, and on start asks
  GitHub for the game's newest release: a newer one gets a download button.
  Offline it says nothing.
- `game.files` takes globs: `*.iso` makes a folder holding a disc image the
  game, for a title whose setup takes an image rather than an install.
- `installer.yml` takes `platforms` (default `windows linux macos`), so a
  Windows-only game doesn't publish installers that can't build it.
- A `game.files` entry may be alternatives, `a|b`: `HOVER.EXE|hover*.zip` is
  the game's folder or a folder holding a zip of it.

- The Windows installer carries version info and a manifest, and a release
  has `SHA256SUMS.txt`, so antivirus heuristics and players can check it.
- A log of why the installer stopped (`%APPDATA%\recomp-launcher\launcher.log`
  on Windows), and an error box instead of the window vanishing.

### Fixed
- On Windows a step line after a blank line was glued to the line before it
  (ConPTY skips the blank line with a cursor move), so the bar missed that step.

# CronyX v3 

## 🆕 New Features

- CronyFG — experimental own native frame generation engine.

- Screen Stretch slider (0–100%) in screen effects — smooth stretching instead of hard full-stretch.

- Removed forced sharpening when stretching — effects are now controlled only from the effects menu.

- In-game virtual buttons editor over the running game: add/move/delete, change theme, assign keys — without leaving the game.

- Auto-search for .exe files in Downloads folders — import your apps in one tap.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.6
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.6** - *Сборка с исправлением смены шрифта интерфейса, позиционированием окна STORM GAMES WORLD, живым переключением 3X (6K) и улучшениями ядра и рендера*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Шрифт интерфейса и стабильность настроек**: Выбор шрифта обновляет весь интерфейс Qt целиком при многократном переключении без перезапуска; устранено обрезание кнопок в шапке настроек и исправлен вылет при повторном открытии диалога настроек (Use-After-Free в коллбэке `ConfigureDialog`).
- 🌟 **Окно STORM GAMES WORLD**: Диалог автоматически центрируется относительно главного окна эмулятора с ровными отступами по 100px сверху, снизу, слева и справа (`width - 200px`, `height - 200px`).
- 🌟 **Живое переключение 3X (6K) без зависаний**: Переработан синхронный сброс и перестройка текстур/пайплайнов на GPU-потоке (`ApplyPendingResolutionChange`, `RequestResolutionUpdate`), устраняющие фриз при смене масштаба во время игры.
- 🌟 **Графика, стабильность и ядро**: Обновлены профили глубины `NEEDS_D24` для серии Xenoblade (`XC1 DE`, `XC3`), уточнён `ConvertBorderColor` для сэмплеров карт теней, добавлена безопасная очистка буферов и улучшен обработчик `STx_mult_2` в NCE.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.5
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.5** - *Исправление зависания Diablo III, мгновенное закрытие сервисов (Xenoblade Chronicles 3), плавный фреймпейсинг на ПК через Mailbox VSync, адаптивный пропуск кадров и синхронизация скриншотов*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения
- 🌟 **Diablo III: Eternal Collection и модальные апплеты**: Устранено зависание ядра на 43.47 с и блокировка закрытия окна (`WM_CLOSE`) из-за модального окна выбора контроллера.
- 🌟 **Мгновенное завершение эмуляции (Xenoblade Chronicles 3 и др.)**: Устранены многосекундные задержки `CloseServices` (`hid`, `arp:r`, `psc:c`) - время закрытия сокращено с 9.10 с до 1.91 с.
- 🌟 **Плавность на ПК (Desktop Mailbox VSync + адаптивный Frame Skip)**: Режим VSync по умолчанию для ПК переключен на `Mailbox` (Android сохраняет `Fifo`), а пропуск кадров срабатывает только при реальной очереди вывода (`present_queue >= 2`).
- 🌟 **30-FPS тайтлы и 4K рендер (Diablo II: R, Xenoblade DE / 3)**: Исправлен опрос неподтвержденного Vulkan-тика в swapchain, добавлена автоадаптация `DynamicPerformanceScaler` под нативную каденцию 30 FPS и защита профиля `Animal Well`.

> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.4** - *Крупное обновление графического ядра Vulkan и производительности: исправлены критические визуальные дефекты в Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (сжатие в четверть экрана, полосы растяжения, чёрные лица, невидимые модели и мигающие прямоугольники), устранены пропажа/обрезка глифов и низкий FPS в Diablo II: Resurrected, внедрена комплексная оптимизация быстродействия, нагрева и расхода ОЗУ/VRAM, а также устранены зависания при выходе.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения

- 🛠️ **[Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition и глобальное видеоядро Vulkan]**:
  - Исправлено «ослепление» конвейеров и деградация вьюпорта при смене масштаба разрешения на лету (`1X -> 2X`): новый метод `PipelineCache::HandleLiveResolutionChange()` сохраняет `graphics_key.state` (`viewport_swizzles`, состояние смешивания и вершинный ввод), принудительно помечает грязными флаги `Shaders`, `VertexInput`, `ViewportSwizzles` и `Blending` на всех активных каналах и дедуплицирует `vulkan.bin`.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.3
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.3** - *Полноценная интеграция открытого драйвера Vulkan 1.3 `malisx2` (`bmdhacks/malisx2`) для устройств Android с ГПУ Arm Mali / Immortalis (v7-v12, без root, Android 10+), глубокая ревизия и исправление ошибок загрузчика драйверов и Vulkan-движка на Mali (защита от вылетов на MSAA `sampleCounts == 1` и заглушке `vkCmdResolveImage`), оптимизация компиляции шейдеров и памяти VRAM.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения

- 🔥 **[Интеграция `bmdhacks/malisx2` для Arm Mali / Immortalis (Android 10+)]**:
  - Подключён официальный репозиторий `bmdhacks/malisx2` в загрузчик драйверов (`DriverFetcherFragment`) и резолвер (`DriverResolver`) с офлайн-каталогом (`v0.6.1`, `malisx2-0.6.1-9fbc7da290.zip`), строгой фильтрацией только `.zip`-архивов (исключены `.sha256` и `.tar.gz`), активной вкладкой `Mali (malisx2 / PanVK)` (автовыбор на устройствах Mali) и быстрой установкой актуального релиза `malisx2` из баннера в менеджере драйверов.

> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.2** - *Крупное обновление эмулятора STORM SWITCH (Windows + Android): полная стабилизация и исправление графики Donkey Kong Bananza на Nintendo Switch 2, устранение зависаний и вылетов при остановке эмуляции («Стоп»), исправление барьеров самочтения рендер-таргетов (feedback loops) и интеграция 5 оптимизаций рендеринга и фреймпейсинга.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые изменения и улучшения

- 🎮 **[Donkey Kong Bananza и архитектура Nintendo Switch 2]**:
  - Восстановлена 100% корректная отрисовка каменного тоннеля, освещения, отражений и разрушаемых воксельных скал (пропуск неполного нативного `ShaderType::Geometry` `stage 4` по умолчанию + эталонный GameFix-профиль `040074A01BF12000` с `enable_gpu_buffer_readback=true`, `sync_memory_operations=false`, `cpu_accuracy=1`), производительность в 3D выросла до `22-28 FPS`.

- 🌟 **Графика, стабильность и ядро**: Обновлены профили глубины `NEEDS_D24` для серии Xenoblade (`XC1 DE`, `XC3`), уточнён `ConvertBorderColor` для сэмплеров карт теней, добавлена безопасная очистка буферов и улучшен обработчик `STx_mult_2` в NCE.

releases.body:
## v11.5.1 摘要

**这是一次纯文档修复** — CHANGELOG 里属于 11.5 的六条变更（批量 / 扫描导入、自定义封面 + exe 图标提取修复、`FilterTest` 扩例、封面回列表重绑、「继续游玩」真排序 + 三维组合过滤、多选条与删除确认）此前写在 `## [11.4]` 段落下面，读起来像 11.4 已经包含它们。现在拆出独立的 `## [11.5] - 2026-10-26` 段（Added 三条 / Fixed 三条），顺带把 `FilterTest` 例数按实测改成 33 例（含 `IconCodec` 6 例）、`[Unreleased]` 比对基线改指 `v11.5` 并补 `[11.5]` 链接引用。见 PR #64。

**代码与 v11.5 完全同一份** — `git diff v11.5..v11.5.1` 只有 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) 一个文件（34 insertions / 25 deletions，全是段落移动）。versionCode 36 / versionName 11.5 未变，也没有重跑构建：已经装上 11.5 的机器不需要做任何事，这个 tag 的作用只在于**源码归档里的变更历史与实际发布内容对齐**（`v11.5` 的 source archive 早于这次文档修复）。

功能、真机验收与已知限制见 [v11.5](https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/releases/tag/v11.5)。

---

## What's Changed
* docs(changelog)：把 11.5 的六条变更从 [11.4] 段落拆出 by @ReSerendipity in https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/pull/64


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/compare/v11.5...v11.5.1

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

逐条变更与提交号见仓库 [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ReSerendipity/GalgameShell/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。下面自动生成的 PR 列表只覆盖经过 PR 合并的条目，直接推送到 `main` 的提交不在其中。

---

emulators.latest_body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

releases.name: hakuX 0.3.1
releases.body:
## hakuX v0.3.1

### Performance
- Fix significant FPS regression on "lower-end" devices (Adreno < 740)
- Proper BC3 support
- Multiple tweaks to texture cache, significant improvements on titles such as Forza Motorsport

releases.name: EmuHub-v0.2-ALPHA
releases.body:
# EmuHub v0.2 ALPHA

> ⚠️ **Alpha notice**  
> This is an early preview. Some features may still be refined, but core functionality is stable. Please report any issues on the [Issues page](../../issues).

---

## ✨ What's changed
### New Download Manager
- Persistent download history – Completed downloads saved to SharedPreferences and reloaded on app start.
- Active downloads list – Shows filename, progress bar, percentage, and bytes downloaded/total.
- Completed downloads list – Shows filename, size, file path, date.
- Delete file functionality – Delete button with confirmation dialog; physically removes file from storage (works for MediaStore and SAF URIs).
- Unique IDs for downloads – Each completed download gets a UUID, preventing duplicate entries when deleting.
- Unique filename generation – Duplicate files automatically renamed with counter before extension (e.g., file (1).zip instead of file.zip (1)).
- Custom download folder – Settings screen allows user to pick any folder via Storage Access Framework (SAF). Default is Downloads.
- Download start toast – Short notification when a download begins.

releases.name: EmuHub-v0.1-ALPHA
releases.body:
# EmuHub v0.1 ALPHA – First Public Release

🎉 **Welcome to the first alpha release of EmuHub!**  
EmuHub is an open‑source Android application that helps you download and manage GPU drivers (Turnip, Qualcomm) and PC emulation components (Wine, Proton, DXVK, etc.) for Adreno‑powered devices.

> ⚠️ **Alpha notice**  
> This is an early preview. Some features may be incomplete, and you may encounter bugs. Please report any issues on the [Issues page](../../issues).

---

## ✨ What's included

- **Device detection** – Shows Android version, total RAM, GPU model, and Adreno series.
- **Turnip driver downloads**  
  - For Adreno 8xx: choose between **StevenMXZ** (official) and **whitebelyash** (experimental) sources.  
  - For Adreno 6xx/7xx: automatically uses the stable v26.x branch.
- **Qualcomm driver** – Official driver (v863.1) offered for Adreno 6xx/7xx devices.
- **Emulation components** – Download Wine, Proton, Box64, WOWBox64, DXVK, FEXCore, VKD3D from the [WinNative-Emu Components](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/Components) repository.
- **Latest version auto‑selection** – All releases are sorted semantically (e.g. `2.7.1` > `1.5.5`) and the newest is preselected.

releases.body:
RomSieve 1.3.0 applies your patches (translations, fixes, hacks) to the ROMs of your collection without ever modifying
them, and organizes the destination for Batocera, RetroPie, ES-DE, Recalbox or MiSTer. Your settings, profiles and
journals stay as they are, and a sort made with an earlier version can still be undone.

## New

### Patches

- **A folder of patches.** The new **Patches** card of the **Collection** step takes a folder of IPS, IPS32, UPS and BPS
  patches, loose or in ZIP, 7z or RAR archives. Each patch whose original ROM is identified in the source gives a
  patched version, a new file: the original ROM is never modified, nor is the patch.
- **Matched by their checksum.** A UPS or a BPS is matched by the checksum it records. An IPS is matched by the CRC32
  in its name (`Game (T-En) [47E70E08].ips`) or in its readme, with or without the copier header of the ROM. For the
  NES, older patches made for the iNES 1.0 header of the time are found too.
- **Named after the original ROM.** `Game (Japan) (T-En).bps` applied to `Game (Japan).sfc` gives

of several gigabytes is neither decompressed nor compressed again. Your settings, profiles and journals stay as they
are, and a sort made with an earlier version can still be undone.

### Preserve single-game archives

- **An archive written as it is.** The new option **Preserve single-game archives**, in the *Writing the files* frame of
  the **Output** step, writes a source archive (ZIP, 7z, RAR) as it is when it holds a single game (one file, or a
  descriptor and its tracks) and the sort keeps every file it holds. The archive is copied, moved or linked, according
  to the mode. An archive that holds one more file, such as a readme or a `.nfo`, has its content extracted, as before.
- **Named after its game.** The archive takes the name the DAT gives its file, with its own extension: `tetris.7z`,
  which holds `tetris.gb` identified as `Tetris (World).gb`, becomes `Tetris (World).7z`. The files it holds keep
  their names.

releases.name: v0.7.8
releases.body:
v0.7.8 reverts the v0.7.7 swapchain `preTransform` change. On devices reporting `ROTATE_90`, selecting `currentTransform` rotated the already-upright window-space blit a second time: the landscape game rendered portrait and the stick-driven mouse cursor (Switch analog stick) and the options Display tab were pushed off the visible canvas.

This release restores the identity-preferred `preTransform` that shipped in v0.7.5 (falling back to `currentTransform` only when identity is unsupported), so the frame, touch overlay, and cursor stay upright in landscape.

- `preTransform` is identity-preferred again in `nvn_vulkan.c`. Log line `[vulkan-surface-transform]` prints supported / current / selected masks each session; expect `selected` to equal identity on ROTATE_90 panels.
- Everything else from v0.7.6 and v0.7.7 is retained: sticky immersive mode (Java `applyImmersiveMode` on create/resume/focus), the complete package-only `--game-run` APK, Java launcher/game activity, `classes.dex`, normal/large touch-layout migration profiles, MaliSX2 0.6.0, PanVK r10, Turnip T30, ADPF, and Display routing.

releases.name: v0.7.7
releases.body:
v0.7.7 fixes the Android surface orientation: the v0.7.6 build restored the identity-preferred swapchain preTransform that had shipped in v0.7.5, and on devices reporting ROTATE_90 the composer applied that rotation a second time to an already-upright window-space blit. The game UI rendered sideways and the touch overlay and cursor left the visible area, which is why the on-screen cursor and some options panels (e.g. the Display tab) did not appear where expected.

This release returns the swapchain preTransform to the current display transform, so the composer no longer adds an implicit rotation. Framebuffer, touch overlay, and cursor share one orientation again.

- `preTransform` is now `cap.currentTransform` in `nvn_vulkan.c` (the code path that shipped in the working v0.7.4 build), instead of identity-preferred. Log line `[vulkan-surface-transform]` prints the supported / current / selected masks each session; expect `selected` to equal `current`.

releases.name: v0.7.6 - MaliSX2 0.6.0
releases.body:
MaliSX2 updated to 0.6.0. The complete package, Display routing, PanVK r10 and Turnip T30 are unchanged.

- Bundled MaliSX2 moved from 0.5.1 (`308fe121c7`) to 0.6.0 (`62d6d62423`); packaging verifies the archive SHA-256 `55b17293…47f8` and library SHA-256 `c1c8738f…76fb`.
- Driver matrix updated for the new upstream list (adds G620/G720); G71/G72 stay on PanVK r10, system Vulkan remains the fallback.
- APK: `0.7.6-android-port`, code 706, 43,020,844 bytes, SHA-256 `9e7a3be222a301da82364f456290afe68955a8593539b1e16799bcf3a955e7ea`; v3 signature verified; bundled `libvulkan_malisx2.so` matches the pinned library hash.
- Device validation of the new driver is still pending; the launcher option alone does not prove presentation. Confirm `[vulkan-device] profile=` in logcat.

Installing over an existing build requires the same signing key (`$DM_ANDROID_TOOLS/debug.keystore`, or `--keystore PATH`).

releases.name: v0.7.5
releases.body:
v0.7.5 corrects the Android game surface orientation without dropping the complete package.

- Reverted the v0.7.4 Vulkan swapchain preTransform selection after runtime evidence showed the native game framebuffer rotated while the Android touch overlay remained upright in landscape.
- Restored the earlier working identity-preferred preTransform behavior, with currentTransform only as the fallback when identity is unsupported.
- Retained the --game-run complete package-only APK, Java launcher/game activity, classes.dex, normal/large touch-layout profiles, ADPF, MaliSX2 0.5.1, PanVK r10, Display routing, and recent native changes.

### Complete Android package rebuild

- The previous v0.7.2 and v0.7.3 manual APKs were diagnostic NativeActivity probes because `--game-run` was omitted; they did not contain the launcher/game Java surface.
- This package-only APK restores `LauncherActivity`, `D2RActivity`, `classes.dex`, and both normal/large touch-layout migration profiles from the earlier complete build line.
- Retains the Vulkan `currentTransform` orientation fix, ADPF changes, MaliSX2 0.5.1, PanVK r10, Display routing, and recent native performance changes.
