Release artifacts contain the Android port and launcher only. They do not contain game data, firmware, keys, saves, or protected game content.

releases.name: Rush5 0.10
releases.body:
First public release of Rush5, a launcher and touch-control layer for the ARM64 Android port of GTA V Legacy.

**Install:** download `Rush5-0.10.apk`, install it, then follow the game-file setup in the README (copy your GTA V Legacy data to `Internal storage/Games/GTAV/`).

**Highlights**
- Fully editable touch layouts with four control modes and automatic vehicle switching
- Hold-and-drag buttons: hold Weapons or Radio and drag to steer the wheel, no right stick needed
- Turnip driver picked per Adreno generation, DXVK 3.1, editable dxvk.conf
- Graphics profiles, engine command-line flags, performance and crash diagnostics

Requires Android 11+, arm64, Adreno GPU, and your own copy of GTA V Legacy (builds 1.0.2699 to 1.0.3504).

emulators.latest_body:
This release candidate fixes a startup crash that could leave an extracted Switch 2 title stuck on **Launching…** in rc9. The affected title now gets past that point in our desktop test. It still runs below full speed.

### What's new since rc9

- **Extracted games:** Ruzu can open an extracted `exefs/main` and find the matching RomFS without opening every file in the game directory at startup.
- **Graphics stability:** fixed a freeze that could occur when one GPU channel reused a buffer another channel had already released. Native compute shaders now use the correct local-memory addresses, fixing a GPU fault observed on AMD hardware.
- **Video and applets:** improved AV1 intro playback and fixed software keyboard requests that were rejected when a title used an extended applet ID.

### Known limitations

Switch 2 support is experimental. We tested the affected title on a Radeon RX 5700 XT with Mesa RADV, not on a physical Steam Deck. This fixes the startup crash reported in [#28](https://github.com/vricosti/ruzu-emu/issues/28); it does not establish full-speed gameplay or long-session stability.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc9
releases.body:
This release candidate adds experimental support for Nintendo Switch 2 titles, together with stability fixes when stopping a game and an optional GPU path for texture recompression.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc8.

### What's new since rc8

- **Experimental Switch 2 title support:** per-session hardware profiles with automatic memory sizing, native title loading, the mesh and task shader draw path, and the display path used by these titles.
- **Stopping a game:** fixed several freezes on "Closing software..." and shortened shutdown when a large shader was still compiling.
- **GPU ASTC recompression (experimental, Vulkan):** a new option in Graphics > Extras decodes ASTC textures and encodes them to BC3 on the GPU instead of the CPU. On the tested system it shortened the first minute of loading by several seconds and reduced stutter. Off by default.
- **Texture handling:** BC7 as a recompression target and a disk cache for converted textures.
- **Metal (macOS):** Switch 2 task and mesh draws, and fixes for compute storage buffers.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc8
releases.body:
This release candidate completes support for the cheat instructions implemented by Eden's DMNT engine and improves cheat-file parsing and process targeting.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.
- **Cheat execution:** corrected nested if/else handling, loop decoding, arithmetic behavior, and handling of truncated or unknown instructions. Controller input is sampled once per execution so multiple button conditions see the same input state.
- **Cheat files and process targeting:** fixed parsing of names containing Unicode symbols or accents. Memory operations and pause/resume now target the process identified by the cheat metadata, with a cached non-owning process reference.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.0 - 6 months after
releases.body:
This release improves Home Menu support, controller navigation under Gamescope, system-service compatibility, and macOS rendering.

### What’s new

- **Home Menu and applets:** improved startup, launching installed applications, firmware-specific application information, and document loading. Fixed menu-focus issues. Home Menu compatibility remains experimental.
- **Gamescope and controller navigation:** added in-window menus and dropdowns to avoid clipped or hidden popups. Improved navigation throughout the interface, fixed SDL axis-direction handling, and prevented navigation from interfering with control configuration.
- **Compatibility and stability:** expanded system-service coverage with updates from Eden, corrected service-session ownership and cleanup, and fixed recursive locking during web-applet completion.
- **Rendering (Vulkan):** incorporated upstream display-composition updates. macOS Vulkan builds now use a pinned, Eden-compatible patched MoltenVK. The experimental Metal backend gains depth/stencil fixes, compiled shader-library reuse, and improved diagnostics.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.0.9
releases.body:
This release focuses on controller-friendly navigation, Linux and Steam Deck packaging, and improved system-service coverage.

### What's new

- **Controller navigation:** navigate menus, buttons, the game library, and Ruzu’s file dialogs with a controller, including the startup prompt.
- **System services:** implemented missing application-management, filesystem, audio, and SSL commands to improve compatibility.
- **Local wireless services:** implemented missing LDN commands, network callbacks, and state-change notifications. Fixed scan locking so discovery can receive responses while waiting. Real multiplayer sessions still require validation.
- **Linux AppImage:** added `./build.sh appimage` to build and package Ruzu.
- **Steam Deck packaging:** added a dedicated Docker-based build with Zen 2 optimization, bundled runtime libraries, and X11/XWayland forced like Eden’s AppImage. Desktop and Gaming mode compatibility still requires hardware validation.

releases.body:
## v0.1.23 (2026-07-07)

> _Report anything that misbehaves._

**New — Mii selector & creator**
- In-game **"Create a Mii"** (Miitopia, and any title that calls the Switch Mii applet) now opens a
  real, gamepad-navigable Mii selector: pick one of your existing system Miis, generate a random
  Mii, or cancel — instead of the game being silently handed a blank default face. A random Mii is
  saved into your system Mii database, so games that re-read it pick it up too.
- Guest applet dialogs — the Mii selector, profile selection, and controller-connect prompts — now
  **render and are fully controller-drivable in Game Mode**. Previously, because a guest applet
  pauses the game, the emulator's frame loop went idle and the overlay never composited over the
  frozen frame (it showed as a black screen); it now re-composites the overlay over the held frame,
  so the menu appears over your game and the D-pad / A / B drive it, handing control back cleanly.
- **Direct Mii Creator access** from the launcher top bar — the full Mii editor is one button away,
  as befits a Switch headline feature.

**New — Deck-native input**

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.22
releases.body:
**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of
  real frames on a dedicated present thread. GPU-light titles roughly double their perceived
  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).
- It is self-limiting by design: generation only engages when it actually helps — it suspends below
  a per-title frame-rate floor, when the GPU has no spare headroom (measured from real per-frame GPU
  time, so misreported "100% busy" titles are handled), and when the game already runs near panel
  rate. A zero-delay dip veto skips generation for any single spiked frame (e.g. a shader-compile
  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.
- Fixed: the feature now engages reliably on every launch (previously a first-launch state could
  latch process-wide), the blade reports its live state honestly (including a "restart game" hint

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.21
releases.body:
**Smoother in motion — every game**
- Fixed a per-frame Vulkan memory allocation in the FSR upscaler (the default scaler) that blocked the render thread on GPU fences hundreds of times per second under load. Heavy titles no longer dip as hard when the camera moves — every game running the FSR scaler benefits.

**New — console features**
- **Console Mode**: choose Docked or Handheld globally *and* per game, with a live mode tag in the overlay. Your per-game choice always outranks the built-in recommendation.
- **Cheats in the Quick-Access blade** (L3+R3): browse and toggle individual cheats live, in-game.
- **Boot lands on your last-played game**; launcher + overlays navigate with the left thumbstick too.
- Controller-aware button glyphs, a boot splash, gallery export, usage-based achievements, a real battery reading, and over-scroll fixed in every list.

**Stability — sessions survive more**
- **A GPU crash no longer kills your session** — the reset is contained and you're routed back to the launcher.
- **Closing from Steam now exits cleanly in seconds** (was an 8-second hang + force-kill, every time).

releases.name: Ryudeck v0.1.20
releases.body:
## v0.1.20 (2026-06-30)

**More games running**
- **Xenoblade Chronicles 3** no longer crashes on its fully-rendered opening cutscene. A shader the game

- **Super Smash Bros. Ultimate** now boots into gameplay — it was crashing on load — and holds ~60 fps.
- **Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!** no longer soft-locks on the control-select screen: the game asks for a

**Frame pacing — simpler + correct**
- The QAM **Frame Rate** control is now **two clear knobs** instead of three overlapping ones:

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.4.1 Hotfix
releases.body:
Restores missing scene graphics reported on the Infinix X6886 with Mali-G57 MC2. The tester confirmed that Sonic's model in Act Trial and the stage scenery were visible again.

- The Android hotfix disables user clip planes in Vulkan using the same mode tested in `0.3.4.1-test1`.
- Resource uploads that arrive between Vulkan command lists are recorded in the next list. Uploads and resource releases keep their order.

The release packages the same native library tested on the Infinix X6886. Android 10 or later, ARM64 and Vulkan are required. Thanks to the tester for checking the menu and gameplay. [Report an issue](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/issues)

[Full source diff](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/compare/v0.3.4...v0.3.4.1)

Хотфикс восстанавливает пропадавшую графику на Infinix X6886 с Mali-G57 MC2. Тестер подтвердил, что модель Соника в меню «Испытания актов» и окружение на уровне снова отображаются.

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.4
releases.body:
**Vulkan compatibility update for Mali.** Shaders now read buffer addresses without requiring `shaderInt64`. This addresses a startup blocker on drivers that expose Vulkan buffer device addresses without 64-bit shader integers, including some Mali-G52 and G76 drivers.

- Corrects Vulkan array-texture bindings and handles fixed descriptor allocation failures.
- Specializes software clip planes when creating graphics pipelines so the fragment shader can omit clip-plane discard when clipping is disabled.
- Queries MSAA support for the formats the renderer uses and adds Vulkan capability details to `log.txt`.

The APK is for Android 10 or later, ARM64 and Vulkan. Device verification for this release is pending. Reports of missing scene graphics on Helio G200 in v0.3.3 remain under investigation. If the issue persists in v0.3.4, please include the scene, graphics settings and a fresh `log.txt` in your report. [Report an issue](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/issues)


[Full source diff](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4)

---

## Русский

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.3
releases.body:
**Mali Vulkan compatibility.** This release adds a fixed-descriptor rendering path for drivers that lack the features required by the bindless path. It targets startup failures such as those reported on the Infinix HOT 40 with Mali-G52.

- Orders vertex and index buffer updates on Mali, snapshots dynamic texture uploads, and decodes guest BC1/BC3 textures when the GPU lacks BC support. These changes address hazards that can affect videos and loading screens.
- Fixes the conditional visibility query used by effects such as lens flares. Adds fragment-shader clip planes when the driver lacks native clip distances and has enough shader inputs and outputs.
- Skips extracting the bundled Adreno drivers in Auto mode when the device is known to use another GPU.

Startup was verified on **POCO F5 (Adreno 725, Turnip)**. Testing on Mali is pending. If you try this release on Mali, please include your device model, Android version, and `log.txt` in your report. Tell us whether you reached the title screen and loaded a level, and whether videos or loading screens flicker. [Report an issue](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/issues)

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.2.2
releases.body:
**Shared save folder.** You can now store your progress and achievements in a shared folder for tools such as Syncthing. By default, the game continues to use the saves in your existing installation.

1. Fully close the game and reopen the launcher. Go to **Game files → Choose save location → Shared folder (Android/media)**.
2. Choose **Copy current saves** to bring your progress and achievements with you. The launcher keeps the originals and stops the copy if it finds a different save in the destination. Choose **Use this folder** if it already contains the saves you want to play with.
3. Point your sync app to the path shown in the launcher. On primary storage it is `/sdcard/Android/media/io.github.sansnope.marathonrecomp.android/saves`. Close the game on one device and wait for sync to finish before opening it on the other.

Copying saves, loading existing progress, and writing a new save to the shared folder were verified on **POCO F5**. Version **0.3.2.2 (code 20)** requires Android 10 (API 29) or later, ARM64, and Vulkan.

[Full source diff](https://github.com/SansNope/MarathonRecomp-Android/compare/v0.3.2.1...v0.3.2.2)

---

## Русский

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.2.1
releases.body:
**Improved Spindash** now carries momentum into jumps, and **Improved Mach Speed** adds braking and wall rebounds inspired by P-06. Both options are off by default. Enable them under **Options → Game Settings**.

- **Improved Spindash** — press **A** during a SpinDash to carry 60% of your speed above the normal air limit into the jump. The extra speed fades gradually in the air, so a faster roll gives you a longer jump.
- **Improved Mach Speed** — hold **B** or pull the left stick back to brake in Mach Speed sections. You can steer while braking with **B**, and Sonic carries the reduced speed through a jump. A wall hit below 90% of top speed knocks Sonic back without taking rings.

Developed with assistance from **Gemini 4 Neon** and **GPT 6.2 Sol**. Gameplay was confirmed on **POCO F5 (Adreno 725)** with `0.3.2.1-test4`. Version **0.3.2.1 (code 19)** uses the same native library, Android app ID, and release signature. Requires Android 10 (API 29) or later, ARM64, and Vulkan.

emulators.name: gears of war 2 pc port
emulators.description: 《战争机器 2》Xbox 360 版的静态重编译 PC 移植。
emulators.latest_body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.name: v0.4.5
releases.body:
The Riftworm interior no longer crashes or goes black with Vulkan, the game picks the right GPU settings on Linux and under Proton, every chapter can be picked from the start, and co-op gets a key and a controller combo to go to player 1. Everything from [0.4.4](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.4) is included.

## Vulkan (Linux and SteamOS, Proton with Vulkan, Android, Vulkan on Windows)

- **Inside the Riftworm (act 5) no longer loses the GPU.** The worm's flesh is drawn with tessellation, and the shaders the renderer builds for it read their settings from the wrong slot, so the tessellation factor came from unrelated memory: the scene stayed black, would not load, or the game closed with a lost device. Fixed in SDK patch 0091 (found with the Khronos validation layer). On a Radeon RX 7800 XT the worm interior now runs 120 s at 60 fps where it failed within seconds. Under Proton, Vulkan (`gpu_backend = vulkan`) is the backend to use for that chapter: D3D12 through vkd3d-proton was also reported to lose the device there and we could not test it.

## Linux and SteamOS

releases.name: v0.4.4
releases.body:
Less memory traffic on phone GPUs, less work per draw on the GPU command thread, and a new option for the CPU core the game spins while it waits for the GPU. Everything from [0.4.3](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.3) is included.

## Vulkan (Android, Linux and SteamOS, Vulkan on Windows)

- **Each render pass now covers only what it draws.** The renderer sizes its render targets for the console's whole EDRAM (1520x3456 on the phone) and every render pass loaded and stored all of it, even when its draws touched only the 1280x720 of a 720p frame. Phone GPUs render in tiles and pay for every byte a pass loads and stores, so they moved about 5.7 times the memory they needed. Now each pass begins with only the area its draws and clears can write (SDK patch 0089). It follows the Vulkan rules, so the picture should not change; it has not been measured on a phone yet. If part of the picture looks missing or stale, set `vulkan_tight_render_area = false` in `gow2.toml` (it takes effect at once) and open an issue with the scene. Direct3D 12, the Windows default, is not affected.

## Every platform

releases.body:
Another year has gone by, therefore we are releasing a new ScummVM version. As you may notice right away, we are changing our version numbering schema, but that’s not all! We are also planning on more frequent releases!, which you can read about on [sev’s blog](https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-milestone-in-149535385).

This could be the biggest release we have made so far in terms of the added features and engines. If I count correctly, we have added 12 new engines to our compatibility page. Not games, engines. In terms of games, it is challenging to count, since two of the engines, SLUDGE and WAGE are authoring tools, but if you count games in our detection tables, that adds up to at least 194 titles!

And there is so much more...

## This is the first public beta release of **SeedlessDS**. SeedlessDS is a Nintendo DS emulator app for Android built around the **DraStic r2.6.0.4a** core, with a new Android frontend, a new UI written in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, RetroAchievements integration work, and dual-screen behavior designed for modern Android handhelds.

emulators.latest_body:
# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。
- 原生回归覆盖 21 类存档故障、280 轮重复存读档及请求交错。

releases.body:
# 原声加速修复与 RP Duo 滤镜

加速时使用 SoundTouch 保留音高，音乐和音效节奏随游戏加快。修复此前加速连续爆音，以及 1.0.38 加速声音尖锐的问题。RP Duo 用户已确认 1.0.39“音色自然了，效果合适”。

包含按上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的 Vulkan 柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜，以及低延迟音频的暂停恢复和异常回退修复。

| `replacement.apk` | 原包名替换版 | `com.seedlessds.app` |
| `coexist.apk` | 与官方版共存，可更新本分支旧共存版 | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` |

releases.name: v0.1.7-beta - Mali BC texture fallback
releases.body:
## Changes in v0.1.7-beta

- Query Vulkan format support and decode BC1–BC7 texture uploads on devices without support for the source BC format.
- Keep hardware BC sampling unchanged on GPUs that support the requested format.
- Set Android package version to 0.1.7-beta (versionCode 8).
- Include the generated Android manifest when building the signed APK.

The BC fallback is based on the Mali-G720 crash report. Runtime verification on the affected device is still needed.

releases.name: v0.1.6-beta - Mali & MediaTek GPU Support
releases.body:
### Changes in v0.1.6-beta:
* **MediaTek & ARM Mali GPU Support:** Fixed startup crashes on MediaTek (Dimensity, MT6899, etc.) and ARM Mali GPUs (Mali-G720 / Immortalis). Relaxed desktop Vulkan feature requirements (sampleRateShading, depthClamp, drawIndirectFirstInstance, shaderClipDistance) in SDL_GPU backend and enabled compatibility with core Vulkan 1.1+ drivers.
* **Native SDL_GPU Vulkan:** Renders directly on both Qualcomm Adreno and ARM Mali/MediaTek GPUs.
* **Touchpad & Touch fix:** Fixed pointer coordinate translation and mouse simulation.
* **Native PRX Shims:** Native ARM64 implementations for ImeDialog, SaveData, AudioOut, Mouse, VideoOut, UserService, SystemService, Random, Rtc, WebBrowserDialog, NetCtl.

releases.name: v0.1.5-beta - AnyPS5 Mewgenics Android Port
releases.body:
## v0.1.5-Beta

- **Native SDL_GPU Vulkan:** Fixed a Turnip Mesa WSI crash; rendering now runs directly on the Adreno 830 GPU.
- **Audio and stable 60 FPS:** Added a native AAudio backend (48 kHz stereo), a hardware audio clock, and VSync.
- **Color correction:** Enabled a native RGBA swapchain and 1080p buffers; colors now render correctly.
- **Touch controls:** Touch hover shows cat stats without accidental dragging. Long press (350 ms with vibration) picks up and moves a cat; a tap clicks, and two fingers trigger right-click.
- **39 built-in patches:** 1080p canvas, cutscene fix (SWF Atlas 4096), and native TLSF `lzcnt`/`tzcnt` instructions (+17% CPU performance).
- **Glaiel Runtime:** Added a native ARM64 library with GON and libtess2.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.4-beta
releases.body:
Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.3-beta
releases.body:
Fourth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. Menu elements that never showed up before (e.g. the Co-op / Vs. tombstone) are back.
- "storage texture has no committed guest pages" crash.

### Performance and heat
- Draw recipes now work for the menu (repeated draws reuse their recorded setup).
- Box64 spin-waits sleep (`PAUSE=3`, WFE) instead of spinning: less CPU load for the same frame rate.
- The driver's two threads wake each other only when one actually waits.

### Requirements
- Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU only; Android 11+ recommended. Tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.2-beta
releases.body:
Third beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over v0.1.1-beta, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **⚙ Settings tab**: graphics, controls, language and help in one place.
- **Touch layout editor**: drag the controls, resize one or all, hide or add buttons (right stick, R3), opacity, reset.
- **Profile name input**: the game's text input now opens the phone's keyboard (the name used to be a fixed default).
- **Resolution**: Auto (screen proportions, no taller than the game's 1080p frame), Screen, 720p; image on a wide screen: Fit / Fill / Stretch.
- **Logs for a bug report (zip)** at the bottom of Settings: game log, logcat, device info and the reason of the last crash, no root needed. Attach it to an [issue](https://github.com/SFEZSergey/ReplantedAndroid/issues/new/choose).

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.1-beta
releases.body:
Second beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted**. Installs over v0.1.0-beta (same signing key, game data and settings are kept).

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### What's new
- **Launcher in English** by default (follows the phone language; English / Russian can be chosen in "Language").
- **GPU driver** setting: the built-in Turnip, the phone's system Vulkan driver, or your own driver package (an adrenotools `.zip` with `meta.json`, as used by Yuzu/Eden/Winlator). If the chosen driver fails to load, the built-in Turnip is used.
- **Game language** setting: the languages the game is translated into (read from the dump: English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil)), or "System" — the phone's language if the game has it, English otherwise. The game itself has no Russian translation.
- The APK is now signed with **v2 + v3** signatures, so it installs on MIUI / older Android versions that rejected v0.1.0 ("There was a problem parsing the package").

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.0-beta
releases.body:
First public beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted**.

> ⚠️ The game is not included in the APK — you need your own **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802, the folder with `eboot.bin`).

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+, arm64.
- **An Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU.** The bundled Turnip driver only works on Adreno.
- 8 GB of RAM and a fast CPU recommended (tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite).

### How to run
1. Install the APK.
2. "Папка дампа" (dump folder) → pick the dump folder (the one with `eboot.bin`).
3. "Импорт и запуск" (import and run) — the first time, copying and preparation take a few minutes; afterwards the button is "Играть" (play).

### What works (Snapdragon 8 Elite)
- Intros and title screen — 60 FPS; main menu — ~37–43 FPS; levels — ~48–53 FPS.
- Sound, gamepad, touch controls (a virtual gamepad; the eye button hides it).
- FPS limit 60/45/30 and "GPU turbo" in the launcher.

### Known issues
- Strong heating during long sessions → the phone lowers its clocks and FPS drops. For long sessions use the **45 FPS** limit.
- The menu is slower than levels (the driver is still single-threaded).
- A rare crash while a level loads — just restart.

releases.name: shadps4 v0.21.0 - codename Until Mavethee Dawn
releases.body:
Another week another release . There are ton of changes , so why not ? 

## Core
* Properly check where an input came from for digital->analog input smoothing
* cpu_patches: Work around Rosetta 2 mistranslating negated scalar compares 
* file_sys: Report stable file identities in stat and fstat 
* Allow file type identification for '/addcont' path
* emulator: stop clearing temporary data on boot 
* Add PT_SCE_MODULE_PARAM case
* cpu_patches: Fix JIT patching at addresses outside any module
* core: Fix MemoryManager::Free unmapping past the released rang
* file_sys: don't abort when a guest path goes through a regular file
* use VMA pointers instead of copies in TryWriteBacking 
* cpu_patches: Workaround Rosetta 2 crash on VMASKMOVPS/PD
* Handle ELF metadata and toolchain comments program headers
* common: reuse one high-resolution waitable timer per thread in AccurateSleep
* Don't abort when optional ELF metadata segments can't be read
* cpu_patches: Fix register clobbering in Rosetta 2 VMASKMOV workaround 
* renderdoc: Add library name for macOS
* renderdoc: Add alternate path for macOS 
* lru_cache: Fix early stop in ForEachItemBelow

releases.name: shadps4 v0.20.0 - codename Dead Or Stephen 5 - The Comeback
releases.body:
That was close wasn't it? I know you are not used to so close releases but we have a lot of new things to demonstrate so why not? This release is following the first official stable release of shadNet 0.1.0, so we have some online playability available (yes Bloodborne fans, online Bloodborne is now officially available). There are also a tons of fixes to different areas of emu , you can check the list below. The release is dedicated to our friend Stephen, who is taking a break from shadPS4 due of his studies. Stephen if you are reading this we already miss you ;/

## Core
* cpu_patches: Apply comprehensive SSE4a CPU patches on macOS 
* Shutdown NpHandler before restarting
* cpu_patches: Enable static patching on Linux
* cpu_patches: Patch (V)RCPPS and (V)RSQRTPS on Intel
* Speed up game ID resolution
* Anchor the FPS counter at startup and refactor counter movement check
* address_space: Restore protections after splitting a mapped region on Windows
* kernel: Implement POSIX file attribute and sync APIs
* file_sys: Normalize guest paths and fix mount matching

releases.name: shadps4 v0.19.0 - codename The Shadoween special
releases.body:
Welcome back to another shadPS4 release . It is over one month since our previous release and guess what we are back again with a lot more fixes and a lot more playable games . Rapid work has been done in different areas of the emu, but i guess the glory goes to the huge amount of GPU fixes that improved so many games, some of them are really playable now . I won't steal the fun of discovering these, so here is a brief list of changes.

### Core
- Rewrote signal emulation again 
- Fixed incorrect error return on attempting to create a file in a nonexistent folder in a writable mount 
- Fix reserved region coalescing in POSIX address space code 
- Support loading entitlements from RIF licenses 
- Optimized logger by replacing hash map with table lookup and hide implementation details 
- Support loading DLC as ZAR 
- Reworked slot vector 
- Fixed sceKernelReserveVirtualRange alignment and add ClearName 

### Libraries
- Use present scheduler for blank frame prepare 
- np_auth : Change default GetAuthorizationCode returns to be valid 
- np_trophy: Fixed displaying of trophy name 
- http2 : Fixes and cleanups
- np_tss : Added TSS support

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

# Lua Scripting
- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.
- Added a script debugger: breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and log messages), Step Into / Over / Out, Break on Errors, and Variables, Watch, Call Stack and Breakpoints panels.
- 28 example scripts under `Help > Examples`: FPS Counter, Sprite Boxes, RAM Heat Map, Input Display, Cheat Finder, Trace Logger and more.
- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

# Enhancement Chips (DSP-1/2/3/4, Cx4)
- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.
- The joypad watchdog is off by default. Fixes Lethal Weapon being thrown off the machine.
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Nintendo Super Disc
- Added support for the BIOS in the BIOS Manager.
- Added support for disc insert and eject (eject resets to the home screen), and the disc's name in the window title.
- Working Titles:
  - Super Boss Gaiden
  - Test CD, [sdtest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32607729/sdtest.zip)
- Added hotkey tabs
- Load with Preview now shows previews

# Super Famicom Box
- The keyswitch position is remembered, and the window title names the running game.

# Super Game Boy Color (new, Experimental)
- New SGBC mode: an SGB2 with a Game Boy Color inside with customs borders support.
- This mode runs a memory patched SGB2 BIOS with per-game in-memory patch to support colors and borders.
- Color now comes from the cart instead of the stale SGB palette. 
- Pre-palette fallback goes through BGP.
- DMG-compatibility color is routed through BGP/OBP.
- Carts whose SGB detect beats the Color branch get dedicated patches.
- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

# Super Game Boy
- MLT_REQ is latched in the ICD2 instead of waiting for the BIOS.
- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.
- GBC-only carts are no longer forced out of SGB BIOS mode on the container path.
- Sprite-limit hack offered in SGB BIOS sessions.

# Game Boy

# Emulation

## Voicer-kun
   - Play Voicer-kun enabled games by attaching the included audio CDs with the game (can be in cue/bin files format,  or .zip containing cue/bin); 
   - Voicer-kun IR peripheral is fully emulated so the games drive the CD themselves.
   - Menu placed under Sound => "Voicer-kun"
   - Only one disc can be attached in the drive at a time (EMIT requires to change CDs during the game).
   - Port 2 is forced to a joypad as attached device so that the voicer-kun device is detected.
   - IR burst looped so the learn wizard registers keys automatically, port 2 reports only the device id, not player buttons.
   - IR burst will work when selecting the game's automatic mode (not manual)
   - Supported voicer-kun games:
     - EMIT Vol. 1 (CD1, CD2)
     - EMIT Vol. 2 (CD1, CD2)
     - EMIT Vol. 3 (CD1, CD2)
     - Angelique (CD1)

## GB / GBC / SuperGameBoy
   - Optional `no-sprite-limit` for the BIOS-less GB/GBC core added to `Hacks...` window. This fixes the sprite limitation of the actual hardware.
   - `Allow Invalid VRAM Access` override for games that need it, surfaced in Win32/GTK/Qt with proper enable/gray-out handling.

## Get started

1. Download the zip for your computer below: `nx2android-v0.3.0-windows-x64.zip` (Windows) or `nx2android-v0.3.0-macos-arm64.zip` (Mac with Apple silicon, M1 or later). ## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 2.0.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

This is a major release for this project, where the biggest change is that we have completely redesigned the bottom screen UI to feel more native to Silksongs design language. The bottom screen UI should now feel familiar to anyone who has used the in-game menu and any action can be taken from the bottom screen menu, making the in-game menu obsolete.

Thanks to Kaz Kirigiri for doing most of the design work and providing sketches for this revamped UI!

## Changes since 1.1.0

### Completely revamped bottom screen UI

- All tabs have been revamped to follow the in-game menu as close as possible
- Every action from the menu can now be done from the bottom screen. Use items, change crest and tools, place markers
- Smoothly animated item selection, tab switching, etc

## Changes since 2.0.0-rc1

### Dual screen
  - Zoom slider on the map: drag up to zoom in, down to zoom out. Fades out like RESET when you're not touching the map

## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 1.1.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

## Changes (since 1.0.3)

### Mods (beta)
- Mod support: install BepInEx 5 plugins from a folder, build them into the game, and turn them on and off without rebuilding
- Configuration Manager support (needs the mod installed, see docs. Press L3+R3 to open)

### Display
- New setting: **Unlock aspect ratio** — fills non-16:9 screens completely (off by default, as it can have visual issues)
- Fixed the video options menu showing no usable resolutions
- The game now stays landscape and no longer flips to vertical (which caused a squashed picture)

- The second screen now uses a native Android presentation layer, taking its touch input straight from the Android surface instead of through Unity. This may also fix the second screen not responding to taps on some devices, but that is unconfirmed

- The second screen now hides when you minimise the game, and comes back with it

releases.name: Arceus Native 1.0
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** Everything new in 1.0 was built and checked on a PC (including simulated Mali, Adreno, Xclipse and PowerVR GPUs), but has not been played on a phone yet. Expect problems, and please report them with a debug report (☰ → Bug reports → Make a debug report).

Install it over v0.99 or older. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

---

## Fixed: v0.99 closed right after starting

- A diagnostic that sampled the game during loads broke the game's code on some phones, and the game closed at start (the workaround was `DM_LOAD_PROF=0` in env.txt: you can remove it now). It is now off by default and made safe.

## New in 1.0

- **Less work for the GPU**: fewer drawing passes per frame (clears are folded into the next pass, empty depth passes are gone) and depth and stencil that a pass does not change are no longer written back to memory. This helps most on Mali and older Adreno phones. If objects go missing or flicker after updating, add `DM_VK_LAZY_CLEAR=0` to env.txt and tell us in an issue.

## From v0.99

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.99
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** The crash fix below was played on a Galaxy S25+ (start, field, steady 30), but not yet through the village exit that crashed: please tell us if leaving Jubilife still closes the game. The speed work from Galar Native was built and checked on a PC for Legends: Arceus.

Install it over v0.98 or v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

---

## Crash fix: leaving Jubilife Village

- **The game no longer closes about a minute after leaving the village** (reports from a REDMAGIC 10 Pro, on v0.96 and v0.98). When you left an area, the game gave back some of its memory while effects from that area were still using it; on the phone that memory was reused at once and the game closed. That memory is now kept until nothing uses it (a few KB each time you change area).
- If the game still closes when you change area, please make a debug report right after (☰ → Bug reports → Make a debug report) and attach it: the crash record now names the memory area involved.
- The **Smoke Bomb's fog drawn only in the top-left of the screen** was fixed in v0.98: update from v0.96 if you still see it.

Expect problems, and please report them (see the end of these notes).

Install it over v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

## Crash fix: the game no longer changes its picture while you play

- **Fixed the crash after the picture changed during play** (#90, and reports from a vivo and a REDMAGIC on Adreno 830). Graphics Auto and the heat guard switched the game to handheld mode or a smaller 3D picture while playing, which the game does not handle: a crash about 15 seconds later, striped 3D, or effects drawn in the wrong size (the Smoke Bomb's fog covering only the top-left of the screen). The mode and 3D render scale now stay as set when the game starts. Changes you make yourself in ☰ still apply.

## Setup: your extracted game files, no keys

> **How far this was tested.** Everything below was built and checked on a PC, and this build was played briefly on one test phone (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830): it starts, builds its shaders before play, and holds 30 fps in the field. It has not been tested on other GPUs (Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR, older Adreno). Expect problems, and please report them (see the end of these notes).

Install it over v0.44 or the v0.45 preview. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: the shader translation is the same as before, so just press Play.

The version number jumps from 0.45 to 0.96 because Arceus Native, Galar Native and Paldea Native now share one engine and one version number.

This note covers everything since **v0.44**, the last full release, including what the v0.45 preview already had.

---

## Performance and smoothness

- **A steady 30 on every phone.** When the phone cannot keep up, the game steps down through its own lighter settings until it can: first a smaller 3D picture, then the game's handheld mode, and as a last resort a shorter draw distance from the next start. It steps back up once things calm down.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.45 (pre-release)
releases.body:
**Pre-release.** A preview of what's coming. It installs over v0.44 and keeps your saves and setup.

### What's new
- **A steady 30 fps.** When your phone can't keep up, the game steps down to lighter settings until it can: first a smaller 3D picture, then the game's own handheld mode, and as a last resort a shorter draw distance from the next start. It steps back up once things calm down.
- **Heat guard.** When your phone gets hot, the picture gets lighter before the phone slows itself down. This works on every Graphics setting.
- **Resolution: 720p, 1080p or 1440p.** 1440p works again.
- **Draw distance slider** (50–200 %) and **Mode: Quality or Performance**.
- **Frame rate: Auto, 30, 60 or Dynamic.** You can change it while you play.
- **Frame generation:** the in-between frames leave out the HUD, keep characters clean, and follow the camera on fast turns.
- **Touch controls:**
  - Push the stick past its ring to dash.
  - Swipe the **+** button left or right to change your ride Pokémon.
  - Quick camera swipes no longer switch the selected item.
- **Lower specs and Style move effects** are now built from your own game files.
- **More phones supported:**

This helps most on Mali and older Adreno phones. If objects go missing or flicker after updating, add `DM_VK_LAZY_CLEAR=0` to env.txt and tell us in an issue.

## New in 1.0

- **Less work for the GPU**: fewer drawing passes per frame (clears are folded into the next pass, empty depth passes are gone) and depth and stencil that a pass does not change are no longer written back to memory. This helps most on Mali and older Adreno phones. If objects go missing or flicker after updating, add `DM_VK_LAZY_CLEAR=0` to env.txt and tell us in an issue.
- **A crash risk removed**: a diagnostic that sampled the game during loads could, rarely, break the game's own code at that moment. It is now off and made safe (it closed Legends: Arceus at start in v0.99).

releases.name: Galar Native v0.99
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** An earlier build of the speed work below was played on a Galaxy S25+ (shorter wait before play, less memory, a steady 30). The last part of it (how the game and the graphics wait for each other) and the new setup and Players screens were built and checked on a PC only. Expect problems, and please report them (see the end of these notes). The Mali changes from v0.97 have still not been played on a Mali phone.

Install it over v0.98, v0.97 or v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield (one app runs both, update 1.3.2).

---

## Faster

- **Almost no wait after Play.** The shaders the game needs are ready from the last time you played, so the game starts at once (on the S25+: from about 1.5 s to 0.1 s, and none from the second start on).
- **Shorter loading screens and steadier frames.** The game and the graphics no longer wait for each other longer than they need to, so frames reach the screen sooner and loading screens no longer wait for the screen's refresh on every frame.

releases.name: Galar Native v0.98
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** The memory fix and the other fixes below were built and checked on a PC; they have not been played on a phone yet. The Mali changes from v0.97 (Faster rendering on Mali, less work per object on most G615 phones) have also not been played on a Mali phone yet. Please report problems (see the end of these notes).

Install it over v0.97 or v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield (one app runs both, update 1.3.2).

---

## The Dynamax crash and the crash when changing your lead Pokémon

- **The game no longer closes when one of its memory areas runs out.** Sword and Shield keep fixed-size memory areas for things like effects, textures and lists. On Android some of them filled up, and the game then used memory it never got and closed. That was the Dynamax crash, the crash when changing the first Pokémon in your team, and several other crashes in the middle of play. When an area is full, the game now gets memory from a reserve instead. (#211, #272, #298, #330, #341, #343, #344, #345, #346)

releases.name: Galar Native v0.97
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** The Mali white-screen fix was tested on a POCO X6 Pro (Mali-G615 MC6, Arm's driver r44p1): Route 1 draws correctly. The Mali speed changes below were measured from that phone's logs but have not been played on a Mali phone yet. Everything was built and checked on a PC. Please report problems (see the end of these notes).

Install it over v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield (one app runs both, update 1.3.2).

---

## Mali: the white screen is fixed

- **Sword and Shield now draw correctly on Mali phones with Arm's own driver** (the phone's normal driver). The field, grass and lighting were white. The game stores some per-vertex data, such as normals and colours, as small whole numbers; Arm's driver changed those numbers before the game's shaders could read them, and the lighting came out far too bright. They now reach the shaders unchanged, as on the Switch. You no longer need the PanVK driver for this. (#215, #227, #282, #311, #316)
- If you turned on any of the menu's "White screen tests (Mali)", turn them off again.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.3
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.3: much faster.**
- Before the build the program asks where the result goes: a device over USB or Wi-Fi debugging, or a folder only. With a device, the game files are copied to it **while** the game's code is being built, and the finished app is installed at the end. No ZIP is made then.
- A first build takes about 5 minutes on a fast PC (was about 10): the translation runs in parallel and a 2-3 minute stall at the end of every build is gone.
- The build is kept: after an update of the program it takes a minute or two instead of starting over.
- The window is sharp on screens scaled to 125-200%.
- App 0.3.3: no more 1-second freezes when the game restarts its rendering thread (a sleep in the game's own code, skipped); PlayStation button icons when a DualSense is connected during play; a clear message while the game's code is still being built.

Tested on one PC and a Lenovo Y700: a full build with install over Wi-Fi in about 5 minutes. **Not tested yet:** the full 11.5 GB copy during a build, USB, the 1-second freeze fix in long play.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.2
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.2:** the program says "device" instead of "tablet", since installing works on phones too, and a typo in the Russian text is fixed. The app and the game are the same as in 0.3.1. **Install on the device…** has now been tried over USB on a Lenovo Y700 (the window installed the app and checked the game files in 16 seconds); Wi-Fi through the window and the full 11.5 GB copy are not tested yet.

**In 0.3.1:** after a build, **Install on the device…** installs the APK and copies the game files over USB or Wi-Fi debugging, so the folder no longer has to be copied by hand. **In 0.3.0:** about 150 MB of downloads instead of 1.3 GB, no Java or Android SDK; meant to work under Wine and Proton.

1. Run `RunnerBuilder.exe`. It is not signed, so Windows may show a warning.
2. Choose the folder of the installed game, accept the Android SDK terms and press Build.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.1
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.1:** after a build, **Install on the tablet…** installs the APK and copies the game files over USB or Wi-Fi debugging, so the folder no longer has to be copied by hand. The program downloads adb for this (about 8 MB). Files already on the tablet are skipped, so an interrupted copy resumes. Copying by hand still works as before. **Not tested yet:** the full 11.5 GB copy (a 20 MB test ran at 38 MB/s over Wi-Fi, so about 5 minutes is expected) and USB. No changes in the game itself.

**In 0.3.0:** about 150 MB of downloads instead of 1.3 GB, 16 GB of free disk space instead of 25, no Java or Android SDK; meant to work under Wine and Proton.

2. Choose the folder of the installed game, accept the Android SDK terms and press Build.
3. Press **Install on the tablet…** and follow the steps (turn on USB debugging, or wireless debugging with a pairing code). Or copy the resulting folder to the tablet and follow the instructions inside.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.0
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.0:** a much lighter builder. About 150 MB of downloads instead of 1.3 GB and 16 GB of free disk space instead of 25. No Java, Android SDK or system tools any more: the app comes ready-made inside the program, which only translates the game's code from your copy and adds it. This also makes it work under Wine and Proton (not tested on Linux yet, reports welcome). No changes in the game itself since 0.2.8. Leftovers of earlier versions (about 4 GB) are removed on the first run. The new APK installs over the old one, keeping your game files and saves.

1. Run `RunnerBuilder.exe`. It is not signed, so Windows may show a warning.
2. Choose the folder of the installed game, accept the Android SDK terms and press Build.
3. Copy the resulting folder to the tablet and follow the instructions inside.

You need Windows x64 (or Wine/Proton), about 16 GB of free disk space and about 150 MB of downloads. The build takes from 5 to 30 minutes. The program holds no game code or files. **What it produces does, so do not publish or share it.**

**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 7 (ветка v12.7)**

**По умолчанию — на скорость и FPS**
- Вывод кадров X-сервера получил высокий приоритет (как интерфейс системы) — кадры не ждут за фоновой работой.
- DXVK компилирует шейдеры не больше чем на половине ядер (2–4 потока) — быстрые ядра остаются игре, меньше просадок при новых эффектах.
- Лог DXVK — только предупреждения и ошибки (подробный тратил ресурсы в каждой игре); причина отказа графики по-прежнему попадает в отчёт.

**Лучшее из аналогов**
- «Апскейл как FSR» (идея DroidDeck) в «Графике»: игра рисуется в 720p или 540p, картинка растягивается с настоящей резкостью CAS — больше FPS почти без потери чёткости.
- «Сбросить настройки игры» — вернуть рекомендуемые после экспериментов (идея GameNative: профиль игры по умолчанию).
- «Поделиться логами» — журнал запуска и последний отчёт в Telegram/почту одной кнопкой.

Всё из бет 1–6: ровные 30–60 FPS по такту экрана, Vortek по умолчанию, починка «Студии», журнал запуска. Подпись — единый ключ (SHA-256 b79d7958…).

releases.body:
**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 6 (ветка v12.7)**

**Снова ровные 30–60 FPS — и теперь привязаны к экрану правильно**
- Убраны тормоза беты 5: без лимита кадры опять «не чаще 60» (в бете 5 игра пыталась рисовать до 120 кадров на 120-Гц экране и перегружала видеокарту).
- «Авто 30–60» снова по умолчанию: первые 15 с и загрузки не учитываются, 10 с замер, затем ставится самый высокий ровный лимит (60 / 45 / 40 / 30), который игра держит 90% времени, и частота экрана, кратная ему.
- Кадр выдаётся точно по настоящему такту экрана (а не просто по таймеру) — кадры не «съезжают». Опоздавший кадр по-прежнему отдаётся сразу, без лишнего ожидания.
- Игра просела на 4 с — лимит на ступень ниже (не ниже 30). 30 с держит ровно — пробуется ступень выше; не удержала — тихо назад.
- Убраны кнопки, которые ничего не меняли: ручной выбор частоты экрана и дубль лимита FPS в «Графике». Лимит — в «☰ ▸ FPS».

Всё из бет 1–5 на месте (починка «Студии», Vortek по умолчанию, журнал запуска). Подпись — единый ключ (SHA-256 b79d7958…).

releases.name: Winlator Hybrid DXVK v12.7.0-beta.5
releases.body:
**Winlator Hybrid DXVK 12.7.0 — бета 5 (ветка v12.7)**

**Исправлено: вылет игры после изменений в «Графика»**
- Причина: старая «Студия графики» при «Сохранить и применить» затирала настройки контейнера — ставила Box64 «Ультра-Турбо» (StrongMem=0, BigBlock=3) и FSYNC (Unity падала, старт замедлялся), включала DXVK 2.4.1 (на Mali/Vortek не запускается), а ползунок FPS лишь ставил потолок в DXVK.
- Теперь вместо неё простое окно «Графика и FPS»: частота экрана (системная / 60 / 90 / 120 Гц — что поддерживает телефон, сразу), лимит FPS (сразу), разрешение игры, шейдеры (выключены по умолчанию). Box64, переменные и DXVK это окно больше не трогает.
- Уже испорченные настройки чинятся автоматически при запуске игры (появится сообщение 🔧).
- 90/120 Гц теперь действительно поднимают потолок кадров: синхронизация кадров идёт на частоте экрана, а не на жёстких 60.

**Быстрее старт**
- Подробный оверлей больше не заставляет Wine опрашивать видеокарту при каждом окне (на Vortek это тормозило).
- DNS для игр — без IPv6 и с коротким таймаутом.
- Журнал запуска: «окно игры через N с / первый кадр через M с» — в «Загрузки/Winlator-logs/startup.txt» и в «Производительности».

releases.name: SkyEmu v2
releases.body:
It is my pleasure today to announce the release of the SkyEmu v2 GBA/GB/GBC emulator. 

You can access the web build [here](https://web.skyemu.app/v2) or download the native builds linked at the bottom. 

Lets take a look at some of the new features in this release:

# Display Options

SkyEmu v2 adds 5 high quality upscaling shaders covering the most popular upscaling algorithms. All filters are antialiased so they look nice at a variety of resolutions and the LCD filters even adapt themselves to the characteristics of the screens of the HW being emulated. For example when playing a DMG game the LCD filter's pixel outline color changes and its sub-pixel grid is replaced with a slight drop shadow.

![SkyEmu-Shaders](https://github.com/skylersaleh/SkyEmu/assets/7118296/ab75b4af-2abe-4d69-9448-631daddc8637)

On top of the upscaling shaders SkyEmu v2 adds a bunch of scaling and display emulation options:
- Forced Integer Scaling
- Stretch to Fit Scaling
- Color Correction 
- Screen Ghosting
- Screen Rotation
- Customizable DMG GB Color Palette

releases.body: # SkyEmu v1 SkyEmu is a low level GameBoy, GameBoy Color and Game Boy Advance emulator. Its primary focus is to provide a good user experience through a good mixture of tradeoffs of accuracy, performance, features and usability. # Features - [Highly accurate Game Boy Advance emulation](docs/Accuracy.md) - Game Boy and Game Boy Color Emulation - Experimental Nintendo DS support (only capable of running homebrew currently) - Cross Platform: Windows, MacOS, Linux, Web App (with touch screen controls for iOS and Android) - Game Controller and Rumble Support with configureable keybinds - 4x Save Slots with screenshot preview - Game fastforward and rewind support (supporting [very long rewind times](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sfc_1NKbiKg)) - Support for emulating the Real Time Clock - CPU, MMIO, and Memory Debuggers - Dark and Light Themes - Support for loading official BIOSs dumps Web build: https://web.skyemu.app/v1/

releases.body:
This is a Diagnostics v1 developer preview, packaged as a Debug APK for owner testing.
It installs alongside Pine and the old diagnostics app as **Pine Diagnostics Preview** (`io.github.pine.emu.diagnostics.preview`),
version `2.1.2-diagnostics-v1`. Diagnostics is off by default.

The old and initial fixed CI APKs have different Debug signing certificates.
This fresh application ID avoids requiring an uninstall or clearing old data.
It does not migrate another app's private settings, files, URI grants or exit
history. Configure lawful local content in the new app; do not share keys.
Continuous in-place Debug updates still require a stable development signer.

This revision repairs the identified VMA mapped-allocation contract and safe
failure for missing/revoked SAF content, including ACTION_VIEW metadata entry.
Controlled regressions pass; restored device game startup remains unverified.

It adds bounded asynchronous JSONL/PineDiag events, actual content selection and
storage observations, guest message/DFX forwarding, developer settings, redacted
export and Windows ADB collection. Main and emulation process logs are isolated.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.4
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.4

Source revision: `c57e7f5d7608691bde97bc1c523c22ddf25604c6` (version code 7, version name `0.2.4-stable+c57e7f5`). A small update to 0.2.3.

### Fixes

- **Frame generation is smooth again when the game runs below half the screen's refresh rate.** The FPS counter used to double, but each generated frame and the real one reached the screen on back-to-back refreshes (about 8 ms apart, then a 25 ms gap), so motion looked no smoother than without frame generation. This was reported on a OnePlus 11 with BeamNG 0.34. Now the frames are shown evenly spaced, for example every 16.7 ms when 30 FPS is doubled to 60 on a 120 Hz screen. Checked for Linux games on Box64 + bionic and FEX + bionic. Windows games with frame generation go through the same code, but were not tested.
- Frame generation now caps the game's own frame rate at the screen's refresh rate divided by the multiplier (60 for 2x on a 120 Hz screen), since the extra frames could not be shown anyway.

Game profiles and the other registry files are read from the tag `v0.2.4` of the components repository (the same content as `v0.2.3`).

### Download and installation

|---|---|

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.2
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.
  - Windows games get the driver mapped to your GPU when they start, or the system driver when none is mapped.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.
- BeamNG 0.34 now starts on Box64 + bionic without PRoot. It used to crash about a second after start with exit 134 (seen on a OnePlus 11).

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.1
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.0
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. A Box64 + bionic + no PRoot preset starts BeamNG 0.39 reliably.
- Games run directly from shared storage: FEX retries file mappings that Android's noexec storage refuses, so BeamNG no longer needs staged copies. The old staging code is removed, and its leftover files are deleted when a Linux session starts.
- Steam libraries on shared storage (`SkyNetEmu/Games`): installs work, installed games get shortcuts, and a fresh install finds games that are already downloaded there instead of offering to download them again.
- Tomb Raider (2013, 32-bit) runs from a shared-storage library on the PRoot glibc FEX.
- Android 16: FEX and the shim emulate `openat2` and `faccessat2` (BeamNG exited with SIGSYS).

emulators.latest_body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.1.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.1.0

- **Selevet support:** the emulator patcher now supports Selevet Eglantine performance build 4, including both normal and 30 FPS Windows downloads.
- **Future-build matching:** minor Selevet updates can be recognized when the reviewed loader and metadata-reader fingerprints still match. Unverified matches are labeled experimental; changed or ambiguous hooks are refused.
- **Settings preserved:** adding or removing the metadata patch keeps `nx2_switches.txt` and the existing 30 FPS setting unchanged. Exact original executable backups remain available for removal.
- **Supported-build list:** added Selevet and adjusted the patch dialog so its full compatibility list remains visible.
- **Validation:** both Selevet downloads passed byte-exact patch removal, isolated native hook checks and real startup timing comparisons. Patched startup without a companion matched the external-NPDM path at 31.25 MHz. These checks do not establish gameplay compatibility or FPS gains.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.0.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.0.0

- **New branding:** NSP Box, with redesigned icons and a new app logo.
- **Smoother UI:** subtle animated background, fluid transitions, and improved spacing.
- **NSP-only packaging:** removed XCI output from games and DLC.
- **Dedicated DLC tab:** create separate DLC NSPs for compatible emulators. Thanks [@ryzendew](https://github.com/ryzendew) for requesting separate packages in [#1](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/1).
- **Expanded patch support:** Eglantine build 98, AMD Experimental build-99, and PokeDinner 2.1.0a. Supported builds are now listed in the patch panel.
- **Fixed drag-and-drop crashes:** artwork and folder drops no longer crash the app. Thanks [@WicCaesar](https://github.com/WicCaesar) for reporting [#2](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/2).
- **Windows x64 portable release**, with source code included as a separate download.
- **Existing game packages don't need rebuilding** to use the expanded emulator patch support.

**Experimental build — limited real-world testing.** Emulator and DLC compatibility varies. Supported patched emulators can load packages without an external `main.npdm`.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0

- **New Emulator patch panel:** select a Windows x64 emulator folder, check compatibility, add the patch and remove it later. Eglantine build 96 standard/PGO and PokeDinner 2.0.0 GUI/CLI profiles are recognized; matching future builds and forks can be tried experimentally without a new menu entry.
- **No separate `main.npdm` needed after patching:** compatible emulators read Switch 2 metadata already embedded inside this packager's plaintext XCI/NSP. Restart the emulator after applying the patch. Existing packages do not need rebuilding, and the packager need not remain open while playing.
- To create only a single XCI/NSP, uncheck **Create package folder**. The option remains on by default for unpatched emulators; without the patch, retain each game's exact external companion in its own folder. Selecting 12 GiB alone can still use incorrect timing and reduce performance.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4

- Add the reported performance drop without an external `main.npdm` to the startup caution, Notes & compatibility, README and release notes.
- Recommend keeping **Create package folder** enabled and retaining its companion beside the game. The performance observation is user-reported, not a controlled benchmark.
- Refresh remembered-caution preferences so the new warning is shown after an older notice was dismissed.
- Retain the 12 GiB guidance, default-on package-folder option and single-file output when unchecked. Packaging behavior is unchanged from 1.4.3.

Portable Windows x64 build. Extract the complete Windows ZIP and run `Switch2-XCI-Packager.exe`. Source, licenses and build notes are included. No game data, artwork, firmware or retail keys are included.

**Caution — experimental:** set emulator memory to **12 GiB** before testing Switch 2 packages. Booting without an external companion was reported in PokeDinner 2.0.0 with this setting; other games/builds may differ. The app does not change emulator memory settings. Verification does not guarantee booting or gameplay.

Thirteenth beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

## What's new since beta 12

- **Sharper tutorial pages and lower-screen menus on one screen.** When the lower screen is shown big over the whole picture (a tutorial page, the load menu, the world list, a mission's page), it is now drawn at the size it is shown at, and a tutorial page's text is drawn sharp on its own.
