releases.name: 358/2 Days for Android: 0.1.5 beta 12
releases.body:
Twelfth beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

Coming from an earlier beta? The game offers this update itself on the title screen, or install the APK below by hand; your game, HD files and saves are kept.

## What's new since beta 11

A beta about speed with the HD pack's KH2 models.

- **Scenes with the KH2 character models are no longer slow.** A KH2 model with a coat made the whole 3D picture take a slow path. On a Mali-G57 tablet the scene after Day 7 ran at 16-22 pictures a second; now 51-60. Stronger devices gain too in close-ups.
- **Enhanced character shadows cost much less.** With the setting on, an AYN Thor went from 93 to 62 pictures a second in the Grey Area; now 86.
- **A frozen picture on Mali devices is recovered from.** When the graphics driver stopped answering, the picture stood still for good while the game went on. The game now notices and carries on after a short hitch, and one of the two moments where it happened is gone.

releases.name: 358/2 Days for Android: 0.1.5 beta 11
releases.body:
Eleventh beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

Coming from an earlier beta? The game offers this update itself on the title screen, or install the APK below by hand; your game, HD files and saves are kept.

## What's new since beta 10

A small beta about starting the game.

- **Much faster starts on some devices.** The graphics card's programs are now kept between starts instead of being made again every time. On the AYN Odin (Adreno 630) the screen stayed black for one to four minutes at every start; now it is about 3 seconds. Other devices start a little faster too.
- **"Compiling shaders – First boot only"** shows on the first start after installing or updating, while those programs are made, instead of a black screen. That first start can still take a minute or so on older devices.

releases.name: 358/2 Days for Android: 0.1.5 beta 10
releases.body:
Tenth beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

Coming from an earlier beta? The game offers this update itself on the title screen, or install the APK below by hand; your game, HD files and saves are kept.

## What's new since beta 9

A beta about how the game feels and how the top screen behaves at scene changes.

- **Snappier controls.** Button presses and the stick reach the game sooner, and Roxas turns more smoothly (the PC port's newest input work, brought over). On the Thor, the time from pushing the stick to Roxas moving went from about 68 ms to about 29 ms.
- **The visions of Sora show their static on the lower screen only**, as on the DS. With two screens it flickered on the top screen too.
- **A widescreen top screen keeps its picture at camera cuts and crossfades.** It could flash an empty 4:3 room or black bars for a few frames.

releases.name: 358/2 Days for Android: 0.1.5 beta 9
releases.body:
Ninth beta of KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days for Android on **[khdays-port 0.1.5](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases/tag/v0.1.5)**, Yokimitsuro's native PC port that this Android version follows. All the credit for the port itself goes there.

Coming from an earlier beta? The game offers this update itself on the title screen, or install the APK below by hand; your game, HD files and saves are kept.

## What's new since beta 8

A beta about speed at high resolutions, mostly for the Thor.

- **The HUD, menus and text are drawn much faster at 3x and above.** They were worked out again at every pixel of the picture; now only where something finer than a DS pixel is drawn. The picture is the same. On the Thor in the Grey Area at 4x: two screens went from about 69 to 94 frames a second, and one screen runs at about 92.
- **Each screen has its own resolution: Settings > Video > Upper screen and Lower screen.** The upper screen's setting covers its 3D and its HUD together. The lower screen at 2x costs far less and leaves the upper screen at full detail.
- **The Thor now starts at upper 4x, lower 2x** (it started at 2x). If you had chosen your own resolution, it is kept.

\- Added **X++**, a native X server in C++ with asynchronous presentation for Android

releases.name: Ludashi 4.0: Early Access
releases.body:
What's new:


📲 UI
\- Completely rewrote the UI using Jetpack Compose.

🖥️ Renderer Backend

\- Added a new EGLRenderer.
\- Improved the overall performance of the VulkanRenderer and added ReShade support.

\- Added DisplayX, a new implementation based on SurfaceFlinger for native composition.
\- Provides support for the Android Hardware Composer (HWC).
\- Supports the Android Performance Hint API.
\- Supports an X Server bypass, allowing DisplayX to bypass the traditional X Server composition path.
\- DisplayX is currently experimental.

---

🖥️ X Server

\- Fixed a long-standing issue with X resource management.

\- Reworked the DRI3 and Pixmap extensions to provide proper direct rendering support.

\- Reworked the Drawable backend to allow hardware-accelerated Xlib buffers.

\- Added the GLX extension for Zink DRI3, allowing proper GPU-accelerated OpenGL rendering.

\- Added the XComposite extension for proper offscreen rendering support.

\- Improved Zink performance for OpenGL games, benefiting non-Adreno GPUs.

\- Added support for Freedreno, the Powerful OpenGL driver for Adreno GPUs.

\- Freedreno can massively improve performance in OpenGL games.

📦 Proton & Assets

releases.name: Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.6
releases.body:
# Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.6

What's new since 1.9.8.4.

## Picture fixes
- **Smeared picture fixed (two causes):**
  - After a load, the game sometimes rewrote a command buffer it had already handed to the GPU. The picture then stayed broken or smeared until the game was restarted. Every submitted command buffer is now copied first (`BB_COPY_GPU_BUFFERS=0` turns this off). The same cause was behind "Unimplemented PM4 type 0" and "PM4 header ... rest of the buffer dropped" in logs.
  - After a start with an empty shader cache, one saved pipeline could be lost for the whole next session. The game's motion blur then kept blurring the last frame, so the picture looked smeared and frozen from the first camera turn on.
- Rainbow tiles on hit enemies and a light line along the top in cutscenes are fixed.

releases.body:
# suyu v14.1.0

This minor update fixes two graphics compatibility problems while retaining the
safer defaults introduced in v14.0.1.

## Graphics corrections

- Fixed corrupted NVIDIA rendering with graphics pipeline libraries enabled.
  Fragment-output libraries now retain the full pipeline state when cached.
- Fixed stretched character geometry in Tears of the Kingdom on macOS MoltenVK.
  Packed vertex weights use a supported three-component format when the unused
  fourth component would cross the vertex stride.

Graphics pipeline libraries, Fast GPU Time, async shader building and SPIR-V
optimization remain off by default. Explicit user settings are preserved.

**Re-export existing Static and Hybrid packages** to receive the corrected host.
Translated game code remains part of those exports; official downloads contain
no games, keys or firmware.

## Tested scope

MK8D 4.0.0 and TOTK 1.4.3 native Static opening replays completed on Linux
RTX 3090 (NVIDIA 580.159.03), Windows Radeon RX 9070 XT and macOS Apple M5.
The 6,001-frame MK8D and 12,001-frame TOTK checks used default settings and
optional pipeline-library/Fast GPU settings. All Static cases exited normally

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.2.0.2-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.2.0.2-beta

Less memory trouble in heavy places, a clearer "Compiling shaders" screen, and Pokémon Pokopia's shader update made short.

**Install over 0.2.0.1-beta.** Games, packs, mods, saves and shader libraries are kept, and nothing is prepared again.

## Fixed

- **A game that slows to a crawl when the phone runs out of memory** (Zelda: Ocarina of Time entering Castle Town on a 16 GB phone fell to under 1 fps for minutes). The texture cache now notices when the phone starts swapping the game out and stops growing instead. If a game still stutters in big areas, turn on **RAM saving** (Game settings) and close other apps.
- **Zelda: Ocarina of Time on phones with 12 GB of RAM or less** uses less memory for textures and graphics memory (from Banana Native).
- **The "Compiling shaders" screen** shows its whole text on two lines (the time left and "Tap to skip" were cut off), and its bar follows the count.
- **Pokémon Pokopia** updates its shaders quickly after installing 0.2.0: about 60 shaders instead of all of them.

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.2.0.1-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.2.0.1-beta

A fix for 0.2.0-beta: no more black screen while a game prepares its pipelines.

**Install over 0.2.0-beta.** Games, packs, mods, saves and shader libraries are kept, and nothing is translated or prepared again.

## Fixed

- **A black screen at the first start of a game** (seen with Turnip drivers, for example on a Redmagic 11 Air). Since 0.2.0, a game prepares its known pipelines before it plays (at most 90 seconds). The loading screen had already gone by then, so the game looked stuck. Now the loading screen stays and shows **Compiling shaders: N of M**; tap it to skip the rest. On Turnip the pipelines are made one at a time, so the first start takes the full 90 seconds unless you skip; the next starts are short.

Everything else is as in [0.2.0-beta](https://github.com/mamcjr/Swap2-Native/releases/tag/v0.2.0-beta).

## Thanks

**moceure and the Banana Native contributors**, **enjoyerofslop / DroidPlay Core**, **Sergii "iOrange" Kudlai** (bcdec), **erickmendes22** and **EddizEge / AnkaNative**. Licenses and attribution are included in the sources.

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.2.0-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.2.0-beta

Five more Switch 2 games boot, Zelda: Ocarina of Time draws its grass and gets faster, and a new graphics menu offers four upscalers with a level, plus grass and fog options.

**Install over 0.1.9.3-beta.** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. **The shaders change:** each game updates its shader library the first time you play it after installing. Only the shaders that changed are translated again, so in most games the update is short (Ocarina of Time about 2,300). It takes longer in **Yoshi and the Mysterious Book** (about 40,000), and two games translate all of their shaders again: **Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave** (about 17,000) and **Pokémon Pokopia** (about 131,000, which takes hours; keep the phone charging). While a game updates, its earlier shaders keep it playable. **Games you already prepared also prepare their code again once** (the "rewrite" step of Prepare; Mario Kart World takes about an hour and a half on a POCO F7 Ultra): keep the app in front until it is done.

## New

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.3-beta

Swap2-Native now speaks the Switch 2's 16 languages, works with a controller from the library to the in-game panel, has a redesigned in-game panel, and offers a frame rate cap in every game.

**Install over 0.1.9.1-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **The app in 16 languages.** Every menu, dialog and the in-game panel follow your phone's language: English (US and UK), Japanese, French (France and Canada), German, Italian, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). To use another one, pick it in **Settings › Interface › App language** (or in Android's own app language setting).
- **Controller navigation.** In the library, with a game selected: **A** plays it, **Y** opens its Game settings, **L / R** switch tabs. Buttons follow the Nintendo layout (A right, B bottom) by default; **Settings › Interface** keeps the Xbox layout if you prefer it.

releases.name: Swap2-Native 0.1.9.1-beta
releases.body:
# Swap2-Native 0.1.9.1-beta

Zelda: Ocarina of Time can run at 30 fps in its heaviest scenes, and every game can be played in your language.

**Install over 0.1.8.9-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. The shaders do not change.

## New

- **Mesh geometry** (Game settings › Graphics, and the in-game panel, where it applies at once). Turned off, the game's mesh-drawn geometry is not drawn: in Zelda that is much of the foliage, the falling leaves and some objects. The scene gets much lighter: at Link's porch in Kokiri Forest on our POCO F7 Ultra the GPU went from 38-40 ms to about 30 ms a frame.
- **Game language** (Game settings). The language the game gets from the system: the default (English, US, as before), your phone's language, or any of the 16 Switch languages. A game shows it where it has that language. It applies the next time the game starts.

## Faster

releases.body:
- **Fixed: "Security warning" from ColorOS.** On OnePlus and Oppo tablets, 0.5.0 made the system show "an attempt by a malicious app to damage the system has been stopped" a few seconds after Steam started. Nothing was damaged; a change meant to save CPU in Steam triggered the check, and it is gone.

releases.name: Pons 0.5.0
releases.body:
- **Mouse and keyboard work like on a desktop.** Left, right and middle click, scroll wheel, drag, and keyboard shortcuts go straight to the game. Touch gestures for tablets without a mouse.
- **Less memory.** Box64 pp13: Crusader Kings III uses about 0.6 GB less RAM.
- **Less CPU.** Steam and the game talk to each other without going through proot each time: proot stops fell from about 3,750 to 300 per second, and the app uses about 20% less CPU in game. Same 30 fps.
- **Fixed: Android keyboard bar over the game** when a hardware keyboard is connected.
- Helpers 38, Box64 pp13, Mesa Turnip pp10.

releases.name: Pons 0.4.0
releases.body:

- **Fixed: black screen after leaving the game.** Coming back to the game screen now shows the game again.
- Helpers 35, Box64 pp12, Mesa Turnip pp10.

releases.name: Pons 0.3.0
releases.body:
- **Much faster downloads and starts on some networks.** Linux now uses the DNS servers of the network Android is on (and follows network changes). Before, a fixed DNS server that some hotspots and VPNs drop made every lookup wait 5 seconds: Steam downloaded at 0.03 Mbps instead of 22, and signing in took a minute.
- **Loading screen.** No more black screen on first start: a progress bar for the setup and Steam's update, the step in progress, and the game's artwork behind.
- Helpers 34, Box64 pp12, Mesa Turnip pp10.

emulators.latest_body:
Adds ShizukuPlus compatibility to Aether while retaining stock Shizuku support.

- Discovers supported managers in the current Android user and verifies Binder callbacks against the manager UID.
- Bundles independently verified stock and Plus rish loaders, preserves verified manager selection, and supports an explicit RISH_BACKEND override.
- Uses Termux's shared libexec path and handles Android bind aliases by directory identity.

Use the matching Aether API 1000.0.2 companion for its ShizukuPlus diagnostics and reconnection support. The coordinated suite includes both verified APKs and the existing verified native packages.

Updating a shared-UID Termux APK can end active sessions. Complete active work before installing. The separately signed Aether Steam/probe app is not included in this release.

releases.name: Aether 1000.0.1
releases.body:
Updates the Android app and coordinated Aether suite to 1000.0.1 while preserving existing application IDs, signing identity, guest data and configuration.

- Adds immediate Gboard dictation insertion, Ctrl-tap handling for wrapped URLs, one-line selection copying, and a wider drawer gesture area.
- Improves Shizuku-backed foreground/background execution and session cleanup, native Go toolchain integration, terminal rendering and source verification.
- Includes persistent Arch launcher defaults and the updated API companion. The suite reuses the unchanged Exec 1000.0.0 package.

Download the Pacman suite and matching checksum for the coordinated upgrade. The APKs, matching Aether source archive, installer, component provenance and checksums are also included.

releases.name: Termux-Aether 1000.0.0
releases.body:
## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. No wildcard overwrite or editing of checksum-protected scripts is needed. Use `aether-update` for later protected upgrades, or install new suite packages with `pacman -U` directly.

releases.body:
1. Ability to attach files and insert their paths into the input panel 
2. Additional action buttons for the input panel (input history, attach files, paste from clipboard). Can be disabled in settings 
3. Option to enable a double-tap gesture to open the keyboard in terminal applications where single-tap actions are consumed (e.g., in opencode)

releases.name: Release21
releases.body:
1. Added support for terminal application notifications via the kitty OSC 99 protocol (used in opencode 2.0.  However, its current notification implementation is buggy, and a notification sent from one session is duplicated by every other running opencode session. To address this, the app includes a "Notification deduplication" workaround, though it cannot guarantee accurate identification of the source session.)
2. Added the option to enable the input bar above the terminal. 
3. Fixed various issues when using the bubble window. 
4. Fixed terminal rendering issues in certain scenarios (fixed color fill bugs in Vim when resizing the terminal window, and eliminated garbled output when displaying Hindi characters).
5. Improved handling of display cutouts, and added an option to extend the window into the cutout area.

## 中文

本期新增 termux-ui 模块，为 Windows 应用、Linux 桌面、文件和运行组件提供统一图形界面。

- Windows 应用与游戏：通过独立的 Wine 环境导入、配置、管理和运行程序。
- Linux 桌面：创建、启动、管理和重新安装 Native 与 PRoot 桌面环境。
- 运行组件：下载和管理 Wine、Box64、图形及配套组件，支持自定义 Wine 和 Box64 版本。
- 文件管理：浏览文件、批量操作、查看文件信息，并将检测到的 Windows 程序导入程序库。
- 输入与显示：按程序配置显示设置、键盘鼠标输入、虚拟按键和游戏手柄。
- 备份与恢复：导出和恢复 PRoot 桌面容器、Wine 环境及 Wine C 盘。

## English

Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Windows apps and games: import, configure, manage, and launch programs with dedicated Wine environments.
- Linux desktops: create, launch, manage, and reinstall Native and PRoot desktop environments.
- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.
- File management: browse files, perform batch operations, view file details, and import detected Windows programs.

releases.name: Version 5.10.2
releases.body:
Changes:

- Fix authentication for registries without token service: Nexus, Artifactory and htpasswd-protected servers.
- Report bad `PD_DOCKER_AUTH` credentials before initiating install or push session.

releases.name: Version 5.10.1
releases.body:
Changes:

* `install`, `push`: better handling for registry rate limits (HTTP 429) by honoring `Retry-After`, show detailed error when rate limit occurs while using a shared Docker Hub frontend (proxy) instead of raw `Network error: HTTP Error 429`.

Notice for users: this does not resolve issue with rate limits imposed by Docker Hub registry. Such issue just can't be resolved at proot-distro side because restriction applies to client IP address, which in case of NAT (CG-NAT) or proxy may be shared between large amount of devices.

Don't submit bug reports if encounter HTTP 429!

Workaround:

1. Create Docker Hub account.
2. Use `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:password"` or `export PD_DOCKER_AUTH="username:personal-access-token"`, the personal access token must be created through account settings with permissions at least for read-only access.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: Version 5.9.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- `login`, `run`: export variables `PD_CONTAINER=<name>`, `PD_IMAGE=<image-ref>`, `PD_IMAGE_ID=<sha256-digest>` and `container=proot-distro` in sessions. Build gets same except `PD_CONTAINER`.
- `pull`: detect whether image config or manifest is shorter than `Content-Length`.
- `build` (ADD, COPY): placing directory over an existing regular file is now a refusal instead of a silent tree/layer mismatch.
- `build` (... --chmod): validate value as an octal between 0 and 07777.
- `build`: Dockerfile is read with 16 MiB limit.
- `push`: send the Bearer token on the upload PUT only when the Location URL belongs to the registry itself.
- Registry credentials are only sent to the origin they were addressed to.
- Do not carry Authorization header if host redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.
- A token endpoint realm must be `https://` (`http://` allowed under --allow-insecure). `file://`, `ftp://` and `data:` realms are refused.
- Environment strings from image config are validated before exec (no NUL, encodable, under 128 KiB).
- The `profile.d` snippet is written for every session of a normal-type container, not only default-mode Termux logins.

releases.name: ExaltDS 0.1.4
releases.body:
**You MUST set up the game again from the sidebar after updating to get the Bonus Box content.**

**Bonus Box (SpotPass)**
- All SpotPass bonus content is now available in Wireless > Bonus Box: bonus teams, items, Double Duel challengers and the bonus paralogue maps. Nintendo's SpotPass servers are offline, so ExaltDS now treats every bonus as delivered.
- Added "Unlock bonus box content" to the sidebar (on by default, also under All settings > System). Turning it off stops new bonuses from being added; anything your save has already received is kept.
- Fixed an issue where opening the Bonus Box asked you to accept the Nintendo 3DS Service Agreement.
- Fixed an issue where the game froze after choosing Update now in the Bonus Box. It now shows the game's message and returns to the menu.

**Performance**
- Improved performance of map dialogue scenes on the Retroid Pocket Duo. With HD portraits at 4x resolution they now run at 60 fps (previously around 32 fps).

**Dual-screen devices**
- The first time you start 0.1.4 on a device with a second screen (AYN Thor, Retroid Pocket Duo), the bottom screen is moved to the second display. If you turn it off afterwards, it stays off.

releases.name: ExaltDS 0.1.3
releases.body:
**You MUST set up the game again from the sidebar after updating to get the Recall Fate fixes.**

**Recall Fate**
- Fixed an issue where Recall Fate wouldn't record actions on maps with certain victory conditions.
- Fixed an issue where actions taken after loading a save state or resuming a suspended battle weren't recorded until the next turn.
- Fixed an issue where the screen would occasionally flash green while the Recall Fate list was open.
- Fixed an issue where the cursor would disappear when moving down a long Recall Fate list.
- Fixed an issue where the Recall Fate button in the map menu lost its background after opening Options.
- The Recall Fate list now fills the whole panel and scrolls with the cursor. Uses left are shown in the help bar below.
- Turn entries in the list are now centered.

**Dual-screen devices**
- Potential fix for the bottom screen moving to the top display for the rest of the session after a display error (#1). ExaltDS now reconnects to the second display, retrying up to three times, before falling back to the top display. If it does fall back, close ExaltDS from recent apps and reopen it to try the second display again.

**Save states**

releases.name: ExaltDS 0.1.2
releases.body:
**New (experimental)**
- **HD cutscenes from your own video.** If you have your own HD copy of Awakening's anime cutscenes, such as a rip of the *Fire Emblem: HD Movie Collection* Blu-ray or another recording, ExaltDS can play your HD version in place of the game's 400×240 movies. The 3D cutscenes stay as they are.
  - **Nothing is included.** This release contains no HD cutscenes, video files or pictures from the game. ExaltDS only uses the video you choose and your own game file.
  - **How the import works:** in the sidebar, open **Mods / textures**, choose **HD movies from your video…** and pick the video file.
    - ExaltDS decodes the game's own movies from your copy and searches your video for each of the 14.
    - It finds where each one starts, any black bars, how the picture is framed, the frame rate and the brightness, then matches it to the game frame by frame.
    - It then renders the matched frames into HD clips on your device, with the device's own video encoder, and checks each clip.
    - On the AYN Thor this took about 8 minutes for a 15-minute video, with all 14 movies found and 99% of frames in HD. Then use **Apply and restart**.

releases.name: ExaltDS 0.1.1
releases.body:
**New**
- **Recall Fate: 10 uses per battle.** The list's title shows what's left, "Recall Fate (10 left)", and the menu entry greys out at 0. A new battle gives all 10 back.
- **Sidebar: Export saves… / Import saves…** Back up your in-game saves to a ZIP, or bring them in from one. An import restarts the game, and your previous saves are kept as a recovery copy. Save states aren't affected.
- **Sidebar: Set up the game again…** Closes the game and opens the setup screen, for example to rebuild after an update.
- **Mods / textures: import ZIPs as downloaded.** You can pick several at once (packs split over several ZIPs add up). A texture pack is added to the one already installed, and you choose what happens to pictures that clash.

**Fixed**
- **Naga's Tear is now granted on your first visit to the world map, whichever chapter you're on.** Before, it didn't appear in chapters 4, 7, 10 and 11, which have their own world-map scenes. If you've already seen the conversation, it won't play again.

> [!WARNING]

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Microphone permission required for Voice Chat.** When you activate voice chat (dashboard → Game Configs → Voice Chat), BannerHub will prompt for the **Microphone** permission. You must allow it for in-game calls to work — without it the call falls back to opening in your browser.

releases.name: BannerHub Lite v1.0.1
releases.body:
## BannerHub Lite v1.0.1

First stable on the BannerHub API.

> ⚠️ **URGENT — read before first launch.** If you see **"Failed to initialize the simulator"** when launching a game, your firmware is still on the old version. Open **Settings → Components → Firmware** and **manually update / install firmware 1.3.7**, then launch the game again. The auto-update prompt may not fire on every install, so do this manually if the error appears.

### Known issues

- **Proton 11 hangs on "Initializing…" when launching Steam games with a Steam client.** The launch never proceeds past the initializing screen. Workaround: use a different Wine/Proton component for Steam-client launches until this is resolved.

### What changed since v1.0.0

- **BannerHub API switch** — all 9 variants now point at `https://bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev/` instead of the EmuReady worker. Components, firmware, and the in-app catalog are all served from the BannerHub Components release on this org.
- **Firmware bumped to 1.3.7** — the in-app firmware update prompt will offer `imagefs_137.zst` (171.9 MB). 5.x clients (BHL) and 6.0 clients (BannerHub 3.7.x) now receive the same firmware.

emulators.latest_body:
## BannerHub v6 1.0.2-631 > ⚠️ **Read before installing — USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** BannerHub v6 is a **separate project** from BannerHub 3.7.x and BannerHub Lite (own package names, keystore, and backend) — they do **not** update over one another, and v6 is a **work in progress, barely tested**, with different game compatibility. Full details below. ⤵
⚠️ Important — separate projects & compatibility (click to expand) **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch.

# NgpCraft Emulator v3.15 - what's new

This release is mostly about the built-in BIOS, the one the emulator uses when you have no
`bios.bin` (and the one the web player always uses). It now behaves much more like the real
console BIOS. macOS users also get proper app packaging and Finder support.

## Built-in BIOS: much closer to the real one

Many thanks to **Napomex**, who compared our built-in BIOS with the real one game by game and sent
us a detailed report with a fix for each problem. This work started from that report.

We then ran 123 cartridges for one minute each, with button presses, under both the real BIOS and
the built-in one, and compared every frame. About 70% of them now play frame for frame like they
do with the real BIOS, up from about 25%.

- **Fewer crashes.** Puzzle Link, Puzzle Link 2, Magical Drop Pocket and Densha de Go! 2 could
  crash, especially while saving. The built-in BIOS let the game interrupt it in the middle of a
  system call. Found by Napomex.
- **Saving is safer.** When a game erased all of its save memory, the built-in BIOS did not wait
  for the cartridge to finish and could freeze the game. It now waits like the real BIOS. This

# NgpCraft Emulator v3.12 - what's new

New features, netplay fix attempt. **If you play mirror matches online,
both players must update**: this version cannot play a mirror match with 3.9.1 or older.

## New features

- **Updates from inside the emulator.** *Settings ▸ General ▸ Check for updates* tells you if a
  newer version is out. On Windows and Linux, *Install and restart* downloads it, installs it and
  starts it: no more trip to the GitHub page. On macOS the button opens the download page. The
  emulator also checks by itself at startup, at most once a day, and never interrupts a game
  (untick *Check for updates at startup* if you would rather it did not). Your saves, settings and
  library are kept: only the program file is replaced. **This is the last version you need to
  download by hand.**
- **Run-ahead (optional, off by default).** *Settings ▸ General ▸ Run-ahead*: shows the picture the
  game will draw 1 or 2 frames from now, with the buttons you are holding, so the delay built into
  the game itself disappears from the screen. In *Sonic*, a jump now shows up 4 frames after the

releases.name: v3.9.1
releases.body:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tixul/Ngpcraft_emulator/compare/v3.8.9...v3.9.1

NgpCraft Emulator v3.9.0 - what's new
This release is about playing two players over the internet. It is still being tested, but the
first results are encouraging. If you play online, both of you should update, and please tell us
how it goes.

Online play in mirror mode should be smoother
Less input lag at the start of a match. The player who finished loading first used to start alone and wait for the other one. That wait made the emulator think the connection was slower than it really was, and it could add noticeable delay to that player's controls for several minutes. Both sides now start together. This idea comes from Blueteemo, who proposed it in pull request #26. Thank you!
Fewer freezes on a connection that loses packets. Your button presses are now also sent a second way, repeated several times, so a single lost packet should no longer freeze both screens. In our tests on a deliberately bad connection, most of the short freezes went away.
If the other player has an older version, the match should still work, just without these improvements.

# The Last of Us Remastered — Daedalus Android v0.1.1

This update expands game compatibility and improves the overall Android experience.

### What's New

- Game update 1.11 support, including compatible executables and updated graphics and resolution patches.
- Updated Turnip drivers: Gen8 V39 Patched and R2 for older Adreno GPUs.
- Improved interface: new app icon, redesigned dialogs and log viewer, and cleaner in-game menus.
- Additional stability and rendering fixes, particularly for supported 1.11 game files.

**Game compatibility:** Versions 1.00 and 1.11 — CUSA00552, CUSA00554, CUSA00556, CUSA00557, CUSA00559 (requires a compatible executable).

~ hikari_no_yume, on behalf of the touchHLE development team

releases.name: v0.2.1: All treat, no trick! 🎃
releases.body:
Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a new release, two months after the previous one. 

Before I get to the changelog, some special notes:

- From this release onwards, the old list of supported apps is replaced by the new, crowdsourced [touchHLE app compatibility database](https://appdb.touchhle.org/).
- In case you missed it, the [touchHLE app archive](https://touchhle.org/app-archive/) was recently launched. It only has one app at the moment, but that's hopefully just the start. If you were an indie developer in the early iPhone days, please get in touch!
- If you want to get notified about future releases, you might want to join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sVMXc8z3eS). You can't post there, but you'll be @'d with updates. There's also a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@touchHLE) where I post short gameplay videos with new releases.
- If you want to help me keep working on this full time, please consider [supporting me financially](https://liberapay.com/hikari_no_yume).

Finally, a big thanks to all the other contributors who made this release what it was! If it weren't for them, there might not have been any new game support in this release.

releases.name: v0.2.0: touchHLE on Android!
releases.body:
At long last, it's here: the first release to work on Android, the first release with an app picker UI, the first release with (very limited) UIKit support, and much more!

This release required a lot of effort, and not just from me! I want to especially thank @ciciplusplus, who dared to try to port touchHLE to Android and somehow succeeded. I also want to thank @KiritoDv and @LennyKappa, who also made big contributions to this release.

Thank you all for your continued patience and support. I hope you enjoy!

~ hikari

[Update 2023-09-01: When the release was tagged and uploaded yesterday, two changelog entries were mistakenly in the v0.1.2 section rather than v0.2.0. The copies of the changelog below and in the release zip files have now been corrected. Additionally, the `OPTIONS_HELP.txt` file was mistakenly absent from the Android release zip file, but it has now been added.]

----

Compatibility:

- API support improvements:
  - Various small contributions. (@hikari-no-yume, @KiritoDv, @ciciplusplus, @TylerJaacks, @LennyKappa)
  - PVRTC and paletted texture compression is now supported. (@hikari-no-yume)

emulators.name: Odin
emulators.description: Sega Hikaru 街机模拟器，采用低层模拟，Valkyrie 的分支。
emulators.latest_body:
## Add
- Gaelco initial support with three games: ATV Track, Gaelco Football, Smashing Drive (thanks @dmanlfc)
  - Gaelco boards emulated at a low level, Neon 250 included
  - ATV Track Vibrator cabinet: its seat shakes the gamepad
  - ATV Track and Smashing Drive: force feedback on the wheel from the cabinet's wheel motor
  - Outputs and link to Gaelco boards
- Artwork for Gaelco games
- Cabinet models: Star Wars Racer Mini Deluxe (seat woofer and shaker), Smashing Drive upright, ATV Track Vibrator
- More out of the box support for known wheels (many Logitech, Thrustmaster and MOZA models)
  - Pedals read the right way on any wheel, any driver
  - Second device per player (multi-inputs): shifters, pedals, separate devices
- Test button on the Input page to try every control without messing with the UI
- Input page: multiple devices numbered (eg.: steering wheel with custom pedals)
- Remade the entire audio page with visuals
- Hotkey button can be bound and chosen
- Test and Service hotkeys in every game
- Hold `Escape` one second to bind it as a hotkey
- Invert STICK V option for Planet Harriers
- `-V` and `--version` commands show the version, also in odin.exe properties

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body:
The first release of Odin.

Odin (ᚨ) is a low-level emulator of the SEGA Hikaru arcade board. It runs the programs of the real chips wherever they are known, and draws with OpenGL or Vulkan. It is a hard fork of Valkyrie, by Stefano Teso.

## Games

All six Hikaru games, two of them in two versions:

- Air Trix (`airtrix`, `airtrixo`)
- Brave Firefighters (`braveff`)
- Planet Harriers (`pharrier`)
- NASCAR Arcade (`sgnascar`, `sgnascaro`)
- Star Wars Racer Arcade (`swracer`)
- Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force (`von4`)

They play with a keyboard, mice, gamepads, wheels with force feedback (NASCAR) or light guns (Brave Firefighters). Each game is a MAME ROM and needs the BIOS `hikaru.zip` and `mie.zip` too.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| odin-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip | Windows 10 or 11 |
| odin-x86_64.AppImage / odin-v0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | Linux PC with glibc 2.38 or later (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04) |
| odin-aarch64.AppImage / odin-v0.1.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz | Linux ARM64 with glibc 2.38 or later and OpenGL ES 3.1 |
| odin-macos.dmg | Mac with Apple silicon, macOS 13.3 or later |
| Odin-Artwork.zip | The title screens and bezels of the games |

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.8
releases.body:
## Changes

- On Windows, store settings in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coffee GB\coffeegb.properties`. Existing settings are imported from the user profile without changing the old file.
- Add `--portable` to keep settings beside the JAR or an unpacked application launcher. The application directory must be writable; saves and other application data retain their existing locations. The single-file Windows EXE extracts to a temporary directory, so use the JAR or an unpacked application image for persistent portable settings.

## Known platform limitations

- On macOS, game controllers require a compatible system SDL2 installation. Keyboard input and emulation remain usable without it.

## Merged pull requests

- [#697: Move Windows settings to LocalAppData and add portable mode](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/697) by [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek).

## Fixed issues

- [#694: Windows portable build](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/issues/694).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/compare/coffee-gb-2.1.7...coffee-gb-2.1.8

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.7
releases.body:
Coffee GB 2.1.7 adds link-cable startup support for Renju Club, improves netplay handoff and recovery, restores a Java ROM-loading constructor overload, and adds pressed-state feedback to Android touch controls. Compatibility documentation and acknowledgments were also updated.

## Merged pull requests

- [#690 Switch SGB sessions to DMG for netplay](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/690) — preserve the session-only DMG fallback through controller handoff, forward local client output, retain diagnostic state paths, ignore stale save sidecars for batteryless games, and restore the Java ROM-image constructor overload. [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek)
- [#691 Add Android pressed control artwork and touch feedback](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/691) — show held buttons and directions in the Android touch controls. [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek)
- [#693 Fix Renju Club link startup](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/693) — start two-player sessions with both cable endpoints attached so the game can negotiate its link. [@trekawek](https://github.com/trekawek)

## Fixed issues

None.

## Known platform limitations

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.6
releases.body:
Coffee GB 2.1.6 adds BESS save-state interchange, expands Game Boy peripheral support, and brings connection choices and device controls together in the desktop menu.

## Changes

- Load and save BESS-compatible states from the File menu, with validated ROM matching and interchange for supported DMG, CGB, and SGB configurations.
- Use HuC-1/HuC-3 cartridge infrared and send or receive GBKiss GBF files.
- Scan EAN-13 barcodes with the separate Barcode Taisen Bardigun reader.
- Run Pocket Sonar with MBC1S sensor emulation and simulated sonar input. Scene changes now end active input recording, and the mapper is included in state coverage checks.
- Use Turbo File GB internal memory and removable cards, including import/export, persistence, and write protection. The GBA-only Advance choice is no longer exposed in the menu; legacy state and storage support is retained.
- Emulate Singer and Jaguar sewing machines, including the JN-2000 embroidery arm, live stitch preview, and PNG export.
- Organize Peripherals into Link port, Cartridge, and Infrared. Device submenus combine Connect with their controls; Mobile Adapter configuration moves from Preferences into its device submenu.

releases.name: Coffee GB 2.1.5
releases.body:
This release fixes Razor Freestyle Scooter multiplayer startup and race disconnects, and keeps netplay input logs available only as an internal diagnostic feature.

- Starting netplay in Razor now lets the host coordinate a fresh boot of both games with the link connected. The reboot explicitly bypasses autosave loading on both machines.
- Opposing directional inputs are resolved consistently, preventing the race disconnect reproduced from a supplied input log.
- Netplay diagnostic logs capture every player's input and rollback timing. They are hidden and disabled by default; developers can opt in with `-Dcoffeegb.netplay.inputRecording=true`. Ordinary input recording and playback are unchanged.

## Merged pull requests

- [#673](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/673) — Fix Razor netplay startup and race disconnects, by @trekawek.
- [#678](https://github.com/trekawek/coffee-gb/pull/678) — Hide netplay input diagnostics behind an opt-in flag, by @trekawek.

## Fixed issues

emulators.name: NetherSX2 Classic
emulators.description: 基于 AetherSX2 的 NetherSX2 经典版，带防篡改补丁。
emulators.latest_body:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/8b502b31ce797d5a162bc6b9300b5f02351b0b6b290b8dc1390b8dfb826673ab)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/2029e30dcc1ba1ecb8d73313f18b429b40e6044c7785c52af08b948ef94b3ddf)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

# Skyrim for Android 0.40.1

APK: `Skyrim-0.40.1.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `8c3e92cbcbe633b5f02b85d2d756aa05e5f97359`

- Redesigned launcher. A cleaner tabbed layout, with the base-game video settings (preset, resolution, aspect, shadows, AA, etc.) moved onto their own screen so the port's own options are easier to find.

releases.name: Version 0.30.15
releases.body:
# Skyrim for Android 0.30.15

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.15.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).

## New
- Basic controller support has been added to the launcher. The launcher was designed with touchscreens in mind, so future versions may refine this further.

## Fixed
- Water rendering was broken due to float emulation being disabled, it has since been fixed.
- Screen aspect ratio now uses your phone's native resolution. This may also prevent black bars on certain devices.
- WIP: Audio in other languages - currently working on implementing the decoder. English languages are stored as 48khz surround while languages like Spanish are 32khz mono with some additional data.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Skyrim folder to any bug report.

releases.name: Version 0.30.6
releases.body:
# Skyrim for Android 0.30.6

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.6.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).

## New
- "Disable end-of-frame image space (post-processing)" option. It does the same as the TEOFIS console command at every launch. It fixes the black world map and solid-colour underwater screen, but it also turns off all end-of-frame post-processing (tonemapping, bloom, colour grading and depth of field), so the game looks more naturally lit.
- "Asynchronous rendering" option. It's off by default and when it's on, shaders compile on background threads. New effects may pop in for a frame or two instead of causing a hitch. 

## Fixed
- Shader caching is removed. The DXVK state cache rebuilt every saved pipeline on 5 extra threads at startup, which took CPU away from the game's main thread and caused crashes on Mali devices. Nothing is cached between launches now, and the game runs better overall.
- Traps triggering freezes was due to failed lookups with vertex optimization. The function has been turned off for now.
- Audio in other languages - the decoder was reading each WMA bitstream but with the wrong block-size config. Should be working now.

releases.name: Version 0.30.5
releases.body:
# Skyrim for Android 0.30.5

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.5.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `6cb3995aa8cdf36d859f0473dd116f3496c4bf9e`

## New
- The loader now decrypts the retail Steam `TESV.exe` directly on the device. You no longer need to run Steamless or supply a `TESV_unpacked.exe`. The redistributable DLLs (`d3dx9_42.dll`, `X3DAudio1_7.dll`, `binkw32.dll`) are still required beside the game for this build.

## Fixed
- Non-standard aspect ratio "failed to initialize renderer". The launcher's screen aspect wrote a resolution the renderer's adapter-mode list didn't contain. The launcher now picks that same nearest named ratio for screen, so the chosen resolution is always one the renderer offers.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Skyrim folder to any bug report.

releases.name: Version 0.30.4
releases.body:
# Skyrim for Android 0.30.4

APK: `Skyrim-0.30.4.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `f4fa3f61cc472031cc996116db26e343a947bdd6`

## New
- Disable tree animations option, under Disable shadows.
  - Writes `fUpdateBudget=0` in Skyrim.ini and `bRenderSkinnedTrees=0` in SkyrimPrefs.ini, which stops the per-frame animation on trees.
- Restyled launcher.
  - Two columns on 16:9 screens: game folder and graphics options on the left, effects, language and controls on the right. Wider screens keep two columns, capped to a readable width and centred. Screens narrower than 16:9 (4:3, square, portrait) get a single scrolling column.
  - The options list and long dropdowns such as Resolution scroll on their own, with a scroll indicator.
- The launcher now reads your real `SkyrimPrefs.ini` and `Skyrim.ini` when it opens, so every option shows what the game will actually use. Pressing Play only rewrites the settings you changed, and hand-edits to the rest are kept.
- Launcher settings save as soon as you change them, so options like Show FPS counter stick even if you leave without pressing Play.

releases.name: v2.0.0
releases.body:
Dusklight 2.0 is here! This update brings **mod support**, **an in-game mod browser**, and **our own built-in randomizer**, alongside more polish, performance improvements, and ways to play. Thank you to everyone who helped make it happen!

## Mods and built-in mods

- **Added:** Mod support! Install gameplay mods, asset replacements, and texture packs as `.dusk` bundles, and manage them from the Mods menu. (Modders: check out our [modding documentation](https://github.com/TwilitRealm/dusklight/blob/main/docs/modding.md)!)
- **Added:** An in-game mod browser: search for mods, view information and screenshots, and download and install without leaving Dusklight.
- **Added:** Mod update checks, release notes, and a quick way to update all mods.
- **Added:** Drag and drop `.dusk` mods onto the Dusklight window to install them.
- **Added:** Enable, disable, and reload mods in-game, with dependency handling and per-mod settings and logs.
- **Added:** Built-in Dusklight Randomizer, our own randomizer with seed generation, settings presets, shareable
  permalinks, and more.

RimWorld 1.7 updated to build 5005 on the unstable branch, and that build closed right at startup on RimDroid. This release fixes it.

### ✅ Update the game without a new instance (RimWorld 1.7)

1.7 updates often. Now you don't need a new instance for every build: instance card → **⋮** → **Update the game**. Mods, saves and settings stay where they are. The previous build and a copy of your saves are kept, and **Back to …** on the same screen returns to them if the new build doesn't work for you.

### ✅ Steam Workshop inside the app

Side menu or bottom bar → **Workshop**: RimWorld's Workshop with Steam's own search and filters. Tap **↓** on any mod or collection, then **Download**. No Steam login needed.

RimDroid runs RimWorld 1.7, the update Ludeon is testing on Steam's unstable branch. It starts natively on Android, with nothing emulated, on Ludeon's new engine — and on a phone that shows: much lighter than 1.6, with higher FPS and TPS on the same phone.

- **Mods.** Ludeon promised that mods made for 1.6 keep working on the new engine, and many do — but not all yet. Use the Harmony mod from the Steam Workshop (the current version supports 1.7). Some 1.6 mods work only partly: Camera+, for example, works, but breaks the right-hand panel of the game's own mod list (mod details, the enable switch, Save). Manage such mods from the launcher's Mods screen instead.

✅ **Dragon Age: Origins now runs on a new native renderer by default.** It draws the game's frames directly with Vulkan instead of emulating the Xbox 360's graphics chip, and it is much faster: on a Galaxy S25 Ultra, at the same spot with the frame cap off, it reaches 110–190 fps where the emulation gave 42–55. releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.8 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.8 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: the games now get their own title number, as on the PC. A small release: saves, settings and the frame rate stay as they were. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **The games got 0 when they asked for their title number.** Each game asks for it once at start-up and makes its title ID from it (CUSA02344 from 2344). With 0 it used a placeholder, CUSA09999. The app's preparation now writes the number from your dump's title ID into content.bin, as uncharted_pc's prepare.py does since its 750bb93. Your saves stay where they are: the app keeps them under the dump's title ID, and the game's own title ID now matches it. Checked in all three games on the Retroid Pocket G2: the saves load as before, and the frame rate is the same.

**Changed**

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.7 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.7 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: dumps made with Itemzflow now prepare and play. The app takes executables that are already decrypted (plain ELF files), and Itemzflow's update folder. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **A dump made with Itemzflow stopped at Preparing with `eboot.bin: expected PS4 SELF` (#40).** Itemzflow writes the executables already decrypted, as plain ELF files without the SELF wrapper. The app now takes those as well (eboot.bin, the two .elf files, libc.prx and libSceFios2.prx), as uncharted_pc does since its #498. A dump turned into plain ELF files prepares to the same files, byte for byte, as from the SELF files in all three games, on a PC and on the Retroid Pocket G2.
- **Itemzflow's update folder is found.** `<game folder>-patch` next to the game folder (for example `CUSA02320-patch` next to `CUSA02320`) now counts as the update folder, like `<game folder>-UPDATE`. Choose the game folder and press Prepare: the launcher names the update folder it uses.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.6 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.6 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: upstream uncharted_pc 0.3.15 is merged (Uncharted 3's Load Game hang and fixes for checkpoint loads and textures), a rare crash of Uncharted 1 is fixed, Uncharted 3 gains about 1 FPS without the frame rate limit, and the GPU skinning checks its own inputs, so the rare GPU fault storms can no longer start there. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 1 could close now and then in play.** On the Retroid Pocket G2 this happened about once in three hours without the frame rate limit. A job of the game's scene update read an object whose two fields the game's other code had not filled yet. The update now waits up to about 1.6 ms for them, and if they are still empty it skips the one query that needs them; the game does not use that query's result. In a test that skipped the query every time for two minutes, the game played on unharmed.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.5 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.5 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's spider rooms run at full speed (chapter 7 ran at 10-15 FPS on the Retroid Pocket G2), a rare hang or crash of Uncharted 3 is fixed, and the app now says what is wrong with a copy of the game instead of crashing or stalling without a word. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: the rooms with the spider swarm ran at 10-15 FPS** - chapter 7, "Stay in the Light", and the swarm's return in chapter 11; on the Retroid Pocket G2 at 1280x720 the room now holds the 30 FPS limit (15.0 and 13.2 FPS before, 30.0 and 30.0 after, in two pairs of runs). One pixel shader of the swarm's material picks values from a small table by an index. The translated shader chose among all 84 of its registers at each of twelve such reads, more than the shader compiler of an Adreno has registers for, so it kept values in memory: 52 ms of GPU time a frame for a small part of the screen. The reads are now limited to the table (0.5 ms a frame); the picture is the same

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.4 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.4 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's desert chapters are drawn right - Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were stretched across the screen, on every device. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were drawn as stretched triangles** (#35). The port runs the game's many small skinning jobs in batches, and that code knew one vertex layout for each of the game's skinning shaders. From chapter 16 on the game has a second one (32-bit normals and tangents) for the models with cloth or morph targets - Drake's desert outfit, the horses' blankets and reins - and the batch wrote those vertices at the wrong places. It reads the layout of every job now and batches both; a layout it does not know goes the ordinary way and is named in the log. Thanks to @sergeymetallic, who traced the glitch to the batch, and to @tranhuythang1704 for the save the horses were checke

emulators.latest_body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.1 [REVOKED]
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> This APK has been withdrawn. Install [version 0.5.2](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/releases/tag/v0.5.2) instead.

Version 0.5.1 unintentionally shipped with always-on GPU performance instrumentation that added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead. Its APK asset was removed to prevent further installations.

All legitimate 0.5.1 changes and its full changelog are preserved in the 0.5.2 release and in `CHANGELOG.md`. The tag and this release page remain available for project history.

releases.name: v0.1.6
releases.body:
- Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 / 8 Elite, e.g. OnePlus 13, Redmi K90): `spore.apk` no longer draws the picture as horizontal stripes, it picks the right renderer by itself (#15, #26, #27). No need for `spore-vk11.apk` on these phones anymore.
- Phones with 4 GB RAM: textures load at a lower size by default, so Android closes the game less often (galaxy map, #29). `texture_skip_mips` in `Spore/sporere.ini` still overrides it.

`spore.apk` — Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones). `spore-vk11.apk` — older GPUs with Vulkan 1.1 only.

releases.name: v0.1.5
releases.body:
- Mali GPUs: the game now gets an NVIDIA card instead of an ATI one, which fixes the too-dark ground and shadows (#13). If you made `sporere.ini` with `fake_gpu` for testing, you can delete it.
- Holding the stick no longer blocks the camera: other fingers work while the stick is held (#22).
- **Cheats** button in the menu: opens/closes Spore's cheat console (type with ⌨, e.g. `addDNA`).
- Tribe and civilization: hold a finger until it buzzes, then drag — drags with the left button (place buildings from the palette). A quick drag still moves the map, hold and release is still a right click (#23).

`spore.apk` — Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones). `spore-vk11.apk` — older GPUs with Vulkan 1.1 only.

releases.name: v0.1.4
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Backspace on the on-screen keyboard works (it did nothing when the field already had text from the game, like a planet name).

**New**
- Space: an LMB button. With it on, holding a finger holds the left mouse button instead of flying: beams, abduction, terraforming tools. Turn it off to fly again.
- The FPS counter can be moved in Settings → Layout and has a dark outline, so it reads over the game's UI. By default it sits inside the picture, not under the camera cutout.
- Screen 16:9 / Safe area: the bars at the sides are black (pixels off on OLED screens).

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Space stage: the ship flies now. Hold a finger where you want to go, or push the stick (it sends the arrow keys in space). The cause was a bug in how the game code is translated for Android, so other odd behaviour may be gone too.
- Galactic Adventures is detected again: the menu item is back, and the game no longer closes on start after its options were saved.
- Settings → Screen 16:9 and Safe area no longer squash the picture.
- The settings panel fits on short screens.
- Adreno 7xx: `enable_tp_ubwc_flag_hint=1` is on by default (flicker in screen recordings). `turnip_features` in `sporere.ini` sets `FD_DEV_FEATURES`.
- The game is also found one folder deeper (`Spore/SPORE/...`).

**New**
- Your own Vulkan driver: put a `.so`, or a `.zip` from Adreno Tools driver releases, into `Spore/driver/`.
- Logs: on every start the last run's logs are copied to `Spore/logs/`. Attach them when you report a bug.

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body:
Early build, expect bugs. `spore.apk` is for Vulkan 1.3 GPUs (most phones), `spore-vk11.apk` for older ones with Vulkan 1.1.

**Fixes**
- Older phones (Snapdragon 6xx and other Cortex-A53/A73 chips) no longer fail on start with `libmain_v80.so not found`.
- Saves now live in `Spore/UserData` next to the game files, so any file manager can reach them. Old saves move there on the first start. If some save files can't be read (for example, another app copied them in), the game lists them instead of closing.
- The on-screen keyboard types into the game (planet names and other text fields).
- Adreno 8xx: the newer bundled Turnip is tried first and UBWC is off by default. This fixes the noise instead of the picture. `turnip_debug` in `sporere.ini` sets `TU_DEBUG`.

**New**
- Settings → Screen: Full / 16:9 / Safe area. Safe area keeps the image clear of the rounded corners and the camera cutout. It applies after a restart.
- Editor: ▲/▼ buttons act as the mouse wheel. Tap a part, then press ▲/▼ to resize it.
- Space: the WASD stick is shown by default. W/S fly forward and back.

Vita3K Android release 12 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- SD card support: Allow any folder to be specified as the OS/game data folder (inspired by the PR from nurunuruslime)
- Allow the overlay to be used at the same time as the touchscreen
- Fix black bands appearing sometimes at the top and bottom of the application on some devices
- Fix bug causing game installation to be 10x slower than expected
- Fix accelerometer and gyroscope on android game consoles
- Some crash fixes
- Add controller opacity (dima)



Rebase on PC version:
- Fix audio regression (bookmist)
- Code cleanup, refractoring and small optimisations (bookmist, Nishinji and GermanAizek)
- Improved error messages (croden)
- GUI improvements (Zangetsu)
- Improve depth-stencil retrieval, fix Ratchet and Clank (Macdu)
- Add support for module unloading/reloading, allows FFX to be playable (Macdu)
- Improve ffmpeg dependency (KhoraLee)
- Improve Transfer downscale/copy, fix graphical issues in Phantasy Star Nova (Macdu)
- Improve Polish localization (mavethee)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 11

Vita3K Android release 11 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- Revert part of the shader optimisations from the last release (because of turnip driver bugs...)
- Fix some issues with the handling of MSAA 2x, fix graphical issues (partial blur) in some Nihon Falcon games
- Allow custom drivers and renderer to be set differently for each game
- Fix some crashes when installing games / custom drivers
- Use a static version of ffmpeg now that the Android version is open source

Rebase on PC version:
- Implement fractional upscaling, allows game to render at 1.25x, 1.5x (or 0.5x) the original resolution (Macdu)
- Add a FPS hack option which allows some games running at 30 FPS on the PS Vita to run at 60 fps on the emulator (Ys 8, GoW, Uncharted...) (Macdu)
- Language updates (Corden, nishinji)
- Multiple fixes (bookmist)
- Use hardware accelerated decryption: speed up game installation by almost 10x (Macdu)
- Improve depth/stencil identification: Fix shadows in Gravity Rush (Macdu)
- Use paths instead of wide strings for paths (bookmist)
- Improve path support on Linux (Steveice10)
- Put audio parameters in a new audio tab (Zangetsu)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 10
releases.body:
Android v10 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Fix crash on Android 14 (thanks to Kazuki/Adrien for their help)
- Graphical fixes for double buffer (fix the rendering in Terraria)
- Fix some io-related Android specific crashes
- Implement asynchronous shader compilation: reduces significantly stutter caused by shader compilation (at the cost of temporary graphical glitches) and speed up by 2x-3x shader compilation time
- Shader performance improvements
- Fix some performance regressions from v9

PC rebase:

- Use guest pointer for the gxm alloc space, allows FIFA to go ingame with native buffer / page table (Macdu)
- gxm and renderer refractoring (bookmist)
- Improce codec/renderer YUV support, fixes the FMV in Ys origin (Macdu)
- Plenty of shader fixes: Fix graphical issues in 2D ubisoft games (child of light, Rayman) (Macdu)
- Fix kernel thread end callback, allows Tearaway to go ingame (Macdu)
- Page align the stack top, allows spiderman to go ingame (Macdu)
- Decrease the rendertarget size, allows Killzone to go ingame (Macdu)
- Update Indonesia/Malaysia translation (Croden, kitakata, darkhash)
- Update Japanese translation (nishinji)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 9
releases.body:
Android v9 Changelog (non exhaustive list):

- Improvements to double buffer: Fix graphics in games like J-Star victory, Gravity Rush...
- Overlay joystick improvements: You can now run diagonally
- Touchscreen fixes: Fix regressions and touchscreen issues
- Overlay improvements: Should use a lot less GPU power
- Overlay: The overlay button size can now be modified
- App pausing: Re-enabled and no longer freezes the application
- Fix gxm alignment issues: Fix regressions in Tokyo Xanadu, Trails of Cold Steel 2
- Texture replacement support: Support png, uncompressed textures, BCn compressed textures (Snapdragon only), ASTC compressed textures (any phone). Textures have to be manually places in /Android/data/org.vita3k.emulator/files/textures/import/game_id


PC Rebase:
- Kitakata/Zangetsu: Add Indonesian and Malaysian languages
- ExtremeExploit: Use curl for http request, should fix issues preventing the compatibility database to be updated
- redpolline: Refractor the filesystem architecture (not relevant for Android but still a lot of work)
- Macdu: Improvements and fixes to the ngs player, fix the Audio in Borderlands 2, Mickey Power of 2, Valhalla Knights 3

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 8
releases.body:
Android V8 Changelog:

- Implement motion sensor: If you have a connected controller which has motion sensors, these will be used. Otherwise your device motion sensors will be used
- Add renderer accuracy option
- Add an option to create a shortcut for each game. The shortcut will be added to your home screen and use the game name and icons.
- Make sure clang does not optimize function calls it thinks are useless (fixes fmv flickering)
- Improve memory trapping (fixes freezes when using double buffer)
- Memory mapping can now be configured for each game (and can be modified before starting a game without rebooting)
- Rewrite the texture cache architecture, should fix games becoming slower over time
- Update to NDK 26
- Update SDL to 2.28.3 (improve controller support)
- Multiple performance improvements (using faster data structures and less mutex locking)

PC rebase (non exhaustive list):

- Zangetsu: Add support for controller touchpad (PS4/PS5 controller), not tested on Android
- Croden, HuanJiCanShang: Translation improvements
- Scribam: Code cleanup and update dependencies

releases.body:
# Примечания к релизу: v1.2.18

Здесь собраны все изменения от **v1.2.1** до **v1.2.18** порта статической перекомпиляции Mass Effect (2007) для Android и Linux.

## Что нового в v1.2.18
- **Режим экрана (растягивание на весь экран)**: добавлена настройка `port.stretch_mode` с тремя режимами:
  - **По размеру (Fit)** — сохранение пропорций 16:9 с чёрными полосами (letterbox).
  - **Растянуть (Stretch)** — заполнение всего экрана без сохранения пропорций.
  - **Заполнить (Fill)** — масштабирование на весь экран с обрезкой краёв без искажения картинки.
- Настройка доступна в UI лаунчера Android и передаётся в игру через переменную окружения `ME1_STRETCH_MODE`.
- Оба пути рендеринга (GLES и Vulkan) теперь поддерживают динамический расчёт Viewport в зависимости от выбранного режима.

## Изменения от v1.2.1 до v1.2.18

### v1.2.18 — Режим экрана (растягивание на весь экран)
- Добавлена настройка `port.stretch_mode` (Fit / Stretch / Fill) в `settings/me1settings.c`.
- Обновлён `MainActivity.java`: добавлен Spinner для выбора режима растягивания.
- Реализован динамический расчёт Viewport в `hle_d3d9_gl.h` и `hle_d3d9_vk.h`.

### v1.2.17 — Аудит встроенных x87-инструкций (этап 8, шаг 4)

releases.name: v1.2.1
releases.body:
# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |
| ADPF-цель / `uclamp.min` | — | — | 8 мс / 512 | 8 мс / 1024 |
| Лимит FPS | 30 | — | — | — |

releases.name: v1.1.5
releases.body:
## Что нового

### Linux — новая платформа
- Порт игры на Linux (x86-64 и aarch64): X11 и Wayland, рендеры OpenGL ES, Vulkan и Zink. Клавиатура, мышь с захватом
  (Ctrl+Alt+M — отпустить или захватить), геймпады с вибрацией и горячим подключением, звук.
- Свой лаунчер `me1-launcher`, повторяющий Android-версию: выбор папки игры, автоподбор настроек под видеокарту,
  графика, моды, DLC, переменные окружения, журнал запуска. До первого кадра игры показывается экран загрузки.
- Разумные значения по умолчанию: Vulkan на дискретной видеокарте, разрешение рабочего стола, без ограничения FPS,
  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

### Сборка
- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.
- Сами находят `msvcr80`, `msvcp80` и `d3dx9_31`: в папке игры, префиксах Proton и Wine, на разделе Windows или
  достают из установщиков `vcredist_x86.exe` и DirectX. Версии DLL проверяются, заглушки Wine отбрасываются.
