releases.name: NHL Legacy 2027 - 1.0.3
releases.body:
## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.3

Выбранный в лаунчере язык RU/EN теперь используется на экране подготовки графики и в Android-настройках во время игры: меню Select, настройках кнопок, окне назначения и режиме перемещения кнопок. Лаунчер переключается сразу, внутриигровые экраны — при следующем запуске игры. Язык оригинального игрового интерфейса выбирается отдельно.

The launcher’s RU/EN choice now carries into graphics preparation and in-game Android controls: the Select menu, game settings, button mapping, and button-layout editor. The launcher updates immediately; in-game Android screens use the choice on the next game launch. The original game language remains separate.

Signed Android ARM64 APK, `versionCode 14`, same package and signing certificate as 1.0.2. Native libraries, game assets, and the ISO importer are unchanged byte for byte. The Y700 installed this version over 1.0.2 without deleting imported game files. Device checks confirmed the graphics-preparation screen and game settings in both EN and RU, the English button-mapping and layout screens, and both Select-menu languages. A match was not replayed for this text-only update.

releases.name: NHL Legacy 2027 - 1.0.2
releases.body:
## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.2

Лаунчер теперь поддерживает русский и английский языки. Кнопка **RU / EN** в правом верхнем углу переключает текст сразу, сохраняет выбор для следующих запусков и работает независимо от языка самой игры. Переведены главный экран, настройки, импорт ISO, составы, видеодрайверы и сообщения об ошибках. Справка первого запуска исправлена: игровые данные импортируются из ISO.

The launcher now supports Russian and English. Tap **RU / EN** in the upper-right corner to switch immediately; the choice persists across restarts and does not change the game's own language. The home screen, settings, ISO and roster imports, graphics-driver controls, and common diagnostics are translated. The first-launch help correctly refers to ISO import.

releases.name: NHL Legacy 2027 · 1.0.1
releases.body:
## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.1

### Русский

- Первый публичный APK для Android ARM64 с лаунчером NHL Legacy 2027.
- Игровые файлы импортируются **только из ISO**. Проверяются 20 файлов по размеру и SHA-256; ZIP игровых данных больше не поддерживается. ZIP составов и драйверов остаются отдельными функциями.
- Два режима матча: 960 × 540 и 1280 × 720, интерфейс 1280 × 720. Доступны настройки полной арены, управления, системного или пользовательского Vulkan-драйвера и очистка графического кеша.
- При ошибке либо отмене импорта прежняя установка сохраняется. Успешное обновление сохраняет кеши и пользовательские данные.

Полный импорт ISO подтверждён пользователем на Lenovo Y700 (`TB321FU`, Android 15); все 20 файлов дополнительно проверены независимым чтением. Полное прохождение и совместимость со всеми GPU не подтверждены. Возможны просадки FPS и неверная поза вратаря в отдельных повторах.

Для игры требуется собственный оригинальный ISO NHL Legacy Edition. Образ и игровые данные здесь не распространяются. После импорта ISO может быть удалён с устройства, поскольку нужные файлы установлены в хранилище приложения.

### English

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc3
releases.body:
# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc3 is here!!!

This release brings a large collection of game compatibility and graphics fixes, more flexible controls, audio improvements, and easier management of save states and DSi configurations. Highlights include **optional Vulkan low-latency mode**, **independent A/B/X/Y touch controls**, **DSi profiles**, **improved save-state access**, and the new WatermelonDS icon!

--- ## Controls and Gameplay ### Optional Vulkan low-latency mode A new optional Vulkan mode improves touch responsiveness, including in affected gameplay scenarios in **The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass**. This can make touch-driven gameplay feel more responsive, but enabling it may reduce smoothness in demanding games. **It is disabled by default.** ### Multitouch fixes

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2: Vulkan, Audio and Library Stability Update!
releases.body:
# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2 is here!!!

This release focuses on smoother high-resolution Vulkan performance, audio and graphics fixes reported by the community, and quality-of-life improvements for libraries, saves, and RetroAchievements. --- ## Vulkan performance improvements Vulkan has received major performance and stability improvements in this release. Repeated calculations and redundant reads were reduced, and rendering work is now grouped more efficiently. These improvements benefit different internal resolutions and are not exclusive to a single chipset or device family. Tested results include: | Device / SoC | Internal Resolution | Result in tested sections | |---|---:|---| | T820 | **6x** | Close to **60 FPS** in the tested sections of Spirit Tracks, Phantom Hourglass, and Dragon Ball Origins. Smoothness was also confirmed in user testing. | | Snapdragon 865 | **8x** | Close to **60 FPS**. Spirit Tracks and the reviewed sections of Golden Sun now hold pacing better, with both technical and user validation. |

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.7.0 is finally here!
releases.body: ## This is a very special release. After several release candidates under the **melonDualDS** name, the project is now officially renamed to: # WatermelonDS This is the final **0.7.0** release and the first public release with the new WatermelonDS identity. WatermelonDS keeps the same goal as before: providing a powerful Nintendo DS emulator experience on Android, with modern Android features, RetroAchievements support, Vulkan rendering, shader support, and a lot of customization.

releases.name: melonDualDS 0.7.0 RC5: RetroAchievements Stability Update!
releases.body:
# Next release will be WatermelonDS!

This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options.

This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name.

The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases.

However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible.

For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

# Minimum System Requirements for Winlator WB64:
- __OS (Operating System):__ Android 7.0 or later
- __Processor/CPU (Central Processing Unit):__ Qualcomm Snapdragon 460 or higher
- __GPU (Graphics Processing Unit):__ Adreno 610 or higher 
- __Graphics API:__ Vulkan 1.1 or higher
- __Internal Storage:__ At least 2GB of free space
- __RAM (Random Access Memory):__ At least 1GB of free RAM available, depending on the game requirments
- __Root Access:__ Not required
- __Gamepad:__ Optional (xinput/xbox recommended)


__NOTE: Recommended for game titles released before 2013 or DX9-based, Some games especially those from 2013 onwards, may experience performance issues.__
__Results can vary based on the device used, environmental conditions, and other factors, such as simultaneous processing, and different processor capabilities.__

__Please be careful when downloading from other websites. We recommend downloading only from this GitHub repository or official.__

✅ __[WINLATOR.ORG](https://winlator.org) is the original site.__

releases.name: Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0
releases.body:
# Winlator 中文版 (Wine 11) v1.0.0

基于 [Winlator 11.1](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) 深度定制:

## 主要变化
- **Wine 10.10 -> Wine 11.15**: 移植 brunodev85 全部定制补丁 (Android 存储符号链接、GPU 信息上报、X11 窗口属性等) 至 Wine 11.15 新 WoW64 模式 (x86_64-unix + i386/x86_64 双架构 PE)
- **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好
- **完整中文支持**:
  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名
  - rootfs 注入 zh_CN.UTF-8 locale (glibc + X11)
  - Wine 前缀注册表中文字体替换 (宋体/SimSun -> Noto Sans CJK SC)
  - 新建容器默认中文环境

## 下载安装
直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。

## 技术说明
- APK 为 debug 签名, 与官方 Winlator 签名不同, 两者不可互相覆盖安装
- 由 GitHub Actions 全自动云端编译: Wine (约 50 分钟) -> rootfs 注入中文化 -> Gradle 打包
- 构建配方见仓库 `wine/`、`chinese/`、`.github/workflows/build.yml`

# 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

Here's the full summary:

---

## ⚔️ NEW — LAN Multiplayer Bug Fixes

### 🐛 Bug: Crash when entering Cities
- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.
- **Fix:** Problem fixed, and you can now teleport and enter cities perfectly.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

releases.body:
# 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

Here's the full summary:

---

## ⚔️ NEW — LAN Multiplayer Bug Fixes

### 🐛 Bug: Crash when entering Cities
- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.
- **Fix:** Problem fixed, and you can now teleport and enter cities perfectly.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op

## Mali+ updates

- Refined Liquid Glass styling across dialogs, dropdowns, cards, and in-game surfaces.
- Enhanced Liquid Glass is enabled by default on fresh installs. Toggle it in **Settings > Appearance & Themes > Theme & Colors > Enhanced Liquid Glass**; turning it off disables the enhanced animated-backdrop treatment, while popup/dialog blur remains available.
- Improved game cover-art loading and refresh handling.
- Fixed container-list refresh after creating a container.

releases.name: Winlator Mali 1.2+ Update — Vulkan, PanVK & Shortcut Enhancements
releases.body:
Winlator Mali+ 1.2 update, based on Winlator Mali 1.2 Bionic Latest. This update keeps the upstream EGL/Gladio renderer and ZeroFG path while adding optional Vulkan and game-library improvements.

## Highlights

- Optional Vulkan host renderer with renderer configuration, native-rendering/scanout support, and Vulkan LSFG/Win-FG controls.
- Online Bannerlator wrapper catalog with installed-wrapper selection and archive validation.
- Live PanVK release browser in Adrenotools GPU Drivers. Refreshes GitHub releases from three projects, filters for recognized Adrenotools ZIP packages, verifies downloads, and imports drivers directly.
- Shortcut-library improvements: full-cover portrait and landscape cards, per-game artwork handling, executable shortcut creation with container selection, and selected-game graphics details.
- Animated PlayStation-inspired backgrounds and liquid-glass styling across application and in-game menus.

## Experimental PanVK notice

releases.name: Winlator Mali 1.2+ Bionic
releases.body:
## Winlator Mali+ 1.2 Bionic

A customized Winlalor mali from [GunaCharanTeja](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja) an improved console-inspired game library, downloadable graphics wrappers, and an experimental Vulkan rendering/frame-generation path.

### Highlights & Features
- Winlator Mali+ branding and an animated, responsive launcher with portrait/landscape game cards, selectable shortcuts, game cover art, and a compact per-game summary of Vulkan wrapper, FEXCore, Box64, and presets.
- Cloud-fetched and custom game cover art, with local fallback behavior when online artwork is unavailable.
- Bannerlator wrapper catalog integration: browse, download/update, checksum-verify, and select wrappers per container or shortcut; saved selections are restored and applied when launching a game.
- Vulkan host renderer settings for color order, present mode, and installed host driver, plus optional Native Rendering/low-latency scanout.
- Experimental native Win-FG frame generation and optional LSFG Native after importing and validating the user's own `Lossless.dll`; the DLL is not bundled. Compatibility depends on the Vulkan driver/device.

releases.name: WinLite v1.4.0
releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

WinCore 4.0.0 — App Icon Issue

WinCore 4.0.0 was released without the intended WinCore app icon because of an error during the GitHub release/build process. The supplied artwork was not correctly integrated into the APK, leaving the release without the proper WinCore branding.
This issue was addressed in WinCore 5.0.0, which includes the updated green four-panel app icon and logo, with automated checks confirming the branding resources were included.

releases.name: WinCore 3.0.0
releases.body:
WinCore 3.0.0 expands Android device-profile customization with per-game and per-container CPU profile overrides, configurable Box64 mappings, and automatic chipset-family detection.

This release introduces adaptive launch safety for low-memory and severe thermal conditions, an optional live session monitor, JSON device-profile sharing, and appearance reset.

Existing Winlator container management, game shortcuts, graphics settings, controller support, and compatibility diagnostics are preserved.

Note: CI verifies the build and APK integrity. Actual game compatibility and performance have not been verified on physical devices.

releases.name: WinCore 2.0.0
releases.body:
WinCore 2.0.0 introduces automatic chipset-family detection for common Dimensity, Snapdragon, and Exynos devices, with selectable device profiles applied through Box64 when launching Windows programs.

This release also adds eight app-wide accent color options and three interface sizes: Compact, Standard, and Large. Existing Winlator containers, shortcuts, settings, controller navigation, and read-only compatibility diagnostics are preserved.

Note: chipset-to-profile mappings are baseline defaults and have not been benchmark-verified.

releases.name: v2.6 – Xbox 360 games through Xenia, Xbox and Xenia settings tabs
releases.body:
Title: v2.6 – Xbox 360 games through Xenia, Xbox and Xenia settings tabs
Repository description:
Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu (original Xbox emulator) with a console-style dashboard, Xbox 360 games through your own Xenia, one-click 60 FPS patches, upscaling filters, CPU/GPU boost with per-game settings, and tools for finding out why a game is slow. Not supported by the xemu project.
---
Release body (paste into the GitHub release):
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.6
Xbox 360 games, through your own Xenia. xemu does not emulate the Xbox 360, and this fork still doesn't include or change any 360 emulator. If you download Xenia or Xenia Canary yourself, the library can now list your 360 games and start them in it.
Turn on Show Xbox 360 games on the new Xenia tab and choose your `xenia.exe` / `xenia_canary.exe`. Your game folders are scanned for disc images (.iso), extracted games with a `default.xex`, .xex files, Games on Demand and Xbox Live Arcade packages.

releases.name: v2.5 – Tron Red theme, sphere emblem, holographic covers, DOA3 color fix, Linux AppImage
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.5

Tron Red. A third dashboard color next to Neon and Green, red with amber. It works on every dashboard style. Pick it under Settings > Dashboard theme or the Library menu.
Sphere and fins is the default dashboard, with an X emblem on the sphere. New installs start on Original Blades in the original green. The sphere, fins, web, orbs and bars take the theme color you choose (cyan for Neon, red and orange for Tron Red), and so does the emblem. If you already picked a style or theme, nothing changes for you.
Holo and Aurora dashboards. Two more styles. Holo is a hologram terminal, and now has a light-cycle fight in its arena: two cycles meet, one is wounded and breaks into cubes of light, the other runs on and a new pair appears.
Holographic covers. Settings > Home screen covers has a third choice, Holographic: cases float over a projector ring, bob and turn slowly, with scanlines, a sweep of light, an occasional glitch and a tint in your theme color.

releases.name: v2.4 – Faster library scanning, Clear library, version in the title bar
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.4
Version in the title bar. The window now reads "xemu Modern GUI v2.4 | xemu v0.8.139", so it's easy to tell which build you're running.
Faster library scanning. Games appear as soon as they're found instead of after the whole folder has been read, several disc images are read at once, and extracted game folders (any folder containing `default.xbe`) are no longer searched file by file. Recycle-bin and hidden folders are skipped.
Clear library. Library > Folders has a new "Clear library..." button. It empties the game list and forgets your game folders, individually added games and hidden games, so you can add them again from scratch. Your game files are never touched. Play time, favorites, custom names and per-game settings are kept.

1.4 GHz CPU option. Real hardware speed can pace to 733 MHz (stock) or 1.4 GHz (like a modded console), under Settings > Performance. Real hardware speed is off by default.

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

releases.name: v2.2: four new dashboard styles, stick drift test, achievements that unlock themselves
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.2
Four new dashboard styles (Settings > Library style, or the Games menu). They are original artwork inspired by the look of old consoles: no Microsoft or Xbox artwork is used.
Original Xbox: black and green with a glowing wireframe globe. The list of sections slides to the left and a section opens in a window over the globe, so the list stays visible.
Original Blades: a bright green web, a glowing sphere with fins and an arc of orbs, one for each section, like the first Xbox's menu.
Glossy Blades: silver blades on glossy green, in the spirit of the Xbox 360's first dashboard. Every blade stays visible and the active one rises, with its window beside the row.
Modern: a calm side menu with icons and one card at a time.
The two Original styles use the Russo One font (SIL Open Font License) and have their own animations. All the tabs work in every style, from a controller too.

emulators.latest_body:
Hotfix release following 0.3.0: fixes a frame-pacing and input-latency regression in input polling, eliminates shader-translation busy-wait CPU spikes, adds a 20 FPS limiter option, and enables full resolve readback automatically for FIFA Street (2012).

* Fix the 0.3.0 `jit_frame_start` polling-hold regression (stuttering / sluggish input in CoD MW2 and other titles) and switch the default back to Off (#144)
* Replace shader-translation busy-spin loops with `std::atomic::wait` and drop an unnecessary audio stub yield to reduce battery draw and frame-time spikes (#123)
* Add a 20 FPS option to the GPU frame rate limiter (#140)
* Enable `readback_resolve = "all"` automatically for FIFA Street (2012) so indoor pitches render with proper colors (#114)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/phforner0/Xendroid-Plus/compare/XenDroid-v170-2859aae4...XenDroid-v173-20c4aabb

releases.name: Xendroid+ 0.3.0
releases.body:
Scheduler and file I/O fixes from upstream Xenia Edge: file reads and writes finish the way they do on the console, and kernel timers and DPCs behave like the console's.

Adds ZeroFG frame generation: the screen shows twice the game's frame rate (30 → 60, 60 → 120).

Halo: Reach runs much faster and shows the characters' faces again: from 17 to its limit of 30 fps in the first mission on a POCO F7 (Adreno 825).

Gears of War 3 returns to its 30 fps cap in its opening checkpoint on a POCO F7 (Adreno 825), cutting GPU frame time by 37% (44.9 to 28.2 ms).

Game folder management after initial setup, a 40 FPS frame rate cap for 120 Hz displays, lower power draw and heat on Android, and improved physical controller trigger and remapping support.

Upstream Xenia Edge synchronization (batch 16) bringing 40 audio, kernel, scheduler, threading and CPU fixes, plus an ARMv8.0 JIT fix for older Snapdragon chips.

Improves Vulkan startup compatibility on older Adreno GPUs, ports rendering accuracy fixes from Xenia Edge, and reduces vertex shader overhead when software round-toward-zero emulation is active.

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4
releases.body:
# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4

## What's new

- Vulkan Drivers and DXVK show what the game last loaded and what is selected for the next launch, including driver fallback.
- Driver ZIP imports show progress, can be cancelled, and keep your current driver selected. You can now view and clear shader caches individually.
- The touch layout editor has snap-to-grid and safe-area guides. Controls has a controller test for buttons, sticks, and dead zones.
- LAN room details show the host, local or virtual connection, and build compatibility information. You can view your enabled resource mods and measure outgoing traffic from the room.
- Large settings files can no longer stop launch when diagnostics tries to copy them. Startup also does less work on repeated package checks and optional reports.
- Supported phones have an optional sustained performance mode. Graphics startup errors now identify a rejected Direct3D feature level when the log records it.

## Install

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-preview4.apk** over Preview 3 Hotfix 1 to keep your settings. Use your own compatible GTA V Legacy files. [Buy GTA V](https://store.rockstargames.com/game/buy-gta-v)

- Fixed the Preview 3 startup crash that could close the game as soon as it launches.

- The previous-game error dialog title now appears in English.

## Install

Preview 3 can crash at startup. Install [Preview 3 Hotfix 1](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/releases/tag/v0.3-preview3-hotfix1) over it.

## What’s new

- Fixed an SDL startup failure that could occur when retrying a game launch.
- Startup reports show the first error and the last stage reached.
- Recording History shows frame timings, long gaps, memory use, and screen refresh when available.
- Refresh matching returns control to Android when the option is off or the frame rate is uncapped.

## Install

This is a development preview. It uses the 1.7.57 LAN rooms from Preview 2. Gameplay and multiplayer still need testing on phones.

Use your own compatible GTA V Legacy files. [Buy GTA V](https://store.rockstargames.com/game/buy-gta-v)

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — Launcher Fix
releases.body:
# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — launcher startup fix

Preview 1 could close immediately without showing the launcher. Its rebuilt APK omitted 146 original artwork files required during application startup. Preview 2 restores those files, preserves their authentication and touch icons, and adds checks using the final signed APK's own resources.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-Preview2.apk** over Preview 1; the app ID and release key are unchanged, and the version code is newer. There is no need to uninstall first. **XHYN V Bridge stays at 0.1.0**; an already installed copy does not need updating.

All 0.3 features remain: the 1.7.57 multiplayer base, LAN free roam, room chat, shared vehicles, street races, themes, XHYN graphics/DXVK controls and diagnostics. See the full [changelog and multiplayer guide](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/blob/v0.3-preview2/README.md).

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 1 — Superseded
releases.body:
> **Superseded — install [XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/releases/tag/v0.3-preview2).** Preview 1 omitted artwork required during startup and cannot open the launcher. Preview 2 restores the files and passes startup/launcher checks using the final APK resources. Install it over Preview 1 without uninstalling. Bridge remains at 0.1.0. Physical-device gameplay and multiplayer remain untested.

# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 1

## What's new in the 1.7.57 base

- **Experimental LAN free roam:** create or join rooms for **2–10 players, including the host**, using Wi-Fi, a hotspot or a virtual LAN.
- **Room tools:** room discovery, player names, a member list, connection/latency information, chat, host announcements and host-controlled friendly fire.
- **World synchronization:** character clothing/accessories, nearby vehicles and shared vehicle seating, with time, weather and nearby traffic following the host. Visual synchronization has not been verified on devices.
- **Street races:** record checkpoint routes, save recent tracks, choose sprint or circuit races, enter races and view results. Spawning/teleporting restrictions apply during races.

emulators.latest_body:
# YukiHub v0.4.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**四平台游玩状态同步 · Hikarinagi 快捷登录优化 · SD 卡目录授权 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **同步游玩状态至四个平台**：现在可以把本地的游玩时长与进度，一键同步到 **NextMoe·未萌（鲲 Galgame）**、**VNDB**、**Bangumi** 与 **Hikarinagi**。四个平台的入口统一收进个人资料页的「同步游玩状态」折叠卡，点开后按平台逐项操作，状态一目了然。
- **Hikarinagi 快捷登录支持邮箱识别**：现在用 Hikarinagi 快捷登录时会一并读取邮箱，若该邮箱已在 YukiHub 注册过，**将直接登录并绑定到原账号**，与 NextMoe·未萌 的行为完全一致，不再另开新号、云同步数据也不会分裂。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **内置 Gal 工具箱常规维护**：同步更新内置工具箱里的网址与内容，保持可用。
- **同步进度弹窗重做**：进度展示改为环形进度 + 分步状态，四个平台的同步过程都能清楚看到当前在做什么。
- **新增取消绑定游玩状态同步凭证**:打开对应窗口后，长按即可弹出取消，清空凭证以重新登陆。
- **bangumi游戏自定义查询新增id查询**:因api缺陷，部分游戏不能直接搜到，因此新增了id搜索，在自定义搜索界面，直接输入数字is即可。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复 NextMoe 源封面模糊的问题**：部分作品封面会取到低分辨率图，现已修正取图逻辑。
- **修复通知权限疯狂弹窗的问题**：此前会反复请求通知权限，现已正常。
- **修复 SD 卡授权时选不到指定文件夹的问题**：内置文件选择器新增 SD 卡支持，现在可以正常选中 SD 卡里的游戏目录。

## 📌 说明

- **同步范围**：VNDB 不支持通过 API 写入游玩时长，因此同步到 VNDB 时只同步状态。
- **首次同步需要授权**：各平台同步需先在对应平台完成一次授权，之后会在后台自动使用。
- **Hikarinagi 登录**：已用旧方式登录过的老账号不受影响，仍会登录原来的账号；新登录会自动识别邮箱。
- **升级不影响存档**：本次更新不涉及引擎与存档逻辑，原有存档数据可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

- **修复 NextMoe 源封面模糊的问题**：部分作品封面会取到低分辨率图，现已修正取图逻辑。
- **修复通知权限疯狂弹窗的问题**：此前会反复请求通知权限，现已正常。
- **修复 SD 卡授权时选不到指定文件夹的问题**：内置文件选择器新增 SD 卡支持，现在可以正常选中 SD 卡里的游戏目录。

## 📌 说明

- **同步范围**：VNDB 不支持通过 API 写入游玩时长，因此同步到 VNDB 时只同步状态。
- **首次同步需要授权**：各平台同步需先在对应平台完成一次授权，之后会在后台自动使用。
- **Hikarinagi 登录**：已用旧方式登录过的老账号不受影响，仍会登录原来的账号；新登录会自动识别邮箱。
- **升级不影响存档**：本次更新不涉及引擎与存档逻辑，原有存档数据可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

# YukiHub v0.4 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。
- **大屏模式新增回首页按钮**：右上角可直接退出大屏模式回到首页；原设置按钮同步改为图案化设计，并增加点击动效。
- **Yuki社区新增收藏集功能**（萌萌点回收计划二期）。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。

# YukiHub v0.3.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**新引擎支持 · 大屏体验 · 社区互动 · 在线状态 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **新增 PC 引擎**：支持兼容 **Winlator-CN** 快捷启动。使用方法：手动选择 PC 引擎 → 添加游戏文件夹 → 选择 exe 文件启动即可。（请确保已安装 **Winlator-CN 1005 或更新版本**）
- **新增 FVP 引擎兼容启动**：FVP 引擎正式可用。
- **大屏模式新增搜索功能**：位于分类栏最上方，支持按游戏名与会社名搜索。
- **社区接入 NextMoe 贴纸表情包**：现在可以更愉快地带表情包发言了（bushi）。
- **在线状态区分手机 / 电脑端**：在线标记已区别化显示，为 PC 端接入做好准备。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **FVP 引擎新增虚拟鼠标按钮**：复用 KRKR / Artemis 的虚拟鼠标方案，操作更顺手。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复扫描入库的游戏固定使用 VNDB 源的问题**：扫描入库后现在会按设置中选择的资料源进行匹配，与手动添加保持一致。
- **修复大屏模式游玩时长不计入网页端每日任务的问题**：大屏游玩现在会正常上报服务端，经验与每日任务均可正常结算。
- **修复设置面板上下滑动时选项被误判为点击、导致界面被"硬控"的问题**。
- **修复 FVP 引擎视频播放问题**：需手动将原游戏视频转换为标准 MP4 格式 —— 编码 **H.264 (AVC)**、音频 **AAC**；720p 推荐 4000 比特率，1080p 推荐 6000 比特率。
- **移除 Bangumi 镜像源**：因镜像源频繁失效，已正式下线；此前使用镜像源的用户升级后将**自动切换为 Bangumi 官源**（官源访问可能需要一点 🔮）。

## 📌 说明

- 网络类静默失败已补充日志记录，开启日志后更便于排查问题。
- 以上修复均不涉及引擎存档镜像逻辑，原有存档数据不受影响。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.3 更新简介

> 本次更新聚焦：**UI 全面焕新 · 大屏模式 · 展厅功能 · 资讯与正版导购 · 账号体验 · 大量稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **大屏模式（主打）**：全新大屏播放体验，支持在大屏上畅享游戏 PV；新增从**文件夹**选取视频的来源（部分设备受系统限制无法从相册正常浏览图集，只能按时间一个个翻，很麻烦，现已绕开）。
- **首页接入 Gal 资讯**：打开 App 即可浏览最新 Galgame 动态。
- **正式接入 NextMoe 数据源**：账号快捷登录同步迁移为 **NextMoe·未萌** 快捷登录；聊天室支持 NextMoe 表情包。
- **游戏库正版导购**：网页社区游戏库新增游戏详情页，接入 **DLsite 正版链接** 与 **Steam 正版链接**（通过 Steam API 显示实时价格）。接入 NextMoe 分销链接，流量好的话后续会在社区发放 DL 正版游戏优惠券。
- **忘记密码 / 找回密码**：支持自助找回账号。
- **游戏时长编辑**：支持手动编辑游戏时长记录。
- **展厅玩法扩展**：3D 游戏展厅与多人在线展厅持续建设中，本版本新增音乐间（离线展厅可播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐），并支持共同观影等多人互动玩法。
- **多人在线展厅（重磅）**：全新网页端多人 3D 展厅上线！和朋友一起在线逛街、聊天、互动，包含：
  - 影院：共同观影、点播排队、投票换片、管理员管理（强制播放/跳片、远程灯光等）；
  - 音乐间：播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐，附赠一台古典音乐播放机；
  - 钓鱼等小游戏与更多互动玩法；
  - 离线展厅同步升级音乐间。
- **3D 游戏展厅**：以"逛博物馆"的仪式感重新设计，游戏以实体盒子陈列在虚拟 3D 房间中。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **UI 全面焕新**：整体视觉语言与配色体系全面重设计，界面更现代、更统一，观感焕然一新。
- 注册 / 登录页交互逻辑全面优化。
- 首页、游戏库按钮样式与配色统一化，UI 细节全面打磨。
- 手柄适配继续完善。
- 融合 GalToolbox 能力。
- 软件内更新默认源切换至 **GitCode**。
- 鲲 Gal 域名变更同步。

## 🛠 问题修复

- 修复好友列表"离线用户仍显示正在游玩"的 bug（根因为游戏时长未成功回传形成记录闭环）。
- 修复聊天室图片只缓存一半的问题。
- 修复验证码无动画反馈的问题。
- 修复共存版无法扫描添加文件的问题（初始库默认缺失生成项）。
- 修复游戏时长相关的若干功能 bug。
- ONS 游戏：视频播放改为**长按 2 秒跳过**（原为点击跳过，避免误触）。

## 📌 说明

## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.

  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

[![Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Support_on_Patreon-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

---

## Upgrade Notice

* **Install Direct:** Install Xenra 0.4.0 directly over your existing Green installation. Do not uninstall first, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.
* **Gold Edition Discontinued:** Gold is retired as of 0.4.0. Installing Green (`Ali.Xanite.green`) will install alongside Gold. Gold data remains intact on your device, but a one-time setup (selecting BIOS, game paths, and granting storage permissions) is required on Green.

---

## Highlights

### Interface & Responsiveness
* **Touch & D-Pad Navigation:** Touch target resolution defers to `ACTION_UP` without walking full view trees. D-pad navigation eliminates ~170 filesystem probes per press for instant library scrolling.

## Game Data Management

Access the dedicated **Game Data** menu by long-pressing any title in your library:

* **Xbox 360 Patches & Mods:** Direct installation of `.patch.toml` files (with Title ID verification) and `.xex` plugins via `plugins.toml`.
* **Xbox 360 Saves:** View saves grouped by profile; import and export ZIP archives.
* **Original Xbox Saves:** Direct FATX hard disk image integration. List, import, export, and delete saves with synchronized `UDATA` and `TDATA` handling.

---

## Performance & Rendering

* **Render Pipeline Optimizations:** Refined render-target handling and GPU synchronization eliminate unnecessary render passes, improving frame rates on mobile hardware.
* **Faster Rendering Path:** Fixed an underlying bottleneck, allowing default `gpu_upstream_conformance` to drop from 15 to 14. Existing configurations migrate automatically.

releases.name: Ymir v0.4.0
releases.body:
# Ymir v0.4.0
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/54fead6/)

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

# Ymir v0.3.2
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/584dcc1/)

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

Performance got another huge boost in multiple avenues with this version. First, thanks to @SternXD, you can now offload audio processing tasks to another CPU core, freeing up the emulator thread to focus more heavily on the SH-2s and general system logic. This alone can boost performance by up to 25% and possibly more, depending on how much work is put on the SCSP DSP.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

## Changes

- **Less CPU time spent drawing each race frame.** The game's main thread now finds textures and sets them up for drawing with much less work, so busy frames with many objects on screen are less likely to run late, especially on phones that slow down when they get hot. On the AYN Thor, drawing a race frame takes about 0.7 ms less (about a fifth less per object drawn). The picture is unchanged. For #176

## Validation

- **Drawing time on the AYN Thor** (frame timing on, the middle of a Dolphin Resort race): 2.8 ms of drawing a frame and 3.1 µs per object, against 3.4–3.7 ms and 4.0–4.1 µs in 0.10.75; texture work went from about 1.0 ms to 0.3 ms a frame.
- **The picture is unchanged on Windows:** the same Windows checks as 0.10.75 all passed (see below), and while PR #454 was tested, the new code drew the same 27 pictures bit for bit as 0.10.75 from the title screen up to the race (races themselves never repeat exactly, so they were compared by eye).
- **The rest, as in 0.10.75:**
  - **Windows x64 package:**

releases.name: v0.10.75 — Hourly update check, and AVATAR without a model
releases.body:
## Changes

- **The update check now runs at most once an hour,** instead of once a day, so a new version shows up in the launcher sooner. It still sends no personal data, and you can turn it off under **General › Updates**. For #365
- **Picking AVATAR without a VRM model no longer hangs.** Before, choosing AVATAR in the character ring when no model was set in the launcher stayed on Now Loading for ever. Now you race as an empty rider (the Avatar's gear and board), and for the first seconds of the loading screen a note says **NO AVATAR MODEL. CHOOSE ONE IN THE LAUNCHER**. If you already have a model, nothing changes.

## Validation

- **AVATAR without a model (Windows x64 package):** AVATAR was picked in Free Race with no model set. The race started with all 12 racers, the board raced with no rider drawn, and the note showed on the loading screen and was gone by the start. Picking Sonic the same way raced exactly as in 0.10.74.
- **Update check:** on Windows and Linux, the launcher found the latest release when told it was an old version, and a second start within the hour sent no request (`skipped=checked_recently`).
- **The rest, as in 0.10.74:**
  - **Windows x64 package:**

releases.body:
## Changes

- **Move and resize the touch buttons (Android and iOS).** A new section, **Controls › Touch and tilt › Move and resize touch buttons**, shows the game's screen with the touch buttons on it. Drag a button to move it. Tap a button to choose it, then use the **Size** slider to make it bigger or smaller. **Reset this button** and **Reset all buttons** put things back.
- **A layout made on one screen still fits another.** Each button keeps its distance from the nearer side of the screen (or from the middle), so a layout you make on a wide phone still has your thumb buttons at the sides, and START in the middle, on a 16:9 tablet.
- The game uses your layout for drawing the buttons and for where they react to touches. In races, the floating stick area follows the stick to its side of the screen.
- If you never open the new section, nothing changes: the buttons look and work exactly as in 0.10.73.

For #443

## Validation

- **Touch button layout (PR #449):**

releases.name: v0.10.73 — Plain race loading screen fixes on wide screens
releases.body:
## Changes

These fixes are for the **General › Gameplay › Plain race loading screen** option (added in 0.10.71, off by default):

- **No more half-window picture on wide screens.** On a screen wider than 16:9 (for example a 20:9 phone, or Aspect Ratio Auto in a wide window), when Now Loading went away the screen turned into a black frame squeezed against the right side for about 12 seconds before the race. The touch buttons and the frame-rate counter moved with it. Now the screen stays full until the race begins, and nothing moves. The Now Loading sign itself keeps its shape in the corner.
- **The hidden practice is now silent.** Before, you could still hear Omochao and the practice's sounds behind the black screen. The race's own sounds play as usual.
- **Buttons pressed during the screen no longer change the race start.** The hidden practice used to react to your controller, keyboard, touch buttons or tilt. Pressing buttons could start the race a little earlier than usual. Now your input is ignored until the race begins, so the race starts at the same moment however much you press.

Nothing changes when the option is off.

For #365

## Validation

releases.name: v0.10.72 — Round touch buttons on wide phones, and per-button touch options
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Touch buttons stay round on wide phones.** With **Graphics › Aspect Ratio › Auto** on a wide phone (19.5:9 or 20:9, for example a Galaxy A55), and on iPhones, which use Auto by default, the touch buttons were stretched into ovals, and the places you had to touch were stretched the same way. They are now round at any screen shape, the same size as before, and keep their distance from the screen edges, so each thumb's buttons stay where the thumb is. What you touch now matches what you see. At 16:9 (the Android default, and 16:9 devices such as the AYN Thor) nothing changes.
- **New: Customise touch buttons.** Under **Controls › Touch and tilt › Customise touch buttons** there is a row for each touch control (LS, RS, A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LT, RT, START) with two switches:
  - **Shown**: turn it off to remove the control completely. That part of the screen then works as empty screen. For example, hide the left stick (LS) when you steer by tilting.
  - **Name**: turn it off to keep the button but hide its letters.
  - The existing **Button names** switch still hides every name at once. Everything is shown and named by default, so nothing changes until you choose.

releases.name: v0.5.1
releases.body:
# v0.5.1

Uma versão de segurança. Um jogo aberto no emulador podia ler, sobrescrever e apagar arquivos
fora da própria pasta. Agora cada jogo enxerga só o que é dele, e os saves de todos os jogos
passam a ficar num lugar só.

Bugs corrigidos:

- **Um jogo não alcança mais os arquivos do computador.** Um `.mod` aberto fora de um pacote,
  direto de uma pasta como `Downloads`, podia mexer nos arquivos ao lado dele: ler, trocar o
  conteúdo e apagar. Num pacote `.zip`, podia apagar arquivos do próprio jogo. Nenhum jogo da
  biblioteca faz isso, mas um `.mod` de origem desconhecida faria. Agora:
  - o jogo só lê o que veio com ele, e não consegue alterar nem apagar esses arquivos;
  - tudo o que o jogo grava vai para a pasta de saves do emulador;
  - atalhos (links simbólicos) dentro da pasta do jogo são ignorados;
  - um save state alterado à mão não reabre arquivos fora do que o jogo alcança.
- **Os saves de todos os jogos ficam juntos**, em `saves/mod/`, uma pasta por jogo, como no
  console. Um jogo que usa o save de outro, como o Zeebo F.C. com os bonecos do Zeeboids,
  continua encontrando o que precisa

releases.name: v0.5.0
releases.body:
# v0.5.0

O Ultimate Chess 3D, o Alice no País das Maravilhas, o Rally Master Pro e o menu do Quake voltam a
funcionar, e a água do Bóia Cross ganha a cor do console. Carregar um save state e usar o rewind
deixam de trazer o som de antes e a tela preta, e a pausa passa a parar a música. Chega o atalho
de reiniciar o jogo, no Qt e no Android.

**A interface em Qt ganha cara nova e save states.** Temas, menus, barra de ferramentas e de
status, configurações com barra lateral, e o jogo abre na própria janela principal. Os save states
chegam ao Qt com dez slots por jogo e atalhos de teclado, e o Android passa de cinco para dez
slots.

**A interface antiga, em egui, saiu.** O emulador passa a ter uma interface só, a em Qt, que já
era a principal desde a v0.4.0 e é a que recebe as novidades.

Para quem usava a interface em egui (o programa `zeebx`, o pacote `zeebx-standalone-egui` ou o
cask `zeebxteam/tap/zeebx`):

- ela fica na v0.4.2 e **não vai receber atualizações**. O emulador não troca uma interface pela
  outra sozinho;
- para continuar recebendo as versões novas, instale a interface em Qt pela página de releases

releases.name: v1.2.1
releases.body:
1.2.1 Changelog:
* New features for mod developers:
  * Added optional dependency functionality, which allows mods to run different code based on the presence of another mod. See [this section of the template mod toml](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/mod.toml#L42) and [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L37) for more details.
  * Added exports to get the return value of a function from within a return hook. See [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L11) for more details.
  * Hooks and callbacks are now run in an order determined by the order of mods in the mod menu. Regular hooks and callbacks are run from top to bottom, while return hooks are run in the reverse of that order. Reordering mods after starting the game does not affect this ordering.

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]  
> There's currently a known issue where installing mods by dragging them into the main menu instead of the mods menu might lead to mods being disabled or crashes. Until this issue is resolved, it is recommended to drag mods to the game window while in the mods menu rather than the main menu. 

Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.

* Modding support has been added. Mods can be installed by dragging them onto the game window or by using the "Install Mods" button in the mod menu before starting the game. You can find many mods on the Thunderstore page at https://thunderstore.io/c/zelda-64-recompiled/. More info can be found in the readme.
* Texture pack support has been added. Texture packs are managed with the same menu as mods and installed in the same way. Some texture packs can be found on the thunderstore page linked previously.
* MacOS is now supported via a Metal renderer. Thanks @dcvz and @tanmaysachan!

releases.name: v1.1.1

**Wondering about your save data when upgrading? Don't worry! Your save data is stored separately to the game itself. You can overwrite your old version and your save data will still be there, completely intact, and will work on the new version.**

**NOTE: There are known rendering issues with AMD RDNA3 integrated GPUs on Windows (e.g. Ryzen Z1 or Radeon 780M). Use the workaround in https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/Zelda64Recomp/issues/289 or wait for AMD to fix it in a driver update.**

- The ocarina now accepts DPad inputs (#311)
- Analog camera improvements:
   - When aiming inside of a deku flower, Link will follow the camera (#306)
   - When rolling as Goron, the camera will automatically switch to auto mode when the spikes come out (you can touch the right stick again to make the camera free again) (#306)
   - The Wart boss fight will now start if you look at the boss with the analog camera (#308)
- Added a workaround for an AMD driver bug affecting the usage of a 64 bit framebuffer on RDNA3 GPUs on DX12. These GPUs will default to Vulkan until AMD fixes their issue. (#314)
- Added an automatic file backup system for the config files to prevent file corruption (#335)

releases.name: v1.1.0

* Added an analog "free" camera in the style of later entries in the series. Moving the right stick will allow you to freely rotate the camera, and pressing the Target button or going through an entrance will switch back to the normal camera.
* Improved motion blur effect at high framerates by using a high precision internal framebuffer (won't be enabled on machines with less than 1GB of VRAM).
* Implemented N64 noise dither (affects the motion blur scenes).
* Extended Dawn of the X Day screen to account for faster load times to match console timings.
* Added a configurable scaled deadzone option to the menu. (#257)

# PanProbe 1.3.2

Vulkan conformance and performance probe for the Mesa PanVK driver on Mali GPUs (mali_kbase). It loads the bundled driver, the system Vulkan driver or an imported `.so`, shows what the driver reports, and runs **41** on-device tests.

Bundled drivers:
- `rc5` slot (default): [Mesa PanVK 26.3.1](https://github.com/zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android/releases/tag/panvk-kbase-v26.3.1), `26.3.0-devel (git-795ca7ff3e, p0175, 2026-10-31)`, build 122i, universal Mali v6-v14 (v15 not fully supported).
- `rc4` slot: the RC4 driver (`panvk-kbase-v0.1.0-rc4`), for A/B runs.

Package `dev.zenithblue.panvktest`, versionName 1.3.2, versionCode 21. It updates 1.2.7 and 1.3.x in place.

## What is new since 1.2.7

- Bundles build 122i (26.3.1) in the default slot; the `rc4` slot keeps RC4 for A/B runs.

releases.body:
## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 build 1192

The launcher now lists a mounted .pkg file once, under **PKG**. Copies in different folders remain visible.

### Validation

- In a six-folder library, 7 PKG/exFAT duplicates were removed. The launcher went from 43 to 36 entries and kept both Balan Wonderworld copies from separate folders.
- 196 Windows automated checks passed, including 35 Vulkan checks on an RTX 5060 Ti.
- The b1191 updater installed the final b1192 ZIP in an isolated installation. The test verified 50 payload files and preserved 5 data markers for saves, settings, games and modules. Rollback and interrupted-update recovery both passed.

Use **Check for updates** in the launcher or download the Windows x64 ZIP below. The matching source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums are also attached.

Corresponding source commit `018f0bc33deb74b54a0048b2104e2c8cb15d4628`.

releases.name: ZeraPS5 v0.1.1-b1191
releases.body:
## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 build 1191

The Windows x64 package includes matching sources, component licenses and relinkable objects. Some titles require the user’s own `libSceAgc.sprx`. The package excludes firmware modules and shaders extracted from them.

### Technical changes

- **Vulkan presentation.** Find GPU-written framebuffers through another mapping of the same memory. This fixed black output in the recorded development runs of The Messenger and Goodnight Universe.
- **Compute and writeback.** Start another batch when the writeback list fills. Finish queued reads while guest mappings remain pinned and compare GPU results with the same snapshot that was uploaded. Require 32-lane compute subgroups when the shader uses cross-lane operations.
- **System services.** Extend AMM and AMPR memory and file operations, add semaphore and Audio3D handling, and provide non-PSSR fallback responses from `libScePsml`.
- **Launcher.** Show the library counts when no system library is installed. Keep the missing-module message for games that require one. Supported Unreal profiles can also be read from PKG and exFAT applications.

### Game observations

Experimental Windows x64 release. Corresponding public source commit: c7f3f09. Development snapshot: 4db61f5.

releases.body:
# ZeraPS5 0.1.1 build 1080

[Windows ZIP](https://github.com/zeraps5/ZeraPS5-Releases/releases/download/v0.1.1-b1080/ZeraPS5-v0.1.1-b1080-win64.zip) · [Matching source](https://github.com/zeraps5/ZeraPS5-Releases/releases/download/v0.1.1-b1080/ZeraPS5-v0.1.1-b1080-win64-source.zip) · [Compatibility](https://github.com/zeraps5/ZeraPS5-Releases/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md)

Experimental Windows x64 release. Corresponding source commit **de3949f**.

## Changes since build 984

- **Vulkan and shader compatibility.** Includes fixes for RADV-generated shaders, texture modes 25 and 26, 8-bit index streams, sub-dword typed buffer loads, and render targets that share guest memory. GPU-only pixels can be restored from R32 to an RGBA8 view without changing their bytes.
- **Longshot.** Adds startup and memory support for the targeted build and shader fixes for the black patches, flicker and ghosting seen in development.
- **R-Type Delta HD.** Adds AJM control handling, an ATRAC9 fallback and a title-specific input timing fix.
- **Game images.** Adds direct, read-only access to supported .ffpfsc images, including nested PFS and PFSC-compressed data.

emulators.latest_body:
**Nixport v1.2.304-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> Published by hand: built and signed with the same key as v1.1.299-alpha and
> v1.0.267-alpha (upgrades install over them without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.1.299-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Single-player pad model** (replaces v1.1's player slots): exactly one physical
  pad feeds the game at a time. The pad you touch takes over automatically
  (last-active wins); the session drawer offers "use this pad" to pin a choice for
  the session. The effective pad and the on-screen controls merge into one player.
- **Fix: intermittent directional input**. After opening a menu or losing focus,
  sticks / D-pad / triggers now reach the game immediately at their current position —
  no more "only X works in the load screen" or "the first press does nothing".
  The old "stay blocked until centered" gate is gone (keys only).
- Rumble now always lands on the effective pad (Xbox-protocol pads don't expose
  motors to Android — enable "phone vibration" as the fallback).
- On-screen stale-state fix: a closed overlay can no longer pin the virtual stick
  over the physical one.

releases.body:
**Nixport v1.1.299-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> **The project is still being prepared.** This build was published by hand: the
> tag points at the current remote `main`, and the APK is built and signed with
> the same machine and key as the local v1.0.267-alpha release (upgrades install
> over it without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.0.267-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Player slots**: Player 1 = on-screen controls + one selected physical pad, merged.
  The in-game drawer (Input tab) now lists every physical pad under "Physical gamepads" —
  set one as Player 1, assign pads to Players 2-4, or unassign them. An explicit choice is
  remembered across sessions.
- **First input wins**: with no explicit choice, the first pad that actually produces
  input becomes Player 1. Phantom devices (e.g. HyperOS's `uinput-xiaomi`) no longer eat
  Player 1 and silence your Bluetooth pad in-game — the main fix of this build.
- **Rumble return path**: a game's rumble request travels back over NXP2 v3 and drives the
  pad's own motors (falls back to the phone's motor when the pad has none).

releases.name: Nixport v1.0.267-alpha
releases.body:
**Nixport v1.0.267-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> **The project is still being prepared.** The source code is not public yet — it will be open-sourced in [NixPort/nixport](https://github.com/zFitness/nixport) once the release is ready. What you get here today is the documentation plus a runnable APK.

**Install:** download `nixport.apk` from this release and install it on an ARM64 Android phone (Android 9 / API 28 or newer). The APK ships the Linux environment inside it and unpacks it on first run.

If the app is already installed, update from inside the app (Home). Note that this build is signed with a different key than the CI-published ones, so it may require uninstalling the previous build first.

**SHA-256 of `nixport.apk`:**
`9541187e23d823f1e883ad002c002093791437fc740544e370addbd9c1208817`

**Size:** 281,440,841 bytes

`nixport.json` next to the APK carries the same metadata (commit, build time, size, SHA-256) and is what the in-app updater reads.

emulators.description: 把自备的 Switch 游戏逐个移植到 Android 的兼容层，游戏自身代码在设备上运行。

releases.body:
## What this release fixes · 本版修复

**EN**

- Porting some games stopped at the "GLSLC capture" stage with a build error
  and produced nothing (Eastward and Tokyo Xanadu eX+ were reported). The
  capture works again: games that compile their shaders at run time port
  through now.
- Pressing "Update runtime" on a game's page rebuilt the runtime without the
  game's per-build tables, and Unreal-engine games crashed at startup
  afterwards (FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Octopath Traveler 0, DRAGON QUEST VII
  Reimagined). The rebuild carries the game's full build data now.
- The build page's progress reads correctly, and installing a game no longer
  retranslates every shader (@mijuu, #79).

**Before you update**: your games keep the runtime they have and play exactly
as before — the fixes take effect when you port again or press "Update
runtime". If a game of yours crashes at startup after a rebuild, press it once
more after updating: the game starts, and your saves were never at risk.

**中文**

- 一些游戏的移植停在"GLSLC capture"阶段并报构建错误、没有产物(已收到
  Eastward 与 Tokyo Xanadu eX+ 的报告)。现在可以正常通过:运行时自己编译
  着色器的游戏能移植了。
- 在游戏页面点"Update runtime"重建运行库时会丢掉游戏的 per-build 数据表,

### The assistant is in the app

The app carries an assistant now. It runs on the phone itself, in the same
Linux environment the porting tools run in, so no computer is involved. Ask
it in your own words - why a game crashed, why a port would not build, what
is in the library - and it reads the game's log, the build's output and the
library's state by itself. It answers in the language you write to it.

A game that misbehaves goes to a case worker: it opens a case file for that
game - the symptom, the cause, the fix it proposes - and its steps are
visible while it works. A code change waits until you say yes. The knowledge
it diagnoses with ships inside the app: over 400 upstream porting cases,
sorted by what you see, searchable and offline.

To talk to a model the assistant needs one of your own: the Settings tab
takes a provider, a model and a key, and the key stays on the phone.
Without a key, everything else in the app works exactly as before.

### Porting on the phone

A merged dump - one file holding the base game, its update and the DLC
together - now ports as its own version; it could pick the wrong patch or

### The gamepad and the touch stick

The face buttons of a controller are one choice now: by position (the Switch's
layout - X on top, Y on the left, A on the right, B at the bottom) or by what
the controller prints. It is set per controller in the gamepad center and takes
effect at once. The per-key rebinding is gone: it needed a capture flow and a
binding table, players got lost in it, and a rebound button took another key's
source away without anyone seeing why. The center's scope shows what the game
receives, so pressing a button is the test.

The controller's axes are read the way that controller reports them. The Xbox
family (a USB xpad, a Bluetooth XInput pad) puts its triggers on Z/RZ and its
right stick on RX/RY - the opposite of the usual layout - so those pads'
triggers never fired and their right stick never reached the game. The app now
works the roles out of the device's own ranges.

The touch stick starts where the thumb lands: the offset is taken from the
point the finger went down, so a thumb on the rim has output right away. A
small dead zone around that point, the rim is the full deflection, and the
right stick is finer at low speed.

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This build fixes the runtime build on the phone. If you have not imported the profiles package of v0.4.0-alpha01 yet, you still must: the app runs the games on the new host (0.4.0), and the old package's packs were built for the previous one. Import it in the environment check (the "manage" box).
- (中文) 本版修复了手机上的运行库构建。如果你还没有导入 v0.4.0-alpha01 的档案包，现在仍然必须导入：App 用新宿主(0.4.0)运行游戏，旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的。到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入。

## Fixed: the runtime a game needs on the phone builds again

The new host (0.4.0) checks every profile's picture - the screenshot the README shows - and looked for it in the app's own tool folder, where the pictures are not shipped: the build failed with "readme_image 'docs/images/...': no such file in the repository", and every game whose profile names a picture could not be rebuilt. The check now runs where the pictures are (a checkout of the repository), and the app's own copy leaves it out. Sixty games had a picture in their profile: all of them build now.

The fix is in the app, so the runtime on the phone is rebuilt as soon as the app is updated. Nothing to import for this one.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复:游戏在手机上需要的运行库又能构建了

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This release moves the packs onto a new host (0.4.0). After the app updates, you **must** import the new profiles package in the environment check (the "manage" box): the old package's packs were built for the previous host and will not work with this app. The app will remind you and point you there. Update the app first, then import the package - both steps are required.
- (中文) 本次更新更换了数据包运行的宿主(0.4.0)。更新 App 之后，**必须**到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入新的档案包:旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的，和新版 App 不匹配，无法正常使用。App 会主动提醒并指路。先更新 App，再导入档案包，两步都不能少。

## New games: NieR:Automata, Link's Awakening, Silver Pines

Three games join the profiles package:

- **NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition** - boots with update 1.0.3, and the map is drawn correctly after loading a save. Broader gameplay checks are still pending, so expect rough edges.
- **The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening** - playable on update 1.1.0, verified on a Lenovo TB323FU. It runs at a dynamic 30/60 fps by default; the stable-60 option stays off (it can judder on weaker chips). It needs the firmware files.
- **Silver Pines** - the v65536 update (1.0.1) plays, verified on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16).

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.3 - Course Editor Hotfix
releases.body:
## Fixes
- Correct complete-course snapshot content binding so metadata-only edits do not reuse an incompatible retained snapshot.
- Handle terminal disk-write refusals without trapping Course Edit in its save wait loop.
- Fix the host editor's remaining 64-node admission ceiling. The supported total remains 127 nodes, including forks.
- Restore Content Library layout previews for supported tracks above 64 nodes.
- Adapt native load, overwrite, and delete confirmations to long filenames while keeping normal-size text and the Yes/No controls in place.
- Size the Course Edit information panel dynamically to fit the track title, length, and node count.

## Save compatibility — read before updating
Close the game and back up the complete installation save/state set before updating, not only the cartridge `.sav` file.

This release writes version-2 `.gcs` snapshots and still reads version 1. Older builds cannot read version-2 snapshots or packages that contain them. Before downgrading, restore the complete matching pre-upgrade save/state backup. Keeping old snapshots alone is not sufficient.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix
releases.body:
## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.1 - The Small Improvements and Fixes Update
releases.body:
## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and `course-elements.gdxs`, `course-forks.gbs`, and
`course-settings.gks` together. Do not open snapshot-backed saves in an older executable.
The new, extended tracks that go above the original 64 node limit are not compatible with the original Expansion Kit or older tools.

## Course Edit

- Widen the native course information panel at a fixed size. Keep full 20-character names on
  one row and fit three-digit node counts without moving the buttons below it. Dynamic sizing
  is deferred.

- Raise the combined main-path and alternate-path control-point ceiling to **127**. Geometry,
  jump, effect, decoration, and junction budgets still apply; 127 points is not a guarantee
  that every layout fits.
- Add complete, content-bound save snapshots for extended courses and complete course/cup
  package sharing. Missing or mismatched required snapshot data is rejected rather than
  silently loading a truncated course.
- Keep both paths selectable after editor reload and save/reload. Show stored branch nodes

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.

## New platforms

Built from nx2 at `fdc7cdaf8df179775685d0afb57fca178f876a51`.

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 366 (7e2316d)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 316 (5a66c89)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.

releases.name: Beta 6.1
releases.body:
**Beta 6.1** 

**Fixed**
- Windows on ARM: fixed a crash while building the game code, and the black screen and missing text on Qualcomm's driver (#779).
- Adreno 7xx with Turnip: fixed black specks while moving.
- Mali with PanVK older than 26.1: fixed white triangles. Thanks to @wolfchimneyrock (#633).
- Frame pacing fixes (#811).
- Touch: tapping the title starts the game in every language, not just English (#863).
- Hint Sheet: no longer stuck on the Flying Rooster after you wake him in seeds where he isn't a randomized item (#822).
- Room shuffle: a doorway no longer leads back into its own room, door jumps after a dash or feather jump land correctly, and the spoiler log no longer crashes on copied rooms.
- Start screen: each Resolution choice shows its real size.
- Added 334 shader variants from players' logs, for less stutter the first time effects appear.

releases.name: Version 0.1.4
releases.body:
# Oblivion for Android 0.1.4

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.4.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).

## New
- GOG version supported: the GOG release of Oblivion 1.2.0.416 now works as well as the Steam one. Its game data is identical to Steam's, so it plays the same.

## Fixed
- 2 fps with the frame cap on fast phones (reported on a Snapdragon G1 Gen 2). The frame cap could "spin" the CPU instead of waiting, which dropped the game to about 2 fps with short bursts every few seconds.
- Physical keyboard and mouse: Keys now do only their normal PC action.
- Full-screen mode/black bar no longer shows on certain devices

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

releases.name: Version 0.1.3
releases.body:
# Oblivion for Android 0.1.3

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.3.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `e74c55c378825480eedb6b2c781946bc4bef3555`

## Fixed
- Mali GPUs: geometry no longer explodes into streaks on Mali GPUs (Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor, Kirin), which lack the clip-distance feature.

## Performance
- Each thread keeps its own cache of recently freed small blocks and reuses them without taking the global heap lock. In testing, an allocate-and-free went from about 34 ms to 5 ms. Freeing the same block twice is still detected and logged though.
- A thread that re-enters a lock it already holds now just counts up the way Windows does, instead of going through the real lock each time.
- Memory copies: the base memcpy routine, about 10% of all CPU, now runs as Android's native copy.
- The game reads the clock hundreds of thousands of times a second. QueryPerformanceCounter, GetTickCount and timeGetTime now read the processor's hardware timer instead of making a system call.
- A missing Data folder is now remembered after the first check - no repeated path search and log line each time.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

releases.name: Version 0.1.2

emulators.latest_body:
OpenSA2 0.1.0-alpha.7 adds four tweaks and settings that players asked for: Chao items you can give again and again, a longer homing attack, a text language setting, and on Android a choice of which controller is player 1 and player 2, plus a new look for the touch controls.

You must supply your own unmodified PC game installation: the version Steam sells and installs today. These downloads include recompiled game logic and the port's runtime. They contain no original game executable or assets.

### What's new

**Endless Chaos Drives and animals** (Tweaks, Chao). After a Chao takes a Chaos Drive or a small animal, the item is not used up: it drops, and you can pick it up and give it again. The stat points are the game's own and stay in your Chao save. Fruit is not covered. While the tweak is on, any item a Chao lets go of drops instead of being used up.

**Longer homing attack** (Tweaks, Gameplay). The homing attack locks on from about twice as far: 200 units instead of 100. The same longer reach applies to the game's other "a target is nearby" checks. On Windows and Linux, `SA2_HOMING_RANGE` in `game.env` sets the reach from 100 to 400.

releases.name: Marchwind64 HD 1.4
releases.body:
Marchwind64 的可选 HD 图片包，版本 HD 1.4，macOS、Windows、Linux、安卓通用（Switch 用下表里单独的一份），配 Marchwind64 0.5.4 或更新的应用使用。HD 包有自己的版本号，内容变了才发新版；有新版时游戏的更新检查会提示。

| 文件 | 大小 |
| --- | --- |
| `Marchwind64-HD-1.4.zip` | 636 MB |
| `Marchwind64-HD-1.4-switch.zip` | 1565 MB |

## 本版更新（HD 1.4）

### 地图机体图标

- **图标顶满原版的格子**：HD 图标原来四周各空出约 8%，看起来比原版小；现在按原版图标的外框等比放大，面积大多大了约两成，像素不混色。
- 高达Mk-Ⅱ和超级夺地者的图标重画。

### 机体立绘

- 超级夺地者的立绘重画。

### 战斗

- 补齐还缺的 15 种战斗天空配色：地球和月球的第二层远景，以及 13 种已有 HD 图的换色版。
- 多蒙、东方不败和阿尔伯特的生身战斗动作换成各自的图和配色；多蒙和东方不败的未命中动作原来配错成爆炸的图。
- 战斗查看器的「地球」场景有了缩略图和预览背景。

没变的：人物头像、其余机体立绘、场间背景、剧情世界地图和战术地图的底图。

**HD 1.4 要配 Marchwind64 0.5.4 或更新的版本**：生身战斗动作的第一帧由 0.5.4 的程序提前准备，「地球」场景也是 0.5.4 才有的。

## 安装 HD 包

1. 解压 `Marchwind64-HD-1.4.zip`，得到 `hd` 文件夹。
2. 放进用户目录：
   - macOS：`~/Library/Application Support/SRW64Recomp/hd`
   - Linux／Steam Deck：`~/.local/share/srw64-recomp/hd`
   - Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\SRW64Recomp\hd`

   也可以放在游戏所在的文件夹里，和 `Marchwind64.app`、`marchwind64.sh` 或 `Marchwind64.exe` 放在一起；两处都有时用用户目录里的。macOS 上放在应用旁边时，应用要先在访达里移动过一次（比如拖进「应用程序」），否则系统从别处运行一份副本，看不到旁边的 `hd`。
3. 打开应用即为 HD。F6 或设置窗口里的“图片”可以随时切回原版。

Android 不用手动解压：长按应用图标选「导入 HD 包」，或用 Marchwind64 打开下载的 zip。

更新时整个替换旧的 `hd` 文件夹。

releases.name: MOD: Original Characters' Battle Voices (AI) 1.0.5
releases.body:
Battle voices for SRW64's 12 original characters (Ark, Selain, Brad, Manami, Ehrlich, Rish, Kurtz, Aisha, Lawrence, Val-A, Avie-Lu, J-Ren): 843 battle lines, synthesized with Irodori-TTS. Not a real voice actor's voice. Needs Marchwind64 0.5.2 or later; drop the file on the game window to install it.

Changes since 1.0.4: six of Brad's lines are redone (two shouts, one misread word, and three finishing-move names that were shouted one syllable at a time and are now shouted as words). The other voices are the same. As before, one of Kurtz's roars ("ぬぅぅぅっ!") takes a single roar from the original disc voices as its source, converted to the AI voice with Seed-VC.

原创人物 12 人（阿克、塞蕾茵、布拉德、玛娜米、埃尔利希、利修、卡茨、艾夏、劳伦斯等）的 843 句战斗台词语音，用语音合成 Irodori-TTS 生成，不是真人声优的声音。需要 Marchwind64 0.5.2 或更新；把文件拖进游戏窗口即可安装。

相比 1.0.4：重做了布拉德的 6 句台词（两句喊声、一处读错的词，以及三句原先一个字一个字喊的必杀技名，现在按词连着喊）。其余语音没有变化。和之前一样，卡茨的「ぬぅぅぅっ!」这一声吼叫，是拿原版光盘语音里的一声吼叫作素材，用声音转换（Seed-VC）换成 AI 音色做成的。
