emulators.latest_body:
# Let's Go Launcher 0.2

This is the second release of Let's Go Launcher. More modifications are coming — this is just the beginning.

## What it is

Let's Go Launcher is an Android port of Pokémon Let's Go Eevee, based on letsgo-recomp. It runs the game natively on Android and includes:

- Its own NSP importer — import the game from your own NSP dump. The import runs as a foreground service, and if an import is interrupted, the data file is verified and rebuilt automatically.
- Data pack import — import a ready-made data pack (zip) instead of an NSP.
- Turnip drivers — install and try community Turnip Vulkan drivers, with automatic rollback if a driver fails.
- Touch controls and physical controllers — play with the on-screen controls or a connected gamepad.

## What's new in 0.2

- **Mali support** — the game now runs on Mali GPUs (Galaxy S20+ and other Exynos devices). The Vulkan runtime falls back to render passes when dynamic rendering is unavailable, uses EXT dynamic state, and decodes BC7/BC6H textures on the CPU when the GPU can't sample them. Characters and the world now render with full textures on Mali.

releases.name: TNRP Alpha 2.2.2
releases.body:
TNRP Alpha 2.2.2 — hotfix for Android.

Linux and Windows stay on Alpha 2.2.1: https://github.com/thebabyhippo303/nimbus-recompilation-project/releases/tag/alpha-2.2.1

# Nimbus Alpha 2.2.2 for Android

A second hotfix for Android. Linux and Windows stay on 2.2.1.

## Fixed

- **Phones that still showed "Nimbus could not start graphics" on 2.2.1** (for example some Helio G99 phones on Android 14) now start their games. On these phones Nimbus uses a second graphics path.
- Heads up: the second graphics path is slower than Vulkan, so games on those phones may run slower. Every other device stays on Vulkan.
- Every other device runs exactly as on 2.2.1.

## Good to know

- After updating, Nimbus prepares its shaders once more on the first start.
- Online play is unchanged: 2.2.2 on Android plays with 2.2, 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 on every platform.

## Updating

Install the 2.2.2 APK over 2.2 or 2.2.1. It updates in place and keeps your links and saves. Do not uninstall first.

Thanks to Velkooky on Reddit for finding and reporting this bug.

Gundam vs. Gundam NEXT PLUS would not boot on Linux and Windows — an audio package was missing from the 2.2 build. It's in now, and Gundam boots.

Everything else on Linux and Windows is identical to Alpha 2.2 — all 14 games and the same packs.

# Nimbus Alpha 2.2.1 for Android

A hotfix for Android. Linux and Windows are already on 2.2.1 and are unchanged.

## Fixed

- **Black screen, then back to the Library, when starting any game on some Android devices.** On these devices every game failed to start graphics. Games now start.
- If a device's graphics driver still cannot run Nimbus, the Library now says so and names the graphics device, where before it gave no message.

## Good to know

- After updating, Nimbus prepares its shaders once more. This takes a short while on the first start and does not happen again.
- Online play is unchanged: 2.2.1 on Android plays with 2.2 and 2.2.1 on every platform.

## Updating

Install the 2.2.1 APK over 2.2. It updates in place and keeps your links and saves. Do not uninstall first.

Thanks to Velkooky on Reddit for finding and reporting this bug.

Android ARM64 release candidate with corrected gameplay sizing. Gameplay uses
the largest available area at the original aspect ratio, while landscape gyro
play and touch controls remain available. This build also includes the verified
native startup callback records.

Android ARM64 experimental build with native coverage and the real recompiled BIOS. The Android APK is signed with the prior release certificate. Android runtime/device validation was skipped at the owner's request.

Removes an obsolete BIOS HLE workaround and uses the real recompiled BIOS by default.

Supply your own supported game ROM and GBA BIOS. ROMs, BIOS dumps, saves, and remembered settings are not included.

Source: 8e7a6e2e911a69ca1090f57bae2ab5d7bc7034b2
PR: https://github.com/mstan/WarioWareTwistedRecomp/pull/3

releases.name: v0.0.2
releases.body:
Updates the native engine and launcher, including callback discovery and guarded RAM/cartridge execution fixes. Each Windows package passed a clean-extraction, fresh-save 6,000-frame strict-static boot with zero dispatch misses, interpreted instructions, or healed functions. This covers the tested boot route; it does not certify every gameplay route.

Removes an obsolete BIOS HLE workaround and uses the real recompiled BIOS by default.

Supply your own supported game ROM and GBA BIOS. ROMs, BIOS dumps, saves, and remembered settings are not included.

Source: 8e7a6e2e911a69ca1090f57bae2ab5d7bc7034b2
PR: https://github.com/mstan/WarioWareTwistedRecomp/pull/3

releases.name: Android v0.0.4 — Native CPU and expanded microgame coverage
releases.body:
﻿Android now uses the expanded native CPU corpus by default, including the Spindex microgame callbacks and ROM-backed routines copied into RAM for interrupts, arithmetic, decompression and audio.

- Retains fixed landscape orientation when you turn the phone upside down, while motion controls continue to work.
- Includes the native corpus exercised across all 223 Spindex microgames on desktop: 600 frames each, zero dispatch misses and zero interpreted instructions in those sampled routes.
- The final ARM64 APK passes Android emulator startup and 14 representative microgames with zero interpreter fallback, plus windowed play, gyro input and seven orientation poses. QA and public APKs contain identical native code.

This remains an experimental release. Coverage describes tested routes; other paths may still use interpreter fallback. The recorded native/interpreter comparison differences and validation scope are documented in the repository.

emulators.latest_body:
The Sims 2 for Android **0.3.1-dev** improves Lua error handling, material creation, renderer diagnostics, texture conversion, and the launcher. Changes since **0.3-dev**, from signed source commit `a84f6585caca7a90afe140540714f879800c33bb`.

One APK includes **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The minimum requirements are now **Android 8.0 (API 26)** and **OpenGL ES 3.1**; the native Vulkan renderer accepts **Vulkan 1.0**. Game data must come from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. Android 8.0–8.1 and GLES 3.1-only devices still need further device testing.

## Stability and startup

- Fixed the embedded MSVC `setjmp/longjmp` implementation used by Lua: returning to an error handler now unwinds the actual native call stack as well as restoring guest state. The bridge covers all 34 original setjmp call sites and both longjmp epilogues.
- Handle nested and repeated Lua errors, restore exception state, and remove jump contexts when their function returns, a C++ handler unwinds past them, or their thread ends. A jump to a function that has already returned is diagnosed.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
One APK now supports both **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The port requires Android 10 or later, OpenGL ES 3.2, and game data from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. ARM32 also requires Thumb-2, NEON, and 4 KiB kernel pages. Android chooses the ABI, and the app unpacks the matching XZ-compressed engine on first use.

## Graphics and performance

- Fixed flickering and missing objects on Mali-G51 in OpenGL ES. The workaround defaults to on and can be changed in Advanced renderer settings. Fixed a related driver hang reproduced on Mali-T830.
- OpenGL ES compiles and links uncached shader programs in the background, reducing stalls when zooming out, rotating the camera, or changing floors.
- The in-game **Minimal Graphics** preset lowers 11 settings to reduce memory use. It saves the previous values, persists across restarts, and restores those values when switched off.
- **Android performance hints (ADPF) are off by default.** The launcher still lets you turn them on for the next game start.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.2-dev

- **Vulkan textures.** DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 now use the correct BC formats on drivers that support them. This fixes colored noise on terrain, roads, and trees seen on Adreno 735 with both the system Vulkan driver and Turnip.
- **OpenGL ES.** Fixed dynamic buffer updates that could corrupt neighborhood chooser panels and text on Adreno 650 and 735, and the neighborhood HUD on Adreno 650.
- **Vulkan UI scaling.** The APK now includes precompiled SPIR-V variants for FSR 1 UI scaling for all 81 pixel shader entries and the built-in fixed-function pixel shader. Shaders outside the library, including shaders used by some mods, can still be compiled on the device.
- **Shader coverage.** The bundled library grew from 194 to 380 captured shaders and from 215 to 408 entries, including sampler variants. The updated capture tool checks bytecode hashes and records sampler variants. A strict diagnostic mode and a library format check help verify coverage.

## Install or update

Download the APK below or check for updates in the launcher. This build supports ARM64 devices running Android 10 or later and requires compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection game files.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.1.2-dev

- **Graphics.** The port's own OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan 1.1 renderers handle Direct3D 9 calls. OpenGL ES is the default. Vulkan supports the system driver, bundled Turnip or PanVK on compatible devices, and imported drivers. DXVK has been removed.
- **Graphics settings.** Both renderers support render scaling, FXAA, MSAA, FSR 1 for the scene and interface, and the launcher’s ETC2 and ASTC texture cache. Existing FSR 3.1 selections switch to FSR 1.
- **PowerVR performance.** OpenGL ES buffer handling reduces severe frame-rate drops on affected PowerVR devices.
- **Lower-latency audio.** The game's EA SND mixer outputs directly to Android AAudio. DirectSound emulation has been removed.
- **Mods folder.** The launcher shows the folder for .package mods and lets you copy its path. Mods in subfolders are supported.
- **Touch input.** The on-screen keyboard opens when you tap previously blocked text fields, including pet names.
- **Loading screens.** Startup captions and town and lot loading animations follow the original game timing.

## Install or update

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.1.2-dev
releases.body:
Development release for the Android ARM64 port of The Sims 2 Legacy Collection. The supported PC source is Steam build 18015495. See the [build and installation guide](https://github.com/phys-winner/pc_decomp_ts2/blob/f2b7cce5/readme.md) for requirements and instructions.

### Graphics and diagnostics

- OpenGL ES is now the default renderer. An explicitly selected renderer takes priority when it is available.
- Added DXVK with Mesa PanVK for compatible ARM Mali and Immortalis GPUs. The launcher checks the active driver and its Vulkan 1.3 capabilities, and supports importing a custom PanVK driver. The bundled kbase driver requires 4 KiB kernel pages. On Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia) and TB373FU, PanVK uses linear buffers to address frame corruption.
- Added a live FPS counter and frame-time graph across renderers. The extended view shows system, GPU, memory, battery, thermal, and display information where Android makes it available.
- Improved Android surface handling in OpenGL ES and DXVK, including EGL recovery after a failed window bind. Added validation for shader bytecode, D3DX constant tables, GLSL generation, and texture dimensions and row pitches.

## Somniel v0.1.7a

**A small update: a way to save a log of what went wrong, so crashes and loading-screen hangs can be tracked down.**

### New
- **Save diagnostic log.** A new row in the sidebar's main page saves the game's log to `Downloads/somniel_logs` in one
  tap. Do this before closing the game if it is stuck or misbehaving.
- **Asks to save the log after a crash or freeze.** When the game is opened again after it crashed or stopped
  responding (not after you simply swiped it away), it asks whether to save the log of that run to the same folder.
  Choose *Save log*; nothing is sent anywhere, the file just waits in your Downloads folder.
- The audio-failure log from v0.1.7 now goes to the same `somniel_logs` folder (it used to be `Somniel_log`).

### Bug reports
From now on **every crash or hang report needs the saved log attached** (the `.txt` from `Downloads/somniel_logs`).
Without it there is usually no way to tell what happened on a GPU we cannot test.

### Download
`Somniel-0.1.7a.apk` (6.4 MB)

SHA-256: `af029030c21a6821677a74dbef09029608a96de29bcb67f948b31943225013fb`

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.7
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.7

**Save export, customisable on-screen controls, dynamic resolution, Skip intro, a redesigned sidebar, and a fix for
missing sound.**

### New
- **Export saves.** The sidebar's *Import / Export Saves...* (was *Import saves...*) can now also export: all your saves
  go into one `.zip` wherever you choose, and the game keeps running. The file is checked after it is written, and it
  imports again as it is.
- **Customisable on-screen controls** (sidebar, *On-screen controls*):
  - **Size** (50% to 150%) and **Opacity** (20% to 100%) sliders.
  - **Edit layout**: drag any control (left stick, D-pad, right stick, A/B/X/Y, Minus/Plus, ZL/L, R/ZR) to where it
    suits you, tap one and use *Smaller* / *Bigger* to resize just that one, *Reset* for one or all. Back finishes.
  - **Reset layout** puts every control back (size and opacity are kept). Layouts are saved on the device.
- **Dynamic resolution** (on by default, checkbox under the render scale): when frames keep missing your frame rate,
  the resolution steps down in 5% steps, at most 20% below the render scale you chose, and climbs back when there is
  room again. It never goes above your choice.

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.6
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.6

**Dynamic game speed, a redesigned on-screen gamepad, and better telemetry.**

### New
- **Dynamic game speed.** The game's speed now follows the frame rate you actually get, so walking, cursor and game time
  stay at normal speed when your device dips below the frame rate you chose. It scales down to a floor of 20 fps.
  Applies to the hub walk speed, world-map walking and all per-frame game logic.
- **Redesigned on-screen gamepad** (phones).

### Improved
- **Telemetry** (only if you opted in to Share anonymous data): hitch reports now include a coarse reason for each slow
  frame, and time spent in the background is no longer counted. Still no names, accounts, IPs, paths or saves.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy (or use **Check for updates**). **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game
  data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

### Download
`Somniel-0.1.6.apk` (6.4 MB)

SHA-256: `85d69fda4469c84c6092bb0f2dfd3dc46de4759f2a96c7ec7054ba4b187e51d5`

releases.body:

**Dual-screen companion, save import, in-app updates, and smoother battle starts.**

### New
- **Dual-screen companion.** On handhelds with a second screen, the bottom screen now shows a live touch companion:

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.4
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.4

**A smoother Somniel on Mali GPUs, far fewer stutters, and a working anti-aliasing switch.**

### New
- **Hidden object culling** (Graphics page): skips objects that are completely hidden behind walls. On a Dimensity 7300 (Mali-G615 MC2) the
  Somniel shops went from about 25 fps to a steady 29–30 fps. **Auto** (the default)
  turns it on for Mali GPUs only, because it made a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740) slower in testing.

### Fixed
- **Stutters while walking around the Somniel.** Shaders the game had already prepared were being prepared again,
  causing pauses of up to half a second. Walking the Somniel Plaza now has no pause longer than about 50 ms.
  This is repaired automatically the first time you start v0.1.4.
- **Anti-aliasing Off now works in the Somniel.** Before, it only took effect on the battle map. Turning it off gives
  about 2 fps more in busy spots on Mali GPUs.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy. **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

### Download
`Somniel-0.1.4.apk` (5.5 MB)

releases.name: Eastward Custom v1.1.9 (Eksperimen)
releases.body:
## Eastward Custom v1.1.9 (Eksperimen)

> Build ini ditandai sebagai **Pre-release (Eksperimen)** untuk pengujian komunitas (tetap bisa kembali ke rilis stabil `v1.1.8` jika ada kendala di HP tertentu).

### Eksperimen Optimasi Performa & FPS Lock (MediaTek Helio G80/G88/G99 & Snapdragon)
- **Bebas Lock 30 FPS saat berjalan (`DM_VK_MAILBOX=1`)**: Swapchain Android memprioritaskan `VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR` lalu `FIFO_RELAXED_KHR` (fallback `FIFO_KHR`) dan memisahkan `VkPresentTimesInfoGOOGLE` saat mode ini aktif, agar frame `17–32 ms` tidak langsung dipaksa turun ke `30 FPS` saat berjalan atau pindah area. Dapat di-toggle via **Bebas Lock 30fps (Eksperimen)**.
- **Wakeup Present Instan (`ALooper_wake`) & Skip Clear Penuh**: Thread present dibangunkan langsung saat frame siap (`mtl_present` -> `front_android_wake`) sehingga mengurangi jeda polling `ALooper_pollOnce(4)`, dan melewati clear swapchain saat gambar mengisi layar penuh.

releases.name: Eastward Custom v1.1.8 (Glitch-Free + Clean Settings)
releases.body:
## Eastward Custom v1.1.8 (Glitch Fix + Simplified Display & Pixel Quality Settings)

### Perbaikan Glitch Visual (1.1.7 dibatalkan / dihapus)
- **Glitch bintik merah di layar judul & kotak/segitiga hitam di karakter/musuh diperbaiki total**: penyebabnya di 1.1.7 adalah penandaan RelaxedPrecision (FP16) pada OpLoad dari Uniform & Input yang mengganggu kalkulasi alpha/kedalaman/bloom. Sekarang Uniform & Input tetap dijaga pada **FP32 penuh**, sementara aritmatika internal & variabel lokal tetap memakai jalur cepat FP16 (teruji langsung di Adreno 610: 0 glitch dan ~40-44 fps di scene berat Dig Site dengan resolusi 100% tajam).

### Penyederhanaan Pengaturan (Auto-Chipset Bekerja Otomatis di Balik Layar)
- **Pengaturan internal chipset yang sudah terdeteksi otomatis tidak lagi membingungkan menu**: *CPU Core Topology (DM_VK_PIN)*, *CPU Boost UClamp*, *Adreno GPU Clock Floor*, *TBDR Clear LoadOp*, *Descriptor Reuse*, *Async Shader Compile*, *Threaded Vulkan Recorder*, *Render Pass Batch*, *Display Timing Sync*, dan *Precise SPIR-V Float* sekarang otomatis dikonfigurasi sesuai GPU/CPU/Android HP Anda.
- **Tampilan Setting sekarang fokus dan jelas**:
  - **Resolusi (720p / 1080p)**

releases.name: Eastward Custom v1.1.5
releases.body:
Performance & GPU/CPU throughput optimizations for Snapdragon Adreno (such as SD680/685 Adreno 610) and MediaTek/Exynos Mali devices.

### Optimizations in v1.1.5
- **Native -O2 Build (CMakeLists.txt):** Upgraded dmcore (HLE, NVN command decode, dirty tracking, texture deswizzle) and dmhost_app from -O1 to -O2 while keeping full ARMv8.0-A compatibility.
- **Adreno KGSL GPU Clock Floor (DM_VK_GPU_FLOOR):** Added UI control & Auto-Tune (85% default on Adreno, 100% in Performance profile) to prevent Adreno GMU/DCVS from downclocking between CPU chunks.
- **FP16 Fragment Shader Math (DM_VK_MALI_FP16):** Enabled safe RelaxedPrecision color/lighting math for both Mali and Adreno 6xx+ GPUs (while preserving FP32 texture UVs/coordinates).
- **TBDR Render Pass Batching (DM_VK_MID_DRAWS):** Tuned to 256 (512 in Performance) to cut unnecessary mobile GMEM tile load/store reloads.
- **Threaded Vulkan Recorder (DM_VK_RECORDER):** Offloads kCmd* recording to a dedicated worker thread on 4+ core CPUs.

releases.name: Eastward Custom v1.1.4
releases.body:
Fix silent Force Close (SIGILL) on ARMv8.0-A devices without LSE atomics (e.g. Snapdragon 680/685 / Cortex-A73/A53) and add dynamic page-size handling for 16 KB page Android 15/16 kernels.

### Changes in v1.1.4
- **ARMv8.0-A Compatibility:** Compiled dmcore & t_nvn with -march=armv8-a (outline atomics with runtime LSE detection) and lowered stadd LSE assembly in nvn_entry.S / nvn_thunks.S to ARMv8.0 LL/SC loops via asm_elf.py.
- **16 KB Page-Size Safety:** Updated dm_slots_thread_init() in plat_android.c to align slot & guard pages dynamically with getpagesize().
- **Version:** v1.1.4 (versionCode 10).

emulators.latest_body:
## 更新内容

### ✨ 新功能与本地游戏库升级
- **多级子目录递归扫描**：各平台目录支持最多 3 级子目录扫描（自动跳过媒体/隐藏目录、`.nomedia` / `.pocketdeckignore` 与符号链接循环），支持跨目录 `.m3u` 与分目录多盘聚合
- **主流本地封面与元数据规范兼容**：完整兼容 `gamelist.xml`、`metadata.pegasus.txt` / `metadata.txt` 以及 Pegasus / ES-DE / Miyoo / OnionOS / RetroArch 常见本地封面目录与命名后缀
- **本地封面零主线程 I/O 与本地优先**：所有本地封面在后台扫描与目录/文件变更时预扫描并持久化至 V4 二进制缓存，滚动期间零磁盘访问；存在本地封面时默认优先显示本地图，不再重复请求远端封面（优先级：自定义封面 → 手动远端选图 → 本地封面 → 自动刮削缓存）
- **App 与 Web 手动选图支持本地图片**：手动刮削与编辑页支持在离线状态下检索并选用本地候选封面；Web 管理端同步支持浏览与选用掌机本地封面（新增 `/api/local-cover` 路径边界校验接口）

### 🎨 界面交互优化
- **连通性测试与高清大图预览**：服务连通性测试内联融合至刮削源列表，游戏详情页与手动刮削弹窗统一支持全屏高清封面大图预览浮层

### 🛠️ 兼容性与问题修复
- **模拟器启动与磁盘格式兼容**：支持自动识别 PSX2PSP PBP 标题与平台、修复 PPSSPP 大写扩展名与 Android 11+ `FileProvider` `content://` 启动兼容，默认优先 RetroArch PCSX ReARMed，并自动忽略 `.csz` 辅助文件
- **文本查看器编码自适应**：App 与 Web 文本查看器自动识别 GBK / Big5 / Shift_JIS / UTF-16 编码，解决中文与日文攻略/说明乱码
- **压缩包解压体验优化**：RAR 压缩包解压支持实时流式进度上报

### ✨ 新功能与交互升级
- **默认外观焕新**：将「星海漫游」设为默认背景主题并置顶，将「悬浮磨砂岛」设为默认导航栏样式（原默认样式更名为「经典通透」作为第二选项）
- **批量刮削任务弹窗重构**：设置页点击先预览待刮削 / 缺封面 / 缺信息明细再确认开始；运行中隐藏右上角关闭按钮消除歧义，点击「终止任务」立即锁定为「正在终止…」防连点；结束态支持直达「查看日志」与「继续刮削」
- **全局弹窗键盘避让与手动搜索优化**：`DialogPanelCard` 统一支持软键盘弹起平滑上移、收起平滑复位；手动搜索刮削提示词常驻（支持触屏与 3 级手柄焦点流），新增清空与收起键盘快捷按钮
- **服务连通性测试**：在「设置 → 刮削 → 操作」新增并发服务连通性检测，一键查看各刮削源与更新服务在当前网络下的可达性与延迟

### 🛡️ 稳定性、网络容错与性能优化
- **网络可用性与离线提示**：完善 Wi-Fi / 移动网络（SIM）在线判定，为批量刮削、手动搜索、Web 网页管理及掌机快传补齐离线 / 未连局域网提示
- **刮削容错增强**：新增 `HostCircuitBreaker` 域名熔断保护、扩展 `cjk_aliases` 中文别名词库与封面回退机制
- **性能与内存优化**：优化冷启动 `offline_db` 预载与多平台并发控制，修复顶栏 60fps 空转动画，离线库 TSV 解析改用 `indexOf` 零临时列表切片（保持 11.2 MB 轻量体积）

releases.name: PocketDeck v0.6.8
releases.body:
## 更新内容（相对 v0.6.7）

• **立体扇形（CoverFlow）快滚流畅度大幅优化**：移除 `CoverFlowStage` 冗余参数消除快滚期双重重组，并为默认封面标题接入 2D 离屏纹理缓存（`CompositingStrategy.Offscreen`），在保留无封面卡片标题显示的同时消除 3D 透视文字光栅化卡顿。
• **手柄快捷键方案重构与底栏图标升级**：调整默认键位（`A` / 点击封面查看详情、`START` 直接启动游戏、`X` 切换收藏、`SELECT` 打开应用列表、`B` 纯返回，同步更新设置页键位说明），并将 `BottomBar` 快捷键提示替换为统一风格的矢量图标。
• **核心性能与刮削准确率优化**：完成 P0/P1 性能瓶颈治理、封面与元数据刮削准确率提升，以及多视图交互流畅度与 UI 细节规范化升级。
• **画廊与立体扇形元数据展示完善**：恢复快滚期间底部元数据实时更新，并在画廊视图（`GalleryView`）底部信息胶囊中补齐游戏类型（`genre`）展示。

releases.name: PocketDeck v0.6.7
releases.body:
## 更新内容（相对 v0.6.6）

• **Web 端 SSE 实时刮削任务管理**：通过 SSE `scrape_progress` 事件实时同步掌机端刮削进度（建连即推、状态切换即时推、运行中 250ms 节流）；合并为单一悬浮刮削任务面板，支持查看当前进度/已更新/未匹配统计、随时停止、重新刮削、最小化胶囊恢复、查看实时日志，并针对手机浏览器视口自适应全宽展示。
• **静态资源内容哈希 ETag 缓存控制**：Web 控制台 `app.js` / `style.css` / `login.js` / `login.css` 改用进程内缓存的 SHA-256 内容摘要作为 `ETag`，热更或版本升级后自动失效旧浏览器缓存。
• **后台运行与熄屏电源策略**：恢复尊重系统默认自动熄屏时间，仅在刮削任务或 Web/快传服务开启时按需保持亮屏；为 Web 服务与局域网快传接入 `ForegroundService`（含锁屏后台 `PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK` 与 `WifiLock`）。
• **新增 4 种桌面视图模式与滚动修复**：支持 `CoverFlow`（3D 透视轮播）、`Hero`（焦聚大图+胶片条）、`Arc Wheel`（弧形转盘）、`Collector Shelf`（实木收藏柜），并优化 4 种视图重组性能与 `Apps` 页面首尾行方向键滚动裁切问题。

releases.name: v0.6.6
releases.body:
## 更新内容（相对 v0.6.5）

• 修复升级兼容性崩溃：为 `LocalPrefsStore` 增加 `PrefsValueKind` 运行时类型校验与旧版 NUL 分隔 `Set<String>` 映射的无损兼容读取，解决老版本升级后进入游戏库/应用时 `UserStore.toUserData` 触发 `ClassCastException` 闪退问题；同步修复 `CoverSource` 后台初始化协程竞态 NPE。
• 存储与并发加固：重设计 `ScrapeDatabase` v1 schema 与版本化 `user_prefs.json`；加固 SSE 写入通道、PIN 校验超时、LocalSend 锁范围与刮削取消逻辑。
• Web 管理端文件安全加固：限制 `auto-create-platforms` 禁止越权将存储根目录或敏感目录加入 `romDirs`；限制 `/api/files/text` 仅可写可编辑纯文本；`here` 模式解压不静默覆写已有文件并跳过隐藏点文件，统一规范 Web 文件名校验。

## P4GP 0.5.7

Versión estable pública de P4G-Android-Plus basada en Persona 4 Golden Android. Conserva el proyecto y el historial de su repositorio de origen, con identidad de aplicación independiente para instalarla junto a otros ports.

### Cambios incluidos desde el proyecto original

- Paquete Android independiente `io.github.synndras.p4gp`, nombre visible P4GP y recursos de marca propios.
- Launcher rediseñado con identidad visual Persona 4 Golden, fondo y recursos CRT, distribución panorámica adaptable y ajustes rápidos.
- Navegación del launcher por categorías con L1/R1; navegación de las opciones del submenú con el D-pad y gamepad.
- Categoría «Más opciones» para opciones adicionales y botón independiente de créditos.
- Créditos a nxdevxz, Brandon04Gonzalez, Chakeyy y synndras.
- Aviso en el launcher cuando se publica una actualización nueva.
- Menú de pausa nativo con estilo P4G, reanudar y salir, categorías de ajustes, controles táctiles y navegación por gamepad; L1/R1 cambia de categoría y el D-pad recorre las opciones.

emulators.summary: Native Android port of Castlevania: Belmont's Curse for the Retroid Pocket Flip 2. Early version. Bring your own extracted game files.
emulators.latest_body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.4.0
releases.body:
## Save report and update notices

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/castlevania-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

## Installing

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.3.0
releases.body:
## Full screen, without Android's bars

- **Android's navigation bar no longer stays on top of the game.** With three-button navigation (or a visible gesture bar) the bar at the bottom of the screen covered part of the image. The app now hides the system bars while the game runs; swipe in from an edge to bring them up for a moment. Thanks to the player who reported it on a Retroid Pocket 5; it was reproduced and checked on the Flip 2.
- The settings panel opens as before: swipe left from the right half of the screen.
- To keep the bars on screen, create an empty file named `con_barras_sistema` in the game's data folder.

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/castlevania-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

## En español

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.body:
## What's new

- **TV mode.** A new switch in the settings panel makes the game run as it does on a TV: the scene renders at 1344×756 instead of 896×504 and the game outputs a full 1080p, so the port no longer has to upscale it. It still holds 60 fps on the Flip 2 (GPU at ~78 %). The controller is then seen as a single wireless controller, which is what the game expects on a TV. The switch takes effect the next time you open the app; an empty `modo_tv` file in the game folder does the same.
- **Bluetooth and USB controllers fixed.** The Retroid's system re-creates every external controller with the device's own IDs, so the port took a DualSense (or any other pad) for the built-in one and, in Retro mode, swapped its buttons. Now the built-in controller is recognised by its name and every other controller is read by position, like on the game's original console: the bottom button is B, whatever mode the device is in.

## Installing

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.1.0
releases.body:
## First public release

A native Android port of the console version of **Castlevania: Belmont's Curse** for the **Retroid Pocket 5** and the **Retroid Pocket Flip 2**, running from your own copy of the game.

- **Playable, early.** Tested on the Flip 2 from the title screen into the prologue (the Paris harbour and the first rooms of the sewers) at 60 fps. It has not been played through yet, so later areas may still show problems.
- **Setup screen.** The app asks for the folder with your extracted game files, checks them and starts the game; it is not tied to one game version (prepared with 1.1.0).
- **Controller modes.** In both of the Retroid's modes (Xbox and Retro) every button does what the button in that same place does on the game's original console, and you can switch modes while the game is running.
- **Settings panel.** Swipe in from the right edge of the screen to slide out a panel with the FPS counter switch and *Change folder*.
- **Straight into the game.** After the first run the app starts the game directly; *Change folder* in the panel, or opening the app twice in a row (within ten seconds), brings the folder screen back.

emulators.summary: Native Android port of Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition for the Retroid Pocket Flip 2. Bring your own extracted game files.
emulators.latest_body:
## Runtime update (no visible change in this port)

This release carries a fix from the Catherine port's runtime, which both ports share.

Some games bind a block of shader constants that is shorter than what their shader actually reads. On the console the bytes just past the block are the next bytes of the game's own structure; the port was filling them with zeros. It now copies them from the game's memory up to the next 16-byte boundary and keeps zeros beyond that.

**Nothing changes in Xenoblade: its G-buffer vertex shader reads up to 368 bytes with 256 bound, and 256 is already a multiple of 16, so it keeps getting zeros — exactly as before.** Re-verified on the Flip 2 with a copy of the save: characters whole (Shulk with the Monado, the party), 30.1 fps in battle, saves untouched.

## En español

Esta versión trae un arreglo del runtime que comparte con el port de Catherine.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.body:
## Sharper 3D

- **The 3D image is upscaled with AMD FSR 1 before the game adds its interface.** The game draws its 3D at a dynamic resolution (for example 704×416 in handheld mode) and stretched it to its 720p window with a simple filter; on the Flip 2 that 720p image was then stretched again to the 1080p screen. Now FSR rebuilds the 3D at 720p first, and the step to 1080p sharpens instead of only stretching. The interface is untouched. The difference is largest in TV mode, where the 3D is narrowest.
- It costs about 2.8 ms of GPU per frame and turns itself off for a moment when a heavy scene would not fit in the 30 fps frame. Measured on the Flip 2 in the open field: 30 fps in handheld and TV mode.
- To get the previous image, create an empty file named `sin_fsr_escena` in the game's data folder (it takes effect while the game runs).

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

## What's new

- **Bluetooth and USB controllers fixed.** The Retroid's system re-creates every external controller with the device's own IDs, so the port took a DualSense (or any other pad) for the built-in one and, in Retro mode, swapped its buttons. releases.body:
## What's new

- **Controller modes.** The face buttons now follow the Retroid's controller mode on their own. In both modes (Xbox and Retro) every button does what the button in that same place does on the game's original console: B at the bottom, A on the right, X on top, Y on the left. You can switch modes from the quick settings while the game is running. Before this update the Retro mode came out with A/B and X/Y swapped.

- **Other controllers** are read by position. If one comes out swapped, an empty file named `botones_xbox` or `botones_retro` in the game folder forces a layout.

emulators.summary: Native Android port of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 for the Retroid Pocket Flip 2. Early version. Bring your own extracted game files.
emulators.latest_body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

A native Android port of the console version of **Xenoblade Chronicles 3** for the **Retroid Pocket 5** and the **Retroid Pocket Flip 2**, running from your own copy of the game.

# FFRS v1.1.4 发布说明

## 版本信息
- 版本号：`v1.1.4`（`versionCode: 84`）
- 安装包：`FFRS-1.1.4-universal.apk`
- 包名：`org.ffrs.gamewindow`
- 架构：`arm64-v8a`（通用版，适配高通骁龙与联发科天玑设备）

## 更新内容
1. **修复战斗与计算着色器调度时的 `SIGSEGV` 空指针闪退**
   - 定位并修复 `dispatch()` / `draw()` 在准备描述符期间触发 `resolve_pending()` 同步写回时，当前记录槽位被提前回收导致 `d.entry` 被置空并在 `PipelineDefinition::view()` 触发 `SIGSEGV`（`fa=0x10`）的问题；改为在描述符准备完成后再绑定至当前录制槽位，并在槽位切换后刷新命令缓冲句柄。

   - 包含手机/平板自适应虚拟按键默认布局、`vcache` 显存块复用、骁龙 8 至尊版 / Gen 5 通用 `ordered_buffer_clear` 与双超大核亲和性适配、画质与帧率菜单及 Switch v1.0.1 官方 5 项金手指。

   - 若此前曾手动保存过按键布局，可在菜单「编辑按键布局」中点击「重置」应用新的默认布局。

   - 骁龙 8 至尊版 / 第五代骁龙 8 至尊版（`SM8750` / `SM8850`）通用 `ordered_buffer_clear` 与双超大核亲和性适配。

## 版本信息

## 更新内容
1. **骁龙 8 至尊版 / 第五代骁龙 8 至尊版（`SM8750` / `SM8850`）深度适配优化**
   - 放开高通 Adreno 设备的 `ordered_buffer_clear`（GPU 异步缓冲区清零）策略，不再局限于少数特定机型与驱动版本白名单，消除未列入白名单机型在战斗及大地图/飞空艇场景中每帧触发 `OP_CLEAR_BUF` 同步等待 GPU 导致的严重掉帧。
   - 修复多颗同频超大核架构（2 颗超大核 + 6 颗性能核）下的 CPU 亲和性检测逻辑，避免渲染工作线程被误判为无异构超大核而被系统调度移出超大核集群。
   - 在设备档位识别中显式纳入 `SM8850`，默认以 `1080p / 60 FPS` 旗舰配置运行（仍可在游戏内菜单随时切换 `720p / 1080p` 与 `30 / 40 / 60 FPS`）。
2. **保留 `v1.1.0` 全部特性**
   - 包含 Stage D 通用渲染/描述符/写入回优化、画质与帧率实时切换菜单、Switch v1.0.1 官方 5 项金手指及对称紧凑版默认触控布局。

## 使用提示
- 与 `v1.1.0` 覆盖安装即可，原有存档与设置不受影响。
- 若部分高负载战斗或大地图场景出现温控降频，可在游戏内菜单 **「画质与帧率」** 中将分辨率调至 `720p` 或适当调整帧率上限。

releases.name: 1.1.0 · 全平台通用帧率优化基线版（含画质帧率设置 / 金手指 / 对称紧凑按键布局）
releases.body:
# FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE · Android 原生移植版 v1.1.0 发布说明

- **版本号**：`v1.1.0`（`versionCode=80`，`org.ffrs.gamewindow`）
- **通用安装包**：`FFRS-1.1.0-universal.apk`（`arm64-v8a`，全平台通用）

---

## 本版本主要更新

### 1. 通用性能优化（骁龙 / 天玑全平台适用）
- **描述符与同步热路径优化**：新增图形 `PushMemo` 负载缓存、`PushMemoTexel` 原地刷新与 `SlotSets` 惰性分配，大幅降低重复描述符构建开销；扩大 `push_memo_map` 容量上限至 `32768`，避免复杂大场景频繁整表清空。
- **瞬态着色器自适应旁路**：新增 `PushMemoShaderState` 机制，自动识别连续未命中的瞬态着色器并临时旁路查表，减少无效哈希计算。
- **屏障与状态查询精简**：收窄 `texel` 与 `compute_barrier()` 管线屏障，合并 `pending_view()` 单趟重叠检查，缓存 `VkFormatProperties3` 并跳过只读纹理的重复 `prepare_read`。
- **洞窟场景闪烁修复**：修复洞窟路段左右移动时偶发的右半屏隔帧闪烁问题，保持全场景画面完整稳定输出。

### 2. 完整内置功能
- **画质与帧率设置**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **画质与帧率**）：
  - **帧率上限**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 30 FPS / 40 FPS / 60 FPS`，调节后实时生效，无需重启。
  - **画面输出档位**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 720p 输出 / 1080p 输出`，保存并重开游戏后生效。
- **内置中文金手指**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **金手指**，勾选保存并重启生效）：
  - 移动速度 2 倍
  - 不遇敌（按住 R3 临时恢复正常）
  - 战斗掉落率 100%
  - 战斗经验值 2 倍
  - 战斗金币 2 倍
  - 角色存档修改

### 3. 虚拟手柄默认布局优化
- 缩小肩键（`L1/L2/R1/R2`）与功能键（`- / +`）尺寸，将肩键下移至左右中侧边缘，避免遮挡左上角帧率/任务信息与右上角小地图。
- 对称对齐左右摇杆、`L3/R3`、十字键与 `A/B/X/Y` 菱形按键间距，默认布局更紧凑清晰（仍支持在「编辑按键布局」中自由微调或重置）。

---

## 安装与使用提示
- 请确保设备存储根目录已放置合法导出的游戏数据目录 `/sdcard/FFRS`。

First public Android release of Project Gotham Racing 4 (ARM64, Vulkan).

### Highlights
- **Standalone Launcher:** no PC or ADB needed — pick an extracted game folder (with \default.xex\) or a \.iso\ Xbox 360 disc image directly on your phone.

- **Graphics & Controls:** one-tap presets (*Performance 720p*, *Compatible*, *High Quality*), resolution scale, VSync, FPS/thermal overlay, and touch controls toggle/opacity for gamepads.

> **Note:** No game files are included. Provide your own legal dump of the base Xbox 360 disc (\4D5307F9\).

emulators.summary: A cycle-accurate 6502-family emulator in Rust: NES/Famicom, Apple II, Atari 2600 & 7800, Commander X16, with a game library on desktop, Android TV and the web.
emulators.latest_body:
Open Bus 0.4.7 brings the Commander X16 to phones and tablets, with a keyboard in portrait and a SNES pad in landscape, gives the X16 all its function keys and proper SNES controllers everywhere, and tidies up Android.

## What's new

- **The X16 on a phone or tablet.** Hold it upright for a keyboard: Android's own, with autocorrect and suggestions off, and rows of Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, the arrows, Home/End, Page Up/Down and Delete/Insert above it. Ctrl and Alt are sticky, so Ctrl then C sends Ctrl+C; tap twice to hold them. Fn brings up F1 to F12. Turn it sideways for a SNES pad.
- **Hide controls.** The pause menu on a touch screen can hide the on-screen controls for the rest of the game, and show them again.
- **The X16's F-keys are its own.** On the X16, and on the other computers that use the whole keyboard (Skink and BASIC), F1 to F12 go to the machine, so programs like busterm get them all. Open Bus's own keys move behind Ctrl+Shift: Ctrl+Shift+F1 opens the menu, Ctrl+Shift+F2 saves a state, and so on.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.6
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.6 lets you install the web version as an app that opens without the internet, and fixes a way to get stuck in a game on Android phones.

## What's new

- **Install the web version as an app.** At https://obus.tuxprint.com/, Chrome and Edge offer to install Open Bus with its own window and icon, and Settings → Library has an Install button where your browser supports it. On iPhone, use Share → Add to Home Screen.
- **The web version works offline.** Once it's been opened, it opens again with no internet connection. It still picks up updates whenever you're online.
- **Your games stay put in the browser.** When you first add a game, the page asks the browser not to clear your games when it runs low on space.

## Fixed

- **Stuck in the emulator's menu on an Android phone.** Pressing Select and Start together on the on-screen controls opened a menu the on-screen buttons couldn't work, so the only way out was to quit the game. On-screen Select and Start now go to the game. A gamepad's Select and Start still open the menu, and Back still pauses.

## Downloads

| System                 | File                        |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------- |

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.5
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.5 makes the Android app work on phones and tablets, with on-screen controls for NES games, and keeps the Commander X16's clock on time.

## What's new

- **On-screen controls for NES games** on a phone or tablet with no gamepad: a D-pad, A and B, Select and Start. They hide when a gamepad connects and come back when it disconnects.
- **Move controls.** Drag each piece where you want it, make them bigger or smaller, turn the vibration off, or put B higher than A. Your layout is kept.
- **A pause menu for touch screens.** Back opens it: Resume, Save state, Load state, Reset, Move controls and Quit. Before this, there was no way out of a game on a phone without a gamepad.
- **The library on phones** stays clear of the status bar, navigation bar, camera cutout and on-screen keyboard. Games are always fullscreen.
- **The sidebar with a gamepad.** On a phone, opening the sidebar moves the gamepad's selection into it.

## Fixed

- **A TV remote's OK** stopped choosing in the menus if you bound A to something else, and didn't work in the X16's menu at all. It now always works in the menus, whatever the controls are set to.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.4
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.4 gives the Commander X16's shelf its two standing tiles, and fixes busterm going missing or greyed out.

## What's new

- **The X16's shelf starts with the X16 and busterm.** Commander X16 (BASIC) is always the first tile and busterm the second, each with its own cover, whatever order the shelf is sorted in.
- **busterm in your own folders is left alone.** Open Bus keeps its own copy of busterm and keeps it up to date. A busterm in one of your folders shows as a game of its own, and Open Bus never writes to it.
- **Hide or remove a game from its details.** A game's details window now has Hide (for a game in one of your folders) or Remove (for the library's own copy), so a gamepad or TV remote can do it too.

## Fixed

- **busterm greyed out after removing and downloading it again**, saying its file wasn't found.
- **busterm missing from the X16 shelf after an update** until Open Bus was restarted.

releases.name: Open Bus 0.4.3
releases.body:
Open Bus 0.4.3 brings busterm 0.1.2 to the Commander X16's shelf, all of it.

## What's new

- **busterm 0.1.2, complete.** busterm now comes as more than one file: its program, and `BUSTERM.BNK`, the ZMODEM code it loads into the X16's banked RAM. Open Bus now downloads busterm's whole release, so everything it needs goes on its SD card. With 0.4.2, busterm 0.1.2 would run without ZMODEM.
- **What busterm 0.1.2 brings:** XMODEM and YMODEM uploads that start by themselves, like ZMODEM's; transfers shown in a window with a progress bar; and fixes for the directory on PETSCII calls.
- **Your busterm settings are kept.** Its dialling directory, settings and recent calls carry over. If you have busterm from 0.4.2, the first update replaces it with the new download.

On the desktop, Open Bus 0.4.2 offers this update itself when it starts. Then, the next time you start busterm, it offers busterm 0.1.2.

emulators.latest_body:
## First public release

A native Android port of the console version of **Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin** for the **Retroid Pocket 5** and the **Retroid Pocket Flip 2**, running from your own copy of the game.

- **Early.** Tested on the Flip 2 with version 1.5.2 and its DLC: the title screen and a new game from the opening into Mahana Village. It has not been played much further, so later areas may still show problems.

emulators.latest_body:
# 宝可梦传说 Z‑A 安卓移植 · Mali 零拷贝修复版（宿主 APK）

**这是一个“宿主”APK：只含移植运行时，不含任何游戏数据、NSO、资源或密钥。**
运行它需要你**自备自己游戏卡带/数字版的转储**，并用 [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android)
的 porter 生成数据包（步骤见仓库 README 的「怎么用」与「自备文件与公开性」）。

## 这版修了什么（Mali‑G925 上 3 FPS → 30 FPS）

- **根因**：MTK（MT6991）的 gralloc 给 `AHardwareBuffer` 的 native handle 有 3 个 fd，
  `fd[0]` 是 size 0 的只读元数据文件，`fd[1]` 才是 dma-buf（`st_size == 缓冲区大小`）。
  上游恒取 `fds[0]` 去 `mmap`，于是这台 Mali 上 771 MB 的 NVN 内存池**全部**退回
  “每提交整池双向 memcpy”，每帧约 375 ms——这正是帧时间的大头。
- **修法**：`ahb_buf_fd()` 按 `fstat().st_size == 池大小` 选出真正的 dma-buf fd；
  `pool_zero_copy()` 与 `vk_pool_remap_ro()` 都改用它。补丁全文：
  [`patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch`](https://github.com/Timqt/pokelegza-and/blob/main/patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch)
- **实测**（25079RPDCC，Dimensity 9400 级，Mali‑G925‑Immortalis MC12，Vulkan 1.3.278）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 零拷贝内存池 | 0 / 771 MB | **771.2 / 771.2 MB** |
| 菜单 FPS | 2–3 | **30**（游戏自身 present interval 上限） |
| 帧工作 p50 | 343 ms | **16.9 ms** |
| submit+present | 53–82 ms | 3–4.5 ms |

- 已能从语言选择一路进到开场列车场景（字幕 “Your train has arrived in Lumiose
  City!”）。当前瓶颈是 GPU 渲染（场景内约 20–25 ms，≈48 FPS 上限）。

## 使用

emulators.latest_body:
## The sushi bar scene, fixed for real, and shadows for the first time (v0.1.5 was a wrong diagnosis)

v0.1.5 did not fix the *Kappa Heaven* scene of the second day. The black shots were gone, but the plates and the conveyor belt that pass right in front of the camera were missing, and a dark line floated across the picture. The explanation in the v0.1.5 notes was wrong. Please update.

What was actually wrong is a bug in how the port translates this game's shaders. Its vertex shaders come in two halves, and when the port joined them it converted depth twice. That had three effects in every version that used the original depth format (v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3 and v0.1.4):

- The near clipping plane sat at half its distance, so geometry the console cuts away was drawn. In those sushi bar shots the camera is inside a wall, and the port drew that wall over the whole shot.
- The depth buffer was squeezed into half its range (0.5 to 1), so the depth of field compared its focus settings against wrong depths. This is where the blur problems of earlier versions came from.
- The shadow maps were stored with the same wrong depth, so no cast shadow ever showed.

releases.name: Catherine port v0.1.4
releases.body:
## Depth of field switch

The settings panel (swipe in from the right edge) has a new switch, **Depth of field**. It controls the game's own background blur in cutscenes and menus. Turn it off and everything is sharp, at once, without restarting. It is on by default, as in v0.1.3.

Why: in some close-ups of the *Golden Playhouse* cutscenes, the focus plane can still fall across a character. When they lean forward and back, part of the head moves in and out of the blur. While the port's focus settings for those cameras are being fixed, the switch lets you play without it.

- `<data>/sin_desenfoque` is the same switch as a file, read while the game runs.

## En español

El panel de ajustes (deslizando desde el borde derecho) trae un interruptor nuevo, **Desenfoque**. Controla el desenfoque de fondo del propio juego en cinemáticas y menús. Apagado, todo sale nítido, al momento y sin reiniciar. Viene encendido, como en la v0.1.3.

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body:
## Depth of field that matches the console

v0.1.2 fixed the blurred close-ups in the *Golden Playhouse* cutscenes but broke other shots: in over-the-shoulder shots the person speaking came out blurred while the wall behind stayed sharp. This version goes back to the original depth format and fixes the close-ups properly.

Each camera in a cutscene carries its own focus settings. For cameras placed very close (close-ups, the title screen and the piano menus), those settings only line up with the picture when they are read as if the camera's near plane were 25 units, so the port now converts them for those cameras. The result was compared shot by shot against footage of the console version: title screen, menus, the host's bar introduction and the café scene all match. Faces are in focus in close-ups, the background is soft, and the menus are sharp again.

- `<data>/sin_dof_cerca_25` turns the conversion off (live), and `<data>/profundidad_01` brings back the depth format of v0.1.2 (read at start-up), both for comparison.
- The first start after updating may translate some shaders again: expect a little stutter the first time each place is visited.

## En español

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body:
## Cutscenes and the title screen are sharp (the real fix)

Close-ups in the *Golden Playhouse* cutscenes (the ones with the black bars) could still come out blurred from edge to edge, faces included, and the title screen looked out of focus. v0.1.1 blamed a short block of shader constants; that was wrong: the depth-of-field pass never reads those bytes.

The real cause is the depth format. The game never tells the graphics API which depth range it uses, and the port assumed the OpenGL-style one, which stores depth squeezed into 0.5–1. The game's depth-of-field planes come straight from each cutscene's data and are written for a plain 0–1 depth, so a face in a close-up landed *behind* the focus plane and the whole frame got the maximum blur. When the game does not choose, the port now uses 0–1 depth, so close-ups keep the face sharp and blur only the background, as intended.

- Checked on the Flip 2: the title screen (same shot before/after: background, piano and characters go from blurred to sharp), the host's introduction, the opening credits, the opening nightmare cutscene and the first puzzle stage, at 30 fps.

emulators.latest_body:
First public source release of the Rhythm Heaven Android native port.

Assets
- `rhythm-heaven-android-release.apk` — the app. Contains no game data (placeholder launcher art).
- `rhythm-heaven-kit-0.1.0.zip` — PC-side kit: source snapshot + the APK + `package.ps1` / `install.ps1` + an agent `SKILL.md` that builds the data package from **your own** game dump and installs it.

Bring your own game files: unzip the kit, put `exefs/{main,sdk}` + `romfs.img` into `game-dump/`, then run the steps in `README.txt` (or `docs/PREPARE-GAME.md` in the source). No ROMs, RomFS data, keys, patched modules or translated shaders are distributed here.

What it is: the game's original Switch ARM64 modules run natively (rewritten locally), NVN is reimplemented on Vulkan, audio goes through AAudio, and the touch controls + liquid-glass launcher are rebuilt for Android. Requires Android 15/16 with a recent Adreno GPU (tested at 60 fps on a vivo phone and a Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro).

已知限制 / Known limits: only the tested v0 build is supported; screenshot/art placeholders can be replaced locally; module/shaders preparation needs a Windows PC with the Android SDK/NDK + .NET 10 for shader translation.

emulators.summary: Android launcher that keeps your ported games in one app, such as those made with nx2android: library, per-game settings, GPU drivers and saves.
emulators.latest_body:
Pagurin catches up with nx2android's main branch of 2026-11-17. Three new settings, an audio output picker in the game's pause menu, and Android's Performance Game Mode.

## What's new

- Three settings for each game. Under Input, Menu button shows or hides the on-screen menu button (Back still opens the menu), and Controllers either gives each controller its own player or makes them all player 1. Under Performance, GPU turbo holds the GPU at its highest clock, always or only while frames run late.
- The pause menu's Game tab has an Audio output row. It sends the game's sound to the output you pick, such as the device speaker or Bluetooth headphones, until the game ends.
- Pagurin declares Android's Performance Game Mode. With Pagurin set to Performance, a game keeps its own frame rate instead of stepping down to 40 or 30.
- A game added with the import tool while Pagurin is open now shows its new settings and size right away. In 0.2.1 you had to reopen Pagurin.
- The group headings in a game's settings (Graphics, Input, Performance and so on) are in the app's accent colour, so the groups stand apart.
- The README is reorganised, with a Quick start first.

## Before you update

releases.name: Pagurin 0.2.1
releases.body:
Pagurin catches up with nx2android's main branch of 2026-11-11: games can use local play over Wi-Fi, and a controller's face buttons can follow their labels.

## What's new

- **Local play over Wi-Fi.** Pagurin now has the network permissions a port's host asks for, so a game whose profile turns on local play (`DM_LAN`, such as Animal Crossing: New Horizons) can reach other players on the same Wi-Fi.
- **Face buttons setting.** A game's Input settings have a **Face buttons** row: **Position** (the Switch's layout, the default) or **Label** (A is the button marked A, as on an Xbox-style controller). It's the same setting as the pause menu's Face buttons row.
- **The import tool cleans up `sysdata/` too.** A port made with `--firmware` carries system data, and running the tool again now removes what an older port left there.

## Before you update

- The Face buttons row only shows for a port made from nx2android's main branch on 2026-11-09 or later. An older port doesn't read the setting, so the row stays hidden.

releases.name: Pagurin 0.2.0
releases.body:
GPU drivers now work the way nx2android's main branch takes them, and a game can be removed from the library.

## What's new

- **GPU drivers for nx2android's main branch.** Each game picks one of three:
  - **The game's own driver** (the default): the one its port was made with (`porter port --vulkan-driver`), or the system's if the port has none.
  - **The system driver**, even for a port that brought its own.
  - **A driver you added from a file.** Pagurin carries libadrenotools itself, so this also works for ports made without a driver.
- **Remove a game** from its settings tab. You choose whether to keep its save; a kept save is picked up again if you add the game back.
- **The import tool cleans up.** Running it again removes files an older port of the game left behind in `host/`, `mods/`, `RomFS/` and `aoc/`.
- The game page shows its button hints in the same order on every tab. LB and RB are on the tab bar.

## Before you update

- Choosing a driver needs a port made from nx2android's main branch on 2026-11-03 or later. An older port still runs, on the system's driver. Port it again to choose a driver.

releases.name: Pagurin 0.1.0
releases.body:
The first release. Pagurin keeps your Android ports of games from other platforms in one app, such as those made with [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android), instead of a separate app per game.

## What's in it

- A library of your ports, with search and sorting.
- Settings for each game: docked or handheld mode, the on-screen gamepad, rumble, the frame rate counter and the engine's performance switches. A game only shows the settings its own host reads.
- One game language for every game. A game that doesn't have it runs in English.
- GPU drivers, added from a file and picked per game.
- Save export, import and delete. Import also takes another app's save folder or a zip.
- Games added from a PC with the import tool, or moved over from ports already installed as their own apps (AYN devices, or Shizuku elsewhere).

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Pagurin-0.1.0.apk` | The app. Android 10 or later, arm64. |
| `pagurin-import.exe` | The import tool for Windows. On other systems, run `tools/pagurin_import.py` with Python 3.9 or later. |

**Pre-alpha:** expect bugs and crashes. This installs as an update over 20261114-2100; your settings and saves stay.

The headline: the slabs over Gerudo Town are gone, and motion at the frame rate limit is steadier, with and without frame generation.

- **Gerudo Town slabs fixed.** After a visit to the Depths, huge slabs of terrain could hang over Gerudo Town. The ground there is built from a map the game draws in parts; the undrawn parts now hold what the game expects instead of leftovers from other images.
- **Steadier 60 without frame generation.** Each picture now lands on the screen's refresh grid, so camera pans no longer mix pictures held for one and three refreshes. On our test device the uneven pictures in a fast pan dropped from 4-6% to under 0.1%, for a few milliseconds of extra input lag.
- **No seam at the screen edge with Homemade frame generation.** While panning, a vertical seam could show a short way in from the edge of generated pictures, where new scenery enters the view.
- **Frame pacing follows the screen.** The frame rate limit and frame generation now use the refresh rate the screen actually runs at, measured from the pictures themselves.

- **Gerudo Town slabs fixed.** After a visit to the Depths, huge slabs of terrain could hang over Gerudo Town. The ground there is built from a map the game draws in parts; the undrawn parts now hold what the game expects instead of leftovers from other images.
- **Steadier 60 without frame generation.** Each picture now lands on the screen's refresh grid, so camera pans no longer mix pictures held for one and three refreshes. On our test device the uneven pictures in a fast pan dropped from 4-6% to under 0.1%, for a few milliseconds of extra input lag.
- **No seam at the screen edge with Homemade frame generation.** While panning, a vertical seam could show a short way in from the edge of generated pictures, where new scenery enters the view.
- **Frame pacing follows the screen.** The frame rate limit and frame generation now use the refresh rate the screen actually runs at, measured from the pictures themselves.

**Pre-alpha:** expect bugs and crashes. This installs as an update over 20261111-1410; your settings and saves stay.

The headline: a calmer, softer picture when docked (TAA and Picture softness), a preview of picture settings right behind the in-game menu, smoother and sharper Homemade frame generation, and a much fuller performance overlay.

## What's new since 20261111-1410

- **TAA anti-aliasing (docked).** A new Anti-aliasing choice that blends several frames into each picture. Edges shimmer far less while you pan, and the picture looks a little softer. TAA softness sets how soft.
- **Picture softness (docked).** Sets how the game enlarges its picture to the screen: Original (the game's own sharp filter), Neutral, Soft or Softer. The softer choices calm edges that crawl as the camera moves.
- **Compare settings without leaving the menu.** Change Upscaler, Anti-aliasing or Picture softness in the in-game menu and the exact moment behind it is drawn again with the new setting, for a side-by-side comparison.

**Pre-alpha:** expect bugs and crashes. This installs as an update over 20261104-2350; your settings and saves stay.

## What's new since 20261104-2350

- **Smoother frame generation.** Generated pictures are now shown on time instead of being dropped when the game runs below its target, at 60 Hz and 120 Hz alike. Built-in and FSR 3.1 frame generation now know how moving characters move, so Link and others no longer show doubled outlines.
- **More upscaler choices.** Besides FSR 1: NIS, SGSR, CAS, Lanczos, bicubic, nearest, and the pixel-art scalers MMPX, Super-xBR and ScaleFX. The upscaler is now in the quick menu, and FSR 1's sharpening can be turned down or off.
- **Graphics closer to the Switch.** Several rendering differences are fixed, including grass lying flat away from Link.
- **Updated shared runtime.** The latest MacNativeGames changes are merged in. Your shader cache stays valid.

The [wiki](https://github.com/winterskycode/freudentranen/wiki) explains setup and how to report a bug.

This project was built with extensive AI assistance (Claude).

**Files:** the signed APK, the complete source as AGPL-3.0 requires, and a SHA-256 for each.

First public release. **Pre-alpha:** expect bugs and crashes.

Tears of the Kingdom running natively on Android, from your own copy of the game (version 1.4.3) and your own keys. The app checks your files and sets everything up on the device, so no PC is needed.

Install it with Obtainium using the badge in the [README](https://github.com/winterskycode/freudentranen#readme), or download the APK below. The README lists what you need and how to set up.

- **Tested most on:** AYN Odin 3 (Adreno 830). It also runs on the AYN Thor (Adreno 740) and Sony Xperia 1 VI (Adreno 750), with less testing. Other devices and GPUs are untested.
- **Files:** the signed APK, the complete source as AGPL-3.0 requires, and a SHA-256 for each.

emulators.latest_body:
## 1.0.3 社区发布

本版整合已测试的图形、声音和缓存优化，提供 Android ARM64 安装包与社区应用包。游戏数据由使用者自行准备，应用通过 ARM64 原生执行、HLE 服务桥接及 NVN → Vulkan 兼容层运行。

## 更新内容

- 请求低延迟音频输出，并处理设备拒绝请求时的回退。RG477M 同场景计入应用排队后的时间戳推算播放等待，旧模式约 215 毫秒，本版运行层两轮约 101、137 毫秒。
- 缓存原生模块的分配器导出位置，改进纹理描述符 ID 查找，缩小已证明写回范围的缓存维护。
- 失效描述符缓存的 CPU 元数据按每帧最多 512 项分批清理，清理安排在 GPU 提交和限帧等待之间。
- 保留可编辑虚拟手柄、掌机原生键位与游戏内存档功能。金手指功能计划后续加入。

## 机型与实测范围

- 全部设备采用底座模式，目标帧率为 30。高端高分辨率机型选择原生底座渲染档位，RG477M 使用 800×450 内部三维渲染档位。
- RG477M 的花叶位置测试了 2400 个真实移动帧间隔，实际显示约 29.20 帧，最长显示间隔约 99 毫秒。对照版本同点约 28.44 帧，最长约 116 毫秒。本版发布包的原生库与该次测量使用的原生库逐字节一致。
- 高通、天玑设备分档与厂商条件通过组件回归，包含荣耀 SM8635 / Adreno 735 配置。荣耀平板的本版安装与真实游戏回归等待用户重新连接 USB，其他机型需要逐机验证。
- 图形测试 94 项，93 项通过，1 项缺少私有输入而跳过。运行时 10 项、JNI 分档 4 项及 Java 机型分档合约通过。

## 已知限制

全场景稳定 30 帧尚未完成，复杂城镇、过图与长时间运行仍可能卡顿。对白口型及完整过场的物理音画同步仍待验证。正式发布版本号表示这一阶段的可下载构建，兼容范围以实测记录为准。

## 安装与校验

安装附件 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-arm64.apk`，或解压 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-community.zip` 获取应用、安装说明、版权说明及第三方许可证。准备同版本 v1.0.7 的 NSO、RomFS 与转换后的着色器，目录与权限操作见附件 `install-guide.zh-CN.md`。升级前请备份个人存档。

附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 与 `release-manifest.json` 提供完整性及来源记录。

## 交流群与资源说明

抖音搜索 ID `Cetto`（或搜索 `樱木`），进入主页加入交流群。群公告提供部署说明与资源配置指引。使用者应确保自行提供的数据具有相应使用权，并支持正版游戏。

## 版权与免责声明

releases.name: 1.0.2-preview · RG477M底座适配与帧时间优化
releases.body:
## 📌 版本概述

本版本为 `1.0.2-preview` 社区预览版，重点优化了掌机/手持设备的底座模式适配策略、图形渲染流水线及 CPU/GPU 调度效率。

> ⚠️ **重要声明**：本项目为非官方、非商业的技术兼容性研究程序，**不包含、不托管、亦不分发任何受版权保护的游戏资产、数据包或密钥（prod.keys）**。运行所需的游戏数据须由使用者自行从合法持有的原版游戏中提取。

---

## 🚀 本次更新

- **渲染调度与流水线优化**：优化间接绘制调度流程，精简不必要的 CPU 同步等待，保留精准的 GPU 资源生命周期检查，降低图形提交开销。
- **贴图解码与上传加速**：优化贴图解码上传缓冲机制，复用快路径以提升多线程块纹理解码效率。
- **掌机设备底座模式适配**：RG477M 默认启用原游戏底座模式与 800×450 内部 3D 渲染档位，内置多帧缓冲队列与原生显示时间戳支持，目标锁定 30 FPS。
- **操作与存档支持**：提供可编辑布局的虚拟手柄与物理手柄自动识别支持；游戏进度直接通过游戏原生存档系统保存。

---

## 📱 实测范围与已知限制

- **实测表现**：在 RG477M 上完成实测，常规与移动场景平均显示接近 30 FPS（约 29.8~29.9 FPS）。目前在场景初次加载、过图及部分复杂 3D 城镇场景中，偶发存在短暂掉帧与卡顿。
- **设备支持**：本版本已在 RG477M 上完成验证；荣耀平板及其他主流高通、天玑机型目前正在进行真机回归验证与适配。
- **已知限制**：当前属于预览测试阶段，尚未达到全场景稳定 30 FPS，相关性能与管线优化仍在持续推进中。

---

## 💬 资源数据包获取与交流群

- **数据包获取**：抖音搜索 ID：`Cetto`（或搜索：`樱木`），进入主页加入交流群。
- 群公告已置顶网盘一键下载链接（通用数据包 + 安装部署说明）。
- 欢迎在群内交流各机型实机运行反馈、按键映射体验与性能表现。

---

## 📦 安装与数据要求

1. 附件提供 ARM64 安装包（`.apk`）、完整社区包（`.zip`）及对应校验文件。
2. 运行必须配合 **《空之轨迹 the 1st》v1.0.7 原版游戏数据**（NSO 主程序、RomFS 及转换后的着色器需保持版本完全一致）。
3. 详细安装步骤与目录结构请参阅随包附件《安装说明》（`install-guide.zh-CN.md`）。

---

- 本项目为个人开发的非官方、非营利开源研究程序，用于社区技术交流与兼容性测试，与 Nihon Falcom、Nintendo 及云豹娱乐等权利人无任何官方合作或关联。

releases.name: 空轨 Android 原生兼容程序 1.0.1-preview
releases.body:
# 空轨原生兼容运行程序 1.0.1-preview

Android ARM64 社区流程验证版，包含兼容运行程序、项目自有界面资源、第三方许可与中文使用说明。游戏数据由使用者自行准备。

## 本版更新

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。
- Mali 默认使用原游戏 960×540 三维渲染档位，目标 30 帧。采用缓存读回和两项着色器等价整理，事件延迟发布和大缓冲写跟踪默认关闭。用户已确认这一配置天空无闪烁。
- 天玑 MT68/MT69 默认保留原游戏分配器空指针判断，避免地址位判断破坏分配器状态。
- 虚拟手柄参照同作者 FFRS 项目，支持显示切换、长按编辑、拖动布局、大小与透明度保存。保留原游戏存档。金手指计划后续加入。
- 桌面应用图标采用自有几何山形图案。版本号由本轮整理设为 1.0.1-preview，code 2。

## 实测与已知问题

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

当前复杂户外与城镇仍有明显掉帧，尚未达到稳定 30 帧。无闪烁配置的户外采样约 21～25 帧，复杂城镇约 10～20 帧，首次加载和过图仍可能停顿。曾接近 30 帧的事件延迟实验会出现天空条纹，因此发布配置关闭该实验。完整游戏流程与长时间稳定性仍待验证。

其他天玑机型仍待逐机实测。荣耀平板沿用原有设备分支，本轮按用户要求暂停荣耀真机回归。

## 下载和安装

直接安装 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-arm64.apk`。社区转发可使用 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-community.zip`，其中包含 APK、安装说明、版权与免责说明、完整第三方许可和构建清单。使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验下载内容。

应用包名 `org.snk.the1st.gamewindow`，arm64-v8a，当前为预览调试签名包。覆盖安装前请备份自己的原游戏存档，签名不匹配时先核实旧包来源。

使用者自行准备合法取得并完整合并的 v1.0.7 数据，目录内应包含四个 NSO、RomFS 与配套转换着色器。具体目录与按键操作见随包《安装与使用》。

## 版权与免责说明

# STORM 3DS 1.9.0 (`versionCode = 10900`)

Обновление **1.9.0** полностью перерабатывает раскладку наэкранных стиков и кнопок по умолчанию на Android, обновляет диалоги обновлений на Android и Windows x64, расширяет меню паузы и наводит порядок в настройках и темах оформления.

## Эргономичная раскладка стиков и кнопок по умолчанию (Android)

- **Полный набор New 3DS из коробки**: во всех встроенных макетах (портрет, ландшафт, `Uneven`, `Proportional`, `Fullscreen`, складные экраны) теперь по умолчанию присутствуют `Circle Pad`, `D-Pad`, `A/B/X/Y`, `C-Stick`, триггеры `L/ZL` и `R/ZR`, системные `Select / Home / Start`, быстрые кнопки (`Пауза`, `Перемотка`, `Смена экранов`, скрытие доп. кнопок) и раскрываемая панель утилит (`Быстрое сохранение/загрузка`, `Микрофон`, `Крышка`, `Клавиатура`).
- **Портретный режим без перекрытий**: резервируется безопасная нижняя зона управления с отступами от краев и системной панели навигации (`navigationBars` + `mandatorySystemGestures`), чтобы кнопки и `Circle Pad` больше не перекрывали нижний экран и не сталкивались `D-Pad` с `Select`/`Start` даже на экранах шириной `360dp`.

releases.name: STORM 3DS 1.8.0
releases.body:
# STORM 3DS 1.8.0 (`versionCode = 10800`)

Обновление **1.8.0** исправляет запуск бандлов `.bcxi` и стабильность рендерера на одноэкранных смартфонах, переносит весь блок **P0 + P1** улучшений из **Azahar 2127.0** и добавляет инструменты обслуживания игр в библиотеке ROM.

## Исправление запуска `.bcxi` и стабильности рендерера

- **Защита вторичной поверхности (`HasValidSecondarySurface`)**: в `RendererVulkan` и `RendererOpenGL` добавлена строгая проверка `secondary_window` и `render_surface != nullptr` перед созданием/переключением swapchain и ожиданием `WaitPresent()`. Устраняет падение `Presentation not supported on this platform` (`vk_platform.cpp:201`) на смартфонах без физического второго дисплея при запуске `.bcxi` и других игр.
- **Корректная работа `TarIOFile` и `AutoOpenNCCHNCSD`**: в `TarIOFile::OpenCopy()` сохраняется признак `IOType::Type::TarIOFile` (`IsFileBundle()`), а распаковка вложенных образов в `AutoOpenNCCHNCSD` выполнена итеративно, что обеспечивает стабильную загрузку `.bcxi`/`.bcci` и встроенных в них `.zcxi`/`.cxi`/`.zcia`.

releases.body:
# STORM 3DS 1.6.0 (`versionCode = 10600`)

Обновление **1.6.0** добавляет официальную сборку **STORM 3DS для Windows x64** с проработанным интерфейсом и корректным HiDPI-масштабированием на экранах с любым DPI, а также выравнивает распознавание `.bcxi` и `.z3ds` в настольной библиотеке игр.

## Что нового в 1.6.0

- **Поддержка `.bcxi` и `.z3ds` в настольной библиотеке Qt (`game_list.cpp`, `loader.cpp`, `ncch_container.cpp`, `citra_qt.cpp`)**:

releases.name: STORM 3DS 1.5.0
releases.body:
# STORM 3DS 1.5.0 (`versionCode = 10500`)

Обновление 1.5.0 полностью устраняет проблемы с внутриприложенческим обновлением, перерабатывает фирменный режим 3D-глубины без разделения на два экрана и без двойного размытия, добавляет глубокую оптимизацию компилятора, Vulkan/OpenGL и планирования потоков ЦП, а также исправляет ряд функциональных и интерфейсных ошибок.

## Что нового и исправлено в 1.5.0

- **Чёткий одноэкранный режим 3D-глубины (`GyroParallax`) без разделения экрана и размытия**:
  - **Новый 2-проходный шейдер параллакса (`vulkan_present_gyro.frag`, `opengl_present_gyro.frag`)**: полностью удалено смешивание левого и правого кадра `mix(left_col, right_col, eye_mix)`, вызывавшее постоянное двоение и мыло; вместо этого вычисляется карта глубины из реальной стерео-диспарности левого/правого глаза и перцептивной перспективы с 5-точечным сглаживанием глубины, а итоговый пиксель берётся из одного чёткого кадра с деликатным объёмным освещением окна глубины.

- **Perbaikan Kritis pada Rilis Ini (`v0.8.0-android.12`)**:
  - **Perbaikan Softlock / Stuck Cutscene & Dialog Bahasa Indonesia (`native/lang_id.cpp`)**:
    - Mempertahankan penuh **2-byte opcode `0xF0 <arg>`** (mode tunggu tombol `0x00` vs timer cutscene otomatis `0x0C–0xF0`) pada seluruh 119 file `.rdt`, 3 `.ldt`, tabel XBE (`sys_msgs`, `item_descs`, `choices`), serta *custom overrides* (`custom_id.tsv`) dan pesan yang tidak diterjemahkan.
    - Sebelumnya pemotongan byte `<arg>` menyebabkan VM teks membaca byte pertama pesan berikutnya (`0xF4` / `0xFA`) sebagai timer `8.13` detik non-skippable hingga memicu *softlock* (mis. di `ROOM007.RDT`).

emulators.latest_body:
# Heaven Dust no Android — v0.1 (experimental)

Primeira release do port. Launcher v9 (versionCode 10, jogo 1.0.2).

## O que já funciona (testado no Galaxy S23)

- O jogo abre e roda com a tradução PT-BR 1.1 aplicada e confirmada dentro do jogo
- Porter 8/8: 2.924 / 2.924 shaders traduzidos para Vulkan
- Launcher próprio: importação do data pack, escolha de driver de GPU (incl. Turnip), 3 modos de tela (Fit / Stretch / Crop) no launcher e no menu de pausa, música tema com botão mudo

## O que ainda NÃO foi provado

- Jogar do início ao fim — até agora só a abertura e a tradução foram confirmadas no aparelho
- Números de desempenho / FPS, e se o Turnip realmente fica carregado dentro do jogo

## Importante

- O APK sozinho NÃO é o jogo. Você precisa gerar os seus próprios dados com o porter do nx2android, a partir do seu próprio dump (NSP) e das suas próprias chaves — nunca baixe nem compartilhe RomFS, NSP, shaders ou chaves de terceiros.
- Copie os dados soltos para `Android/data/org.nx2a.t010059100d928000/files/`. Se desinstalar o app, o Android apaga essa pasta inteira (dados e saves).
- Esta release NÃO contém arquivos do jogo, chaves, data pack nem shaders.

releases.name: Winlator Test 10
releases.body:
**Experimental mod only for testing!**

Main feature of this mod is ability to use **box32**. 
If **WoW64** mode is enabled, WoW64 Wine is used (default).
If **WoW64** mode is disabled, the regular bi-arch Wine is used with the **box32** feature. For now, some x86 OpenGL games work in **box32** mode with higher performance than in WoW64 mode.

Other features:
- Built-in custom **frame generation** (_Screen effects -> Frame generation_).
- Support of **Russian** input (Unicode) from the on-screen keyboard.
- **Freedreno** OpenGL driver, **LLVMPipe** driver.
- Optional **Lorie X-server**.
- **Old VirGL** test server with better compatibility.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**
- Added **vkBasalt** sharpness effects for shortcuts (from Winlator Bionic).
- Upgraded **Frame generation**: improved _motion estimation_, added _FPS multiplier_ (x2, x3, x4), added _Motion scale_, _Blending_ and _Post-processing_ adjustments, added _Engine_ options (DIS, QCOM, GLES).
1. _QCOM_ frame generation engine uses more fast and accurate hardware _GL_QCOM_motion_estimation_ (modern Adreno only).

emulators.latest_body:
**Experimental mod only for testing!**

Main feature of this mod is ability to use **box32**. 
If **WoW64** mode is enabled, WoW64 Wine is used (default).
If **WoW64** mode is disabled, the regular bi-arch Wine is used with the **box32** feature. For now, some x86 OpenGL games work in **box32** mode with higher performance than in WoW64 mode.

Other features:
- Built-in custom **frame generation** (_Screen effects -> Frame generation_).
- Support of **Russian** input (Unicode) from the on-screen keyboard.
- **Freedreno** OpenGL driver, **LLVMPipe** driver.
- Optional **Lorie X-server**.
- **Old VirGL** test server with better compatibility.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**
- Added **vkBasalt** sharpness effects for shortcuts (from Winlator Bionic).
- Upgraded **Frame generation**: improved _motion estimation_, added _FPS multiplier_ (x2, x3, x4), added _Motion scale_, _Blending_ and _Post-processing_ adjustments, added _Engine_ options (DIS, QCOM, GLES).
1. _QCOM_ frame generation engine uses more fast and accurate hardware _GL_QCOM_motion_estimation_ (modern Adreno only).

releases.name: Linuxhub1.2.01天玑专版
releases.body:
天玑 / MediaTek X11 专版 · 合成器测试版

本版基于 1.2.0 天玑 X11 分支，**唯一改动是打开 KWin 合成器**，用于真机验证桌面特效（窗口晃动、魔灯等）能否真正生效。

#### 本版改了什么

此前每次启动桌面会话时，脚本都会把 `kwinrc` 强制改写为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=false
Backend=QPainter
```

这正是「在系统设置里勾了窗口晃动 / 魔灯，晃了半天毫无反应」的直接原因——**合成器关着，KWin 会静默忽略全部桌面特效**。

本版改为：

```ini
[Compositing]
Enabled=true
Backend=OpenGL
GLCore=false
LatencyPolicy=Low
WindowsBlockCompositing=false
```

后端固定为 **OpenGL（硬件）**，不使用纯软件 QPainter 后端；LLVM 软件渲染（llvmpipe / swrast）在部署时仍会被删除。

#### ⚠️ 这是未经验证的测试版，请只用于测试

发布者手上没有天玑真机，**本版没有在任何天玑设备上跑过**。请把预期放低。

已知的关键疑点（在我的机器上实测发现，属于**设备无关**的问题）：

1. **guest rootfs 内缺少 `virpipe_dri.so`**。逐个列出 rootfs 中全部 Mesa DRI 驱动后确认：有 `virtio_gpu_dri.so`、`zink_dri.so`、`panfrost_dri.so`、`mediatek_dri.so`，**但没有 `virpipe_dri.so`**——而这正是 VirGL 的 guest 端驱动。会话脚本仍在强制 `GALLIUM_DRIVER=virpipe` + `VTEST_SOCKET=/tmp/.virgl_test`，即**指向一个不存在的驱动**。若真机因此拿不到 GL 上下文，合成器就起不来。
2. **相反方向的证据**：发布者在高通测试机上开启 OpenGL 合成后桌面全黑，日志为 `MESA: error: ZINK: vkGetCalibratedTimestampsEXT failed (VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY)`。但那条日志同时说明 **KWin 当时确实拿到了 GL 上下文**（走的是 Zink）。这与第 1 点互相矛盾，怀疑 KWin 走 EGL 入口、Qt 走 GLX 入口，两者对 `GALLIUM_DRIVER` 的处理不同。

结论：**？能否运行是个好问题🤔**——这正是本次发版要收集的信息。

#### 需要附上的日志

```bash

releases.name: v2.2.0
releases.body:
## New since v2.1.6 (last stable)

- **Steam ISO manual export** — Steam ISO files (`<Game Name>.iso` to `Downloads/front end/`) are no longer written automatically on every game list load. They are now written on demand via the **FileDownload** (↓) button in the My Games top bar, preventing unnecessary writes and duplicate file churn.
- **ISO duplicate skip** — ISO export now checks if the file already exists in `Downloads/front end/` before writing; skips silently if it does, preventing duplicate entries.
- **Game name sanitization** — Game names are sanitized before being used in MediaStore queries and ISO file creation (colons and other illegal filename characters are replaced), fixing a crash/failure when Steam game names contain colons or other special characters.

---

## Full Feature Set

**Core**
- No root required — uses Android's Storage Access Framework (SAF) for secure folder access.
- Single data/ grant — one SAF permission at `<package>/data` covers components, virtual containers, and shadercache simultaneously.
- Multi-app support — automatically detects all installed GameHub variants side by side.

releases.name: v2.1.9-pre
releases.body:
Move Steam ISO export from automatic (every load) to a manual button.

The download arrow (⬇) button appears in the My Games top bar when an app is selected and Steam games are loaded. Tapping it writes/updates the ISOs for all Steam games on demand.

Navigation is now instant — no more SteamRepository.fetch() + MediaStore operations firing silently on every tab visit.

releases.name: v2.1.8-pre
releases.body:
Fix Counter-Strike: Source (and any game with : in the name) creating a new ISO every launch.

**Root cause:** Steam game names with colons (e.g. `Counter-Strike: Source`) get stored in MediaStore with the colon replaced by `_`. The existence check queried with the original name (colon), found nothing, and inserted again — MediaStore then auto-renamed the new file to `Counter-Strike_ Source (1).iso`, `(2).iso`, etc.

**Fix:** Sanitize filename chars `[/\\:*?"<>|]` → `_` before any MediaStore query or insert, so both sides always agree on the name.

releases.name: v2.1.7-pre
releases.body:
Fix duplicate ISO files in Downloads/front end/ on every app launch.

**Root cause:** The old code called MediaStore delete() then insert() each launch. On Android, delete() removes the catalog entry but not the physical file — so insert() would see the file already on disk and auto-rename it to `Counter-Strike_ Source (1).iso`, `(2).iso`, etc.

**Fix:** Query first. If the ISO already exists, skip writing it entirely. No duplicates.
